mdor na rnal 'byor dbang phyug de nyid la thim pa'o/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyid yin yang rung ste/ re zhig gling 'dir brtul shugs kyi spyod pa 'phro bshol te bzhugs pa yin la/ phyis bhi ma sa ra'i dbang phyug gi ling kha zhig la bsdud pa la lan cig dang / glang po che smyon pa 'dul ba la rnal 'byor pa se rol zhes pa gcig byung ste/ de yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'di nyid yin nam zhes grags pas lan gnyis byon pa yin no/ /de dag ni swa wa na tha'i skor cung zad tsam mo/ /gzhan yang 'di'i rnam thar bsdus te tshigs bcad du brjod na/ mkhan por gsol dang mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs/ /ngan par khas slang gaṅgās lam yang byin/ /rgyal po btul dang gaṅgā gyen la ldog /myos byed gsol phyir nyi ma gteng par bzung / /ling ga gas dang dbang phyug lag nas 'khrid/ /tsaṇ+ḍi btul dang sgrol mas zhal 'gyur dang / /rtogs pa phul dang gdong drug btul ba sogs/ /lo rgyus gzhung dang bla ma'i zhal shes bya/ /zhes so/ /rje 'brog mi'i gsung rgyun las ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge dha zhes sdom brtson 'gyur/ /lho yi phyogs su rnam par grags/ /sdom brtson de bzhin sngags kyang 'grub/ /ces pa 'di rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'di'i lung bstan yin par mdzad de/ 'di'i mtshan dharma pa la yin pas/ ming thog bstan pa dang gaṅgā gyen ldog gnyis pa nas tsaṇ+ḍi ka btul ba yan chad lho phyogs yin pas/ lho phyogs su rnam par grags pa ches cher che ba dang / sdom brtson gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa dang / rdo rje bdag med mas byin gyis brlabs nas gsang sngags kyi mchog grub pa sogs thams cad ji lta ba bzhin 'grig cing / yongs su grags pa la dpal ldan chos grags kyi lung bstan du sbyor ba la ni thams cad tshang ba'i nges pa cung dka' ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ de las gsung ngag rin po che'i bka' drin thob pa'i slob ma ni gnyis las/

nag po pa nyid gtso bo yin zhing / de nyid las gtso bor 'phel te/ de yang gaṅgā gyen ldog gnyis pa'i dus kyi ko mkhan rjes su 'brangs pa ni ḍom+bhi he ru ka ste/ de nyid skal ldan gcig car ba yin pas de'i lam gyi sgo nas dkri zhing / lam gyi cha shas tsam gyis bdag nyid dang rtogs pa mnyam par gyur nas/ shar phyogs kyi yul sna tshogs sbyangs ldan/ pho brang ki ka na'i rgyal po 'dul du btang bas/ sbrul gyi srab thur byas nas stag mi zan la chibs/ phyag tu sbrul thogs nas rgyal po btul ba sogs mdzad la/ 'di las 'phel ba rtsa ba med pa cung zad cig yod do/ /deng sang brgyud pa'i phyogs 'di pa ba 'grel pa lugs su bzhed pa'o/ /nag po pa ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rjes su 'brangs pa na/ sngar bstan la ma zhugs shing 'jug 'dod yod pa/ btul te rdo rje'i tshig rkang brjed thor gnang nas/ skal dman rim 'jug pa'i de'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pas rdo rje'i tshig rkang gnang / de'i dngos bstan gyi rim pa dkris pa yin la de nyid la brten nas gsung ngag rin po che 'di rgyun mar 'phel ba yin te/ de yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ grub chen shar phyogs nag po pa la yul dbus kyi rgyal po seṅge rnam par rol pa'am/ rlung las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba la rdo rje'i tshig rkang byin la thul/ de yid ches pa'i rgyab rten du nub phyogs u rgyan dharmā ga tsa ste chos kyi pho brang na rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa'i nang nas lung skor sde lnga zhes bya ba yid ches pa'i lung yod pas de spyan drongs zhes lung bstan nas dper na grub chen lū hi pas dha ri ka pa la dpal mngon par rtogs pa gnang nas de'i rgyab brten du/ u rgyan nas mkha' 'gro ma kun spyod kyi rgyud spyan drangs zhes lung bstan nas de bzhin mdzad pa dang 'dra'o/ lung skor sde lnga zhes pa 'di sa lugs la ni bgros gsal bar med/

zha lugs na yang dang yang du 'byung bas khong pa la lung sde lnga 'di yin gyi gtad so tsam zhig ni nam yang yod pa yin nam gsungs/ gang ltar yang de lta bu'i nag po pa de nyid lho phyogs nas 'ongs kyang yul rgya gar shar phyogs pa yin pas shar phyogs nag po pa zhes bya la/ snyan shal ring bas sam/ yul gyi bye brag kar+ṇa zhes pa la brten nas nag po kar+ṇa pa zhes kyang bya ste 'di la mgon po mngon 'byung gi rgyud ltar na/ ka ha na pa zhes pa gcig nges par thob gsungs/ de lta bu'i nag po pas rgyal po btsun mo bdun cu rtsa gnyis la chags pa zhig kyang btul te/ dang por btsun mo'i dbus su byon/ btsun mo rnams kyis rgyal po la rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas/ chad pas chod cig gsungs pa la/ rgyal po'i dmag phyir phyin rtsa na slob dpon nang du 'ong / nang du phyin rtsa na slob dpon phyir 'ong / phyi nang gnyis ka dmag gis bkang bas/ slob dpon gyis sprul pa'i dmag je mang du btang ste mthar brgya rtsa brgyad du spel bas/ rgyal pos grub pa thob par shes te zhabs la gtugs pa sogs so/ /des na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis ḍā ma ru pa lung bstan pa bzhin du/ nag po pas a wa dhu ti pa/ ḍā ma ru pas ga ya dha ra/ a wa dhu ti pas 'brog ma'i bar du lung bstan nas/ gsung ngag rin po che ni gang zag de dag la snyan nas snyan du brgyud de gab pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pas/ 'phags pa'i yul du de tsam gyi snyan grags che ba dang / 'phel rgyas ches cher spel ba ni ma mdzad de mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thu le ba'i gdams ngag bka' mdo rgyud thams cad kyi bcud phyung ba snying po'i snying po zab mo 'di ni/ snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa dang / gcig nas gcig tu 'ongs te snod ldan kho na'i spyod yul yin pas so/ /de lta mod kyi 'phags yul ba gzhan dag la yang bgros gtan med pa ni ma yin te/ grub chen dpa' bo 'od gsal dang /

thub pa byin la sogs pas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lam gyi srol ni 'di lta bu'o zhes ngos bzung ba tsam yod/ de dag ni 'phags pa'i yul du ji ltar spel ba'i lo rgyus te/ brgyud pa gzhan de dag la ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi cha shas rang gzhan gyi yig cha rnams su 'di dang 'di zhes mang po bris pa ni med/ 'on kyang 'dir ma 'khod pa ni mang po zhig rje bla ma gsungs te/ dper na ḍā ma ru pas stag mi zan dang / mu stegs kyi rgyal po cig phrag la bkal nas mu stegs kyi rgyal po 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa rdo rje theg pa la bkod pa sogs so/ /de nas bod kha ba can du dus gang tsam nas dar ba yin snyam na/ 'di la thog mar chos spyi dar ba'i tshul cung zad tsam brjod na/ de yang dang po bod 'di mtsho chen po gcig tu yod pa las ring zhig nas chu phal cher skam ste/ sa gzhi ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs pa rnams rim gyis chags shing / de la yang lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams ri mtho ste gangs la g.ya' ris bskor ba/ sa gtsang ste zil rdzab dang 'bu sbrang la sogs pa dben pa'i stod mnga' ris skor gsum seṅge khyung la sogs pas 'dzin/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi 'brong dang sha rkyang sogs kyis 'dzin/ smad mdo khams sgang gsum glang po che dang stag gzigs dom dred spre'u la sogs pa dud 'gro'i tshogs dang / gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad dang / ma sang yin zer ba'i mi min 'dre min rnams kyis gang zhing de thams cad kyang phan tshun gcig gis gcig la gnod par byed pas shi tshad ngan song du lhung nas sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong dgos pa las/ skabs cig gi tshe spyan ras gzigs kyis spre'u'i rgyal po ha nu man+dha la khyod gangs can du song la sems can rnams la byams snying rje sgom zhig gsungs pas/ ha nu man+dhas thugs rje chen po'i gsung ltar du g.yor po'i brag la sgom byas pa la sogs pa byung zhing /

bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsung las/ dang po bod 'di mtha' 'khob yin sngon khrims gnyis ka med de zas su ri dwags kyi sha bza' zhing / pags pa gos su gyon/ dge sdig blang dor gyi rnam gzhag gang yang mi shes par rang dga' sil bur gnas nas yun ring por chos kyi ming tsam yang ma byung zhes pa tsam las mi 'byung la/ 'o na bod kyi mi byin po 'di rnams gang las 'phel ba yin zhe na/ 'di la yang ma ṇi bka' 'bum la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kha cig tu/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa spre'u rdzu 'phrul thob pa gcig dang / ma brag srin ma gnyis 'grogs pa las sprel phrug mang po byung zhing / de rnams kyang pha 'dra ba las/ spu dang mjug ma med cing sems cung dul ba zhig byung la/ ma 'dra ba las gdong dmar zhing dug lnga rags pa rnams byung bas de nas rim gyis 'phel te mi'u rigs bzhi la sogs pa byung ste/ de yang se dang / dmu dang / ldong dang / stong bya ba'i rigs bzhi dang / yang 'bra dang / 'bru dang / spra dang / stong dang / lhong dang / mi nyag ste bod mi'u gdong drug ces kyang zer bas de rnams las 'phel ba'i bshad tshul cig dang / lha las phul byung bar bstod pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon shes rab go chas mdzad pa dang / der gsungs pa'i don dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo mtshar snang bar/ skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo brgya pa'i dus/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du ma byon pa'i gong gi lo nyis stong lhag tsam gyi dus su yul dbus kyi dgra ngan gyi bu lnga brgya'i gcen thabs dka' zhes bya ba byung ba'i dus su rtsod dus kyi mgo brtsams pa yin pas/ de'i tshul ni sngon rgya gar nas khyab 'jug dang / 'thab dka' gnyis 'gras te/ khyab 'jug gis skyabs seng gi phyogs byas nas g.yul bsham pa na/ srid bsgrub kyis kho bos nye du'i tshogs gsod mi nus kyis zhes smras pa dang / khyab 'jug gis med lta'i tshig dang /

gzugs sna tshogs bstan pas bslus nas/ srid bsgrub kyi kha lo khyab 'jug gis byas te g.yul bkye bas/ 'thab dka' rigs ngan dpung tshogs bco brgyad po brlag par byas pa'i tshe/ rū pi ka zhes bya ba'i rgyal po dpung tshogs dang bcas pa bu med kyi chas su byas te bros nas ri kha ba can du gnas pa'i rigs las bod kyi mi rnams 'phel ba yin zhes gsungs shing / sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis po/ /skyabs seng bu yis bcom zhes thos/ /zhes dang / lo rgyus kha cig tu/ 'thab dka'i 'gran zla skyabs seng bu lnga brgya'i gcen g.yul ngor bstan pa zhes bya ba'i bcos mkhan zhig byung bar bshad la/ gang ltar yang de dus kyi rū pi ka'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams las bod kyi mi byin 'phel ba'i bshad tshul gnyis tsam byung na yang / dang po ni mkhas pa so so'i bshad lugs tsam ni yin mod/ 'dir rang re sa skya par khas che ba rnams kyis lugs phyi ma nyid bzung bar byed dgos la/ gal te bod kyi 'phel tshul de ltar du bshad pas chog kyang / da 'o na bod kyi rgyal po rnams rigs gang las 'chad cing rgyal po'i thog ma de dus ji tsam nas byung ba yin zhe na/ de yang thog ma ni gnya' khri btsan po zhes bya ba de yin kyang / rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs dang / bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba gnyis su gnya' khri btsan po'i lo rgyus mi 'byung zhing / rje btsun gyi rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭik+ka'i mgo'i lo rgyus kyi dpe zhig na gnya' khri btsan po nas rgyal rab nyer drug gi bar du dam pa'i chos ma byung / nyer bdun pa lha tho tho ri snyan zhal gyi ring la dam pa'i chos dbu brnyes zhes gsungs la/ bla ma dam pas mdzad zer ba'i deng sang rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long du grags pa na/ rgyal rab bka' skol mar/ gnya' 'khri btsan po ni shākya ri brag pa'i rgyud pa/ rgyal po skyabs seng dang /

dmag brgya pa gnyis lhan cig tu skyes nas rgyal srid la ma 'cham par/ dmag brgya pa'i bu chung shos mtshan dang ldan pa zhig gi rgyal srid ma thob par bod du spyugs pa las zhes bya ba la sogs pa bshad do/ /mdor na gnya' khri btsan po de sangs rgyas dang dgung mnyam gyi rgyal po 'char byed ces bya ba zhig byung ba de yin par byas 'dug cing / deng sang gsal ba'i me long du grags pa'i mtshan cig la gnya' khri btsan po bod du sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong na byung bar byas pa yang 'dug la/ kun mkhyen bus/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi brgyud tshigs lnga tshigs sam/ gzugs can snying po'i lnga tshigs sam/ 'char byed kyi bu'i lnga tshigs la sogs pa'i the tshom can du bshad pa rnams byung ba las/ 'dir re zhig rang lugs su khas len rgyu/ bod kyi rgyal po'i thog mar gnya' khri btsan po zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das dang dgung zla mnyam pa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyi bu tshigs lnga pa yin zhing / de'i lo rgyus cung zad cig brjod na/ yang gong gi lha las phul du byung ba'i 'grel par/ bod byin 'phel bar gsungs pa'i 'phros la/ mkhas pa rnams kyi bod kyi rgyal po ni/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po 'char byed kyi ces pa'i tshigs lnga pa'i bu/ mig gzi mas kheb la/ sor mo rnams dra bas 'brel zhing mtshan dang ldan pa zhig byung ba de mi dpyad mkhan la bstan pas/ yab rgyal po la gnod dogs 'dug pas 'di yul gzhan du spyugs zer ba la/ yab rgyal po na re/ bod na grags ngan gyi dpung zhig kyang bros nas yod pa rnams la 'bangs dpon med pas/ de rnams kyi rje bor bskyal lo zer nas/ bud med yin par byas nor skal mang po dang / nu ma bsnun pa'i ma ma/ 'khor yon tan shes pa bcu gnyis/ dmag brgya dang bcas te brdzangs nas/ bod rnams la 'di la rje bo gyis zer ba'i 'phrin btang zhing / des dbus kyi lha rir bzhugs te/

bod kyi mi chen dgu dang / rus chen bco brgyad kyis che dgu ring dgu byas gros byas nas bod mgo nag gi rje bor mnga' gsol/ mi'i gnya' bar khri byas nas 'khur bas gnya' khri btsan po zhes pa'i ming btags te/ 'di ni lha dbang po brgya byin gyi sprul pa yin zhes gsungs pas de ltar du yin la/ yang lo rgyus kha cig na gzhan 'dra ba la/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi btsun mo snang chen mngal dang ldan par gyur te/ mtshan mkhan la bstan pas/ gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i khye'u gcig btsas te/ des yang na rgyal po'i mnga' ris rlog par byed/ yang na rgyal po thams cad 'dis zil gyis gnon pa byed zer zhing / lo 'khor ba na khye'u mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ lus rags shing sna rgyud bzang ba/ rna ba'i shal dpung pa na sleb cing / mig mig mas kheb pa/ sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba zhig btsas pas/ yab na re phyis legs par brtag gi dmangs ri khrod pa rnams la gso ru chug gsungs nas/ de ltar byas pas cher skyes te zan la sogs pa snyigs ma'i 'tsho ba mi bza' zhing / nags na gnas pa'i srog chags rnams kyi sdum sgog dang / me tog gi 'bras bu 'dren cing / rtsed grogs byed la/ tshad pa dang / char pa sogs byung ba'i tshe ljon shing rnams yal kha 'dud cing skyobs par byed pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang ldan zhing / ri khrod pa rnams kyang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs nas mod par gyur nas yod pa la/ khye'u des rang lo bcu drug lon pa'i tshe ri khrod pa rnams la nga su'i bu yin zhes smras pa dang / de rnams kyis kyang lo rgyus zhib tu bsnyad pas/ yab la thugs chad de nags kyi bar zhig na yar 'dzegs nas gangs kyi mgul g.ya' ri mthon pa zhig gi rtse mor phyin pa dang / phyogs thams cad du gzigs pas/ gangs can gyi yul dbus gangs yar lha sham bu dang nye ba'i ri spo mtho gzigs nas de'i steng du byon pa dang /

sa sros pa na sku la 'od yod pas lha'i skas them dgu la babs nas byon pa'i 'od de btsan thang sgo bzhi'i bar phreng pa rnams kyis mthong zhing / sang snga mo na stong lha bon po la sogs pa yul gyi mi drag shos bcu gnyis kyis lha gsol du phyin pas/ de na yod pa'i rdzi bo rnams na re/ khyed la lha mnyes par 'dug gi mdang spa spo mtho'i rtse mo nas 'od chen po cig babs song zer/ der gsol du song pa dang / mi ya mtshan can gcig lha chab la khrus byed kyin 'dug pa dang / khyod su yin byas pas btsan po zer/ gang nas 'ong byas pas gnam la mdzub mo bstan byung pa dang / lha dngos su byon par 'dug pas 'di phud du 'khur zhes gros 'cham ste sngar bzhin du byas pas bod kyi rgyal po thog mar byung ba'i bshad tshul gcig dang / yang lo rgyus kha cig tu/ rgyal po skyabs seng gi bu lnga'i bar pa mig bya ltar mas 'geb pa/ g.yu'i smin ma can/ sen mo bya bzhin du 'brel ba/ dung so 'khor mar yod pa cig skyes pas/ rgyal po na re/ 'di lta bu ltas ngan yin pas gsod gsungs pa la/ blon po rnams kyi mtshon gyis gsod ma nus par zangs kyi sgrom bu'i nang du bcug ste gzer gyis bsdams nas chu bo gaṅgā la bskyur ba de yangs pa can na yod pa'i rgad po rnams kyis brnyed nas gangs can gyi khrod du bskyal ba sogs kyi bshad tshul gsum tsam 'byung ba las/ 'dir dang po nyid gtso bor byas nas bshad par bya ba yin pas/ de yang gong du bshad pa ltar gyi rgyal po 'char byed kyi brgyud tshigs lnga pa gnya' khri btsan po zhes bya ba bod du byon nas des rgyal po mdzad pa ni thog ma yin la/ de nas bzung ste srib khri btsan po man la gnam gyi khri bdun zer zhing / de'i sras gri gum btsan po/ de'i sras gsum gyi bya khri la spu lde gung rgyal zhes pa'i ming btags te yab sras 'di gnyis la stod kyi steng gnyis zer ba gsal ba'i me long la sogs pa'i lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu 'byung yang /

/de yang gri gum btsan po yan la gnam gyi khri bdun dang / spu lde gung rgyal la lder gcig tu mdzad cing / de'i sras khri btsan/ de'i sras khri dgra dpung btsan/ de'i sras khri thob btsan te de gsum la smad kyi btsan zhes bshad pa kha cig tu 'byung / yang rje btsun gyis/ khri dgra dpung btsan gyi sras khri rje dang / de'i sras khri thog btsan te de ltar na smad kyi btsan bzhir mdzad pas/ des na de lta bu'i rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa drug yan la bod du dam pa'i chos kyi ming tsam yang ma byung bar bshad la/ de nas bod kha ba can 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dus nam gyi tshe byung ba ni/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di la yang ye bzang rtse ba'i deb gter sngon mor grags pa las/ gdong dmar gyi yul de rgya nag yin no zhes pa dang / dus 'khor ba kha cig dang / khyad par du paṇa chen shes rab rin chen gyi gsungs las/ gnya' khri btsan po nas rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa drug pa yan la lo stong dang sum brgya zhe lngar gsal/ zhes dang / des na lung de ni 'gyur skyon yin pas ma dag pa yin zhes gsungs kyang lugs dang po de ni ston pa nyid lha las babs te rgyal po u dra ya nas bzhengs pa'i tsan+dan jo bo la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ nga mya ngan la 'das nas lo stong na 'dis rgya nag gi yul du sems can gyi don byed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa dang 'gal zhing / gnyis pa yang sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas bod kyi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa drug pa yan la lo stong dang sum brgya zhe lnga las ma song ba la shes byed kyi lung khungs thub pa med cing / lung de 'gyur skyon nam ma dag pa yin na/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang bu ston kha che sogs bod kyi mkhas pa chen po rnams kyi bstan bcos rnams las 'di'i skabs su lung 'di gtso bor mdzad pa dang 'gal zhing /

yang na mkhas pa chen po de gnyis kyis 'di'i skabs kyi lung de'i rgya dpe la thugs rtog ma chug gsung ba yin nam ci yin/ de lta bu'i bshad pa ni mkhas pa chen po su'i zhal nas byung yang bzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin du dor nas/ da yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lung de'i don bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed pa ni thub pa'i dbang po mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can te bod kyi yul du dam pa'i chos byung ba yin la/ de yang rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun pa lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi sku ring la dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ srong btsan sgam po'i ring la srol btod/ khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la dar zhing rgyas par byas zhes 'byung bas/ de la dang po dbu brnyes pa'i tshul rags pa tsam brjod na/ de yang sngon rgya gar du chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi gdung brgyud rgyal po mang po rjer grags pa'i thog khar dam pa chos kyi glegs bam char du babs pa de rnams gser zhun mas bris nas rin po che'i za ma tog tu bcug la rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags la mchod pa phul nas yod pa las skabs shig gi tshe rlung chen po gcig gis bcad nas gar 'khyer cha med par gyur pa na/ de'i nangs par lha tho tho ri snyan shal dgung mkhar yum bu glang mkhar gyi yang steng na bzhugs yod pa'i phyag tu nyi zer gyi lam nas rin po che'i za ma tog cig byon pa gang yin ngo ma shes par/ gnyan po gsang ba zhes ming btags nas mdzod phug tu bzhugs su gsol te gsol ba btab pas ci bsam 'grub cing / de'i tshe nam mkha' las/ khyod nas rgyal rabs lnga na 'di'i don shes pa'i rgyal po gcig 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ zhes lung bstan pa yang byung zhing / de'i yon tan gyis rgyal po yang gzhon sha can du gyur nas dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu thub ste/ rgyal po de'i dus su dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes pa yin la/

de nas rgyal rabs lnga na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po zhes pa byon te/ rgyal po des bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar byed pa na/ thog mar yi ge shes dgos la/ de yang da lta bod na yi ge med pas rgya gar la yi ge slob tu gtong dgongs nas/ thon mi a nu'i bu thon mi sam+bho ṭa zhes pa 'khor bcu drug dang bcas te yi ge slob pa la brdzangs pas/ des kyang rgya gar na yi ge la mkhas pa bram ze li byin ces pa la lañtsha dang / wartu la sogs pa'i yi ge'i rigs mang po bslabs shing / yang paṇ+ḍi ta lha rigs seṅge zhes pa'i drung du sgra la sogs pa'i bstan bcos rnams bslabs nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyur te/ rgya gar gyi yi ge rnams bod yig sum cur gtan la phab nas bcos shing / de nas bod du byon te/ thog mar rgyal po nyid kyi drung du yi ge'i phud phul cing / rgyal pos kyang lo bzhi mtshams bcad nas yi ge rnams bslabs te dam pa'i chos shes par byas nas sngar gyi za ma tog gi nang na yod pa'i dpa' skongs phyag rgya pa/ dge ba bcu'i mdo/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo rnams dang / gzhan yang spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / 'dus pa rin po che'i tog dang / sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa rnams bsgyur cing / slar yang ma 'ongs pa na bod 'dir bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel du sprul pa'i dge slong a ka ra ma ti zhes pa gcig la bka' bsgos nas siṅga la'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram na rdo'i rang byon khar+sa pa ṇa'i rgyab na sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi dus su dgra bcom pa rdzu 'phrul thob pa zhig gis 'og min nas tsan+dan sbrul snying sgang bu cig 'khyer yong pa de'i nang na 'bru bzhi yod pa'i gsum sangs rgyas la phul/ gcig khar+sa pa ṇi rang byon de la dbu thog tu phul ba de re zhig nas rlung gi bskyod de sku rgyab tu ltung ste sas non nas yod pa'i thog tu mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis tshes bco lnga'i nub mo bdud rtsi 'pho bas brlan byung ba la brten nas myu gu byung ste/

gser thub kyi dus su me tog rgyas/ 'od srung gi dus su 'bras bu smin/ shākya thub pa'i dus su sdong po cher rgyas nas yod pa la/ thub pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe sdong po de 'gyel nas bye mas non pa'i 'og gi tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i nang na bcu gcig zhal gyi sku rang byon dang / rgya gar dang bal po'i mtshams kyi nags khrod cig na tsan+dan ha ri'i sdong po 'od zer 'phro ba zhig yod pa'i nang na 'phags pa lo ki shwa ra/ wa ti bzang po/ 'phags pa dbu gang pa/ dza ya li ste jo bo mched bzhi yod pa'i 'phags pa lo ki shwa ra dang / yang blon po mgar la bka' bsgos nas bal po'i rgyal po de wa lha zhes pa gsal ba'i me long na 'dug la/ bus 'od zer go cha zhes gsungs shing / gang ltar yang bal po nas rgyal po kri kri thugs dam rin po che'i sna tshogs bsdus pa las grub pa'i byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo dang / shākya'i rgyal po dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad du 'od srung nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i jo bo mi bskyed rdo rje'i sku dang / rgya nag gi rgyal po tha'i jung gi lag nas brgya byin gyis bzhengs shing ston pa nyid kyi phyag nas zhugs pa jo bo shākya mu ne dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad la sogs pa'i rten khyad par can rnams spyan drangs shing / lha sa 'phrul snang la sogs pa gtsug lag khang du ma dang / jo bo bcu gcig zhal gyi sku rang 'byon lnga ldan du grags pa la sogs pa'i sku khyad par can rnams bzhengs pa yin la/ de ltar na rgyal po de'i ring la slob pa'i chos grwa btsugs pa tsam las btsun pa rnams la sdom pa len pa dang / sngags pa rnams la dbang bskur bya ba ma byung yang / gong du bshad pa bzhin gyi yi ge dang chos du ma bsgyur cing gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas rten byin rlabs can rnams spyan drangs te bod 'bangs thams cad la dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas nas chos kyi sgor bcug pas na srong btsan sgam po'i ring la dam pa chos kyi srol btod ces bya ba yin la/

de nas rgyal rabs lnga na khri lde gtsug brtan bya ba mes ag tshoms su grags pa/ de'i sras rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan zhes bya ba byon nas de'i ring la/ sngon mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi drung du khye'u gsum gyis smon lam btab pa'i mthus/ rgyal po des sba gsal snang rgya gar du brdzangs te mkhan po bo dhi satwa dang / bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa sogs la bod kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir du sba ye shes dbang po/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ 'chim shākya pra bha/ shud pu dpal gyi seng ge rnams slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gdan 'dren du btang pas de gnyis kyang sngon gyi smon lam de'i dbang gis bod du phebs te/ slob dpon chen pos bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can btul te sa 'dul mdzad nas/ rgyal blon rnams kyis dpal bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs te/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ sngags 'chang dharmā kirti sogs kyis rab gnas mdzad cing / yang rgya gar nas gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs/ zhes lo rgyus kha cig tu 'byung yang / 'dir bla ma dam pa'i ngo mtshar snang ba las 'byung ba ltar du bshad na/ de nas gzhan yang paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas gsang pa/ mkhan po dā na shī la/ bi ma la mi tra dang / shi len+t+ra bo dhi la sogs pa mang po spyan drangs nas gzhon nu blo gsal ba rnams la sgra dang lo tsā slob tu bcug pas/ thog mar bod du rab tu byung bar rung mi rung sad pa'i phyir/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa la rab tu byung zhus pas/ shin tu ngo mtshar ba mkhan slob sogs yid smon pa byung bas/ lo tsa ba sad mi mi bdun zhes bya ba byung pa yin zhing / 'di la yang lo rgyus gzhan 'ga' zhig las ming dang go rim mi mthun pa du ma zhig 'byung yang /

re shig bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bshad pa bzhin brjod na/ sad mi mi bdun la rgan gsum/ bar pa gcig gzhon gsum las/ rgan gsum ni/ dang po dbas rin chen bsrung ba zhes bya ba bod yul du btsun pa la snga ba/ mkhan po sku gshegs nas 'dis mkhan po byas pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni sba ye shes dbang po bsrung ba ste/ sangs rgyas kyis byang chub sems dpa' rta skad ces par lung bstan pa de yin/ gsum pa rin chen dbang po bsrung ba ste rgan gsum dang / de nas bar pa ni mkhan po klu'i dbang po'i zhang po bde bar gshegs pa'i go cha bsrung ba ste glang khams pa go char grags pa de yin zhing / gzhon gsum ni/ rnam par snang mdzad bsrung ba/ klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ lha'i dbang po bsrung ba ste sad mi bdun dang / de rnams la ka ba dpal rtsegs la sogs pa'i lo tsā ba che ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyis rab tu byung zhing blo sbyangs/ de dag la lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs pa stong rtsa brgyad kyis rab tu byung nas blo sbyongs mdzad cing / de rnams kyis sgra bsgyur dang / zhu chen dang / mchan bu'i lo tsā byas te rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ zhi ba snying po la sogs pa rnams kyis mdo sde mang po dang / de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa'i rgyud sde du ma dang / gzhan yang sgrub thabs mang du bsgyur cing / chos rgyal de'i sku tshe'i smad tsam gyi dus su mkhan po bo dhi satwa'i slob ma slob dpon ka ma la shi la spyan drangs te/ rgya nag ha shang gi grub mtha' dang / lta ba ngan pa rnams sun phyung nas bod kyi skye dgu rnams yang dag pa'i grub mtha' dang lta ba la btsud pa sogs kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad pa yan khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par byas zhes pa yin la/ de nas rgyal po de'i sras sad na legs mjing yon du grags pa des kyang sngar gyi bi ma la mi tra dang /

ka ma la shī la dang / dzñā na se na dang / bal po hūm̐ ka ra la sogs pa dang / mkhan po klu'i dbang po dang / sma rin chen mchog dang / bran pa nam mkha' la sogs pa'i zhabs tog byas te/ lo paṇa de rnams kyis chos sngar ma bsgyur ba mang po bsgyur/ dkar chung lha khang la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang du ma bzhengs shing / chos grwa dang sgom grwa mang du btsugs nas bod 'bangs rnams bde ba la bkod pa yin zhing / de la bu ston chos 'byung du/ khri lde srong btsan dang / gtsang ma dang / khri dar ma u dum btsan dang / lha rje lhun grub/ khri chen po ste sras lnga byung bar gsungs kyang / ngo mtshar snang ba sogs lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu 'byung ba yongs grags ltar bshad na/ khri lde gtsug brtan sad na legs mjing yon du grags pa de la/ sras gtsang ma dang / dar ma dang / ral pa can gsum byung ba'i gtsang ma ni rab tu byung zhing / dar ma rang rgyud ngan pas yab kyi rgyal srid ma gtad par/ chung ba phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa khri ral pa can la rgyal srid gtad nas/ des kyang dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa nas bzung ste rgyal sa lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi mdzad cing / de'i ring la 'u shang rdo'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa gtsug lag khang stong rtsa gcig bzhengs shing sngon gyi gsung rab rnams la/ rgya dang / li yul dang / za hor la sogs pa'i skad sna tshogs kyis bsgyur ba yod pas ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams kyis brda mi 'dra ba mang pos chos rnams slob dka' bar gzigs nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / su ren+t+ra bo dhi dang / shī len+t+ra bo dhi dang / nyi 'og gi mkhan po dzi na mi tra la sogs pa rnams dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba ka ba dpal rtsegs dang / lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / zhang sna nam ban+dhe ye shes sde la sogs pa rnams kyis sngar gyi chos rnams slar yang bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab nas/ lo paṇa bkas bcad gsum mdzad pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas dam pa'i chos shin tu dar ba gyur pa yin pas/

des na mnga' bdag khri ral bzhugs pa yan la bstan pa snga dar zhes bya ba'i tha snyad byed pas/ de'i dus su spyir gyi gong du bshad pa bzhin mdo sngags kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byung na yang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa nas brgyud pa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag la sogs pa lam skor dgur grags pa rnams ni de'i dus yang ma byung ba yin la/ 'o na gsung ngag 'di bod du dus nam gyi tshe byung ba yin na/ de yang mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyi rjes su rgyal po glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs nas lo bdun cu tsam gyi bar la bod du bstan pa'i ming tsam yang ma byung la/ dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i tshul re zhig bzhag nas/ de'i rjes su glang dar ma'i sras dngos 'od srung dang / de'i sras rje dpal 'khor btsan te 'di gshegs nas bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po ma byung bar grags shing / de la sras gnyis byung ba skyid lde nyid ma mgon dang / bkris brtsegs pa gnyis kyis sa stod smad du srid bzung ste/ de yang nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris stod kyi dgung mkhar nyi ma bzung zhing de la sras dpal gyi mgon/ bkra shis mgon/ lde gtsug mgon dang gsum byung ba la stod kyi mgon gsum du grags shing / bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyis dbus gtsang gi sa cha rnams bzung nas/ de la sras gsum byung ba ni/ dpal lde/ 'od lde/ skyid lde rnams la smad kyi lde gsum du grags pa yin zhing / de rnams kyi ring la yang gtsug lag khang gi gnyer pa sham thabs gong pa can re gon pa la gnas brtan dgra bcom par ming btags pa rnams kyis byed pas na da lta btsun pa rnams kyis ring 'gag gyon pa yang de'i shugs kyis yin par byas 'dug cing / yang sdom pa bsrung zer nas rtsa bzhi sna yud la bsrung la/ de'i rjes su dgag dbye byed zer nas mi bsrung zhing / sngags pa rnams kyis kyang dbang la sogs par med pa sbyor sgrol lam du byed zer nas mngon spyod sogs log par spyod pas gsang sngags rnying ma la lhad kyang de nas zhugs par byed la/

mdor na glang dar ma 'das pa'i rjes su'ang / de yan la sngar bshad ma thag pa'i sbyor sgrol lam du byed pa la sogs pa'i tshul de tsam zhig ma gtogs bstan pa rnal ma rang zhig ma byung zhing / de nas stod kyi mgon gsum las/ kun mkhyen bu ston pa'i chos 'byung du/ chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis zhang zhung bzung zhing / de la sras 'khor re dang / srong nge gnyis zhes bshad la/ ngo mtshar snang ba dang / chos 'byung bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od sogs las/ bar pa bkra shis mgon gyi sras 'od kyi rgyal mtshan dang / de'i sras 'khor re dang / srong nge gnyis zhes 'byung yang / rang lugs la/ rje btsun rin po che'i rgyal rabs su/ bkra shis mgon gyi sras 'khor re rab tu byung ba'i mtshan lha bla ma ye shes 'od du grags pa de'i sku ring la bstan pa phyi dar gyi mgo zug pa yin pas/ des na gsung ngag rin po che ni spyi lam pa'i dbang du byas na bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su byung ba yin zhing / de la yang bstan pa'i me ro stod nas bslangs pa dang / smad nas bslangs pa zhes bya ba gnyis su grags pa las/ spyir gsang sngags dang / bye brag tu de nyid 'dus pa sogs yo ga'i skor rnams byung ba'i tshul ni bstan pa'i me ro stod nas bslangs pa ste/ de yang bkra shis mgon gyi sras bla ma ye shes 'od kyis mnga' ris stod kyi gzhon nu blo gsal ba bdun gyis gtso byas pa'i mi nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya gar dang / kha cher 'dus pa rnam gnyis la sogs pa'i chos slob tu brdzangs pa las/ lo chen rin po che bzang po dang / lo chung legs shes gnyis kyis bod du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa sogs kyi sgo nas 'byung ba yin kyang / 'dir gsung ngag gi skor rnams byung ba'i tshul ni/ 'dzad pa gtsang rab gsal/ bo dong pa g.yo dge 'byung / stod lung la dmar shākya mu ne gsum gyis bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslangs pa'i dus nas 'brel btsal te 'chad dgos pas/

'di la yang cha rgan gyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras kyi lo rgyus sogs kha cig tu gtsang g.yo dmar gsum de mnga' bdag khri ral gyi dus su ka da bstan pa ma dar ba'i sa phyogs su phyin la bstan pa'i bya ba byed snyam du dgongs pa mthun nas khams phyogs su byon par bshad kyang / yongs su grags pa bu'i chos 'byung dang / khyad par du ngo mtshar snang ba sogs nas 'byung ba ltar du bshad na/ gtsang g.yo dge gsum dpal chu bo ri'i brag la bsgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa na/ skabs shig gi tshe der ban gzugs kyi khyi ra ba mang po byung bas ci yin dris pas/ glang dar mas bstan pa snub pa'i gtam thos pa dang / 'dul ba'i po ti dres khal gcig bkal nas khams su bros nas mdo smad an chung gi dgon pa yang zer ba'i dan tig shel gyi yang dgon du byon nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mdo smad tshan bzhi'i sku'i gshen mu btsun gsal zhes bya ba bon la 'gro ba'i lam du phyugs rdzi 'ga' dal gtam byed pa las thos nas/ der blta ru phyin pas cha lugs dang kun spyod la dad de rab tu byung pa zhus pa yin pas/ 'di la yang ngo mtshar snang bar/ dbus gtsang gi bstan pa nyams dmas nas dus ring zhig na sngar dbus gtsang nas bros pa'i g.yo dge 'byung gis mkhan po/ gtsang rab gsal gyis slob dpon/ dmar gyis gsang ston dang / rgya'i ha shang ke wam̐ dang ki bab gnyis kyis kha skong byas nas rab tu byung ba las bla chen mu thur dgongs pa rab gsal bya ba byung zhes pa tsam bshad la/ bu'i chos 'byung dang / khams kyi bon po mu gzu'am/ lo btsun gsal bya bas dan tig shel gyi yang dgon du gtsang g.yo dmar gsum dang mjal ba yan gyi lo rgyus sngar gyi de dang cha 'dra ba las/ des rab tu byung bar zhus pas/ 'dul ba 'od ldan gyi po ti gcig gtad nas 'di la ltos/ dad na rab tu byung bar byed gsungs pas/ des bltas pa dang dad ste mchi ma byung bas/ gtsang g.yo dmar gsum gyis rim pa bzhin/

mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / grogs dan pa byas te thog mar dge tshul bsgrubs nas mkhan po'i ming la dras nas dge ba gsal du btags/ phyis thugs rab che bas dgongs pa rab gsal du grags shing / de nas bsnyen rdzogs zhus pas/ dge slong lnga ma tshang bas mi yong gsungs pa dang / sngar lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje ldan glang thang na bzhugs pa thos pas/ der phyin nas zhus pas/ ngas rgyal po bsad pas kha skong gi dge 'dun mi yong / ngas btsal gyi gsungs nas gong du bshad pa'i rgya'i ha shang gnyis btang nas sngar dge tshul gyi mkhan slob gnyis kyis mkhan slob dang / dmar gyis gsang ston/ ha shang gnyis kyis kha skong byas te dge 'dun lnga'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa byas zhes bshad cing / nye lde bas kyang de dang mthun par bshad la/ cha rgan gyi lo rgyus na sngar gyi mkhan slob de gsum rang gi drung du dge slong chig rdzogs byas zer ba'ang 'dug la/ gang ltar yang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal de nyid gtsang g.yo dmar gsum gyi drung du bsnyen par rdzogs pa la ni rtsod pa med la/ lugs dang po gnyis kyi kha skongs gnyis po de la bla ma mkhas pa kha cig gis dpyad gzhi cung zad mdzad kyang / de ltar gyi tshe na lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje dang / gtsang rab gsal la sogs pa'i mkhan slob rnams la skur pa btab par 'gyur bas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag la/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal 'di yang gsal ba'i me long na 'phan yul ba'i byis pa blo gsal ba zhig gis gsal snang lha khang du phyin pas de na gyang ris la rab byung gi gzugs 'dug pa mthong ba dang / 'di 'dra gang na yod dris pas/ grogs rnams kyis da lta 'di na med/ khams na 'di lta bu'i rab tu byung ba 'ga' zhig yod par 'dug byas pa dang / sngon gyi bag chags sad de khams su phyin nas gtsang g.yo dmar gsum las rab tu byung ba'i mtshan de ltar du grags zhes pa yod kyang lugs snga ma rnams btsan par byed dgos pas/

des na khams kyi bla chen mu thur dgongs pa rab gsal gyis mkhan slob de rnams las rab tu byung nas lo lnga lon pa na dbus gtsang gi mi dad pa dang brtson 'grus che ba rnams kyis khams su phyin nas dan tig shel gyi yang dgon du sngar gyi mkhan slob rnams las rab byung zhus pa yin zhing / de la yang lo rgyus kha cig tu 'bri ye shes yon tan sogs mi drug gi zhes dang / rang re'i ngo mtshar snang bar/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug sogs gtsang pa gsum dbus pa klu mos shes rab ste bzhi'o/ /yang na de'i steng du gsum pa ye shes blo gros te dbus gtsang gi mi lnga zhes gsungs pa ni yongs su grags pa'i gtso che ba rnams smos pa yin la/ zhib tu byas na kun mkhyen bus bshad pa ltar dbus pa klu mas shes rab/ 'bri ye shes yon tan nam/ 'bri btsun rgyal ba byang chub kyang zer la/ de nas reg shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sba tshul khrims blo gros/ ye shes blo gros/ sum pa ye shes blo gros ste dbus pa lnga dang / gtsang tshong 'dus 'gur mo rab kha pa/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug shab sgo lnga'i tshong btsun shes rab seng ge mnga' ris pa 'od brgyad spun gnyis/ bo dong pa u pa de ba dang lnga ste dbus gtsang gi mi bcus gtsang rab gsal la mkhan po zhus pas/ da nga rgas nas mkhan po skyong mi thub pas/ bla chen la zhus gsungs nas khong rnams kyis bla chen la zhus pas/ ngas bsnyen rdzogs byas nas lo bcu ma lon pas mi btub gsungs pa la/ gtsang na re/ dmigs gsal la btub pas gyis gsungs nas/ bla chen mu thur pa rab gsal gyis mkhan po byas/ gtsang g.yo gnyis kyis las slob dang / gsang ston byas shing / dmar dang rgya'i ha shang gis kha skong gi dge 'dun byas te de thams cad kyi bsnyen rdzogs grub pa dang / bla chen gyi zhal nas/ lo ston mthu che bas bstan srung gyis/ klu mes btsun pas mkhan po gyis/ tshong dge blo rno bas ston pa ste chos 'chad gyis/

'bri 'khos mkhas pas gnas gzhi bzung zhes sogs kyi zhal bkod kyang mdzad/ de nas klu mas 'bru ye shes rgyal mtshan la 'dul ba nyan cing bsdad/ gzhan rnams kyis yar 'byon pa dang / reg shi dang sba'i gcung gnyis gcen po bsu ru byung bas/ glang thang du mjal ba dang / gcung gnyis dad de los mkhan po byas/ gcen po gnyis kyis slob dpon dang gsang ston mdzad nas rab tu byung bas/ da lta sba reg gnyis gcig tu bsdebs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin par byed cing / de nas lo ston na re/ khyed rnams 'dir sdod cig ngas tshong pa 'di rnams dang 'grogs te dbus gtsang du phyin la bstan pa dar bar nus mi nus bltas nas/ nus na nga sdod pas khyed rnams kyang yar byon cig mi nus pa 'dug na nga yang mar log nas 'ong gi gsungs nas/ ldan ma'i tshong pa 'dra dang 'grogs te byon pas tshong pa rnams 'phan yul gyi gsum 'phreng du tshong byas nas log dgos snyam pa la/ lo na re/ khyed rnams 'dir tshong ma byed par gtsang du song la gtsang gi 'gur mo rab kha bya ba na lo gtsug na bya ba yod pas/ de la khyod kyi bu rab tu byung nas dbus na sleb yod gyis shig gsungs te der btang nas tshong legs po byung bas/ deng sang tshong 'dus 'gur mo bya ba'i de dus su byung ba yin zhing / de nas klu mas la sogs pa'i mkhas pa phal cher gyis kyang dbus sogs su byon te/ klu mes kyis ka chung dang / sba ye shes blo gros mched gnyis kyis bsam yas kyi sbu tshal dang / dbu rtse/ reg shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas mched gnyis kyis dge rgyas dang / 'bri btsun mched gnyis kyis khams gsum zangs khang gling bzung nas dbus su 'dul ba la sogs pa'i bstan pa dar bar byas shing / de'i dus nas lo tsho tshong tsho/ 'bri tsho zhes pa yang rang rang gi mkhan po'i ming las byung ba yin la/ de nas lo ston gyis thog mar tshong 'dus su byon cing / de'i rjes su nyang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang brtsigs nas der lo ston dang tshong tsho gnyis kyi mkhan po shākya gzhon nu dang /

se ye shes brtson 'grus la sogs pa'i slob ma du ma dang bcas nas yod pa las/ skabs shig tu sngon chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos brtsigs pa'i ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi las/ ru lag na grom pa rgyang gi gtsug lag khang bya ba yod pa de'i bdag po smad kyi lde gsum/ lha rtse'i lha btsun mched gsum bka' bgros te 'u cag la bla'i mchod gnas mkhan slob gsang ste dad dge dang bcas pa gcig dgos par 'dug zer nas nyang smad rgyan gong du mi brdzangs te lo ston dang / tshong btsun gnyis la zhus pas de gnyis kyis kyang / lo ston gyi mkhan bu rgya shākya gzhon nu dang / se ye shes brtson 'grus gnyis dang / nyang rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i dge slong bdun/ dge tshul gnyis/ dge bsnyen gcig rnams brdzangs te de rnams kyis grom pa rgyang du byon nas/ rgyas mkhan po/ ses slob dpon/ nyang rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis gsang ston mdzad nas 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ stag lo gzhon nu brtson 'grus/ legs ye shes gzhon nu gsum bsnyen par rdzogs shing / gzhan yang rab tu byung ba phyed dang sum brgya tsam byung ba'i dus su/ nyang stod du shi'u ston pa byang 'bar gyis/ a man si te/ 'dod log lam du khyer bas tshe 'di la 'tshang rgya ba yin byas pas/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la dgra dar/ nyang smad du zur chu shes rab grags pas rdzogs chen byas shes kyi sangs rgyas yid la byed pa yin/ rnam rtog 'khor ba yin bzlas/ ting nge 'dzin la dgra dar/ dbus ru byang du dge bshes ston pas bka' gdams bshad nyan ngal ba don med yin/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa bsrung zhing / thugs rje chen po la sogs pa'i yi dam re bsgrubs pas/ dus tshod cig la yi dam gyis sgro 'dogs thams cad gcod par 'gyur zhes byas pas lhag pa shes rab la dgra dar/ zhang 'tshal yin pas bla ma la lus srog phul nas 'khrug pa byas pas sangs rgya bzlas pas bslab pa gsum ka la dgra dar nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ldeng por gyur pa thugs kyis ma bzod nas/

rgya dang se mkhan slob bka' bgros pas thugs mthun te/ dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur bzang po zhig byas nas bstan pa'i zhabs tog dang / sems can gyi don la dgongs nas rgya gar du lo tsā slob tu 'gro nus pa yod na mthun rkyen bskur ba yin no gsungs pas/ 'brog stag legs gsum gyi khas blangs/ mkhan po rgyas legs la lkog tu gser srang bcu'i mgo byas pa'i yon bkur nas sngon la brdzangs/ shin tu mkhyen pa che bas yon bdag btsad po lde gsum rje blon/ dge 'dun nye 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gros dris pas/ thams cad yi rangs te dka ru ma mang po byung nas 'brog stag gnyis la gser srang brgya res mgo byas pa'i yo byad gnang nas de rnams skyid grong bar du tshong par brdzus te sngon la bskyal/ cha rkyen bsgrubs pa dang / yar bskyel ba'i bar gyi zla ba bdun du bla chen 'brog mis/ a tsa ra ldum bu ba paṇ+ḍi ta ming btags su btub tsam gcig dang gnyis mtshams bcad nas big paṇa mdo'i blo 'dzin dang blo sbyong mdzad pas/ 'phral skad byang po zhig dang / sam skṛ ta la sogs pa rgya gar gyi chos nyan du btub tsam byung / bod chos kyang mang du mkhyen skyid grong du zla ba gcig tsam chu snyoms na dga' zer nas zhal bkod zhus pas/ blon po dang / yon bdag lha mchod gsum na re/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin pas 'dul ba dang / snying po yin pas phar phyin dang / nying khu yin pas gsang sngags slob la shog gsungs nas dgos par grags shing / de la sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal nas gsung de rnams chos kyi gnad go ba'i zhal lta yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ 'dul ba ni bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin te/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i rab byung med na rnal 'byor pa bzang du re ba mang po yod kyang bstan pa rnal ma zhig mi 'ong / phar phyin med na theg pa chen po'i rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems dang / sa lam gyi rnam gzhag tsam yang mi phyed/

gsang sngags nying khu yin te/ phyi nang gi zab pa'i gnad thams cad dril nas ston pas gsang sngags la ma brten par mthar thug gi 'bras bu mi thob zhes gsungs pa yin zhing / gzhan yang khyad par du bla med kyi rgyud 'grel la sogs pa nyams rtogs kyi rgyur 'gro tshad slob pa la 'bad rtsol dang / sdug sran ma chung / dad brtson dang 'dod pa skyed la/ nged yon mchod rnams kyi chos dang zang zing gi drin lan bsab par gyis/ don de rnams grub nas phyir 'ong dus mang yul tsam nas sngon la lon bskur cig khyed rang gi yon tan dang bstun pa'i bsu ba dang bsnyen bskur byed pa yin gsungs nas gza' skar dang / dus sbyor bzang po la 'brog dang stag lo dpon g.yog bzhi jau ki gcig dang lngas skyid grong bar du ldum bu'i chas su byas/ der yang chu snyoms shing de nas bal po mthil du song ste/ bal po bha ro ham thung ngam/ thugs rje chen po yang zer/ bha dan+ta yang zer/ bal po spyi ther ba yang zer zhing / mtshan dngos shan+ta bha dra ste zhi ba bzang por grags pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta de la kyai rdor/ bde mchog gsang 'dus/ 'jigs byed/ mahā ma ya rnams kyi dbang zhus nas de rnams la slob gnyer mdzad cing / gzhan yang sgra tshad dang yig rtsis la sogs pa bslabs pas/ bla chen 'brog mi la lo gcig tsam nas lo tsā ba'i mtshan thob cing / legs kyis kyang 'phral skad byang po zhig dang / sim skṛ ta la sogs pa chos nyan du btub tsam byung ba la/ stag los rgya klog khyo le ba zhig las ma shes pas/ nga rdo rje gdan du 'gro zer ba la 'brog mis 'o skol mi lnga la 'grul tshan gnyis mi 'thad byas nas bla ma paṇ+ḍi ta dang / nged rnams rgya gar du 'gro bas ji ltar byas na 'thad pa'i zhal bkod dang / bskyel mi sogs mgo thon zhig gtong bar zhus pas/ bla ma'i gsung gis/ de ltar byed na sngon la rdo rje gdan du song byang chub chen po la phyag dang mchod par phul nas gsol ba thob/

yid ches pa'i mtshan ltas mthong ba dang / ding sang 'chad nyan la sogs pa'i bstan pa bṛ ka ma la shī la na dar bar yod pas/ des na rgyal po'i gdugs thob pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya yod pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa 'dzam bu'i gling na mkhas pa sgo drug ces bya ba yod cing / de rnams kyi nang nas kyang mchog dam pa ni nga'i bla ma shan+ti pa zhes bya ba snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa yin pas/ des bṛ ka ma la shi la'i shar sgo srung / sgra tshad kyi rtsod pa zlog lho sgo ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas srung / lung chos kyi rtsod pa zlog ste de gnyis mthun pas slob ma'ang thun mong du skyong / nub sgo shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pas srung / mu stegs kyi rtsod pa zlog cing / khyad par du snyoms par 'jug pa'i lta sgom spyod 'bras la mkhas/ byang sgo jo bo nā ro ta pas srung / sngags kyi rtsod pa zlog ste de gnyis mthun/ dbus kyi ka chen gnyis bya ba kha che dzñā na shrī mi tra dang / rin chen rdo rje gnyis mthun zhing de gnyis la ka chen zer yang gzhan rnams las yon tan che rgyu med/ lnga po thams cad las shan+ti pa mkhyen pa mi chung bas khong can du song / gzhan rnams la'ang chos 'brel re zhus gsungs nas khong rang gi gcung po paṇa chen 'jigs med grags pa dpon slob bdun skyel du btang nas khong rnams kyis kyang ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ thog mar rdo rje gdan du byon nas gsol ba btab pas/ mtshan ltas bzang po mthong ba dang / bla chen 'brog mis bṛ ka ma la shi lar byon te/ shan+ti pa'i drung du lo bco brgyad bzhugs nas 'dul ba dang / nyi khri dag ldan la sogs pa'i phar phyin gyi chos du ma dang / de'i rjes su bde kye sogs kyi dbang gsan cing / khyad par du mdo rgyud kyi don bsre ba zhes bya ba'i man ngag zab mo yang gsan/ gzhan lnga po la yang chos 'brel mdzad pas deng sang 'brog mi'i sgo drug chos 'brel du grags pa yin la/

de yang shan+ti pa la ni gong du bshad pa ltar yin zhing / de nas ngag dbang grags pa la gnyug ma dran gsal/ shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa la phyi rol gdon gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i man ngag nā ro ta pa la sdug bsngal gsum sel/ dzñā na shrī la 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i man ngag rin chen rdo rje la ting nge 'dzin sems kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i man ngag rnams gsan tshar ba dang / paṇ+ḍi ta mi pham bshes gnyen gyis po ta la nas gdan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po khar+sa pa ṇa'i drung du dmod btsugs nas gsol ba btab na don ma 'grub pa med zer ba thos nas de'i drung du byon te/ phyag mchod phul dmod bor nas gsol ba btab pas/ tho rangs shig thugs rje chen pos zhal bstan nas phar lam bla ma gcig dang mjal bar 'dug gi de'i gsung bzhin sgrubs/ phyis bod du'ang bla ma gcig gis chos sgo bskyel la 'ong bar 'dug pas de'i yon tan long pa dang / nyan pa'i spros pa chod la chos shod/ bka' sdoms/ nyams su longs/ ngas kyang rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par byin gyis brlabs bo gsungs nas 'ja' 'od ltar nam mkha' yal song ba dang / da don grub snyam du dgongs nas gsol ba 'debs shing byon pas/ lam gyi nags gseb cig na 'khar sil gyi sgra zhig grags pas/ grong khyer zhig yod pa yin nam snyam 'gram pa bsnyal nas gzigs pa dang / dge slong gcig la shing lo'i gseb nas lag pa dkar 'jam rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa zhig gi bsod snyoms 'bul ba gzigs pa dang / dge slong des dngos grub thob par mkhyen pas/ da lung bstan thog tu phebs sam snyam du dgongs te brgyugs byon nas zhabs spyi bor blangs te bdag rjes su 'dzin par zhu zhus pas rung gsungs nas gsol ras gnang ba bzhes pa dang ro brgya dang ldan par 'dug pas/ nags kyi lha mos bsod snyoms phul bar dgongs nas shing lo'i zil pas chab btang ste de'i phyag phyir 'brangs nas phyin pas/

grong khyer ha de zhes bya ba'i tshong 'dus dang ldan pa'i grong khyer chen po zhig gi nags 'dabs su de nub bzhugs nas sang nyin gsang sngags kyi gdams pa 'dra dgos zhus pas/ dbang bskur dgos gsungs/ sngar mang po thob zhus pas/ des mi chog nga'i gdams ngag 'dod na nga rang gis dbang bskur dgos gsungs shing / de yang do nub nas byas pas rung gsungs tshong 'dus ha de nas yo byad bsgrubs te/ kyai rdo rje'i dbang nub gsum ma zhig bskur/ khrid bka' 'ga' zhig kyang gnang nas/ nga la longs spyod kyi thung pa med de ci dgos thams cad mi ma yin mchog 'bring tha ma rnams kyis bsgrub pa yin kyang / slob ma la gsang sngags kyi sgo nas rten 'brel sgrig pa la khyed rang gi longs spyod dgos pas gser dngul gla rtsi la sogs pa sgrubs la shog lo gsum tsam las mi 'gor de'i ring la bar chad mi 'ong par byin gyis rlobs gsungs/ bla ma'i mtshan ji skad bya ba lags/ gnas gang du bzhugs zhus pas/ nga'i ming rang pradzñā in+d+ra pu ru tsi ra ste shes rab dbang po mdzes pa yin kyang / ding sang dge slong dpa' bo rdo rjer grags/ rgyal po tsa na kas lo gsum gyi gong nas zhu 'bul bas lo bdun khong gi khab tu sdod/ de nas dpal gyi ri la 'gro/ khyod la yang bar chad med cing 'dod don 'grub par spyan ras gzigs kyi byin gyis brlabs 'dug pa gsungs/ de nas byon pas sngar gyi grogs gnyis dang mjal te blo bsdur bas 'brog mi paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur/ legs kyis kyang lo tsā mkhas po mkhyen kyang / stag los so sor thar pa'i mdo dang / karma sha stam la sogs pa'i 'dul ba'i lag len dang / shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa dang / rtsa ba nyid rgya klog tu 'don shes pa tsam las mi 'dug de nas tshur byon te skyid grong du zla ba gsum chu snyoms shing / de'i bar la mkhan slob dang yon bdag gi rtsar pho nya btang pas zla ba phyed dang gsum na bsu mi cha rkyen mang po dang bcas mang yul skyid grong du slebs shing /

de nas byon te yon mchod rnams kyis bar phug nas bsus te shangs len dang / bya dga' rnams kyang bka' che thang du gnang / bla chen 'brog mi la mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams kyis chos mang du zhus shing / yon bdag lha mched gsum gyis dbang bskur zhus/ stag lo la mkhan slob dang / gsang ston dang 'dul ba'i phran tshegs nyan pa'ang 'ga' re byung la phyis tshul khrims kyi mgo thon pas stag tsho'i sde pa yang mang du 'phel zhing / legs la gzhan don tsam ma byung ba dang / bod mun pa'i gling 'di na gser dang bong nga ngo mi shes pa 'dug gsungs nas zla ba drug tsam bzhugs te slar rdo rje gdan du byon nas/ lo gnyis slob gnyer lhag ma rnams mdzad de/ bod du byon nas 'gyur 'ga' re mdzad cing / sde dgon kha yar btsugs pa tsam las gzhan don ni ha cang che ba ma byung bar 'dug la/ de nas bla chen 'brog mas yon mchod rnams la dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje'i lo rgyus rnams zhib par gsungs nas/ nged kyis chos zab la mang ba gsol ba btab yod pas/ yon mchod rnams kyis cha rkyen nam 'dzoms pa'i tshe brda sprod cig gsungs nas lha rtse'i brag la lha bsnyen dang / bsam mno gtong zhing phyag dpe zhu dag mdzad/ lo gnyis nas yon mchod rnams kyis yo byad phun sum tshogs pa brdzangs nas rgya gar du byon te rgyal po tsa na ka'i khab tu dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje dang mjal nas dbang bskur zhus pas/ bla mas dbang bcu gsum mthud mar gnang zhing / bla ma'i zhal nas/ da khyod la bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i rten 'brel lhun grub tu 'grig pa yin da chos rnams sbyin gyi/ ngas spyir chos dpag tu med pa shes kyang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po stobs kyi mgon po dpal bir+wa pa nas brgyud pa'i chos skor rnams thos pas/ rtogs pa sems la skyes/ spros pa nang nas chod gdul bya phyi nas 'dul/ snyan grags phyogs med du rgyas pa yin/

khyod de rnams phal che ba'i snod du rung bar 'dug pas 'bad rtsol skyed cig gsungs nas/ de'i nangs par kyai rdor rgyud gsum gyi dbu btsugs te rtsa ba dang bshad rgyud spel nas man ngag gi kha bskangs te bshad srol dka' ba'i gnad dang bcas pa lo gcig gi bar du gnang nas bla chen gyi thugs su tshud pa'i sngar bslabs pa'i chos thams cad kyi'ang spros pa dus gcig la chod pa dang / bir+wa pa'i chos brgyud dgu pa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mi thub zla ba'i bka' srol de nyid khyad par du 'phags par dgongs nas skad cig kyang ma yengs par bslabs pas lo bzhi song ba dang / bla mas mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gtang rag bzang po zhig btang nas/ nga'i chos rnams bar chad med par khyod la 'phrod pas dga' ba sgoms/ da bod du song la bshad sgrub spel mar gyis/ skabs shig tu ngas spros pa gcod du 'ong / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi chos bdag khyed rang yin pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta gzhan gcig gis kyang chos sgo skyel la 'ong bar gda' gsungs pa dang / bla chen gyis da bod la 'gro bas lung 'dra zhu zhus pas/ khyod kyis sngar rnal 'byor bla med gtso che ba'i rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ man ngag rgyud/ 'phros rgyud/ zab mo dum bu chung ba'i rgyud rnams dang / 'grel pa yang mang du shes pa yin gsungs nas rgyud che ba 'grel ṭika dang bcas pa brgyad cu tsam/ sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa mang po dang / mdo dang gzungs cho ga yod pa lnga bcu tsam gnang nas shes bya la mtha' med gsungs/ rdzongs pa la lam 'bras rtsa ba med pa zhig dang lam skor phyi ma la sogs pa/ rdzogs rim spyi'i gnad thun mong ma yin pa 'ga' zhig dang / 'pho ba'i gdams ngag zab mo zhig kyang gnang ba rnams zhus nas bod du 'byon khar/ de dus bod na rnying ma dar bas ji tsam dris kyang ma rnyed pa la rdo rje gdan gyi sgo gong na ru lu 'bru brgyad pa zhig bris 'dug pa ci yin dris pas shes mi ma byung zhing /

yang paṇ+ḍi ta zhig gi dpe gseb na yang phur pa'i dum bu 'dra 'dug pa khong rang gis kyang ma shes par 'dug gsungs/ de nas bod la byon pa'i lam nas 'phrin btang pas/ mkhan slob dang / mched gsum gyis bsu mi btang ba rnams dpal mo dpal thang du slebs/ lam la stod lho la byon te/ gzhi ma rnams mu gu lung du bskyal nas mkhan slob mched gsum rnams kyis rgyang du shangs len dang 'bul ba chen po mdzad la/ lha rtser spyan drangs te bde kye sogs kyi dbang bskur mang du zhus shing / de nas mched gsum gyis bdag rkyen mdzad nas mu gu lung du bshad grwa btsugs pas mkhas pa'i grags pa chen po byung ba dang / dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi zhwa bo che dang / sham ring po thams cad 'dus pas slob ma yang mar pa chos kyi blo gros dang / 'gos khug pa lhas btsas la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang du byung bas/ de'i dus spyir bla chen 'brog mi nas brgyud pa'i mdo sngags kyi chos dar ba zhig byung yang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal bir+wa pa nas brgyud pa'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag 'di dang / gzhan yang rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo la sogs pa'i lam skor brgyad de/ mdor na lam skor dgur grags pa ni bod 'dir de'i dus su yang dar ba zhig ma byung la/ des na gsung ngag rin po che 'di nyid ni/ bla ma rnams kyi gsung las/ dang por ga ya dha ras srol btod/ bar du 'brog mi lo tsās spel/ mthar rje sa skya pa chen pos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ ces 'byung ba ltar yin pas/ de'i tshul yang bla chen 'brog mi de mang mkhar mu gu lung na 'chad nyan mdzad cing bzhugs yod pa'i tshe/ nub cig bla chen la sngar 'ong ma myong ba'i mnal lam ci yin ngo ma shes pa'i khams che ba zhig byung nas mtshams bcad nas yod pa'i dus su/ snga dro zhig sgo khang na rwa dung 'bud pa'i skad gsan pas snying sangs pa zhig byung nas/

ma gi ci 'dra zhig 'dug lta dgos bsam bltas tsa na gzim khang gi sgo rtsa ru byung nas saṃ skṛ ta'i skad kyis nga paṇ+ḍi ta yin/ lo tsā bas zas blangs/ nor blangs zer/ de'i lan zas sbyin gyis/ nor med ces saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du smras pas/ lo tsā ba'i sgor paṇ+ḍi ta 'ong pa la 'di 'dra'i tshig ngan smra ba zer nas khro ba'i tshul byed pa la/ nye gnas kyis gdan btings nas nang du bos tsha ba drangs pas/ tshig ngan gyi khams log pas zas mi bza' gsungs/ tshig ngan bzlas pa med byas pas/ 'o na zhu dag bya'o zer nas paṇ+ḍi ta la ba dmar po can bzhengs te zhabs g.yas pa lte ba'i thad du bzhag phyag gnyis sked pa la 'jus/ gru mo gdong nas sgeg pa'i tshul du gar bsgyur cing saṃ skri ta'i skad du sngar gyi tshig brjod/ lo tsā bas kyang sngar gyi tshig brjod pas gnyis ka yi ger bris nas sgra bsgrubs pas lag pa nag po gsham la khob la song bya ba zhig byung bas/ lo tsā bas bshags sdugs te/ ngas rgya gar du lo bcu/ lam du lo phyed dang gsum du paṇ+ḍi ta brgyad las slob gnyer mtha' dag byas kyang 'di 'dra zhig la rmongs pa zer ba la/ paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ sgra rgya mtsho chen po dang 'dra/ de'i mtha' khyod pas ngas kyang mi rtogs/ khyed rang snod dang ldan na khyod kyi mkhas grub kyi yon tan rnams ngas rdzogs par bya yis gsungs pa dang / lo tsā ba'i thugs dgongs la spyan ras gzigs dang / dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje'i lung bstan de thog tu phebs pa yin las che bsams nas shin tu dges/ tsha ba'i rjes su ja sbyor zhig gi ring la gsung gleng mdzad pas paṇ+ḍi ta chen por yang 'dug cing / spyir theg chen dang / bye brag rdo rje'i theg pa/ de'i nang nas kyang rnal 'byor bla med/ khyad par du dpal bir+wa pa'i lugs la mkhas par dgongs nas ja grol ba dang / gser srang gang la maṇ+ḍal byas te/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas zhabs spyi bor blangs te rjes su 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/

thugs rje chen pos lung bstan nas khyod 'tshol du 'ongs pa yin/ gser mang po yod dam gsungs/ rjes su 'dzin na thugs dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par byed zhus pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal nas nged paṇ+ḍi ta gsum rgya gar nas 'ongs pa las/ grogs gnyis po'i gdul bya rgya nag na yod pas der song / nga'i gdul bya bod na yod pas de yang pu hrang lo tsā ba gzhon nu shes rab kyis nan chen po gsol ba 'debs kyin 'dug kyang / yi dam lha'i lung bstan la brten nas khyod 'tshol du 'ong ba yin/ zla ba gsum la khong can 'khor ba'i chad byas yod pa la sngar zla ba gcig tsam song / khos kyang gser srang lnga bcu tsam ster bar byas/ sngar srang bcu tsam byin pa kho rang la bcol yod pa de rnams kyis tshogs bsog byed pa dang / bal po nas dpe cha 'dra len du 'gro dgos pas nga snga na lo gnyis/ phyi na yang lo gsum la sleb yong bas/ de'i bar la gser sgrubs/ skyid grong nas bsu ba'i chad gyis/ bir+wa pa'i bshad srol rnams 'gyur med du ster ba la gser srang sum cu dang / lam 'bras kyi bshad pa dang / khrid tshang bar ston pa la gser srang lnga brgya 'dod pas/ de rnams 'grub na 'ong ba yin gsungs pa dang / lo tsā bas de legs te gser rkyang du mi 'grub na dngul/ zangs/ rnga ma/ gla rtsi la sogs pa bzhes par zhus shing / sngar gyi lugs yin pas skyid grong nas bsu zhing / de'i bar du skyel ma yang byed pas de'i ring la nga rang min pa zhu sna dang lo tsā mi byed cing / de'i bar gyi 'bul ba byung tshad bdag rang gis bsdus chog pa zhig zhu/ da res dbang mang rab cig ma gnang na rten 'brel 'chugs dogs pas da res kyang lo gcig tsam bzhugs dgos zhus pas/ gzhan rnams de ltar bgyid/ pu hrang nas 'bod mi nam byung dus 'gro gsungs pa dang / de'i nangs par lha rtse'i brag tu gdan 'dren zhus nas zla ba gcig gi bar du dpon slob 'brel brtag pa'i tshul gyis bla ma lnga bcu pa'i tshul gyi 'chad nyan mdzad/

de nas gdams ngag 'dra'i 'go btsugs te khrid zhu zhing 'gyur mdzad nas 'ga' zhig grub pa la zla ba drug na lo tsā ba gzhon nu shes rab mi gsum rta lnga dang bcas te bsu ru byung ba dang / 'brog mis lo paṇa chad byed dgos zhus pas/ paṇ+ḍi tas pu hrangs su lo gcig las mi bzhugs pa/ lo gnyis song ba dang bal po nas bang chen gtong ba/ 'dir phebs nas kyang lo lnga bzhugs pa/ bir+wa pa'i chos skor rnams kyi dkar chag bzhag nas de thams cad tshang mar gnang bar byas/ lo tsā bas kyang skyid grong nas bsu ba/ gser la sogs pa rnams tshang mar 'bul bar byas nas/ sngar gdams pa zhus pa rnams kyi yon du gser srang bcu dang / nam bza' cha tshang zhig phul cing / lo tsā ba dpon slob rnams la yang bsnyen bkur dang 'bul snod zab/ rta gnyis sha mar gyi rgyab dang bcas te bar phug thub skyel ma mdzad la/ de'i dus paṇ+ḍi ta dmar por grags shing / bla chen gyis paṇ+ḍi ta dpon slob rnams gshegs skyel 'khor mo dag pa mkhan slob dang / yon bdag can du byon nas lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ shin tu legs khyed kyi chos rnams nged la'ang zhu/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i bsnyen bskur dang 'bul ba thun mong du byed gsungs pas/ bla chen gyis sngar zhus pa'i gdams pa rnams phul bas khong rnams kyis gser srang sum bcu tsam dang / gzhan nas kyang 'bul ba mang du byung zhing / de nas 'bring mtshams gnam thang dkar por phebs pa nas brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas/ lo gnyis kyi bar la gser mang po phyag tu byung ste tshur 'byon khar a tsa ra gnyis byung nas bla ma ga ya dha ra mang yul du byon yod pas bsu ru shog gsung ba'i 'phrin byung bas shin tu dges te zhag bzhis mang mkhar du phebs pa mdzad nas nangs par mkhan slob yon bdag can du byon te snyan gsan phab pas khong rnams kyang dges nas rta gnyis dang gser srang gsum bskur/ bla ma thugs skyo yi dogs nas a tsa ra gnyis po zla ba gcig nas skyid grong du sleb pa'i 'phrin bskur te 'phral du brdzangs shing /

lo tsā ba dpon slob nyi shu dang btsad po'i blon po dpon g.yog gnyis/ rta brgya dang / mdzo g.yag nyi shu/ dar gdugs rol cha mang po dang bcas nas byon pas skyid grong du bla ma dang mjal/ 'bul ba zhabs tog byas pas bla ma yang mnyes shing / de nas dpon slob rnams kyis byon pa dang mi kun na re/ kha seng gi a tsa ra de rgya gar na mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig 'brog mi lo tsā ba dang / bod kyi btsad pos gdan drangs par 'dug zer nas snyan grags chen po byung zhing / gser srang nyis brgya tsam gyis mgo byas pa'i phyag rdzas phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas mang mkhar mu gu lung du phebs/ rnyed pa rnams kyi phud nas ser chags dang / lung ston cig mdzad/ bla ma la chos zhu ba mgo 'dzugs pa'i rten du gser srang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal phul/ de'i zhag gsum nas sku mtshams bcad de rgyud gsum la sogs pa'i 'gyur dang / lam 'bras la sogs pa'i bshad pa dang / khrid bka' rnams lo gsum la legs par grub par mdzad nas/ khyod la mi dgos kyang nged rang gi byed lugs yin gsungs nas gur mgon gyi gtor ma paṇ+ḍi ta rang gi dbu thog tu bzhag thang sku rgyab la bkal nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi chos skor thams cad dang / gzhan khyod la byin pa'i chos rnams la lhag ma bzhag ri'i dbu bsnyung bzhes nas/ da nga 'gro bas gser rnams blang gsungs pa la/ bla chen gyis sngar chad mdzad pa bzhin lo lnga bzhugs par zhus pas/ khyod kyi chos rnams tshar nas nga ci la sdod/ lo grangs ma tshang ba'i khyed rang gi gser 'phri la phul gsungs pa dang / bla chen gyi thugs dgongs la gser 'phri ba yang mi rung zhing / 'bul ba'ang mang po byung bas thams cad gser rkyang 'bul dgos dgongs nas gzigs pa dang / cung ma tshang 'dug pa la/ de dus zur po shākya 'byung gnas sku bsod che bar yod cing / sngar gyi slob ma'ang yin pas khong can du lo paṇa gyi gsung yig bskur nas gang 'dod pa'i chos sbyin gyi byon nas bang chen btang pas/

khong lha rje mi nyag gi shang mda' sram pa wa gdong gi brag phug tu gdan drangs te bsgrub pa la zhugs pa dang thug nas 'phrin zer du mi 'dod par zhag gsum bsgugs pa dang / sngags pa gzhon nu ma zhig byung nas de la yi ge bskur nas phul bas/ gzhan thams cad kyis bar chad yin zer yang / zur po che na re/ dngos grub yin pas nga 'gro gsungs/ zur chung shes rab grags la bsgrub dpon bskos nas byon te/ bla ma la gser srang brgyad cu tsam gyis mgo byas pa'i 'bul ba phul bas bla chen gyis kyai rdo rje'i dbang bskur nas/ bsam mi khyab kyi khrid gnang bas/ rdzogs chen dang mthun zhing / mtsho skyes kyi bskyed rim zab pa'i tshul dgus brgyan pa gnang bas/ sgyu 'phrul gyi bskyed rim dang mthun/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa nyer bzhi dang / ltung ba nyer gnyis kyi bshad pa mdzad pas/ sgyu 'phrul gyi lam rim dang mthun par byung bas/ zur na re/ bla ma chen po'i bka' drin gyis/ /a po'i sems phyogs nor du song / /zer paṇ+ḍi ta la bla chen gyis gser srang lnga brgya/ gla rtsi stong / rnga ma dkar po mi rab kyi 'dom re yod pa bcu gcig la sogs pa'i 'bul ba byas pas paṇ+ḍi ta shin tu mnyes nas/ da khyod ci 'dod pa ster ro gsungs/ sngar gyi chos rnams kyi lhag ma zhu zhing / gzhan man ngag zab mo 'dra yod na'ang zhu zhus/ sngar gyi chos rnams la lhag ma yod ri kha sang mna' bskyal ba de yin/ gzhan ma man ngag zab mo sbas pa'ang med/ gzhan ci 'dod gsungs/ 'o rkyen glo bur du drag po byung na brjed kyis dogs pas rdo rje'i tshig rkang lung skor lnga dang bcas pa la brjed tho'i yig chung 'khrugs bsdebs shing / lam gyi mtshan dmigs bsal dang bcas pa zhig zhu zhus pas/ des na 'di ma yin pa'i gnas dben pa gzhan zhig tu mtshams dam po bcad/ tshogs 'khor rgyun mi chad pa gyis gsungs pa dang / de'i nub mo mtshan phyed tsam nas phur dgon du gdan drangs te gsung ltar bsgrubs pas/

tshoms rnams mdzad nas da ci 'dod gsungs pa la/ da ci 'dra zhig dgos pa yin nam snyam nas bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin tshom dang bcas pa'i gsung ngag rin po che 'di bod du gzhan la mi gsungs pa zhig zhu zhus pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal nas/ khyod rang lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'gro zhing / gdung brgyud kyis bstan pa'i bdag po byed pa cig yong rgyu yin pa la/ bus rten 'brel 'chugs pas ci 'dra yong ngam/ da 'pho ba sbyongs shig lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'gro/ gdams pa tshar ba'i bu brgyud rnams la lo bcu gsum nyams su ma blangs par gzhan la mi spel ba'i bka' rgya sdoms/ zas nor gyi sgo nas snod brtag pa gal che gsungs pas/ de ltar bgyid par zhus te/ lo tsā bas kyang la stod thang chung bar bskyal cing / de nas skyid grong bar du skyel mi btang ste paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid lan gcig rgya gar la byon pa yin zhing / des na rje ga ya dha ra de bod du lan gsum byon par grags pas/ de yang dang po ni bla ma dang yi dam gyis lung bstan pa la brten nas bla chen 'brog mi la gsung ngag rin po che'i la sogs pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i chos skor rnams gsung du byon pa yin/ gnyis pa ni 'gos kyis de dus rgya gar na grub chen mai tri par grags che bar byas nas/ de gdan 'dren du se shes rab smon lam dang gnyis kyis ldum bu ba byas/ gser thod pa bam ril gyi nang du bcug tshon gyis khra bor byas nas khur nas byon pa dang / rgya gar gyi mtha' 'khob cig tu paṇ+ḍi ta'i cha lugs can rma bya'i gdugs dang rlung g.yab 'dzin mi gcig gdan dang khres po 'khur mi zhig ste gsum byung ba/ 'phrad pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta de na re/ khyod gang du 'gro ci 'tshol zer ba la/ bdag gnyis ma ga dha ra mai tri pa 'tshol du 'gro byas pas/ mai tri pa nga yin ci byed zer/ bod du gdan 'dren byas pas/ rung gsungs pa dang /

de nas zhag 'ga' phyag phyir 'brangs nas 'brel gtam byas pas/ chos shin tu mkhas par 'dug pa dang / gser srang bdun gyi maṇ+ḍal phul te/ lo tsā ba dpon slob gnyis sngon la bsu ba'i chas len du yong pas/ tshong 'dus shig tu slebs tsa na/ bod kyi tshong pa mang po 'dug pa kun mthun par kha sing gi ldum bu ba 'dra song pa de pa lo tsā bas gser mang po khyer nas paṇ+ḍi ta bos 'ong gin yod par 'dug zer nas mon rnams lam kha thams cad na bsgugs 'dug pas khyed gnyis kyis lam 'di la mgo mi 'thon zer bas/ gser rnams byang smad pa'i tshong dpon dpal zhes bya ba zhig la bcol nas byon par chas pa dang / se na re/ bla ma dkrong na bod mun pa'i smag rum du 'gro bas/ dpon slob gnyis cha lugs brje'o zer te de ltar byas 'ongs pas/ lo tsā ba ngo ma shes shing / se bla ma'i phyogs su lus btang pa'i byin rlabs dang sems bskyed bzang bas mon rnams kyis ma mthong bar lam la mgo thon nas byon pas/ bla ma'i ched du lus srog gtong nus se smon lam shes rab lta bu zer ba yang byung / de nas 'gos dpon slob rta ba bcus paṇ+ḍi ta bsus nas byon pa'i tshe/ paṇ+ḍi tas 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i lo rgyus zhib tu dris pas/ 'gos the tshom zos nas/ nyid ga ya dha ra lags sam zhus pas/ yin gsungs/ 'o na bla mas nga la mgo skor btang byas pas/ khyod chos 'dod pa ma yin nam/ chos ni mai tra pa las nga mkhas pa yin/ nga 'brog mi can na yod dus/ khyod na re nga la de 'dra rgya gar na gha po bya ba bzang bskrun 'dra byed pa'i lto 'tshol ba zhig yin/ rgya gar gyi 'bri klog khyob pe ba cig las gzhan ci yang mi shes/ 'brog glen pa de la paṇ+ḍi ta des chog zer gi 'dug kyang / 'brog dang 'gos mi mnyam/ khyod la mi dgos na khyed rang gi gser phyir gtad la dbus su phyin pas chog gsungs/ 'gos kyis de skad byas pa de bla ma la ma dad pa ma yin kyang bzod par gsol te gser srang gang gi maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'byon par zhus pas/

spyir gyi 'brog dang khyed gnyis dpon slob tu 'dug pa la dam tshig mi bsrung bar chags sdang gis bsgyur ba'i chags sdang gi phan mi thogs te 'o na 'gro 'gro/ ldeng ldeng gsungs nas byon te/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor cha lag tshang bar gsungs shing 'gyur yang mang po mdzad/ 'gos kyis kyang gser srang drug cu tsam phul/ de nas skabs shig tu nya rir zur po che shākya 'byung gnas kyis lo paṇa gsum ka gdan drangs pas 'brog mi dang mjal na mar paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ lo tsā thams cad 'brog mis gyis gsungs nas mdzad pas/ 'gos dpon slob shin tu ma rangs par/ paṇ+ḍi ta la lo tsā nyin re tsam byed par zhus pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta mang po cig bzhad nas lar bod 'di la bzang byas pa ngan du go bar gda'/ lo tsā thams cad khyod la bcol bas chog ste/ khyod gnyis 'gras 'dug pas/ kho'i rtsa ru khyod kyi lo tsā mi 'gyur/ nga paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pas sngar gyi 'gyur rnams ni legs nas yod pas kho la yang bstan pas chog khos lo tsā byed pa la khyod kyis skyon gcig kyang mi zin/ khyod rang khos skyon 'dzin pa la mi skrag na de ring nas lo tsā byed du bcug pas chog gsungs pas/ 'gos kyis lo tsā byed ma nus shing / de'i rjes su chos 'khor rnams thon nas lo paṇa rnams kyis tshong 'dus 'gur mo gzigs su byon pa dang / der 'brog mis kyai rdor gyi dbang zhig zhus pa'i dbang gral du 'gos ma tshud pa la/ de'i sang paṇ+ḍi tas 'gos la bla ma ngan pa'i dbang bskur las nga'i bum chu 'di dga' bas khrus gyis gsungs bum chu gnang / de nas paṇ+ḍi ta 'gos kyis skyid grong bar du bskyal nas rgya gar la byon pa ni bar ma yin la/ de'i dus 'gos la kyai rdo rje'i rgyud kyi bshad pa dang / gsang 'dus sogs ma gtogs gsung ngag ni ma gnang ste/ lo paṇa zur po che shākya 'byung gis nya rir gdan drangs dus mjal ba'i tshe/ 'brog gi thugs dgongs la bla mas 'gos la gsung ngag gnang yod dam snyam nas thugs dam dang 'gal bar mchis so zhus pas/

khyed rang la dam tshig gi nyes pa byung nyen yod/ kho ni gzhung gis tshim nas gdams ngag gi rtsad tsam yang mi gcod par 'dug gsungs/ zhes 'byung bas de dus gsung ngag ma gnang bar gsal zhing / yang de'i rjes su gyi jo zla ba'i 'od kyis pu hrang brgyud nas gdan drangs/ bsnyen bskur zhabs tog cher byas nas chos mang du zhus shing / de nas gyi jo ba'i slob ma la gnyos 'byung po bya bas kha rag tu gdan drangs nas 'bul ba dang / zhabs tog chen po byas shing / lo tsā ba gzhon ban shes rab bya ba zhig gis gser srang drug cu tsam phul kyang / dang po 'brog mi'i dus kyi gser tsam paṇ+ḍi tas rnyed ma myong bar thams cad kha 'cham la/ de nas paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal nas/ da dge sbyor byed pa la bod 'di chu bzang zhing bsil drod snyoms srog chags nyung la zas bcud che bas rgya gar du mi 'gro/ gser mang po'ang mi 'dod/ chos kyang mang po bshad mi khom gsungs nas thugs dam mdzad pa'i zhar la dus 'khor gyi 'gyur zhig mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'brog de yod na pha dang bu gnyis bsgrub pa stabs su byed pa yin te/ kho ni mkha' spyod du song 'dug gsungs shing / 'bul ba ci byung thams cad dge phyogs su btang nas lo 'ga' song ba dang / paṇ+ḍi ta la grongs ltas byung bas/ da 'dir mi sdod/ nga rang gi bu tsha bo rnams thod phu na yod pas der skyol gsungs pa la/ gnyos kyis ya gi na 'brog mi'i slob ma 'phags pa chos snang bya ba dang / 'brom des pa ston chung gi slob ma se rog gnyis zer ba'i sgom chen rmongs pa 'dra las ni med/ de rnams kyang bla ma rang bu legs mod zhus pas/ des mi phan pa zhig yod/ nga ma bskyal na dam tshig la sel 'ong ngo gsungs pa dang / khong rnams kyis kyang bla ma'i gsung bzhin kha rag thod phur gdan drangs pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ 'o dkon mchog rten khroms la mchod pa shoms/ dam tshig ma nyams pa rnams tshogs 'khor gyis gsungs nas de bzhin du bsgrubs pas/

thams cad yo byad kyis tshim pa dang / lus gnad bcas rdor dril thugs kar bsnol nas bu kun sgrub pa la ma g.yel bar byas nas bsgom dgos pa yin/ ngas rgya bod la phar 'gro tshur 'gro dang / bshad pa la 'byams nas sgrub pa la nan tan cher ma khom kyang / rnal 'byor pa 'chi na 'di ltar byed pa yin gsungs nas dbugs thog gsum la tshangs bug nas 'od ril ma tsam gcig thon pa'i dbus na he ru ka'i sku shin tu gsal zhing / rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dang / ma tog gi char dang / gzhan yang 'ja' 'od dpag tu med pa dang bcas te lho nub kyi phyogs su song ba bar thang pa'i mi thams cad kyis mngon sum du mthong bar grags pa yin pas/ de rnams ni bod du dang por ga dha ras srol btod ces pa las 'phros nas bla ma de nyid kyi rnam thar mdo tsam dang bcas pa rnams kyi dpal bir+wa pa'i gdams ngag lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i chos skor rnams bod du dang por byung ba'i tshul rags pa tsam yin la/ des na paṇ+ḍi ta des bod du gsung ngag ni dang po bla chen 'brog mi la gnang ba ma gtogs/ 'gos dang gyi jos spyan drangs pa'i dus gnyis su gnang ba'i lo rgyus ni spyi lam pa la yongs su grags pa ltar/ rje btsun gyi bla ma rgya bod kyi lo rgyus su'ang mi 'byung zhing / khyad par du dmar gyis mdzad pa'i zhib mo rdo rje dang / bla ma dam pa'i ngo mtshar snang ba dang / cha rgan dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyis byas pa'i lam 'bras kyi lo rgyus sogs su/ ga ya dha ra bod du phebs pa'i phyi ma gnyis kyi dus su gtan ma gnang ba de ka 'dug pas des na sngar 'brog mi la bod du gsung ngag 'di gzhan su la'ang mi gsungs pa'i dam bca' mdzad pas na de dus rang ma gsungs pa 'dra zhing / 'on kyang rdo rje 'chang gi chos 'byung du/ gyi jo'i dus su lam 'bras ni ma gsungs so/ /zhes 'brom lugs pa dang / zha ma lugs pa rnams zer yang / gsung ngag gi gdams ngag rdzogs pa zhig yod par snang ste/

gyi jos bsgyur ba'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang / de'i slob brgyud rnams kyis byas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang / bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi sogs yod pas zhes gsungs shing / rang phyogs kyi zin bris kha cig na/ 'gos la ma gnang zer yang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi dbang gi rab dbye la 'gos 'gyur yod pas cung zad gnang ba 'dra zer ba'ang 'dug lam 'bras pa rnams kyis gang dag dpyad ni dgos kyang / de rnams ga ya dha ras 'gos jo gnyis gsungs pa rang gi sgrub byed rnam dag tu 'gro ba ni dka'/ gang ltar yang bla chen 'brog mi nyid kyis jo bo ga ya dha ra la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i chos skor rnams gsan pa'i tshul de ltar du yin la/ gal te 'o na rje btsun sa paṇa gyis/ lam 'bras la sogs lam skor dgu/ /zhes dang / yang rje bas/ lam skor dgu ni khyad par ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'brog mi'i lam 'bras rtsa ba dang bcas pa'i bshad pa dang / man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra la gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad pa yin mod/ lam skor gzhan rnams paṇa grub su dang su la gsan pa yin zhe na/ de la dang po grub chen mtsho skyes kyis brtag pa gnyis pa la brten nas mdzad pa'i rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i gdams ngag dang / yang slob dpon klu sgrub kyis gsang ba 'dus pa la brten nas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems 'grel zhes kyang bya/ de'i sras kyi mchog ar+ya de wa la mchod rten gyi drung du sems thag gcod pa'i phyir du gnang ba'i mchod rten drung thob tu grags pa te de ni rdo rje theg pa gsang sngags kyi lam ni smin grol gnyis yin pas/ lta ba la 'bad pas ci zhig bya snyam pa'i log rtog dgag pa'i phyir du byang chub sems 'grel lam/ mchod rten drung thob brtsams zhes ma ma kha cig gsungs la/ gang ltar yang lam de dang / grub chen tog rtse bas sam+bu ṭa la brten nas mdzad pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa la lngas lam yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i man ngag dang /

slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes bde mchog la brten nas dpyid kyi thig le zhes pa mkha' 'gro ma'i brda'i skad du o la pa ti zhes 'byung zhing / ding sang gtum mo lam rdzogs su grags pa de dang / slob dpon nag po u tsi ṭa 'chi ba med pas ma rgyud mtha' dag la brten nas rlung btsan thabs su dbu mar 'jug pa'i gdams ngag yon po bsrang ba zhes bya ba ste/ de yang rtsa yon po ro rkyang gnyis/ sems yon po gzung 'dzin gnyis/ rlung yon po ldang 'jug gnyis te de rnams dbu mar stobs su byed pa'i thabs yin zhing / de ni slob dpon de nyid kyi gdams pa zab mo cung zad las/ lam yongs su rdzogs pa ni ma yin kyang / slob dpon des mdzad pa'i lam de dang lnga ni dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje dang / rje ga dha ras gnyis char la gsan cing bsgyur pa yin la/ yang sangs rgyas kyi dngos slob in+d+ra bo dhi chen pos ye shes thig le'i rgyud la brten pa gang zag dbang po rnon po'am/ sa khams shas che ba'i gang zag gtso bor chags lam bgrod pa'i dbang du byas nas phyag rgyas lam yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i gdams ngag mdzad pas de dang / grub chen ḍom+bhi he ru kas kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum la brten nas mdzad pa'i rdzogs rim lhan cig skyes pa chos gsum gyis lam rdzogs par grub pa zhes bya ba gnyis paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab gsang ba la gsan cing / slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa zhes bya ba'i gdams ngag ni paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha la gsan cing gdams ngag 'di brtag gnyis dang / gsang ba 'dus pa gnyis ka la brten nas mdzad pa yin kyang / 'di'i byin rlabs bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i sgo nas byed pas kyai rdo rje'i chos skor du bsdus shing / de rnams las yon po bsrang ba ma gtogs/ gzhan drug po lam yongs su rdzogs pa re re ni yin la/ de yang lam 'bras kyi man ngag lta bu ma yin mod kyang /

bla chen 'brog mi nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas bla ma gong ma rnams thugs rtsis che zhing / lung khrid tshun chad kyi sgo nas ma nyams par yod pas na skabs 'dir zur tsam zhig smos pa yin la/ de dag gi sdom ni/ rje btsun grags pa'i gsung gis/ sgo bsrung dpe rnying / rje btsun dngos kyi phyag bris nyid la yod ces bla ma gong ma rnams gsungs/ /zhing pa'i bya ba rtog rtse pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /slob dpon mtsho skyes bzhin du zab pa'i tshul spyod pa/ /ḍom+bhi he ru ka bas kyang lhan cig skyes pa grub/ dpal ldan /nag po spyod pa khro zhing gtum pas ni/ /nag po u tsi tra 'chi ba med pa mtha' gnyis g.yo ba dbu ma'i lam bcug nas/ /'phags pa klu sgrub bzhin du sems thag chod par 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i in+d+ra bo dhi tshul du btsun mo'i tshogs bsten na/ /yi ge med dang slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug thob/ /ces gsungs shing / des na lam 'bras la sogs pa'i lam skor dgu bod du dar bar mdzad mkhan ni 'brog mi lo tsā ba chen po de nyid yin pas/ de'i rjes su gsung ngag rin po che 'di bar du 'brog mis spel ba'i tshul 'di byung bas/ de yang spyir gyi bla chen jo bo thugs rje chen po dang / bla ma rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas spangs rtogs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mnga' la/ khyad par du bla ma yi dam gyi lung bstan rnams thog tu phebs shing 'grub pas gsan pa rgya mtshos thugs tshim nas/ da bshad pa zhig byed dgos dgongs pa'i dus shig gi tshe/ dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje da nangs dpal gyi ri nas 'ongs gsungs nas dro ma ran tsam la mu gu lung du byon byung ba la phyag mchod bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas nas byon pa bka' drin che/ ci don du gnyer nas bsgrub par byon zhus pas/

bod kyi gangs blta ba dang / khyod la'ang sgro 'dogs gcod rgyu 'dra bag tsam 'dug pa gcod pa la 'ongs gsungs nas zla ba gcig tsam bzhugs/ dogs pa 'ga' zhig bcad cing / bzang po yongs gzung / rin chen 'bar ba/ bstod pa nyi shu pa la sogs pa gzhung phran 'ga' zhig bsgyur nas/ dgong zhig u rgyan na bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i ro gcig la tshogs 'khor bya ba'i phyir du rig 'dzin grub thob/ mkha' 'gro srung ma dpag tu med pa 'tshogs par 'dug pas nga 'gro gsungs pas/ 'brog mis gser srang lnga bcu'i maṇ+ḍal phul bas/ 'di 'dra 'dod na rgya mtsho'i gling phran 'ga' zhig na yang mang po gda' gsungs nas phyag gis reg pa zhig mdzad de ji ltar 'os par longs chod gsungs nas nyi zer gyi lam la gshegs zer/ yang de nas zhag 'ga' song ba dang / me tri pa gnyis med rdo rje byon pa la phyag mchod byas nas byon pa legs/ ci don du gnyer bsgrub par zhu zhus pas/ spyod pa skyong ba dang / khyod la man ngag 'dra skyel du 'ong gsungs/ des kyang zla ba gcig bzhugs nas man ngag 'ga' re gnang zhing / mkha' spyod ma'i chos skor kha re yang bsgyur bas/ dben par bzhugs kyang lha rnams kyis bsgrags te rdo rje snying po byon pa tsam gyi grags pa byung bas/ phyogs mtha' dag nas chos zhu ba la yong zer bang chen mang po byung bas/ chos gsung par zhu zhus pas nga mi khom dpal gyi ri la 'gro gsungs nas sang nam langs tsa na bltas pas phyi sgo la sgo lcags bcug pa khrol le bzhud 'dug cing / de'i dus su yang bla chen la nyams rtogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'khrungs la/ gzhan yang spyir gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po yin zhing / bskyed rim la brtan pa thob ste/ lus gcig nas gnyis su sprul pa dang / sbyin sreg gi thab nas yo byad len nus/ rlung gi nus pas nam mkha' la skyil krung bca' nus shing / bsam na shes pa'i mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa de lta bu'i 'brog mi lo tsā ba chen po de la spyir dbus gtsang khams gsum na slob ma dang nying slob bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa las/
