mchog tu gyur pa ni/ rgyud tshar ba/ man ngag tshar ba/ grub pa thob pa rnams su yod pa las/ de yang rgyud tshar ba'i slob ma la man ngag mi ston/ man ngag tshar ba'i slob ma la rgyud mi bshad pa bla ma de'i lugs yin pas/ de la rgyud tshar ba'i slob ma ni/ rje btsun gyi bla ma bod kyi lo rgyus dang / dmar gyi zhib mo rdo rje dang / rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba sogs su/ g.ya' lung gi 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ 'phrang 'og gi dprad ston dkon mchog rgyal po/ lha rtse'i gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ shangs kyi brag rtse so nag pa/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po ste lnga tsam gsungs shing / lo rgyus kha cig tu de'i steng du nya ri'i zur po che shākya 'byung dang drug tu byas pa'ang 'dug la/ man ngag tshar ba ni thams cad mthun par 'brom des pa ston chung / lha btsun ka ba li/ se ston kun rig dang gsum mo/ /gsum pa grub pa thob pa'i slob ma 'di la yang sngar bshad pa'i lo rgyus de rnams su/ gtsang smad pa dgyer bsgom se'o/ rta nag pa gsher bsgom rog po/ 'phan yul pa dbus pa grod po che ste pho gsum dang / mo bzhi ste bdun tsam las ma gsung la/ yang lo rgyus gcig tu pho gsum po de'i steng du cog ro gzhong pa 'bri lce shākya brtson dang / phad drug pa phyug gtsang mthong rgol bya ba gnyis bsnan nas pho lnga dang / mo bzhi ni sngar gyi rnams dang mthun par 'phan yul gyi mched mo nam mkha'/ mang mkhar stong po ba stod mo rdo rje mtsho/ g.ya' mkhar ba dbrad mo dkon ne/ tsha mo rong pa shab pa mo jo lcam rgyal mtshan dang bzhi ste dgu ru byed pa'ang yod/ gang ltar na'ang / dang po gzhung tshar ba rnams kyi nang nas thugs sras dam par gyur pa ni g.ya' lung gi 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po zhes bya ba de yin pas/ de nyid kyi lo rgyus cung zad cig brjod na/ bla ma de ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul 'od gsal lha las babs pa'i gdung brgyud yin te/

de yang dang po gnam lha mched gsum byon pa'i bar ba g.yu ring la sras ma sangs spun bdun zer ba byung ba'i chung shos ma sangs spyi rje bya ba'i sras thog tsha dpa' bo stag de'i sras klu tsha rta po 'od can/ de'i sras g.ya' spang skyes te de yan la 'od gsal lha'i gdung brgyud ces pa'i tha snyad byed ces kha cig zer/ de nas g.ya' spang skyes kyi sras 'khon bar skyes/ de'i sras kyi mtshan dang po dkon pa rje khug stag dang / phyis bod kyi chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi nang blon mdzad pas/ de'i ring la chos dang 'jig rten gyi dpal 'byor dang longs spyod shin tu che bar byung bas thams cad kyis 'khon dpal po cher btags pa de la ngo mtshar snang ba nyi lde ba mus srad pa/ rang re'i chos 'byung rnams su sras khri mdzes lha legs/ tshe la dbang phyug klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ tshe 'dzin sras rdo rje rin chen yin par mdzad kyang / de rnams re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag nas/ 'dir rje btsun rin po che'i gsung bzhin du brjod na/ 'khon dpal po che'i sras klu'i dbang po yin la/ de'i gcung po 'khon rdo rje rin chen/ de'i sras shes rab yon tan/ de'i sras yon tan 'byung gnas/ de'i sras tshul khrims rgyal po/ de'i sras rdo rje gtsug tor/ de'i sras dge skyabs/ de'i sras dge mthong / de'i sras bal po/ de'i sras shākya blo gros/ de rnams ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung lugs dang / rdo rje theg pa gsang ba sde drug le lag bdun/ phra mo nyi shu rtsa gcig gtso bor bzung nas spyod pas rtsis kyi chos drug ces bya ste/ de'i man ngag dang ldan zhing / yang dag gi bsgrub pa dang / rdo rje phur pa'i yi dam gyi sgo nas dngos grub thob pa yin zhing / shākya blo gros la sras gnyis te/ gcen po 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims zhes pa ni/ yab mes kyi chos de dag gis thugs rgyud sbyangs shing /

rdo rje phur pa'i sgo nas dngos grub brnyes te mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan la tshangs par spyod pas mdzes par byas pa yin zhing / de'i gcung dge ba'i bshes gnyen dkon mchog rgyal po zhes bya ba de yin pas/ de nyid yab mes kyi chos la man ngag dang / sgrub thabs phra mo tsam gyis tshim par mdzad nas/ gsang sngags phyi 'gyur la thugs spro bar gyur pa na/ de'i tshe gcen 'khon rog de nyid gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos la gsang sgrogs byed mkhan byung bas thugs 'byung nas/ gcung dkon mchog rgyal po la mang mkhar gyi 'brog mi lo tsā ba bya bas gsang sngags gsar ma zhes pa'i rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ man ngag gi rgyud zab mo bskol nas dum bur phyung ba'i rgyud dang 'grel pa 'dra min mang po cha lag dang bcas pa bsgyur yod par 'dug pa/ ngas dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas/ khyod kyis gsang sngags gsar ma bslabs na gzhan don rgya chen po 'grub par 'dug pas 'brog can song gsungs pa dang / a jo rgyal le dang gnyis kyis yo byad 'dra bsnams nas byon pa'i lam du paṇ+ḍi ta'i cha lugs can gyi rta pa gcig la ban+dhe bzhis bskor ba zhig byung ba dang mjal bas dad pa dang yid skyo shas dung pa zhig byung ste/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba a yin bsams nas khyod gang nas byon/ da gang du gshegs/ mtshan ci lags dris pas/ nga mu khu lung nas 'ongs/ sbal phug tu 'gro/ ming sbal ti lo tsā ba bya ba yin/ la las khyin lo dang / tshur lo tsā ba'ang zer/ nyid su yin/ gar 'gro/ grwa pa ci 'dra na gsungs/ nga g.ya' lung nas yin/ mu khu lung du 'gro/ bla ma 'brog mi la mjal kha gda'am dris pas/ nga khong gi lo chung zhig yin/ do nub khyod kyis der mi sleb pas nged can du gshegs/ khyod la gros 'dra byed rgyu zhig yang gda' yi gsungs pa dang / khong can du byon nas lo rgyus zhib tu byung bas/ khyod grwa pa'i rtsis su 'dug ste/

nged kyi bla ma chos kyi che ba byung ba dang / gang zag gi snod brtag pa'i phyir du nor mang po bzhed pas/ khyod kyi 'di 'dra la ni mjal kha'ang mi 'ong / nga la khyod dang 'brel ba'i rmi ltas bzang po zhig kyang byung bas/ tha mar khyod la bla ma'i bu chen rab cig yong bar 'dug khyod rnying ma ba yin kyang / ngas gsar ma ba'i dge bshes shig bcos nas nga bla ma dang mjal du 'gro ba'i dus zla la phyin te/ 'dris nas sgro 'dogs bla ma la bcad na mi legs sam gsungs pas/ do nub bdag gis bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba btab la sang snga dro snga gros zhu lags zhus pas/ des nan ltar 'thad/ chos pa'i lugs yin pas ngas kyang de ltar bya'o gsungs/ de nas 'tsher du byon te chang cung zad cig nyos nas yi dam gyi 'phrin bsgrub bsdus pa zhig byas/ gsol ba dung pa zhig btab ste dmod bor nas gzim pas/ srod la tshab 'tshub 'ga' byung / nam gung la mnal lam ya mtshan can 'ga' zhig byung nas/ tho rangs gnyug ma lhun grub 'od gsal du gyur/ nam seng langs pa dang lo tsā ba'i drung du 'bod mi byung ba dang byon te/ phyag btsal bas phyag lan mdzad byung pa la mi mdzad pa zhu zhus pas/ phyag phar btsal kyang theg par gda'/ nged la yang mtshan ltas bzang po byung / khyod la yang mtshan ltas bzang po byung ngam gsungs/ rmi ltas bzang zhing bla ma'i gsung rnams kyang sems la 'phrod par byung / 'on kyang bdag gi phu bo de bla ma'ang yin zhing bdag rang yang mos par yod pas/ khong gis dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas mtshan ltas dang bstun te bla chen 'brog mi can song gsungs nas yong pa legs pas khong la yang zhu yig cig gtong / bkas gnang byung na bla chen 'brog mi la'ang chos 'brel zhig zhus/ slob gnyer 'di ru byas na 'thad bsam gyin gda' zhus pas/ skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid de lta bu yin/ bla ma la'ang zhu ba gyis gsungs pa dang / bla ma gcen gyi drung du de rnams gang 'thad kyi zhu yig 'bul ba la a jo rgyal le btang bas/

bla mas rten 'brel legs par gda' ste/ chos kyi 'phro la bar chad cig yong nyen 'dug pas rim gro sogs la brtson par mdzad pa dang / bla chen gyi drung du yang sngon la chos 'brel zhig yod par mdzod/ de nas ci byed khyed rang mkhyen gsungs pa cig byung ba dang / bla ma lo tsā ba la de kho na ltar zhus pas/ rten 'brel nan ltar bzang bar gda' yis brtson 'grus skyed cig gsungs/ lo tsā ba khong la rab byung gsum gsang nas dbang zhu ba'i rten 'brel sgrig pa dang dus 'dzoms te/ dbang bskur zhus pas slob ma kha yar ba zhig dgos gsungs nas rab byung gsum po g.yas gral la bzhag 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po nyid g.yon gral du bzhag nas cho ga cha gnyis su mdzad de gnang ba'i sta gon gyi nub mo mnal lam du sgron me btegs pas 'dzam bu'i gling khra lam ste mthong ba dang / phag chen po gcig gis ded pas skrag nas brag ri chen po gcig la 'dzegs pa dang phag de brag la 'dril nas dum bur song ba la snying rje drag po skyes shing / gzhan yang bla ma lo tsā ba nad mang pa bshal gyin 'dug pa de phyag gis phyis pa'i shul thams cad rin po che sna tshogs su song ba rmis pa la sogs pa byung zhing / de nas dbang thob pa dang sgrub thabs rgyas pa cha lag dang bcas pa byang po zhig byas te mgo bsnyen bskyal tshar ba dang / bla chen gyi drung du lo tsā ba'i phyag phyi byas phyin pas sleb ma thog la mjal kha byung nas gser zho gang phyag tu phul bas/ skra nas bzung ste yas su yin gsungs/ rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ gsar ma'i dbang thob bam gsungs/ kyai rdor gyi dbang bla ma sbal las thob zhus pas/ mngon rtogs bsgom shes sam gsungs/ shes lags zhus pas 'o na sdod cig tshogs bsog pa cig yod kyi/ lar mi gzhan gyi mgo la reg pa bas/ jo sras 'di'i mgo la reg pa nyams myong che ba zhig byung gsungs shing / yang de nyid kyi skye ba sngon ma dran nam gsungs/

mi dran lags zhus pas/ rgya gar shar phyogs 'u 'u ri nas bram ze paṇ+ḍi ta gsungs nas dar cig zhal rog pa bzhugs nas/ slob dpon sbal gyi slob ma bzang / sbal phug tu khyod dpon slob 'dra bas 'chad nyan byed pa ya mtshan che gsungs la/ sbal gyis kyang gser zho gang gi maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bla ma'i bka' srol gyi dang por chos sgo 'byed/ bar du dam tshig gso/ tha mar rtogs pa bskyed pa'i ched du dbang bskur ba'i lugs bzhin sang nub jo sras 'di'ang 'dzud par zhu zhus pas/ khong yang yang gsol ba btab pa zhig legs pas rung gsungs pa dang / jo sras la sa dang po thob ba tsam gyi dga' spro skye shing / de'i nub kyang gnyug ma 'od gsal du song / de nas kyai rdor gyi dbang thob nas byin rlabs zhus pas/ slob dpon sbal la rgyud shod pa'i dus su rgyun du zin thun gyis/ khyod kyi slob ma'i tha ma 'di sngar gyi slob ma thams cad las dga' ba yin gsungs/ de nas sbal phug tu phebs pa'i nub mo dbang bskur tha ma zhig mdzad/ sang nyin nas rgyud btsugs te rgyun du zin thun mdzad nas gsan pa yin te/ de yang lo rgyus kha cig tu/ lo gnyis la rgyud gsum ka tshar bcu gsungs pas bla ma bas mi zhan pa mkhyen/ de nas kyang gsung ba'i rtsis yin pa la/ bla ma sbal glo bur du 'ja' 'od rol mo dang bcas te mkha' spyod du gshegs zer ba 'dug kyang / ngo mtshar snang ba sogs phal che ba na/ dang po rgyud gsung ba'i 'phro la bla ma sbal glo bur du gshegs pa yin zhes 'byung bas/ dang por lo tsā ba'i zhal chems dang / phyis 'brog mi'i gsung dang bstun na phyi ma 'thad pa 'dra'o/ /de'i rjes su dgongs rdzogs 'phral du bsgrubs 'os pa rnams bsgrub nas cha rkyen lhag ma rnams dril bas rta bcu bdun khal dang bcas pa byung ba bla chen la 'bul du phyin pas/ bu'i shod 'phro bshad kyi nyon gsungs bas/ bla chen gyi drung du rgyud gsum yongs su rdzogs par gsan nas man ngag zhus pa na/

dam bca' zhig byas yod pas lam 'bras ni sbyin mi btub la/ 'on kyang khyod kyi bu tsha bo rnams nga'i chos kyi bdag por 'gyur bar bya'o gsungs nas lam skor gzhan rnams gnang / de nas tshur byon te gra bo lung par dgon chung zhig brtsigs nas kyai rdor gyi rgyud la sogs par ci rigs pa gsungs shing / khyad par du rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis mi bcu bdun tsam la mtshan ltas dang bstun nas bshad pa/ bla chen gyis gsan pa dang / rgyud gnyan po mi de tsam la shod pa khyod la rdo rje'i srog pa rtsa grub bam gsungs pa'i bka' gnang ba'ang byung zhing / yang thugs dam mdzad nas bzhugs pa'i tho rangs shig mnal lam ya mtshan can zhig byung nas/ nyin gung ri logs na phar skyo sangs la byon pas/ dpon po ri'i logs sa dkar po'i g.yas gshong pa zhig na rma bya'i gdugs chen po gser gyi tog can phub pa zhig la nag nyer ba'i 'khor gyir bskor ba chos 'chad pa'i rnam pa can zhig 'dug pa dang / sa dkar po la nyi ma'i mdangs phog pas snum la 'od 'phro zhing / byang mkha' lding dang rus sbal bsnol ba/ nub rma bya/ shar glang chen/ lho 'brug lta bu la phyogs mtshams thams cad nas mdzes pa'i ri 'dus pa/ rgya dkar nag gi mtshams chu phyogs bzhir 'bab pa/ mtha' thams cad kyang gangs ri'i dpal dang ldan pas bskor ba zhig 'dug pa dang / rten 'brel shin tu bzang bar gzigs nas de'i sa cha rnams skor sa de la su dbang che dris pas/ spyir btsad po/ sgos zhang zhung / yang sgos sras bsgom g.yu ru 'bar la sogs pa'i ban+dhe grong bzhir dbang che zer/ 'dir dgon chung zhig brtsigs nas bsdad na khyed rnams la ko long yong mi yong 'dri ba la sras bsgom pa g.yu rung 'bar btang bas/ de thams cad na re/ bzhugs na zhabs tog byed do zer bas/ de ltar na khyed rnams la sa cha'i rin spyi ru 'jal byas pas/ thams cad kyis rin mi dgos zer ba la/ bla mas rin yang len par zhu/

zhabs tog byed na'ang blangs pas chog gsungs pa dang / khong rnams kyis de yang 'thad pas gang dges mdzod zer bas/ sa cha'i rin du rgod ma dkar mo gcig nor bu'i phreng ba brgya rtsa gcig khrab gcig mo gos gcig rnams thams cad la spyi ru gnang bas/ khong yon mchod rnams kyis kyang de bas lhag pa'i shangs len la sogs pa zhabs tog gang dgos pa byas nas/ ban+dhe grong bzhi'i gang zag tu byas te grog po gnyis kyi bar du spyil po tho re ba zhig dang / bla ma dkon mchog rgyal pos dgung lo bzhi bcu bzhes pa chu mo glang gi lo ston zla ra ba'i tshes la/ gzim spyil dkar po la sogs pa brtsigs nas dpal ldan sa skya'i 'gram btab ste/ thugs dam la gtso bor mdzad pa'i ngang nas skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams la chos kyi 'chad nyan dang / khyad par du yang bla ma se ston kun rig la rgyud gsungs pa yin te/ de yang bla ma ses bla chen 'brog la gsung ngag rin po che yongs su rdzogs pa gsan tshar nas rgyud zhus pas/ bla chen gyi zhal nas/ dge bshes dkon mchog rgyal po de nga'i rgyud tshar ba'i slob ma rnams kyi mchog yin/ man ngag tshar ba'i mchog se ston kun rig yin/ khyod gnyis ka'i bla ma'i mchog nga yin pas/ mchog gi mchog la mchog gtad do/ rten 'brel mchog tu gyur pas gzhan don mchog tu gyur pa zhig sgrubs shig bya ba'i gsung shog gnang ste mang mkhar nas sa skyar byon nas gsung shog phul bas/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i gsung gis/ 'o skol gnyis kyi bla ma de nges par rdo rje 'chang yin pas 'o skol la 'di lta bu'i gsung shog 'byon pa/ 'u cag grogs mched gnyis a re dga' gsungs shing / se'i phyag nas bzung 'then 'then mdzad/ nye gnas la dam tshig thob la ma nyams pa rnams gdan drongs la bsnyen bkur gzobs/ yi dam dang chos skyong la gtor ma chen po shoms/ gzim spyil la dar tshugs gsungs/ se la gser lhag ma zho do tsam yod pa yang dkar ru mar phul nas dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad cing /

'khon gyis se la nyid nga la bla mas bsngags pa dpag tu med pa mdzad nas sprad pa'i slob ma yin pas go cha skyed cig zin thun byas nas kyang slob gnyer myur du tshar bar byed pas yul du'ang re zhig 'gro rgyu med/ de'i ring gi rgyags ni ngas sbyor gsungs pas/ se na re/ thugs la btags/ nyid cag dpon slob rnam thar mi mtshungs pa gda' ste/ yul bskor nas myur du 'ongs lags zhus te byon/ slar 'bul ba rnams khyer nas sa skyar byon pa dang / bde kye gnyis kyi dbang mthud nas zhus shing / bla ma'i gzim g.yog byed pa'i ngang nas zin thun la 'bungs pas/ lo drug la rgyud gsum ka la shin tu mkhas par gyur nas chos bshad pas grwa bshad bco lnga tsam byung / bshad pa grub nas bla ma la bla chen 'brog mi'i gsung de ci la dgongs mi shes pas/ zhabs tog tu 'gyur na da lam 'bras kyi bka' gsan tsam zhig bla ma'i dam tshig la bsam nas byed pa legs zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas bla chen bka' dam pas bka' rgya yod kyis dogs pa yin te de la thugs la btags gsungs/ gzhan bka' rgya yod na'ang gsung shog de la brten nas bdag cag gi rgyud ni zhu ru 'gro/ don du gnyer na gdams ngag sbyin du btub ste mchi zhus pas/ rten 'brel sgrig pa yin mod/ rdzogs pa bya ru mi btub pa yin gsung gi gda' zhus pas/ des na do nub rang nas zhu gsungs te/ chos sgo 'byed pa dang / bar chad bsrung ba'i don du rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi byin rlabs kyi phyag len rnams bstan/ de nub nas dpon slob gnyis kyi sku mtshams dam du bcad/ nang gtor re yang ma chag pa mdzad nas/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang lung skor lnga dang bcas pa la sa bcad btab/ gol sa bstan/ 'khrugs bsdebs pa'i sgo nas zhag nyi shu tsam la tshar bar mdzad pas gnyis ka la rgyud dang man ngag gi bdag por mtshan thogs pa yin pas des na sa skya'i 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po ni bla chen 'brog mi'i slob ma rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu byed pa yin la/

de nas rgyud tshar ba'i slob ma gnyis pa 'phrang 'og gi brad ston dkon mchog rgyal po ni zur po che'i nyid slob sgrub skor re tsam shes pa'i dad pa dang snying rje che zhing nor phyug la kha drag pa'i rigs yin pa las/ skabs shig ldum bu ba kha cig byung ba rnams la/ mkhas btsun bzang po nyams rtogs can gang na ci 'dra 'dug dris pas/ de rnams na re/ da lta sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bas/ lung phug re na nga po can mang po 'dug kyang / rtsod med kyi mkhas pa chen po 'brog mi lo tsā ba ni khyim mdzes yin pas khyed rang rgyus che yod/ de 'dra ba da lta bod na med nges par gda' zer/ de ci 'dra cig 'dug dris pas/ dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa thams cad 'du/ chos gang 'dod pa shes shing nor mang po 'dod pa zhig 'dug zer ba dang / de thos pas dad pa skyes nas pha mar yul 'dzin pa dang / khyed rang gi zhabs tog khong spun drug pos chog nga 'brog mi lo tsā ba la chos slob tu 'gro byas pas/ pha ma gnyis kha mthun par khyod bu tsha'i dus nas zhi zhing dul/ pha ma la sri zhu che/ sngar yang khyed rnga ldi ri ri 'phrin bsgrub byed pa bag dro ba cig yod/ khyod kyis chos bslabs na mkhas pa zhig yong nges zer zhing cha rkyen gang dgos bskur nas g.yog mda' gzhu can lnga dang bcas mu khu lung du byon nas 'bul ba dang zhabs tog gis mnyes pas lo lnga la rgyud gsum yongs su rdzogs pa tshar nas bshad gsar byas pas/ chos nyan pa yang 'ga' byung zhing / de nas yul du byon pa dang / pha ma spun zla zhang po rnams kyis dbang zhus shing / mtsho skyes kyi skor/ bsam mi khyab/ yi ge med pa rnams gnang / rgyud kyi bshad pa byas pas ston pa 'ga' thon kyang gzhan phan chen po mi 'ong pa 'dra snyam nas sgrub pa mdzad pas nyams rtogs bzang po byung la/ sku tshe yang ring po bzhugs nas mthar 'grong rtags kyang bzang po byung ba yin no/ /rgyud tshar ba gsum pa lha rtse'i gyi ljang dbu dkar bas bla chen gyi snyan grags thos pas drung du phyin nas thog mar glang dor gcig dang /

ba zho ma gcig phul nas phyis gser srang drug cu 'bul ba khas blangs pas/ spyod lam la mnyes nas dbang dang rgyud gnang bas lo brgyad la rgyud gsum sgrub skor lag len dang bcas pa shes shing / khyad par sam+bu ṭi la mkhas par byung nas khams su 'gro bar zhus/ rung gsungs nas byon pas/ rgya nag rgyal po khri don chen bya ba'i bla mar gyur pa na/ ngas bla ma la gser srang drug cu 'bul ba'i khas len byas yod pas brnyed pa 'tshol du 'gro gsungs pas/ rgyal po na re 'di rnams bkul la bzhugs par zhu zer nas gser srang brgya tsam zhig phul ba de rgyun du 'ong ba'i tshong dpon zhig la bskur bas/ de'i phyi lo bla chen gyis khong rang gis ngo shes pa'i kyai rdor gyi thang sku gcig dang / kha che'i rdo rje dril bu gcig gnang byung bas thams cad thugs dges/ bla ma yar 'byon 'dod kyang rgyal pos gtong ma 'dod/ skad rigs mi gcig pas slob ma chos shes pa mang po ma byung yang / dbang sems bskyed zhus nas dge ba bsgrub mi dge ba spong zhing bsnyen bsgrub byed pa mang du byung la/ mthar 'grong rtags ngo mtshar can byung bas bstan pa la phan pa byung zer ro/ /bzhi pa shangs kyi brag rtse so nag pa ni/ tshong dpon dpal bya ba'i bu yin la/ des bla chen la gser srang sum cus mgo byas pa'i 'bul ba byas pas mnyes nas rgyud gsum cha lag dang bcas pa gnang nas lo brgyad la shes shing / khyad par du sgrub skor la mkhas par gyur nas yul du phebs te bshad pas/ pha ma sogs sgrub pa po brgya lhag re las bshad srol 'dzin pa ma byung / 'on kyang thams cad la nyams rtogs bzang po byung bas bstan pa la phan thogs chen po byung ba yin zer ro/ /lnga pa nyi ra'i zur po che shākya 'byung gnas kyis kyang gzi dang g.yu za 'og gi gdan gang ba zhig phul nas chos zhus pas/ lo bzhi la rgyud gsum cha lag dang bcas pa mkhyen cing khyad par du gur la mkhas pa gyur nas chos gsungs pas/

grwa pa'ang brgya lhag re 'byung zhing nya rir rgyud kyi bshad pa 'dzugs par bzhed pa la khong gi bu chen rtse mo gnyis/ rtse lkog gsum/ ka ba bzhi/ gdung ma brgyad/ dral ma sum cu so gnyis/ nag po chen po bzhi bya ba rnams 'dus nas 'bul ba mang po phul nas/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa mi bshig par zhu zer bas bshad ma nus par de las 'phel ba ni cher ma byung la/ 'on kyang 'brog mi'i slob ma grags che ba zhig yin no/ /drug pa mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po ni/ yab bla ma rdo rje phur pa/ yum dgos skyid bya ba'i sras/ gdung rus stag tsho ba yin zhing / rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa zhig gi sku'i skye ba yin pa'i stobs kyis thugs rab shin tu che bas/ dgung lo brgyad pa nas mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa btsugs pas gangs pa she'u dang / shang pa stong ban rgya'o la sogs pa'i slob ma bzang la mang ba byung zhing / dgung lo bcu gcig pa la bla chen 'brog mi'i drung du byon te rta dang g.yag lug rnams kyis mu gu lu gi gshong gang ba phul nas chos zhus pas/ bla chen yang shin tu mnyes nas sngon la gzhung phran rnams bslabs pas/ mtsho skyes la lan lnga'i bar du blo bskyed byung pas/ bla ma mnga' ris pa'i zhal nas sngon gyi bag chags 'di gal che ste/ ngas mtshan nyid rnams phal cher zhig dran zhing / ma dran pa rnams tshar res mkhas par gyur/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i tshig la bla ma'i man ngag dgos zer ba'ang bden par 'dug ste/ mtsho skyes kyi gzhung dum bu 'di la tshar bzhi'i bar du blo bskyed re byung yang lnga pa la sngar gyi de las blo bskyed ma byung / spyir gyi phyi nang gzhan dbang rten 'brel sgrig pa/ 'di las 'di 'byung gi rgyu mtshan dang bcas pas des na chos gsang sngags la thug gda'o yang yang gsungs/ lo lnga la kyai rdor rgyud gsum 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i cha lag thams cad la mkhas par gyur pas/

bla chen gyi zhal nas/ bstan pa phyi dar mkhan slob dang / yon bdag lha mchod kyi sku'i ring la ngas srol btod pa yin/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bshad srol 'di khyod la gtad pa yin pas dar zhing rgyas par gyis shig dar nas 'ong bar yang gda' yi gsungs pa'ang byung ste/ de nas stong por byon nas 'bul ba mang po byung bas/ rta bzang po nyi shu rtsa drug gis mgo byas pa'i 'bul ba rnams bla ma la phul nas dbang zhus te lam 'bras gnang bar zhus pas/ ngas dam bca' zhig byas pas rgyud tshar ba la lam 'bras mi ster ba yin pas/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi sangs rgyas myur du 'grub pa'i kha skong 'di la gzhi gyis gsungs nas 'khor 'das dbyer med dang / phyag rgya chen po skor gsum gnang nas bshad sgrub spel mar mdzad pas/ 'khon sgyu chu ba shes rab 'bar la sogs pa'i bshad srol gyi brgyud 'dzin bzang la mang bar byung ba yin pas de rnams ni bla chen gyi rgyud tshar ba'i slob ma yin la/ de'i rjes su man ngag tshar ba'i slob ma rnams 'byung bas/ de la dang po 'brom de pa ston chung ni/ 'phan yul gyi 'brom 'chad pa/ mched mo nam mkha'i ming po che ba yin la/ de sngar nas mthu che ba gcig yin pa la/ bsam yas nas mi'u thung sor bzhi pa gcig gter nas thon te bltas pas/ ma mo yang snying 'dus pa nas/ bdun 'bum sngags kyis kha bskangs te/ /zhag ni bdun nam dgu dag la/ /dgra srog rdo rje yin yang chad/ /bsnyen pa thongs nas bzlog mi srid/ /bya ba 'dug nas mtshams bcad de bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bdun bskyal bas dpal lha mos zhal dngos su bstan nas ci bya/ su gsod/ myur du smros shig gsungs pas/ dgra bdun gyi ming nas smos pa dang / song nas mgo bo bdun srod la 'khyer ba dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bskyur nas re re'ang gang nye ba gsum gsum 'chi bas sang nyin gtang rag thongs/ de phyin chad rten bcas nas bsnyen pa kha gsos pa tsam gyis chog zer nas nam mkha' la sprin yal ba ltar gyur pa dang /

de ltar byas pas mthu'i nus pa thon te grags pa chen po byung ste/ rgyab rten zhu ba'i yon bdag dang / bu slob mang po byung nas longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byung ba dang / slob dpon thugs 'byung ste/ gdams ngag de rnams gcung po la byin la khyod kyis bsgrub la bstan pa srungs/ grags pa thob nas lag len la ma 'gel ba 'ur thogs/ gdams ngag gzhan la ma ster/ nga sdig sbyong dang byang chub bsgrub pa'i gdams ngag zhu ba la bla chen 'brog mi'i drung du 'gro gsungs nas/ mdzo rta mang po khal gyis mnan te mu gu lung du byon/ bla chen la mdzo rta brgyad cus sna drangs pa'i brgya 'bul lnga byas nas lam 'bras lam skor dang bcas pa lhag ma lus pa gnang bar zhus pas/ bla mas kyang de ltar zhal gyis bzhes nas dbang la sogs pa thams cad rdzogs par gnang nas sgro 'dogs chod pa tsam gyi dus gcig tu/ 'phan yul ba'i jo sras sma ra ser po can gcig dang / sma ra nag po can gnyis 'brog la mthu zhu ru byung bas/ bla ma'i rnam thar la mos nas blo 'gyur te/ bla chen la khrid thob pa med nas 'brom la zhus pas/ khams 'dus pa bar pa yan chod kyi khrid gnang / de nas yul du gshegs bsam ste khal ma'i rta gcig g.yar po zhus pas/ slob mas bla ma la 'bul ba byed pa lugs yin/ bla mas slob ma la 'bul ba byed pa'i lugs med gsungs nas ma gnang bas 'brom yid chad nas/ 'khor rnams la lam du ster mi 'dra yong ngam/ gal te ma byung na yul du 'khur nas 'gro ba ngo tsha bas 'di nas phar 'gro gsungs nas ding ri phyogs la byon pas 'bul ba mang po byung yang / phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i gdams ngag 'di mi mang po la gnang bas bla ma dang dam tshig gi sel bag tsam byung ba'i stobs kyis snyung nad drag po byung ba dang 'grong par mkhyen nas/ nga'i bla ma de sangs rgyas dngos su 'dug bla mas nga'i snod brtags par 'dug pa la/

ngas ma go ba log lta cung zad cig byung bas lan 'dug da nga'i rus pa 'di dang yo byad 'di rnams bla ma'i phyag tu phul nas ji ltar thugs kyi dgongs pa bzhin mdzad pa zhu zhus/ khyed rnams chos zhu na rtsol ba med par gnang bar 'dug ste/ gzhan rnams la ni bsam pa med/ khyed se rog gnyis po'ang ngas phog pa'i khrid kyis khengs nas mi zhu ba 'dug ste/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla ma yin pas/ bla ma gcig la rten 'brel 'chugs na rten 'brel brgyad 'chug tu 'ong bas/ sgom chen gnyis kyang khrid kyi gsal 'debs re zhus na 'thad/ des na nga'i yo byad rnams kyi phyed bla ma la bsngos pa yin pas de tshang ba gal che gsungs nas 'das te/ spur sbyangs pas nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' 'od kyis khengs shing / gdung rnams kyang ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur/ de nas khong rnams kyis gdung rus dang yo byad rnams khyer te mu gu lung du phyin/ bla chen la gdung dang yo byad rnams sngar zhal bkod yod pa bzhin phul bas/ bla chen gyis gdung sku pang du bzhes te bus pha can du bsnyegs sam gsungs nas spyan chab mang du byung ba dang / slob 'khor rnams kyi yang log rtog sangs shing gsung chems rnams phul bas/ 'brom la dam tshig gi sel bag tsam zhig byung 'dug kyang sel de dag nas khong bde ba can du song 'dug da khyed rang rnams chos 'dod na khong gi ngo la ster ro gsungs pas/ gzhan rnams kyis kyai rdor gyi dbang skur zhig zhus/ sgom chen gnyis pos chos nyi ma lnga'i bar du nyan nas nged gnyis kha rag tu bsgom la 'gro bas gegs bzhin byung na drung du 'ong bas thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ khyod gnyis kyis khams 'dus pa yan gyi khrid tshar 'dug pas de bzhin du sgoms la bar chad mi yong bar ngas byin gyis brlabs kyi gsungs shing / 'phags pa chos snang 'di bla ma la sangs rgyas su thag chod/ bshad pa ha cang mi shes kyang /

bsgom khrid thams cad rdzogs shing nyams myong yang bzang ba'i gang zag khyad par can yin khong dang ma bral ba gyis/ khyod kyis kyang khong gnyis kyi mgo 'drong par gyis shig dbus gtsang gi che chung bya mi dgos gsungs ba'i zhal bkod mdzad/ khong rnams kyis kyang de bzhin byas pas se rog gnyis kyis kyang sgom la bar chad med par mgo thon te dngos grub cung zad re thob pa yin la/ des na ngo mtshar snang ba sogs lo rgyus phal che bar 'di'i skabs kyi se rog gnyis 'brog mi'i slob ma grub pa thob pa'i pho gsum gyi sgyer se bo dang / gshen bsgom rog po gnyis dang gcig pa lta bur bshad 'dug kyang / 'di gnyis kyi skye sa yang 'phan yul bar bshad pa'ang 'dug cing / der ma zad rdo rje 'chang gis 'di gnyis kyi dngos grub cung zad re thob skad ces gsungs la/ rje btsun gyis sgyer bsgom se bo sogs grub pa thob pa'i slob ma bdun bgrangs nas/ dang po drug ni lus ma spangs par grub pa thob pa'o/ /mched mo nam mkha' ni thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'o zhes gsungs pas na/ mi gcig pa 'dra ste dpyad par bya zhing / yang ngo mtshar snang bar/ sgyer bsgom dang gshen bsgom gnyis 'chi tsa na dus gcig la 'chi ba'i chad mdzad pas/ sgyer bsgom grong pa'i dus/ nga'i ro 'di ri mthon por skyol cig gsungs pas nye gnas kyis khong gi ro ri mthon por bskyal ba sogs kyang bshad 'dug pas yang na rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma bod kyi lo rgyus na/ lus ma spangs zhes pa de yi ge pa'i skyon yin dgos la/ de ltar ma yin na de gnyis la 'gal spong zhig dgos pa 'dra'o/ /de nas man ngag tshar ba'i slob ma gnyis pa se ston kun rig ni/ mdo smad kyi phyi 'brum pa se lce tshe bya ba'i rigs/ gre lce bde la shes rab che ba zhig yin par sngon gyi bag chags sad pa'i stobs kyis g.yag ma smad sum cu tsam khyer nas mu gu lung du byon te bla chen la phul nas gdams ngag zhus pa na/

'bul ba chen po min yang lung pa phu gsum 'dzin pa la mkho yi gsungs nas 'bul ba rnams bzhes kyang re zhig bar la dbang re tsam ma gtogs gsung ngag ma gnang ba la/ phyis yun ring du bsgugs pa dang / spyod lam gyis mnyes nas gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs par gnang nas thams cad thugs su chud pas nyams rtogs bzang po byung zhing / khyad par gegs sel la mnga' brnyes pas slob ma'ang zhang ston mched gnyis dang / zha ma lcam sring la sogs pa gsung ngag gi lam srol 'dzin pa'i mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung bas bla ma 'di nyid gdams ngag rab tu thob pa yin la/ gsum pa lha btsun ka ba le ni/ yon bdag mched gsum gyi sras kyang yin la/ khyad par yum gyi ming po yin pas gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang yang / de nyid sku tshe thung bas de nas brgyud pa'i lam 'bras kyi bshad srol ma byung bas tha mar thob pa zhes kha cig zer ro/ /de nas grub pa thob pa'i slob ma bdun nam/ dgu'i dang po sgyer bsgom se bor grags pa ni/ gtsang smad pa'i phyug po dad pa dang shes rab che ba zhig yin pa/ des bla chen gyi snyan pa thos nas mang mkhar du byon te/ ral gri bzang po gcig gis thog drangs pa'i 'bul ba bzang po byas nas gdams ngag zhus pas/ rten 'brel bzang / 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal bar 'dug man ngag sbyin gyi gsungs nas thog mar dbang gsum po mthud mar gnang / de nas gdams ngag rnams gnang bas lo gsum la khrid bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa dang bcas pa tshar nas gtang rag la nas khal brgya phul te/ lo bcu gsum gyi bar la stag lo sding la sogs par bsgoms pas mngon shes dang / rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob nas bod na nga'i gdul bya mi 'dug gsungs nas dpal gyi ri la gshegs zhes grags la/ gnyis pa rta nag pa gshen bsgom rog pa ni/ a khu bon po'i grub thob tu byed pa zhig yod pa de 'das nas/ de'i bu slob dang /

yon bdag byang 'brog pa mang po yod pa'i gseb na phar bsod snyoms la phyin pas yo byad mang po byung nas brjes bsgrub rnams byas te/ de'i lhag ma la gser srang bcu gsum tsam byung bas/ bla chen 'brog mi'i snyan pa thos pa dang / bon la yid ma ches par gser rnams khyer nas/ gshen ston g.yung rung grub dpon g.yog bdun gyis 'brog mi'i drung du phyin te gser phul nas lam 'bras zhus pas/ khrid lo lnga la tshar/ bsgrub pa lung sbyin gnang nas byang se mo do la sogs par lo bcu gsum bsgoms pas grub pa thob ste/ gangs ti se na bon po'i rig 'dzin mang po yod pa de rnams yang dag pa'i gdams pas mkha' spyod du gtong ba'i dus la babs 'dug gsungs nas dgong kha'i nyi zer la lam byas nas gangs ri ti ser gshegs skad/ gsum pa dbus pa grod pa che ni/ 'phan yul rag ma ya yo bkras bde bya ba/ rtsal dang snying khams sdug sran che bas ya pho brgya re'i mgo bsdus nas bod nor 'brog tu bskyel zhing / 'brog nor bod du bskyel ba'i chom rkun pa chen po zhig yin pa las/ skabs shig tu/ sring mo dang ngo tsha bsnol bas de sbrum pa dang / ngo tshas rkyen byas nas bag ma phyug po zhig bcom pa'i g.yu stong ri ba gcig gis mgo byas g.yu bcu tsam yod pa 'khyer nas gtsang phyogs su yong pas/ bla chen gyi snyan pa thos pa dang / las 'phro sad nas mu gu lung du phyin te/ bla chen dang mjal g.yu rnams 'bul ba byas/ chos zhus pas snod du mkhyen nas dbang bskur te khrid rnams zin thun du byas bsgoms pas nyams rtogs bzang po byung zhing / khyad par rlung spu gri stobs su gyur pa brten nas za ma gzhung las mi bgrangs par zan bre gsum ma la sogs pa za dgos pa byung bas de skad du grags shing / mthar grub pa thob nas lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la gshegs shing / 'di gsum ni gtso bo yin la/ de nas 'bring rje shākya brtson 'grus ni/

yul lcog ro zangs dkar ba yin zhing / phyug gtsang mthong bsgom ni lho smad gnyan rtse ba grags pa bkra shis bya ba yin la/ 'di gnyis kyis kyang bla chen gyi drung du gdams ngag zhus nas nyams rtogs byung ba sogs kyi lo rgyus 'ga' zhig 'dug kyang rje btsun gyis ma bgrangs pas 'dir yang zur tsam las ma bshad pa yin/ de nas grub pa thob pa'i mi bzhir grags pa las/ dbrad bsgom ma dkon ne bya ba/ mang mkhar phu'i dbrad kyi g.ya' sang ba yin pa des 'brog cig tu khyim so la phyin pas/ lo gcig 'khor ba dang khyo shi ba'i sdug bsngal gyis khams 'dus drag po zhig byung nas rgyun du skad chen pos ngu zhing yod pa la/ bla chen gyis sbra 'dus che sa zhig tu phebs pa'i yar lam mar lam gnyis kar skad gsan nas dris pas/ rgyu mtshan zhus pa dang / mya ngan rang 'byung gi ting nge 'dzin skyes par 'dug nye 'brel 'dra yod na nga can du skyol cig gsungs pas/ sang nyin mi bzhis mdo le byas te bskyal bas bla chen gyis gegs sel mdzad pas gegs las grol ba dang / dang po bla ma dbrad bsgom la bsgom 'phel lam gsungs te sgom btab pa legs sam/ zhag du song ngam/ bdag ni brjed nas dran pa mi gda' zer/ bla mas/ dran pa med cing yid la byar med pa ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'o/ /de bzhin du chos dang dge 'dun dran pa'o gsungs/ de nas nor bu chu shel gyi gdams ngag bstan pas nyin zhag phrugs gcig la ting nge 'dzin gcig tu song la/ sangs pa dang / dbang bskur nas bsam mi khyab kyi bshad khrid spel mar gsungs pas/ mig gi rnam shes rtogs pa yis/ /gnyis med ye shes ngo mtshar che/ /gnyis po dag gis spyad pa yis/ /ye shes me yis 'bar bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshig de la brten nas mu gu lung gi chos grwa de nyid du lus gnad ma zhig par zhag bdun gyi ring la ting nge 'dzin gcig tu song bas/ mos gus can byin rlabs kyis khams 'du ba'i dper mdzad cing /

de nas bsgoms pas tshe 'di nyid la lus ma spangs par grub pa brnyes te re zhig bo dong gi ri'i bye brag jo mo nags rgyal gyi gnod sbyin mo'i mchod gnas mdzad nas mthar u rgyan du gshegs pa yin la/ de nas stod mo rdo rje mtsho byar med ma bya ba ni/ mang mkhar stod spe ma yin cing / des 'bro dgra 'dul du khyim so byas pas bu bdun skyes nas yod pa la/ yul mi rnams kyis bcom nas pha bu brgyad dus gcig la bsad pas/ stod mo zhag lnga'i bar du brgyal ba ma sangs pa dang / pha ming rnams kyis bla chen la zhus pas/ brgyal ba bslong ba la nga mkhas pas khyer shog gsungs/ btegs nas drung du bskyal bas/ bla chen gyis brgyal ba de las bslangs nas ngo sprod btab pas/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po 'khrungs shing / de'i rgyun bskyangs nas bsgoms pas grub pa thob ste lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs pa yin pas de ni las 'phro can rang gi ngang gis khams 'dus pa'i dper mdzad do/ /yang shab pa mo lcam gcig ni/ yul tshwa mo rong pa pha jo rgyal po bya ba'i bu mo/ ming po bdun gyi sring gcig ma rigs bzang zhing / dad pa dang shes rab che ba zhig yin pa des bla chen gyi drung du phyin nas 'bul ba bsnyen bkur bzang po byas nas gdams ngag zhus pas/ bla ma mnyes nas dbang bskur te dbang gsum pa'i dus su zhu bde lhan skyes ngo sprad pas nyi ma dros chen bar ting nge 'dzin du gyur nas sangs pa dang / phyag btsal te/ sku drin che lags so/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dang mjal/ byin rlabs 'phral du zhugs/ sangs rgyas sems las brnyed/ 'khor ba ma spangs dbyings su dag bdag gi don chen grub zin to zer zhing / de nas bsgoms pas lo nyer lnga la mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul brnyes nas u rgyan du gshegs pa yin no/ /de nas mched mo nam mkha' ni/ 'brom de ba ston chung gi a ce yin la/ de yang 'brom mched pa'i bla ma khro rgyal ye shes/

de pa shākya rgyal/ de pa ston chung / 'od zer rdo rje sogs mched lnga'i gcen mo'i mnal lam du bud med mang po byung nas/ khyod kyi sring mo nam mkha' ye shes la nor rdzongs bzang po dang bcas te 'brog mi lo tsā ba can du bskyal nas mkha' spyod du btang ngo / /da lta nged kyis khrid nas 'gro zer ba yang yang byung / de'i dus mched mo nam mkha' yang zhag gsum tsam dran med du song nas dran pa rnyed pa dang / bla ma 'brog mi'i rnam thar mang po 'chad pas pha ma nye 'brel rnams ngo mtshar nas gros byas te/ nor mang po bkur nas bla chen gyi drung du brdzangs pa dang / bla chen gnam thang dkar po'i phar sna mang bzang brag phug bya ba na bzhugs pa'i chos rar bu mo mtshan dang ldan pa gcig pha ma la bla chen can 'gro bar zhus nas 'ong pa yin zer/ g.yu stong ri ba gcig gis mgo byas 'bul ba rnams ji ltar dus la babs pa na mkha' spyod du gtong bar zhu zer ba'i zhu yig dang bcas phul bas/ de'i nub mo nas khong dpon g.yog rnams la bde mchog gi dbang gnang zhing / mched mo la steng sgo rnam par 'gog pa rkyal pa kha gcus kyi gdams pa gnang bas de ma thag rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa'i mtshan rtags byung ba dang / grogs rnams la nga da lta nas mkha' spyod du sleb pa'i mtshan ma byung ngo / /khyed rang rnams nangs par rang yul du gshegs nas yab yum rnams la'ang de skad zhus shig zer nas khong rnams de'i sang de brdzangs/ de nas phag mo'i chos skor rnams gnang ste/ de yang bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa gnod sbyin mo pad+ma sid+dhi dang / khol po pā dha ka dbang du bsdu ba dang / sman chen po'i bcud len rnams gnang bas/ gnod sbyin mo 'grub nas dbus kyi shun brag rum bya ba'i rgya lam du khang chung zhig brtsigs nas mgron po byung tshad la zan gong re dang chang phor re 'gyed pa byung zhing /

phyis de kha nas mkha' spyod du gshegs zer ba'ang 'dug la/ des na grub pa thob pa'i slob ma bdun po 'di thams cad lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag gis sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa ni cung min pa 'dra/ gang ltar yang slob ma'i mchog de rnams dang ldan pa'i 'brog mi lo tsā ba chen po des bod du bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su spyir dam pa'i chos dang / bye brag tu gsang sngags/ khyad par du lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag gis gtso byas pa'i lam skor dgur grags pa 'di rnams spel bar mdzad pa yin la/ de'i rjes su mthar bla ma sa skya pa chen pos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul 'di 'byung bas/ de la spyir 'brog mi nas brgyud pa'i lam 'bras 'di la phyis su lugs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig byung ba yin te/ de yang ding sang spyi lam pa la 'brom lugs su byas pa dang / zha ma lugs dang / gces bsgom lugs/ jo nang lugs/ phag gru lugs/ gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa sa skya pa'i lugs sogs dang zhib tu phye na bka' srol bco brgyad sogs su yod pa las/ dang po lam 'bras 'brom lugs su byas pa 'di la chos 'byung bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od du 'brog gi dngos slob 'brom de pa ston chung gi lugs su mdzad nas brgyud pa dang / yig cha'i rnam grangs bgrangs pa'i mjug tu/ zhib mo rdo rjer 'brom las lam 'bras 'phel ba ni med zer ba ni shin tu ma dag par snang ngo gsungs la/ dmar chos kyi rgyal pos ni/ des na 'brom las lam 'bras 'phel ba med do/ /'brom lugs su byas pa 'di ni jo mo 'brom me zhes pa dbus kyi 'phan yul ba bla ma sa chen gyi dngos slob yin kyang / de la lam 'bras yongs su rdzogs pa'ang med la/ gang yod de yang zhi byed dang rdzogs chen la sogs pa bsres pas na/ gyi na ste bor bar bya gsungs pas gang dag dpyad dgos la/ des na skabs 'dir rje btsun se ston kun rig la yang lam 'bras tha mar thob pa dang /

'bring du thob pa dang / rab tu thob pa dang gsum gyi rnam gzhag byed pas/ de la dang po tha mar thob pa ni/ gze bsgom byang ye yin te khong shes rab dang brtson 'grus mi che zhing sdug sran mi che bas bsgom ma nus par gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs pa ma chod la/ de'i stobs kyis nyams rtogs zhan zhing gzhan phan yang ma byung bas tha mar thob pa zhes bya la/ gnyis pa lam 'bras 'bring du thob pa ni zha ma lugs yin pas/ de la yang sngar byung ba'i mo brgyud dang / phyis byung ba'i mo brgyud ke brag lugs dang / pho brgyud spang rje lugs dang / man ngag thams cad bsres pa'i lugs dang bzhi las/ dang po ni thog mar ma cig zha ma'i lugs la stod pha drug gi zha ma brgya bzhi'i nang nas/ zha ma me reg pa yin la/ de yang lcam sring drug yod pa'i gnyis kyi 'og ma/ lha rje zha ma mtshan rgyal mo lcam zhes bya ba des 'brom ram tsha bya bar khyim so la phyin/ de'i rjes su lo tsā ba rma chos 'bar gyi jo mo byas nas yod pa la/ lo tsā ba 'das pa'i mya ngan gyis rkyen byas te khams 'dus drag po zhig byung nas/ ding rir pha dam pa'i drung du byon te gdams ngag 'dra zhus zla ba gcig gnyis tsam ma gtogs gzhan nad de las grol ba zhig ma byung bar snub yul rong na mar phyin pas lha rje snub pa'i ban chung kha cig e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs/ /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes tsam nyid nas skye ba med/ /zer ba thos pas/ de la nges shes khyad par can cig skyes pas khams lan cig bde/ de nas thu ru song ba dang / yang dam pa'i drung du phyin pa dang / rnga gcig lag tu gtad nas rdungs gsungs pa'i brda mdzad/ brdungs pas skad chen po zhig byung / gzhan ci yang ma byung bar/ gdams ngag zhus pas song gsung ba'i brda mdzad pa dang / gdams ngag 'dug par go nas log yong ba'i lam du bla ma se'i slob ma ding ri sked chag pa khyung po hūm̐ ka ra bya ba zhig dang 'phrad pas de na re/

ding sang bla chen 'brog mi'i dngos slob se ston kun rig tu grags pa de mdo mang bzhengs pa'i glegs shing bsgrub pa la brin du byon yod pa/ de nyid khams 'dus 'grol ba la shin tu rang mkhas pas khong can phyin na zer bas/ rje khum bu ba dang / lcam sring gnyis kyis rta gcig la yo byad rnams bkal nas mjal du byon te/ dang po nas khams 'di ltar byung gi lo rgyus zhus pas/ bla mas lha lcam 'bur ma zhig la lcag gis thug thug mdzad cing / khyod la dang por 'di ltar ma byung ngam/ de nas 'di ltar du ma byung ngam gsungs pa dang / zha ma'i nyams la byung tshod dang mthun pas phyag btsal te/ rje sangs rgyas sam/ bya ba de khyed legs sam zer ba la/ se'i zhal nas zha chung ma la sgom 'dug ste gdams ngag mi 'dug se mkhar chung ba la gdams ngag 'dug ste sgom mi 'dug sprang po dpe the'u 'dis bar chad cig kyang byed du ma 'dod gsungs/ der gdams ngag zhus pas/ dbang bskur dgos gsungs pas/ sngar bla ma la dbang thob zhus pas/ nga'i chos 'dod na nga rang gis dbang bskur dgos gsungs/ 'o na cha rkyen 'dra bsgrubs nas drung du 'ong bar zhu/ bdag gi ming po ston pa zhig kyang yod pa de yang 'khrid yong pas chog lags sam zhus pas/ rung gsungs pa dang rje khum bu ba lcam sring gnyis kyis nor mang po khyer nas mkhar chung du byon/ 'bul ba 'khor gsum yongs dag lan gsum byas pas/ bla ma yang mnyes shing dbang bskur nas gegs sel gyi gdams ngag bstan nas bsgom du bcug pas nad drag ste khrid gnang bas/ zha ma khrid rags rim tsam gyis sems tshim nas 'gro bar 'dug pa la/ bla ma zhang ston la zha ma lcam sring 'di mi chen du 'dug cing gdams ngag gi snod du'ang 'dug pas/ khong la gdams ngag rdzogs pa gcig sbyin bsam ste khong mi zhu bar 'gro ba 'dug pa/ gdams ngag ni ma tshar/ 'o skol gyi brgyud pa 'di'i lugs la slob mas gsol ba ma btab pa bla mas gnang ba'i srol med pas/

khyod kyis gros thob gsungs nas zhang ston gyis de ltar byas pas/ zha ma na re/ jo bo 'di ci gsung / 'bul ba yang mang po byas pas bla ma yang mnyes nas gdams ngag kyang ma lus pa gnang bas de lhag ma med par thag chod/ des tshim yang tshim/ lhag ma yod pa skad gsung yang rjes zhal brdzun mdzad pa yin zer nas ma nyan par song bas/ gdams ngag yongs su ma rdzogs pas 'di ni bla ma se la lam 'bras 'bring du thob par byed pas/ de lta bu'i zha ma des nyang bsgom la gnang / des mkhan po smon mkhar ba la gnang / des kha rag gi gnyos gzi brjid sogs la gnang nas 'phel ba yin zhing / de nas phyis byung ba'i mo brgyud ko brag pa'i lugs ni/ bla ma ldum bu ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan bya ba des mkhan po smon mkhar ba dang / gnyos chos kyi gzi brjid gnyis la zha ma mo brgyud kyi gdams ngag dang / zha ma dkon mchog gis zhus pa'i lam 'bras zha lugs su grags pa'i gdams ngag zhus nas/ des gzhung bshad dang / dbang bzhi'i khrid la sogs pa'i man ngag mang du yi ger bkod nas lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bar la ra sa chu phug tu lam 'bras kyi gdams ngag bsgoms pas mngon shes dang / rdzu 'phrul thob cing rtsa rlung gi gnad gzigs pas gegs sel gzhan la ma ltos par gegs sel rnams thugs la rang shar du 'khrungs pa thams cad yi ger bkod pa/ ha dmigs rgya mtsho sogs gegs sel rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang / bogs 'byin gyi man ngag la sogs pa lam 'bras pa gong ma rnams la ma grags pa'i gegs sel gyi man ngag mang du mdzad nas/ des lha sru lung pa/ mkha' 'gro rgya gar ye shes/ gnyos rdo rje seṅge rnams la gsungs nas spel ba la lam 'bras ko brag lugs zer ba yin la/ de nas zha ma pho brgyud dpang rje lugs su grags pa ni/ rje btsun se mkhar chung pa la ma cig zha ma'i ming po rje khum bu ba zha ma chos kyi rgyal pos zhus nas/ des se bsgom brag skyabs dang /

sras zha ma tsaṇ+ḍi ka gnyis la bshad cing / de gnyis char la dpang rje nyi ma grags kyis zhus nas/ dpang rjes bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar la sogs pa mdzad cing / nyams su len pa rnams yin pas/ de gnyis kyang bsdu na zha ma lugs kyi khongs su 'du ba yin la/ yang 'di'i skabs kyi lam 'bras zha ma lugs su grags pa ni/ bla ma se'i slob ma zhang dgon pa ba/ zha ma dkon mchog slob dpon myang ston/ mkhan po smon mkhar ba'i bar du brgyud cing / zha ma dkon mchog gis zhang dgon pa ba dang / sa skya pa chen po gnyis ka la zhus so/ /zhes gsungs pa ni 'dug la/ gang ltar yang de nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ zhal bzhes nyer bzhi phal cher dang bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas pa'i yig cha yod par bshad pas/ de rnams kyi sgo nas nyams su len pa la gsungs pa 'dra zhig 'dug la/ de nas man ngag mang po bsres pa'i lugs la lam 'bras bka' rgya mar grags pa ni/ bla ma cha rgan dbang phyug rgyal mtshan bya ba grub thob dkar por grags pa des chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i slob ma kun mkhyen pu hrang pa zer ba zhig la lam 'bras sa lugs zhus/ yang chos sding ba myang ras kyi slob ma ma cig nyi khri zer ba zhig la zha ma lugs kyi lam 'bras zhus shing / bla ma de phyis rin chen sgang du bzhugs nas/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang / gong 'og mang po bcos pa'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang la sogs pa'i lam 'bras kyi yig cha pod chung gcig byas shing / de la bla ma mnyam med grags rgyal sogs mang pos zhus nas dar ba rnams la zer zhing / 'di dang cha gan gnyis kyis rgya dpe la ma gtugs par rdo rje'i tshig rkang la 'gyur bcos byas pa sogs rang bzo yang che rab snang zhing / yang zha ma'i lugs bzhin rang 'chad pa'i nges pa mi 'dug kyang / zha ma lugs shas che bas 'di yang de'i khongs su bsdus so zhes bla ma rnams gsung la/

lam 'bras dpang rgyal lugs ni/ jo nang kun spangs chen po'i slob ma la stod dpang rgyal lam/ gnyos dpang rgyal du grags pa des khong rang gi sbyor drug gi sgo nas stong gzugs lta bu'i nyams cung zad cig skyes pa de la zhen nas/ snang ba lha ru 'char ba la/ /bskyed rims rtog bsgom dgos rgyu med/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad du ma zhig brtsams te/ lam 'bras pa snga ma rnams bkag pa'i lugs su byas nas/ rang lugs la thog mar 'khor 'das dbyer med ston cing de nyid sbyor drug gi sor sdud dang don gcig par byas nas mun khang du lus gnad bcas te sbyor drug ltar du sgom par byed pas/ lugs de ni rgya nag ha shang gi 'dod pa dang 'dra bas/ de mi 'thad pa'i tshul ni slob dpon ka ma la shi la'i bsgom rim tha ma las shes la/ lam 'bras jo nang lugs ni jo nang kun spangs kun tu bzang po bya bas/ 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa chen po la lam 'bras sa lugs dang / bla ma spro lung ba'i dngos slob kha char ba rin chen 'od ces pa la zha ma pho brgyud/ mo brgyud gnyis ka'i man ngag rnams zhus nas/ de la brag kha ba grags pa seng ge byang sems rgyal po/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od la sogs pa du mas zhus shing dar bar byas pa rnams la zer ro/ /gsum pa bla ma se la lam 'bras rab tu thob pa ni zhang ston mched gnyis yin te/ de yang gcen chos 'bar dang / gcung gzi brjid 'bar gnyis kyi 'bul ba dang / spyod lam sogs kyis bla ma mnyes nas gsung ngag rdzogs par gnang ste/ bla ma'i zhal nas nga'i chos 'di zhang ston mched gnyis kyis go de'i nang nas kyang zhang ston gzi brjid 'bar gyis go gsungs/ de yang gcung gzi brjid 'bar ni snga mo sku gshegs/ gcen chos 'bar gyis sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i tshul du bzhugs nas rang yul du mtshan mo 'bad rtsol drag pos mnyam bzhag gtso bor mdzad/ nyin mo so nam dang rdzogs chen bshad cing /

rjes thob kyi lta ba bskyangs pas/ lo brgyad nas khams 'dus pa bar pa'i thad sor slebs shing mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul brnyes la/ khyad par du gnyen gcug bzhi la mnga' brnyes pas/ stag dang bya la sogs pa'i lus gzhan du sprul bsgyur nus shing / yi dam dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan la brten nas snod ldan re re tsam la khrid gang zag gi blo dang bstun cing ci rigs par gnang ste/ de yang mdo smad gling kha a seng dang / sbrang yul gyi zhang 'ol ka ba gnyis la khams 'dus pa dang po'i khrid tshar bar byin/ bla ma'i drung du sgro 'dogs chod chod bsgom na 'thad bzlas pas/ sa yul ngan par phan chas mi 'grub zer nas so so'i yul du song / gzhan yang rlung sems la dbang thob pa'i sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa pho mo 'ga' byung / shin tu gsang nas 'pho ba 'byongs pa lnga cu tsam byung / lam 'bras kyi nyams myong gis rdzogs chen gyi khrid bka'i mdud pa grol te/ rdzogs chen gyi grub thob gnyis byung ste sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis dha na ko sha'i gling du song ngo / /zhes kha cig zer la/ de nas lam 'bras gces bsgom lugs ni sa skya pa chen po'i slob ma rgyal tsha lta ba phug pa dang / yang sa chen gyi slob ma khams bsgom chos kyi bla ma bya ba'i slob ma slob dpon jo bo zer ba gcig dang gnyis la gces bsgom rin po ches gsan cing / de la lam 'bras kyi gdams ngag rdzogs pa zhig gnang mod/ 'on kyang yi ger bkod pa ni lam 'bring po'i yig cha zhig yod la/ des bla ma brtson 'grus la snyan brgyud bzhi'i gdams pa nas cung zad tsam 'phel bar bshad gsungs la/ de nas lam 'bras phag gru ma ni/ rje phag mo grub pa de nyid kyis sa skyar bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i drung du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs nas lam 'bras kyi gdams ngag thob pa yi ger bkod pa la lam 'bras bshad mdzod ma zer ba yin gyi/ kha cig gis dpe mdzod ma zer ba ni ma dag pa yin gsungs/

de'i slob ma pradzñā kirti bya bas bshad mdzod ma de nyid kyi steng du phag gru'i gsung bgros rnams bsnan nas cung zad rgyas su btang ba bshad mdzod ma chen mor byed pa'ang 'dug pas 'di ni sa lugs kyi khongs su bsdu ba yin la/ de ltar lam 'bras lugs srol mi 'dra ba byung tshul yongs grags rags pa tsam brjod na de ltar yin kyang / rnam dpyod blo ldan rnams kyis zhib tu rtogs pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir gsung ngag bka' srol bco brgyad sogs byung tshul mdo tsam zhig sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung rab nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod na 'di ltar yin te/ de dag kyang rtogs sla ba'i phyir sdom du brjod na/ 'brog 1 gi rje ga ya dha ra la bdag min pa gzhan la mi gnang ba zhu zhes gsang bar zhus pa des bsgyur nas rgyal khams yongs la thos pa gsang gtam gyi jos2 bsgrags/ /se 3yi lce la re 'di'i gdams ngag kun phag ge lkog gegs byas gsungs pa ltar brkus nas zhang4 sku mched la byin/ /'brom 5gyis nyos pa tsaṇ+ḍa kirti zhabs tog dpag med bsgrubs nas sras 6kyis tshar/ 'brog jab/ /sring 7mos zha ma'i zhar la ming 8po rje khum bu ba chos kyi rjes thob/ /pho 9mo zha ma dang brgyud brgyud bsres pa'i dum bu la/ /ko bra10ga pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan ya zab ha dmigs rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i chos byung / /cha 11gan gyis kyang de thos nas/ zha ma pho mo gnyis sa skya pa dang /gsum bsres chos kyi phye grul 'gam/ /'brog thog mtha'i ma gyi jo rdo rje'i tshig rkang rnams jo 12nang du/ kun spangs chen pos /dkrugs sdebs bshad pas kun dang ma mthun pa mgo bo 'khor/ /thi thom lang pa'i las rigs la/ /khong rang dngos slob la stod pa gnyos dpang 13rgyal ba yi lam 'bras snga ma thams cad bkag pa'i khyad chos 'byung /

/zhang gis chos 'phags kyis lam 'bras mi mkhyen pa'i smyo brdzus btab pa la/ /sa 14chen spyang pos rdzun phugs rdibs/ nas lam 'bras lo ngo bzhi zhus/ /phyis nas sa skya'i ldan sa dkar po'i logs su/ /bir+wa ba 15ngan pas lam 'bras lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhi dang bcas sgo bskyel byas/ /phag16 grus 'thung nas ma 'chun par/ /lam 'bras nying khu skyugs pa la/ /ral phug pas gces bsgom 17bkren pos lce ldags byas/ /tshim nas grub pa'i sa la bzhugs/ /mang 'brog mi nas brgyud pa/ sras lugs/ zhang lugs/ dpang lugs kyi sdom nas brgyud pa rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi 'gyur skabs re rnam grangs su bkod tsam yod lam 18zhig pos gnad nas bzung / /lam srol bco brgyad bshad srol ni/ /rgan mo lhas su sngon dus byung / /da lta ming gi lhag ma tsam/ /thos chung bdag gis khrigs su bsdebs/ /zhes so/ /de dag mdor bsdus te bshad na 'brog mi las yab 1brgyud bu brgyud gnyis/ bu brgyud la sras 2brgyud slob 3brgyud gnyis/ slob brgyud la 'brog lugs dang se 4lugs gnyis/ se lugs la rab 'bring tha gsum du 'phel ba las/ dang po rab tu thob pa zhang 5lugs dang sa lugs gnyis/ sa lugs la nye brgyud ring brgyud gnyis/ ring brgyud la snga bu dang phyi bu gnyis/ snga bu la phag 6gru dang gces bsgom 7gnyis/ phyi bu phyis rje btsun gyis snyan brgyud yi ger spel ba rnams la snyan 8brgyud dang tshig 9brgyud gnyis zhu ba so so'i ngor mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel bcu gcig nye brgyud la gcen la sku dngos kyis lam 'bras rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 10du gdams pa dang / gcung la sku'i rnam 'phrul gyis dmigs pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du gdams 11pa'o/ /'bring du thob pa la pho brgyud mo brgyud bsres brgyud gsum/ dang po la gnyis te/

rje khum bu ba nas se bsgom brag skyabs/ rje mal gyo ba las 'phel ba'i slob 12brgyud dang / yang sras zha ma tsan+t+ri nas dpang rje la 'phel ba sras 13brgyud gnyis su gyes shing / de ltar pho brgyud lugs gnyis dang / gnyis pa mo brgyud la gsum ste/ zha ma'i slob ma myang bsgom la smon 14mkhar ba/ ston 15chung / dbon po 16sher tshul gsum la 'phel ba'i lugs gsum dang / gsum pa bsres brgyud kyi thog ma mo brgyud lugs gsum gyi brgyud pa'i bcud bsdus shing / brgyud pa de nyid la brten pa la/ pho brgyud lugs gnyis kyi bshad tshod 17kun dang / rang gi rtogs bcos ha dmigs rgya mtsho sogs gegs sel du ma'i gzer bus brgyan pa ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan 18pa'i lugs dang / zha lugs mtha' dag gi zab gnad thams cad bsdus shing / zhang dkon mchog gis bla ma dgon pa ba'i gsung zin bris su bkod pa nyid dkyus su bcug sa skya pa'i rnam 'grel bcu gcig gi nang nas mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos sil bu thams cad bsgrubs te rang gi 'dod pa dang mthun par sbyar ba cha 19rgan gyi lugs dang / sngon byon lam 'bras thams cad kyis bzhed pa gcig tu bsdus pa dang mthun par rdo rje'i tshig gi dbu zhabs gong 'og bsgyur ba'i 'grel bshad sogs sngon byon gang gi yang lugs su mi tshon pa'i 'grel pa jo nang kun mkhyen chen po dpal mi 20bskyod rdo rje'i lugs/ 'phros don sngar brjod pa la stod dpang rgyal 21lugs dang / 'brog jo sras gnyis/ zhang mched gnyis kyi ste sgo bzhi'i bcud bsdus pa mang 22lam zhig po'i lugs te bla ma se las 'bring du thob pa zha ma mched gnyis la brten nas dar tshul cung zad smos pa yin la/ de las gzhan se las gdams ngag tha mar thob pa gze bsgom pa byang chub ye shes/ grub chen nyin phug pa dang bcas pa'i lo rgyus rgyas pa yang ma brjod la/ de ltar sngar gyi srol gnyis las/

'brog las 'phel ba gnyis la yang nang gses kyi phra mor phye bas nyi shu rtsa gsum/ sngar gyi gyes gzhi gyi jo lugs bgrang pas rgyas par na nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'byung la/ 'bring gi 'byed na sdom du bstan pa'i srol bco brgyad dang / shin tu bsdu na/ gyi jo/ 'brom/ zhang ston/ zha ma/ ko brag pa/ mang lam/ cha rgan/ jo nang pa/ dpang rgyal/ sa skya pa/ mthar rtsa pa/ gces bsgom pa ste lugs bcu gnyis su 'du ba yin no/ /de ltar na lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i lam srol 'di la de lta bu'i lugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byung ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni rje mkhar chung pa chen po de la lam 'bras rab tu thob pa zhang ston mched gnyis las/ gcen po zhang ston chos 'bar gyis rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po de nyid la gnang ba de nas brgyud pa'i lam 'bras sa lugs thun mong ma yin pa 'di nyid yin pas/ de la ring brgyud/ nye brgyud/ shin tu nye brgyud dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po ni rje sa skya pa chen pos dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe/ rje zhang dgon pa ba'i drung du gsung ngag gsan nas lo bzhi song ba so gnyis pa'i steng du yongs su rdzogs nas bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa yin te/ de yang dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshe bla ma ba ri ba bsten nas 'jam dpal bsgrubs pas thog mar mi g.yo ba zhal gzigs/ de nas da lta 'jam dpal brag phug tu grags par 'phags pa 'jam dpal gtso 'khor gsum pa zhig zhal bstan nas zhen pa bzhi bral la sogs pa'i chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa nod/ de nas rong ngur smrig tu brang ti dar ma snying po la mngon pa/ nyang stong du khyung rin chen grags la tshad ma/ gnam kha 'ub tu dar ma rgyal mtshan sku mched la gsang 'dus/ sgyi chur 'khon dgra lha 'bar ram/ shākya 'bar ram/ dkon mchog 'bar la kyai rdor/ na la rtser mal lo tsā ba la bde mchog sogs gsan pa yin mod kyi/

skabs kyi gtso bo rje 'di nyid dge bcur bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dbugs zhes bya ba'i mdog gi sa char bla ma se chos 'khor gyi gtso bo la spyan drangs pa'i skabs shig tu bla chen sogs dge bcu'i grwa pa kha yar gyis bltar phyin pas/ bla ma se bshad hud mang po gsungs shing / grwa pa rnams la rim bzhin du dri rtog zhib par mdzad/ bla chen gyi thad du rlung ltas legs par brtags nas/ khyed gang pa yin gsungs/ 'khon gyi sras dod yin 'tshal zhus pas/ khyod gzhon nu ma la rdzun che/ nga'i bla ma la sras mi mnga' gsungs/ gral rogs rdo rje 'od kyis sras yin tshul zhib par glengs pas/ mi gson shi mi 'phrad zer te rdzun du 'dug gsungs nas zhal sprad cing shin tu dges par mdzad nas zhag 'ga' dbu sngas sbrel/ gsung ngag rin po che'i rtsa ba gsal byed 'phros don sogs kyi khog sgrigs lam me ba zhig gnang / nga rgan po gog po 'di la chos yod do myur du byon/ sang phod nga 'chi nyan yod do gsungs/ bla chen gyis dge bcur byon nas de 'phral 'byon par brtsams pa na/ gral rogs rdo rje 'od na re/ bla ma 'di pa nged thams cad las khyed kho na la rtsis che bar 'dug pas bla ma la zhus na 'thad zer/ phyag rten yang med/ rjes su mjal bas chog gsungs pas/ dar ljang khu kha gang bton nas/ phyag rten 'di la mdzod zer nas thugs 'thad po min pa zhig la drung du byon nas zhus pas/ se lce la re bya ba rdzun che/ nga'i bla ma mnga' ris pa'i chos kyi dral grul 'dra bsgrugs nas 'chad pa yin/ de la yon tan ci yang med/ rgyud gnyan po'i 'phro ma gcod gsungs nas ma gnang / 'o na sa skyar chas 'dra bsgrub tu 'gro bar zhu zhus pas/ mnyes po rang min pa zhig la gnang nas sa skyar byon te/ de lta bu 'phral bla ma phan tshun gyi phrag dog lta bur snang yang / bla ma se myur du sku 'da' bas lam yongs rdzogs mi 'byung zhing / bla ma zhang la yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas phan 'dogs yag med 'ong ba'i phyis 'byung gi rten 'brel khyad par can gzigs pa yin gsung /

de nas nye bar bla ma dge bcu pa sku 'das/ zhal chems bzhin rab tu byung par dgongs pa na/ bla ma gnam kha 'ub pa'i gsung gis/ phyis 'byung gi rten 'brel zhig yod pas/ rab byung ma byas pa phan che/ khong gshin po las nga gson po ngag btsan/ nga'i dam tshig las 'das na chos skyong gi cho 'phrul 'ong zhes zhi drag gi ngos nas bzlogs te/ sras brgyud kyi chos brgyud dri ma med pa dar rgyas su byed pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can gzigs pa yin gsung / de nas skabs shig tu bla ma zhang la gsung ngag zhu bar bzhed nas/ bla ma gnam la zhus pas/ sgom chen pa 'di tsho rdzun che/ chos la dum bu mang po byas nas lhag yod ri mna' skyel ba skad byed/ bsgom nus na gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs bstan pa'i nor rdzas sgoms gsungs pa la/ bdag rang la yid ches shig bdog zhus pas/ 'o na song gsungs nas gnang / de nas jo sras rgyal po dang gnyis kyis khrab stong ri ba zhig bsnams nas ding du phebs rgan mo zhig la bla ma zhang gang yin dris pas/ pha gi yin zer nas/ thags ma 'dra'i gseb na gtam chal chol 'dra gsungs/ ra thul gyon zhing / sham thabs med pa shang 'gag bsnams pa gcig 'dug lkog mog cig tu spyan drangs nas phyag phul bas/ khyod ni gsar ma ba zhig 'dra na rtog pa'ang che ba yin khyed nor gsungs/ khrab phul bas/ da phyir 'das/ nga rang yang bun len pa zhig yin gsungs/ de ma legs bdag gsung ngag rin po che'i zhu 'dod pa lags gsungs pas/ de 'dra'i ming tsam yang da lan min pa thos ma myong / nga rdzogs chen tsa mun dang / bram ze'i skor la mkhas pa zhig yin/ skom sing dang gnas khang dang yang med do/ /nyi ma snga ba la bzhud gsungs nas ma gnang ba la/ yod do bla mas gsungs pa la bla ma rdzun gsungs par 'dug snyam nas pha tshad du byon pas/ 'od mchog gi pha zhang skyabs ses/ da ci'i de ni deng sang sag thang ding 'di na bla ma ses dges pa'i jo sras sa skya pa de 'dra na zhus pas/

'o na dam tshig gi nyes par 'gyur nyen yod pas ldog gsungs nas thugs dges par mjal te gsung gleng zhib par mdzad/ da lan 'dir nya ma rnams la chos shig kyang bshad dgos yod cing / bsam mno 'dra yang gtang dgos pa yod/ se ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis paṇa chen dang paṇa chung mang po spyan drangs nas chos 'khor byed pa'i skabs su/ rnal 'byor bshad nyan skud pa 'gugs pa 'dra ba 'di mi mdzes/ ston byon cig tshang bar bgyid do gsungs nas dus btab/ ston de bzhin du byon nas gsung ngag rin po che rgyud gsum lam skor cha lag dang bcas pa lo bzhi la tshang bar gsan pa yin la/ khrid kyi skabs su bla ma'i ljags cung zad skrang pa la/ 'o skol gyi bar na dam tshig gi sel cung zad 'dug pas yig brgya zlos gsungs nas de bzhin mdzad pa dang / bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin nas sku'i bkod pa bya dang ri dwags su sprul pa dang / skyil krung gis ding gi gzhung khebs pa sogs bstan nas/ nged spun gyis kyang lo bco brgyad kyi bar du bla ma'i drung du bsdad kyang lan gsum sgro 'dogs gcod du 'gro dgos pa byung / yi ges shes pa'i chos min pas sgom la 'bungs/ sgom nyams kyi spros pa nang nas chod na/ tshig gi mdud pa phyi nas mi grol kha med yin/ lo bco brgyad kyi bar du ming tsam yang ma zer/ de nas 'chad dam/ yi ger 'dri khyod rang chos kyi bdag po yin no/ /zhes lung bstan dpag med mdzad de ring brgyud nas dar tshul lo/ /gnyis pa nye brgyud ni/ rje sa chen dgung lo zhe bzhi bzhes dus zer yang / zhe bdun gyi steng du gsan pa dag gsung ste/ de yang gung thang du dug byung ba'i dug ro langs nas zla gcig tsam gyi bar du snyung bas sngar gyi chos thams cad bsnyel/ grogs la dri sa ni med/ rgya gar du phyin yang ji 'dra yod cha med snyam thugs cung zad ma bde nas/ 'jam dpal brag phug tu sku mtshams bsdams/

bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ ji zhig nas rje dgon pa ba mnal lam du byon nas chos gsungs/ thugs cung zad spro nas gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ rje dgon pa ba dngos su byon nas chos gsungs pas/ chos thams cad thugs la gsal dran/ de nas kyang thugs ches spro zhing gsol ba che cher btab pas/ tho rangs kha rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa zhabs skyil krung / phyag chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas su shar phyogs nag po pa zhabs skyil krung / g.yas ba man gyi rwa dung / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon du ga ya dha ra na bza' dkar po lding gon mdzad nas/ rdor dril thugs khar bsnol ba/ rgyab tu ko ṭa li ba pus mo btsugs nas gdugs 'dzin pa/ mdun du bi na sa ste nags khrod pa thal mo sbyar nas bdud rtsi 'bul ba ste gtso 'khor lnga/ sa dkar po rgyab yol du mdzad/ ya gi'i mon grog nas ma gi'i 'bal grog gi bar skyil krung gis khyab par mdzad nas 'di rnams thams cad nga dbang gsungs shing byon nas zhal bstan pas/ thugs la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs/ a la la ste zhes sogs kyi bstod pa mdzad/ de nas zla gcig gi bar du 'tsho ba zur nas blangs shing sku mtshams bsdams nas gtso 'khor ci rigs par byon cing bla med kyi rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis sam/ bla med dang 'brel ba'i dbang byin rlabs sogs kyi chos sna bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ khyad par du lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhi la sogs pa gsan pa yin te/ 'di dag gi tshul ni rje btsun gyis sga skyog la gdams pa na'ang cung zad yod cing / gsal bar ni zhu byas kyi yi ge na yod pa yin gsungs la/ 'dir gnad kyi gtso bo ni rje btsun sku mched kyis brda tshig gi don bkrol nas gsungs te/ de yang / ye shes zla ba dri med mig la shar/ /sde snod gsum gyi yon tan gsal bar byas/ /rgya mtsho'i gting du nor bu bzhin du mdzes/

/blo dang ldan pas rtogs 'gyur gzhan gyis min/ /zhes pa 'di rje pa'i tshigs bcad gcig dang 'brel nas glegs bam dkar chag gi dpe la la'i mjug tu bris yod pas/ rje pa'i gsung yin no snyam du 'khrul pa'ang yod mod kyi/ dngos po la slob dpon rin po che'i gsung yin la/ de'i don bkrol na/ zla bas ni gcig gi grangs nas mtshon pas/ ye shes lnga ldan gyi gcig rdo rje 'chang chen te brgyud pa kun gyi thug sa dang po'o/ /mig gis gnyis kyi grangs 'dzin pas brgyud pa gnyis pa bir+wa pa ste gtso bo yab yum gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyi 'od dkar dri ma med pa der bshad pa'o/ /sde snod ni gsum gyi grangs 'dzin pas brgyud pa gsum pa bla chen sa skya pa chen po ste de nyid kyi yon tan gyi nor bu gsal bar mdzad pa'o/ /rgya mtsho ni bzhi'i grangs 'dzin pas brgyud pa bzhi pa slob dpon rin po che ste de nyid kyi thugs mtshor chud pas rgya mtsho'i nor bu lta bu shin tu mdzes shing dgos 'dod stsol ba'o/ /tshul 'di lta bu'i nye brgyud kyi don blo skal ba dman pas mi rtogs pas/ skyes thob dang sbyangs pa'i rnam dpyod dang skal ba mchog dang ldan pas khong du tshud nas rtsol ba rab kyis blangs shing bshad bsgrub gyi rgyal mtshan gyi tog tu gzung bar bya ste brda 'grol dang po'o/ /brda tshig gnyis pa ni rje btsun rin po che la/ ram sding ma ba 'byung gnas rdo rjes/ khyed la brgyud pa mchog cig yod 'dug pa/ brgyud pa khyad par can dang / brgyud pa de nyid la yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' tshul zhig cis kyang gnang dgos zhus pas/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa/ /rig byed kyis gsal lag pas me la bgo de 'od kun gsal chu gter 'byung bar babs/ /blo ldan don 'di shes na smra bar gyis/ /zhes lan du gsungs pa yin la/ phyis stong thun sa bcad du 'jug par mdzad pa de nyid yin no/

/'di'i brda 'grol mdzad pa po ni du ma byung ste/ bdag chen rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan skyed lhas kyi 'phags pa brag phug tu thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i skabs gcig tu/ chos rje kun mkhyen gyis mjal du byon/ sku mtshams dam yang thugs dges pas mjal/ zab mo'i don la 'bel gtam kho na mdzad pa'i mu der/ khyod kyis ram sding ma ba la gnang ba'i brda tshig 'di'i don rtogs sam/ 'di gnad du che ba yin gsungs pas/ bdag gi gzhig pa ma 'chug gsungs nas/ dpal ldan sa skya'i bar la/ a bla med phyogs ni zhes yang yang gsungs/ sa skyar phebs ma thag sna ro ban+dhe gshin rje grags kyis bzhengs pa'i rje pa'i sku 'dra'i drung du gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ thugs la brda don gsal ba dran nas brda 'grol nges pa'i dpal ster zhes pa mdzad/ de bzhin du chos rje rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / srad pa kun blo sogs kyis kyang brda 'grol re'ang 'byung zhing / yang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ bla med ni bla med kyi rgyud dam/ bla med dang 'brel ba'i chos rnams/ phyogs ni bcu'i grangs 'dzin te bcu/ ri ni bdun te/ des bsgyur ba'i bdun cu/ mig ni gnyis te bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ rig byed ni bzhi yin la/ 'di bla med kyi rgyud man ngag gnyis char la nye brgyud ston byed yin pas/ rgyud kyi 'chad thabs bzhi dang / man ngag gi snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgo nas gsal bar mdzad pa ste/ lag pa gnyis pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis me gsum pa bla chen sa skya pa la bsgos pa'o/ /de'i 'phrin las kyi 'od phyogs thams cad du gsal bar mdzad nas/ chu gter bzhi pa slob dpon rin po che la babs shing / 'byung ba lnga pa rje btsun rin po che nyid la babs so/ /des ni brda tshig gnyis pa'i don bkrol ba ste/ nye brgyud dus nam gyi tshe dang / tshul ji ltar byung pa bstan pa'o/ /de lta bu'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rin po che de dag gi yon tan gyi khyad par ni ji lta bu zhes tshol ba'i ngal ba ni blo dang ldan pa dag la don med pa yin mod/

'od kyang gdul bya'i snang ngo dang bstun nas ngo mtshar ba'i cha shas ji ltar 'tshams par bstan tshul cung zad tsam thad so thad so'i bsgo skal du gsungs te/ de yang bla chen nyid kyis gling 'di nyid du sku'i bkod pa drug bstan nas mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang / 'jam dbyangs dang bir+wa pa las mdo rgyud kyi zab mo'i gnad thams cad thugs su chud nas 'chad cing 'dom pa dang / skabs shig tu khams pa cig gis/ khyed spyan ras gzigs yin pa'i rtags mngon sum du mi ston na/ kho bo 'di nyid du 'gum mo/ /zhes gri snying khar btsugs pas/ de btsugs mi dgos 'di la ltos gsungs nas phyag mthil nas spyan bstan pa sogs dang / sku 'da' tshul bstan pa'i tshe spur khang nas 'khor lo bde mchog phyogs gang nas bltas kyang zhal bzhi par 'ong ba zhig tu phal mo ches mthong zhing / dge bshes zangs ri phug pas bskor ba mdzad pas rtsa zhal khong la khyu ru ru bsgyur ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad par yang mthong zhing / spur thal mtsho la sbyangs pas mtsho la bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lam me byung nas/ deng sang sku 'bum rnam rgyal du grags pa'i thog la mtshon byed du bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor bris nas yod pa 'di yin/ phyis ne spur bzhu ba'i dud ris la grub pa yin zhes gleng bar 'dug gsungs/ de nas bde ba can/ po ta la/ u rgyan/ gser mdog can bzhir sku'i bkod pa bzhi bstan nas gshegs te/ de'i rgyu mtshan rim pa ltar 'jig rten dbang phyug gi longs bde ba can sprul po ta la yod pa dang / rgyud u rgyan sde'i glegs bam mkha' 'gro mas rgyas btab nas yod pa dang / sras rje btsun 'byon pas de'i zhing sbyong ba'i ched yin zhes zhu byas dngos grub kyis bshad gsungs/ 'o na de lta bu'i bla chen sa skya pas gsung ngag ji ltar spel snyam na/ lnga bcu'i stod kho nar zhang gi gdams pa'i bka' rgya grol bas/

dgung lo lnga bcu skor du slebs pa'i dus de tsam du mdo rmad kyi khams pa a seng zhes grags pa/ skyu ra a skyabs bya ba bla ma zhang la khams 'dus pa dang po tsam gyi khrid tshar ba/ bla chen dang phar slob tshur slob tu 'brel ba de'i dbon nam sras su byed pa des lam 'bras khungs chod nas zhus pa'i ngor gsung gi bka' rgya grol ba dang rten 'brel 'grig pa nas/ gsung ngag rin po che gnang ba'i thog ma de yin/ gzhung bshad la snga ba yang des zhus pa'i a seng ma ste/ lam 'bras yi ger bkod pa'i yang thog mar grags pa'o/ /de nas lo bzhi ma gsungs/ de nas gcig dang / gsum dang / lnga dang / bdun la sogs pa dang / sum cu rtsa bdun dang / mthar nges med gsungs shing / gzhung bshad kyi skabs su/ dang por thog mtha' gnyis dang / bar du gnyis te tshogs 'khor bzhi mdzad/ de nas thog mthar dang / bar dam tshig gso ba ste gsum du mdzad/ de nas gnyis dang gcig la sogs pa ci rigs par mdzad de/ mdor na gsung ngag rin po che'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad pa yin no/ /'o na rje bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i gsung las byon pa'i gzhung bshad sogs ngo mtshar ba'i yi ge'i tshogs ji 'dra yod/ de dag bshad bsgrub kyi sgo nas 'dzin pa'i bu slob kyi tshogs ngo mtshar ba ji 'dra byung snyam na/ bla chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad rnam 'grel ni bcu gcig yod do zhes grags mod/ bcu gcig po'i ngos 'dzin rjes 'jug gzhan thams cad la rang gi pho tshod kyis gzhal ba tsam ma gtogs/ yid ches kyi khungs gsal bar byon pa ni su la yang med la/ dus phyis bdag chen rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan pas/ zhu byas dngos grub kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa zhig nas 'di'i khungs gsal bar rnyed nas yid ches pa'i gtan tshigs dang ldan pa zhig yod do/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang de lta bu'i bstod pa'i dpe de nyid yar lung pa'i bla brgyud sa chen gyi dus/

yar bsgom se'o/ rje btsun gyi dus rgyal tsha lung mang pa/ chos rje pa'i dus do pa ston tshul/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ chos rje bla ma dam pa'i dus yar lung pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rin po che'i dus mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim pa dang / yar lung pa'i gdung brgyud rim par byon dpon slob du 'brel chags byon pa de dag las brgyud de/ seng rgyal gyi dbon po mkhan bsod nams rgyal ba nas/ bdag chen rin po che'i phyag tu byon pa yin la/ de nyid las/ zab don yongs su rdzogs pa'i slob ma ni/ /pho brgyad mo gsum dag la yi ger gdams/ /zhes bshad nas/ de'i mchan rnying du so so'i ngos 'dzin 'byung ba/ bdag chen nyid kyis sdom du mdzad pa ni/ a seng zhu klog yum dang sras/ /zla zangs mang sga 'a 'u snyag /ces gsungs te/ a seng la gnang bas a seng ma/ zhu byas rang la gdams pas zhu byas ma/ klo kya jo sras chos grags la gdams pa'i klog kya ma/ sa chen gyis thog mar bod btsan po'i sras brgyud ma cig yum du bzhes pa las/ sras btsad tsha kun dga' 'bar sku gshegs pa nas/ yum thugs chos la 'gyur nas bla chen las bde kyai gnyis kyi zab don blangs/ bskyed rim bde mchog dang / rdzogs rim gsung ngag la mdzad pa zhig byung ba de nyid la gdams pa/ bskyed rim bde mchog la sbyar ba'i rnam 'grel yum don ma/ sras rje btsun sku mched gnyis kyi don du shog dril du bkol ba/ thugs sras gnyan phul byung pa gtsug tor rgyal por grags pa/ mtshan dngos bsod nams rdo rjes khrigs su bsdebs pa ste sras gsum la gdams pa sras don ma/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan du grags pa bla chen las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs nas sras la phog pa de nyid la gdams pa zla rgyal ma/ zangs ri phug pa la gdams pa zangs ri phug ma/ mang mkhar gyi jo mo mang chung ma la gdams pa mang chung ma/

zhabs cung zad skyog cing gyol ba khams pa sga theng la gdams pa sga thang ma/ g.ya' lung gi jo mo 'a 'u ma la gdams pa 'a 'u ma/ snyag gzhi ra ba dbang phyug rgyal mtshan la gdams pa rnam 'grel snyag ma ste/ gzhan dag gis sna ro ban+dhe ma dang / stod ston byang chub shes rab ma gang 'thad bcug nas mang chung ma dor bas ni pho brgyad mo gsum gyi don ma tshang bas/ rnam 'grel bcu gcig ni 'di kho nar gsal bas gzhan du yid g.yo bar mi bya'o/ /phyis chos rje kun mkhyen la bdag chen rin po ches dpe 'dis gsal btab pa na/ chos rje yang shin tu thugs tshim/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa la gang nas kyang ngo mtshar ba'i cha shas re ka 'dug gsungs nas/ sngar rje rdo rje 'chang gi ngos 'dzin ltar mdzad pa la/ phyis brgyud pa 'di pa ltar mdzad pa zhig byung zhing / chos rje pad rgyal ba la yang de bzhin du mdzad pas phyis 'di bzhin du mdzad gsungs/ mdzad pa'i go rim ni/ thog mar a seng ma/ de nas skabs shig tu sga thang gi ru mtshams su bla chen chos 'khor la spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ khong gi zin bris 'dra gzigs pas gnad 'chugs pa 'ga' re 'dug nas/ da nga shi na chos 'di nub 'gro ba 'dug gsungs nas/ khong gis kyang zhus pa'i ngor rnam 'grel sga thang ma mdzad la/ mjug tu rnam 'grel snyag ma mdzad cing / gzhan rnams kyi go rim ma mthong gsungs/ de ltar na rnam 'grel bcu gcig las/ deng sang gi bar du bshad bka'i rgyun ma chad pa ni snyag ma nyid yin la/ lung rgyun yod pa ni thog mtha' gnyis dang / sras don ma nyid dang gsum sogs 'ga' re yod par sems mo/ /mang mkhar lam 'bras blo bzang dkar mo la rnam 'grel bcu gcig gi lung bzhugs zhes gleng yang / rdo rje'i tshig rkang ma dang / rgyal ba 'byung gnas la gnang ba'i dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod ces sogs rnam 'grel med pa dang ma yin pa la grangs su btab pa'i nor pa du ma mthong bas yid brtan du rung ba tsam med gsungs/

de bzhin du don ri grags chen la gzhung bshad bco brgyad kyi lung bzhugs zhes gleng ba dang / rgan mo lhas pa khams chen byang chub dpal la lam 'bras kyi bka' srol bco brgyad bzhugs zhes gleng ba yang rgyang nas sgra snyan che ba tsam ni 'dug nye bar sleb na de dang 'dra ba las med dam/ zhes snga rabs kyi yig cha 'ga' rer gsungs 'dug go /gzhung bshad dam rnam 'grel bcu gcig po de tsam du nges sam snyam na bla chen nyid kyis slob bu la dngos su gdams pa ni de tsam du grags la/ bla chen thugs sras dang bcas pa'i gzhung bshad gcig tu bsdoms na nyi shu tsam yod gsungs te/ bcu gcig gi khar sna ro ban+dhes mdzad pa/ stod bsgom byang chub shes rab kyis mdzad pa/ mi nyag pradzñā dza las mdzad pa/ zhu brag dmar bas mdzad pa/ zhang ze dmar bas mdzad pa/ 'u yug gi dbyar sbu bas mdzad pa/ phag mo grub pas mdzad pa la sogs pa'o/ /a seng ma chen mor grags pa 'di the ba'i dbang du byas na nyi shu rtsa gcig yin gsungs so/ /slob ma'i tshogs ji lta bu snyam na/ kun gyi mchog ni slob dpon rin po che ste/ 'di ni sa dang po gzhon nu sa la bzhugs shing / sku'i bkod pa gnyis tsam bstan par bshad la/ gzhan bla chen gyi mtshan lam dang / bla ma zhang dgon pa sogs kyi lung bstan dang bstun nas/ grub thob gsum/ bzod thob bdun/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa brgyad cu/ zhes grangs su 'cha' yang / grub thob dang bzod thob sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pas 'di dag kho na'o zhes ni mi gsungs la/ dang po gsum ni/ siṅga gling gi rnal 'byor pa/ byang sems stag bsgom pa skyi 'bar ro/ /dang po ni/ siṅga gling nas 'ong pa'i a tsar gcig gis na la rtser bla chen la sman bzang drug 'ga' dang / bzab chen gyi bla bre gcig phul nas mjal/ lam sbas bshad kyi khrid kyis dkris nas zla ba drug nas grub pa thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ yul stag ste seṅge lung pa/

sku lus zhag bdun dor/ mthar de nyid la zhugs te grub pa thob pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yul 'phrang 'og pa ste hūm̐ ring 'byongs pa'i rgyang skad rag dung 'dra ba/ khrid 'phro gnyan phul byung pa la bskyangs te grub pa thob pa'o/ /bzod thob bdun ni/ rje btsun rin po che/ zhu byas/ sga ston rdo rje grags/ bsgom pa 'od zer grags/ nags bsgom pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ char kha'i rnal 'byor pa/ mang chung ma'o/ /gnyis pa zhu byas ni yul lho pa/ zhu ston rog po bya ba'i dbon po yin/ khong bla chen la dad nas sa skyar 'gro bar zhus pas/ nga rgan po zhig gis btsun chung 'di rnams la kha lta dang chos 'chad pa 'di khyod kho na'i ched yin/ khyod gang la 'gro gsungs pas/ 'o na rang re'i phar phyin na/ bdud la la slob dpon gyi cha byad du 'ong bar bshad pa de khyed du mi gda'am zhus pas lan ma byung ste gnang ba thob/ sa skyar byon nas bla chen la gsung ngag thob/ re zhig gzhung bshad kyi bla ma dang grogs kyi dbang gis thabs phyogs su lhung ba zhes sogs kyi bshad pa gnang ba'i skabs su/ zhu byas kyis cung zad bzhad nas sngar gyi lo rgyus zhus pas/ bla chen gyi zhal nas 'o na cung thal drags pa zhig smras 'dug pa gsungs/ de lta bu'i zhu byas des bod so mi sod gsungs nas rgya gar la bzhud/ bla chen sa dkar logs kyi dan na chos gsung ba'i skabs shig tu/ bya rgod cig 'phur byung / de nas zhu byas 'dra ba zhig chos nyan la 'dug mi rnams the tshom log ge ba'i mu nas/ slar yang bya rgod du byas nas 'phur song ngo / /yang rje btsun sku mched dgong mo tshogs 'khor gcig mdzad pa'i dus/ a bo zhu byas de yang yod na ang gsung ba sogs gleng 'phros byung bas/ a po zhu byas/ 'ol ma se'i phreng ba rlon pa dang / 'bras rlon gyi snye ma tshar re ba zhig gis phyag rten mdzad/ da ci nyi zer la 'ong gsungs nas sleb byung / rje pas/

a po zhu byas do nub mi yang nyung rdzu 'phrul zhig ston dang gsungs pas/ de 'dra mi gsung ba zhu zer rtsab rtsob byed/ mi lto yi cis kyang ston cig gsungs pas/ thog mar rmig rtse zhig nas zhu byas 'dra ba gcig bton nas phyag gsum btsal gral la 'khod/ de bzhin de 'dra bdun byung nas slar rim par bsdus te/ de tsam du gda' yo gsungs te rdzu 'phrul de 'dra ba mang po bstan pa'o/ /sga ston ni khams pa ste/ rje pas sga ston gdams yig gnang ba de yin/ bsgom pa 'od grags ni/ dmyal ba'i gnas sbyong shar ba de yin te/ de yang sa skya'i mdun yin no snyam pa zhig na/ shing sdong zhig gi rtse na 'dug mar bltas pas mtsho dmar ldog gi ba zhig 'dug der ma lhung na dga' ste snyam tsa na lhung song bas/ rus par khrol te song / 'khyags na dga' ste snyam tsa na 'khyags de la lus sbyar bas lkogs pa glo snying khrol mthong tsa na sad pa la sogs pa'o/ /nang bsgom pa ni/ yul rta nag pa yin/ chung ngu nas gshin rje gshed la thugs dam byed pa zhig gis phyugs 'tsho mkhan byas/ khong gis thugs dam gyi lan sod byas pas/ ba glang gshin rje gshed/ sgra thams cad sngags su shar/ khong la zhus pas/ las 'phro yod pa yin gsungs nas bsre ba'i cho ga mdzad pa yin gsungs so/ /tshar kha'i rnal 'byor pa ni/ bla chen gyi sku bkod pa gcig gis tshar khar gsung ngag gsungs nas 'bras bu thob pa'i rtags dang ldan pa'o/ /mang chung ma ni/ dud 'gro'i gnas sbyong shar te/ mang mkhar gyi mdar ko ko yog tu dgos/ g.yag khyu chen po zhig byung ste rmig leb la bcar ba snyam byed pa nas sad pa sogs byung ba de'o/ /gsum pa shin tu nye brgyud dar tshul ni/ bla chen sa skya pa zhi bar gshegs nas lo zhe bzhi/ rje btsun rin po ches nga drug bzhes pa'i tshe/ snye mo ru mtshams kyi gtsang kha dgon par mnal lam du bla chen byon nas rdo dkar 'jam la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa phyogs bzhi stong pa/
