mtshams bzhir ya ra la was mtshan pa'i brda dang / don tshigs bcad du bsdus pa ni/ dang po kun gzhi gdan du byas/ /gnyis pa rlung la sbar 'dzin bya/ /byang chub chu rgyun dbu mar zhugs/ /sa sogs 'byung ba dbang du bsdu/ /zhes nyams len dril nas bstan pa'o/ /de lta bu'i rje btsun rin po che de'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa cung zad ni/ rgya gar du 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gsal zhing / rdzogs rim dang lhag bsam dang bral ba zhig tshe'i dus byas nas/ dbu dgu'i dod lba ba dgu brtsegs byas pa'i 'dre gdug pa can gcig tu skyes/ de nyid kha che paṇa chen bod du byon pa'i rjes su 'brangs/ su gang gis kyang bzlog par ma nus pa'i tshe/ paṇa chen sa skyar phebs pa'i skabs su rje pas rdo dril bsnams nas bsu ba la byon/ 'gab 'brangs de mkhyen nas rdo dril nam khar bzhag nas bskrad pas/ rgya gar la yang ldog ma nus pa rgya nag la song bas/ deng sang rgya nor khams che tsam gyi rjes su myul ba de'o/ /yang skabs shig tu rje btsun gzim spyil dkar po thugs dam la bzhugs dus/ chos rje la paṇa chen gyis/ khyod kyi khu bo ci byed kyin yod gsungs/ thugs dam la zhugs zhus pas/ rang re bltar 'gro gsungs/ bdag gis sngon la phyin lags kyi zhus pas/ mnyam du 'gro gsungs nas/ rje pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i bdag bskyed tshar nas mdun bskyed kyi mchod bstod mdzad pa'i thad du phebs/ rje pas phyag mdzad snyam bzhengs rdo dril lcog rtse khar bzhag pa dgongs tsa na bar snang la khro le bzhag 'dug paṇa chen pa na re/ de tsam la ngo mtshar rgyu tsam yang yod de gsungs pas/ ngo mtshar du re nas byas pa ma lags gsungs/ rje pa la paṇa chen pas phyag lan mdzad pas/ paṇa chung rnams kyis khong dge bsnyen zhig la phyag lan mdzad par mi 'os/ snga gong nas kyang phyag lan mi mdzad par zhu phul bar gda'/ zhes chad yod pa ma lags sam zhus pas/ de yin te khong mahā badz+ra dngos su 'dug pa gsungs te/

gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du gzigs pa yin gsungs/ yang skabs shig tu sa skyar paṇa chen pas dus 'di la nyi ma gza' 'dzin zhes yi ge btab/ rje pas de skad mi gsung ba zhu/ da lan cis kyang mi 'dzin pa 'dug zhus pas/ paṇa chung rnams kyang thugs khrel gyi rnam pa mdzad/ de nas paṇa chen chos rje pa dang bcas pa shangs bsreg shing du phebs/ nyi ma gza' 'dzin dus btab bzhin ma byung bas/ paṇa chen pa na re/ de tsam dag kho rang shes te/ stod ya gi na dge bsnyen rgad po zhig nga rgyal yod gsungs so/ /yang rje pas klu nag po 'khun shes la/ nga gtsug lag khang gcig byed pas khyod kyi nor de rnams gzhan cig tu skyol dgos gsungs pas/ phyogs kun tu btsal bas rgya mtsho'i mtha' pha gi na cung zad cig 'dug gzhan bskyal sa ma rnyed zer/ ci tsam nas 'khyos gsungs pas/ gser rkyang pa bskyas na yang lo stong dgos zer 'o na khyod rang sdod la sa blangs gsungs nas/ mon rdo rje ra dzas sna drangs/ rje pas ded de/ deng sang bla brang shar gyi pha bong rom me ba de yin/ de nas dbu rtse rnying mar grags pa 'di bzhengs pa yin te/ yang rje pa byang gi sa cha brag phug lho sbril ba/ bar na dkar khung yod pa zhig na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba rgyang pa na/ lung pa'i mda' nar jig dir mang po 'dug nye gnas kyis bltas pas rta pa mang po byung / re zhig nas rje pa'i gzim phug tu song / shong pa ni med snyam dkar khung nas bltas pas/ mi mang po skad mi go ba sna tshogs smra zhing thal mo sbyar/ byis pa lo brgyad pa gos dkar po gyon zhing / g.yu'i bya ru bzhi btsugs pa zhig gis lo tsā byed/ rje pa 'gro ba'i don la 'byon dgos tshul zhu ba na/ nga rgas shing las 'brel tsam med pas khyed la phan mi thogs/ nga'i tsha bo kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang khyed las 'brel yod pas gtang ngo gsungs pa sogs gleng / de nas rje pa byon nas chang yod dam gsungs/

mang po tsam med/ bum gang bdog zhus pas/ ci rung gis bltar mi rung bas khyod rang ma lta zhig gsungs/ chang thod par byin rlabs mdzad pas thams cad bzi bzi 'thungs shing / mtshan gang glu gar byed pa mthong ste/ hor gyi lha gnam thel dang / bod kyi btsan thang rgyal po yin par bshad/ gzhan yang klu gtsug na rin chen rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa mgo sa skya dang / mjug rgya nag tu bstad pa'i sgo nas dpal ldan sa skya pa la dpal 'byor gyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa sogs gsungs te/ mdor bsdus tsam yin la/ zhib tu chos rje pa'i mdzad pa'i rnam thar mnal lam la sogs pa bzhin yin no/ /de lta bu'i rje btsun rin po ches gsung ngag rin po che'i bstan pa bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas legs par bzung bas/ slob ma'i mchog bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig byon pa las/ 'phrin las kyi rgyun 'dzin pa'i gtso bo ni chos rje pa nyid yin la/ rje pa nyid kyis lam 'bras glegs bam du bsgrigs pa sogs 'og tu smra zhing / lhor dkar shākya grags/ nub tu nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ byang du gsal lo dbang phyug grags/ shar du ban+dhe gshin rje grags te grags pa'i mtha' can bzhi zhes grags pa'i/ dkar shākya grags kyis gzhung bshad dbang chu sogs mdzad/ gra ston blo gros grags pas kyang gzhung bshad mdzad de tshig gi sna ring zhing phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod/ mdzad byang med pas min no/ /zhes gleng ba'ang yod mod/ brgyud pa 'di pa ba dag des mdzad par ngos 'dzin gsungs/ yang dpyil ston rgyal ba bzang po gyis kyang rje pa la lam 'bras tshar bco brgyad gsan cing / de dag gi bar la lam 'bras kyi yi ge sna gcig kyang ma gzigs/ phyis rje pa la dri gtugs yang dag mdzad nas khong rang gis gzhung bshad cig mdzad de/ 'di la yang gnad zab po yod gsung / rje pa'i bla ma'i gtso bo ni slob dpon rin po che ste sku lus ma spangs par gshegs so zhes kyang 'dod la/

rje pa'i bla ma gnyan phul byung ba ni sa skya'i dan nyid nas rin po che'i khri dang bcas te sku lus ma spangs par gshegs pa kun gyis mthong zhes lam zab kyi yi ge las 'byung gsungs so/ /chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos gsung ngag rin po che'i rgyun spel ba'i slob ma ni/ bshad pa'i brgyud 'dzin lho dmar rnam gnyis/ man ngag dang bsgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin tshogs grub dpon gsum zhes grags pa'i/ dmar chos rgyal gyis chos rje pa'i gsung la zin bris byas gzhung bshad dmar ma dang / chos 'byung zhib mo rdo rje dang / gegs sel bka' rgya ma/ lam bsdus 'dod pa'i lcags kyu/ bla ma rin 'byung sogs yig chung dang bcas pa mdzad de/ de'i slob ma gye re sgang ston nam snar thang sgang ston te/ gang ston sher 'bum/ des dkar po brag pa rin chen seṅge zhes grags pa/ lo brgya dang lnga lon pa des dpal ldan tshul khrims nas brgyud de brgyud pa 'di la zam ma chad par bzhugs pa'o/ /lho pa kun mkhyen rin chen dpal bzang pos gzhung bshad snga rtsom mdzad byang med pa bsdus tsam zhig dang / phyi rtsom rgyas pa mdzad byang can gnyis yod cing / sku shin tu bgres pa nas byang ngos su chos rje nyid la brda don gsal ba'i tho bsgrigs zhus shing gsal byed kyang mdzad/ rin po che tshogs bsgom kun dga' dpal bzang pos/ chos rje pa nyid lo bcu gsum bsten nas bshad bsgrub spel mar mdzad cing / bde mchog gi skor la yig 'jog kyang dum pa mdzad la/ gsung ngag la'ang dbang rab 'bring gsum gyi khrid yig sogs cung zad yod gsungs/ grub thob yon tan dpal bzang pos ni/ chos rje pa'i gzim g.yog lo drug mdzad nas mthar kho bo skye ran tsa na skyes/ chos rje pa lta bu dang mjal/ smin ran tsa na smin/ bsgrub pa snying por byas/ da 'chi ran tsa na 'chi dus 'di'am gsungs shing / 'khor rnams la yang bsgrub pa la nan tan gyis/

ma bde ba byung na nga rang la dris/ sang tsa na bzla rgyu the tshom las mi yong gsungs pa'i bka' gnang mdzad/ chos rje pa la rtogs pa phul bas 'di mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes yin/ da mtshon bya don gyi ye shes myur du 'char bar gda' gsungs/ 'phags pa rin po che la da bdag gis nyams blangs ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ rtag tu lta ba skyangs shing ting nge 'dzin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor mchog la yang yang dbang blangs shing / /phyag rgya chen po'i lam nas 'pho ba yis/ /ting nge 'dzin la rtag tu brtson bgyid pa/ /khyod kyis bgyi ba legs pa bdag gis 'khum/ /zhes pa gnang zhing / zab mo mdo lnga'i lung yang 'phags pas zhus/ mdor na spyi'i sen mo rar rje pa'i gdung bzhugs pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten zhig dpyil ston mched kyis bzhengs 'dug pa gnas de la sogs pa dben gnas mchog rnams su bsgrub pa snying por mdzad pa kho na las/ yig 'jog 'di mdzad bya ba ni med gsungs/ sku'i dbon po 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni/ se ston ri ba'i sku skyer yang grags te/ de yang yab zangs tshas tshogs bdag bsgrubs pas/ tshogs bdag gi glang po ches sna rtser 'khur nas ri rab kyi rtser bskyal te ltos shig zer bas/ zangs tsha skrag nas ring zhig blta ba'i nus pa ma byung / de nas dbus gtsang khams gsum sogs bod kyi gzhung tal tsam zhig gzigs pas/ khyod rang gis gang mthong dbang du 'du ba yin pa la/ dbus gtsang khams gsum sogs khyod kyi bu'i tsha brgyud kyis dbang du 'du ba zhig 'byung / myur du ma mthong bas khyod rang la ni dbang thang med zer/ de nas kyang zangs tsha la sras yun ring du ma byung bas thugs zid thung nas/ tshogs bdag gnad la dbab pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pas/ skabs shig gi tshe glang thang du se ston ri ba'i rtsar tshogs bdag byung nas/ zangs tshas nga la dbus gtsang khams gsum 'du ba zhig dgos zer nas rgyab tshags mig ltar song song bskul ba yin pas/

khong rang la ni dbang rigs mi 'dug kho'i bur khyod skye ba bzhes na 'du ba 'dug pas bsam bzhin skye ba len dgos zer nas de bzhin mdzad pa yin la/ de lta bu tshogs grub dbon gsum gyi brgyud pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'dus pa ni grub chen brag phug pa yin te/ de yang zhang dkon mchog dpal pas/ thog mar grub thob pa las gsung ngag yongs su rdzogs par thob pa/ gnyis pa rin chen rgyal mtshan las gsung ngag rdzogs par gsan nas/ de'i rjes su dge slong kun blo gnyis kyis mdo khams gtso mda'i bar du bsnyegs nas 'phags pa rin po che la gsan pa yin la/ de la brag phug pas gsan pas gnyis/ yang tshogs bsgom pa'i slob ma nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa la'ang brag phug pas gsan pas gsum char 'dus pa'o/ /yang tshogs grub dbon gsum gyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa la/ la nyan zhang gsum zhes grags te/ de yang la ru gser khang du sku 'khrungs pa la ru ba bsod nams seṅges/ thog mar shar pa rdo rje 'od zer la rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gsan nas/ lam 'bras lam skor dang bcas pa'i bshad pa lag len nyams rtogs dang bcas pa la rang bas lhag pa med snyam pa mdzad/ phyis grub thob pa'i snyan pa gsan nas/ spyi'i sen mo rar grub thob pa la gdams ngag lo gsum du gsan/ mdog gi rje rong dbyig mkhar du sku 'khrungs pa'i nyan chen bsod nams brtan pas bla ma tshogs lo bcu gsum bsten/ dger phu nas 'byon pa'i tshe/ da chos 'di ma nyan bya ba dang / sgro 'dogs 'di ma chod bya ba gcig kyang med gsungs/ 'dis mdzad zer ba'i khrid yig kyang yod/ de lta bu'i la nyan gnyis char la spangs khang pa grags pa dpal gyis gsan/ des sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ des theg chen chos rje/ des 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa'i rgyun da ltar yang ma chad pa yod do/ /spangs khang kun mkhyen gangs khrod pas mdzad pa'i lam 'bras kyi chos 'byung sogs yig 'jog kyang mang du 'byung /

'di la brgyud pa'i chu bo mang du bzhugs te/ la nyan gnyis la dngos su brgyud pa'i tshogs grub kyi brgyud pa/ yang la nyan gnyis la don mo ri pa grags pa dpal gyis gsan cing / de la'ang gangs pas gsan/ yang snyag snying po rgyal mtshan gyis tshogs bsgom pa la gsan/ snyag gis mang mkhar rta lung pa bkra shis bzang po dang / ja tsha lung pa rgyal mtshan dpal gnyis la gnang zhing snga ma la'ang gangs pas gsan/ phyi ma de la chos rje bla ma dam pas lam sbas bshad kyi 'khrul 'khor sogs cha lag du ma gsan pa yin no/ /ko brag pas khams chen byang chub dpal/ des 'jim pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ de la'ang gangs pas zha lugs kyi lam 'bras gsan la/ gangs pas 'di la zha lugs gnang bya ba med pas rgyun chad dam gsungs/ yang tshogs bsgom pas snyag snying po rgyal mtshan/ des bar ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgya rgan thugs rje bsod nams sogs mang po la spel/ rgya gan gyi gzhung bshad yod/ bar ston la bar phug pa zhig dang / shab bar sding pa gnyis yod pa'i/ bar ston phyi ma 'di chos rje bla ma dam pa'i gsol dpon yun ring du byas pa de yin/ bar ston snga ma ni 'di nyid yin te/ 'di'i chos 'byung zhib mo rnam dag dang / dbang bzhi ngo sprod kyi byin rlabs/ de'i dmigs rim/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi zin bris/ dmar ma'i gsal byed du 'gro ba'i zin bris sogs yig cha mang po 'byung / tshogs bsgom pa'i slob ma bla dkar ba seng ge rgyal mtshan dang / snyag snying po rgyal mtshan gnyis char gyi khrid yig re'ang yod do/ /de lta bu'i tshogs grub gnyis po bsgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin yin mod/ nyams len gyi srol cung zad mi 'dra ste/ tshogs pa ni thun bzhi'i dbang la gtso bor byed/ grub thob pa ni rlung 'khrul 'khor la gtso bor byed pa yin gsungs te tshogs grub gnyis nas 'phel ba'i tshul mdo tsam mo/ /chos rje pa'i dbon po 'phags pa rin po che'i rgya nag gi 'gro don khad 'gyang pa'i 'byon bzhud brel ba dang /

gsung ngag rin po che'i tshogs gting dpag dka' ba nas cha lag yongs su rdzogs shing brgyud pa zin ches pa mang ba rang ma byung mod/ 'byon bzhud kyi mdzo 'gros dang bstun nas rgyud man ngag spel ba las/ man ngag mdzo 'gros ma'i bka' bla ma dkon mchog dpal pa la babs pas man ngag gi rgyun 'chug med du 'phel ba 'di yin la/ rgyud bshad mdzo 'gros ma'i bka' ni dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal la babs zhes bshad do/ /'phags pa nyid kyis mdzad do zhes grags pa'i gzhung bshad 'phags mdzad mar grags pa zhig kyang yod la/ gzhan yang bdag 'jug la sogs pa'i yig cha mang po mdzad do/ /gzhan yang chos rje pa'i slob ma zhang bya ru ba ar+ya de wa'i khrid yig yod la/ shar gcen rje ba'i slob ma'ang yin pa shes rab 'byung gnas dang / de'i gcung rdo rje 'od zer te gnyis/ gcen gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad cung ma tshar ba'i 'phro gcung gis kha bskangs pa zhig kyang yod cing / gtsang nag phug pa shes rab 'od zer gyis dang por chos rje pa la dgag pa mdzad pas yi dam ma dgyes pa'i rnam pa bstan nas thugs 'gyod de bshags shing / mthar chos rje pa la gsung ngag zhus/ 'phags pa la'ang gdams pa 'ga' gsan nas/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis char la bstod pa'i tshigs bcad dang / gzhung bshad sprin bral nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba'ang mdzad gsungs so/ /spyir gtsang nags phug pa la/ cha pa'i seng chen brgyad kyi nang tshan brtson 'grus seṅge/ jo nang kun spangs zhang gi slob ma bar do 'phrang grol gyi gsol 'debs mdzad mkhan thugs rje seṅge/ chos rje khu dbon gyi slob ma 'jam dbyangs nags phug pa shes rab 'od zer dang gsum yod gsungs/ yang chos rje pa'i slob ma 'di'i gnas cha lung na yod mang mkhar glang ra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis kyang gsung ngag bshad cing yig cha yod la/ 'di la lcang ra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes bris pa dpe ma dag pa yin zhes bdag chen rin po ches gsungs shing /

yang chos rje pa'i slob ma/ long phu pa bsod nams rin chen gyis bsam sding pa gzhon nu grub dang / bkras lung pa shākya dpal gnyis la bshad/ gzhon nu grub ni shangs pa bka' brgyud pa 'jag bsam gnyis kyi zlas phye ba de yin no/ /bkras lung pas re zla ba zhang byang bzhed la gnang zhing / de nyid la chos rje bla ma dam pas cha lag 'ga' zhus pa yin gsungs te/ chos rje khu dbon la sogs pas gsung ngag rin po che shin tu nye brgyud la sogs pa dar bar mdzad pa'i tshul mdo tsam mo/ /'o na chos rje pa khu dbon gyi bstan pa'i rgyun 'dzin pa po su zhig snyam na/ chos rje pa'i gsung ngag 'dzin pa la tshogs grub dpon gsum gtso che la/ tshogs grub gnyis kyi rgyun yang zam ma chad pa yin mod/ gtso bo 'phags pa rin po che yin zhing / de nyid kyi gsung ngag gi rgyun 'dzin pa ni zhang dkon mchog dpal kho na yin no/ /zhang pa la bu slob mang du 'dus kyang / brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo grub chen brag phug pa nyid du nges la/ rgyun ma chad tsam ni dga' ldan pa kun bsod dang / spro lung pa kun smon gnyis la'ang yod de/ de gnyis kyis zhang pa la zhus shing / dpal ldan seng ge la gnang ba dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la brgyud nas zam ma chad pa'o/ /dga' ldan pa'i lam 'bring po'i khrid nang dkyil gyi khrid dmigs sogs yod la/ spro lung pa'i snyag ma'i zin bris/ snyag ma'i gsal byed/ a seng ma'i 'grel pa sogs yod gsungs/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal bas yig cha tsam ma mdzad kyang rgyud man ngag khong gi phyag len la yod med ces zhu dag byed pa kho na byung zhing / de nyid kyi gsung gi rgyun 'dzin gtso bo chos rje bla ma dam pa nyid yin la/ gzhan yang brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ brag phug pa blo gros brtan pa sogs mang du byung ba las/ brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la sa skya bu ston dbang phyug dar ma rgyal po/

g.yag sde pa nam mkha' bsod nams/ blo bzang dkar por grags pa/ khams kyi gtso mdo dpal 'bar gyi thim chu ba blo gros sogs kyis gsan pa yin la/ sa skya bu ston nas theg chen pa/ g.yag sde ba nas brtse chen pa grub chen kun blo las brgyud de yod do/ /thim chu ba blo gros dkar po la khams su gon jo ba ye shes dpal gyis tshar gcig gsan pas/ brag phug pa'i gnyan pa la gsan nas stod la byon/ brag phug pa dkon rgyal la lam 'bras zhus/ snang gsum rdzogs rjes brag phug pa zhi bar gshegs nas/ ri khrod pa blo brtan la rdzogs par gsan pa yin la/ de lta bu'i lam 'bras pa blo bzang dkar po dang / ye shes dpal gnyis char la khams kyi chab la kha ba lam 'bras pa blo bzang dkar mos gsan nas mang mkhar du spel ba las/ lam 'bras pa blo bzang grags pa sogs byung ba yin gsungs so/ /dbang gi mtshams sbyor gyi bshad pa brag phug pa dkon rgyal kho na bzang la/ 'on kyang 'dra min cung zad yod pas 'byed shes pa gcig ni dgos pa yod do/ /lam 'bras pa ye shes dpal la mkhan chen g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal bas gsung ngag 'di gsan to/ /chos rje bla mas ni dpal ldan seṅge la'ang gsan mod/ gtso bor grub chen brag phug pa'i thugs sras mchog tu gyur pa yin pa la/ kun mkhyen gangs pas/ sa paṇa gyi bum pa gang byo tshogs grub gnyis la yod/ de gnyis kyi bum pa gang byo don ni grags chen dang nged dpon slob la yod pas nged dpon slob gang rung la thug par 'os snyam du dgongs mod/ gdung brgyud so so'i kha 'dzin dgongs par 'thad mi 'thad kyis ma yin gyi/ tshogs grub dbon gsum gyi brgyud pa 'dus ma 'dus kyis yin la/ chos rje dpal ldan seṅges zhang pa'i slob ma dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ spro lung pa kun smon gnyis dang / nyan chen pa'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rdo rje gsum la gsan to/ /chos rje bla ma dam pa la sngags kyi rgyal tshab gnyis zhes grags te/

snye thang pa shes rab snang ba dang / yang lung pa seṅge rgyal mtshan no/ /yar lung pas chos rje'i gsung la zin bris byas pa'i po ti yang mang du 'byung / gsung gi rgyun 'dzin ni/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje gzungs pa/ chos rje nya dbon chen po/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ jo nang pa mkhan chen byang chub seṅge/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon la/ chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa na bza' las mtshan thogs pa lam 'bras pod nag mar grags pa yod cing / chos rje dpal ldan tshums khrims kyis thog mar ri khrod pa/ de mtshams dkar brag pa la'ang gsan mod/ rjes su rje 'di nyid la yun ring du gtugs nas brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bor bzhugs pa'o/ /chos rje gzungs pas bzang po rgyal mtshan/ des mnga' ris pa rgyal mtshan dkon mchog des chos rje rdo rje rgyal mtshan nas spel ba'o/ /de dag nas brgyud pa'i gsung ngag rdzongs lugs kyi rgyun zam ma chad pa zhig mdog gi sngags dgon lu phu/ dge bcu sogs na ding sang gi bar du yod par sems so/ /'o na de dag gi rjes su brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bor gyur pa ni su zhig snyam na/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gsung ngag rin po che'i nyi 'od/ glo bur du chos ltar lhags pa'i chu 'dzin gyis dal bur kheb pa tsam du che ba na/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rlung zer gyis phal gyi chu 'dzin bsal te/ gsung ngag rin po che'i tsha zer rma med pa'i 'od 'byin par mdzad pa ni/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po zhes yongs la grags pa'i gangs can gyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur pa de dang / rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal sogs te/ de yang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po 'di nyid kyis thog mar shar chen ye shes yun ring du bsten pa yin na'ang /

shar chen pa nyid chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims la gsung ngag rdzogs pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo gsum ni shar chen pa/ bud+dha shrī/ mi nyag rin chen rdo rje zhes grags pa'i ya gyal gcig yin pas bka' rgya lo bco brgyad gdams nas gces par bskyangs pa nas/ sku tshe ring du ma 'tsho bas gsung ngag gi khog bsgrigs tsam dang / cha lag 'ga' tsam las lam yongs rdzogs gsan rgyu ma byung / phyis lo chen skyabs mchog la snang gsum tsam gsan rjes mnal lam gyi brdas bskul te/ grub chen bud+dha shrī la phul du phyin pa gsan nas bshad bka' khrid bka' mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len sogs ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas gsung ngag rin po che sogs sa skya pa'i bstan pa tshang la ma nor ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i nyi 'od lham mer bshad pa 'di yin no/ /rje de nyid kyi brgyud 'dzin ni/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug gung ru shes rab bzang po/ zha lu mkhyen rab chos rje/ gu ge paṇa chen grags rgyal sogs bgrang par mi bzod par byon yang / gtso bor mus chen sems dpa' chen po nyid yin no/ /rje 'di nyid ni mus stod gling skyar sku 'khrungs/ dbang 'od pa la rab tu byung / sle lung mkhan po dang zur chos pa la phar phyin dang spyod 'jug gsan/ gzhan yang yongs 'dzin du ma la lung dang rigs pa man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sbyang ba mdzad/ mkhas btsun bzang por gyur/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i drung du dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gsung rab zab cing rgya che ba la thos bsam bsgom pa'i sgo nas sgro 'dogs chod/ khyad par gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras kyi chos skor rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang kyai rdor rgyud gsum sogs rgyud 'grel du ma dang / dbang man ngag gi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa nod par mdzad/ lam 'bras kyi bsgrub pa lung sbyin dus rje ngor pa'i gsung gis/

sngon rje 'gos la slob ma rgyud kyi ka chen 'dzugs pa brgyad/ man ngag gi gdung chen theg pa bzhi/ las tshogs dang 'phrin las mkhas pa lcam dang dral ma gshibs pa tsam byung zhes pa rnam pa tsho yid la gsal bar byung gsungs te/ rje ngor pa dpon slob la'ang slob bu de tsam 'phel ba'i rtags yin par 'dug go /yang rje ngor pa'i mnal lam du/ rje nyid kyi dbang gi chu bo yin zer ba'i chu mig cig la slob dpon dkon rgyal ba'i chos gos bkab nas bdag gi'o zhes rmis pas/ nged rang gi dbang gi chu bo'i bka' mus pa slob dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa la babs tshod du 'dug gsungs pa ltar/ lam 'bras la yun ring du sgrub pa kho na mdzad pas nyams rtogs 'khrungs te/ gzhan phan phun sum tshogs pa dang / bir+wa pa dang rje sa chen sogs dang mjal/ sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud mang pos chos zhus/ 'phrin las mtha' yas so/ /yang brag phug pa bsod nams dpal gyi dngos slob brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan las/ sa skya bu ston gyis gsan pa/ de las gsan pa'i theg chen chos kyi rgyal po la rgyal ba brag thog pa bsod nams bzang pos gsan cing / de'i drung du rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis gsan pa yin no/ /'di ni mkhas grub kyi yon tan ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag bla ma bzang dgu du ma las zab rgyas kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son cing / sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams bran du 'khol bas gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa chen po gsar 'debs dang / gtsug lag khang khyad par can bzhengs pa sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che mdzad pa'i skyes bu mtshungs pa med pa zhig ste/ 'di nyid kyi drung du rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal sogs kyis gsan te spel ba'i gsung ngag rin po che'i rgyun deng sang gi bar yang dpal rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa chen por dar rgyas su bzhugs shing / gzhan yang brgyud pa 'di pa la sa skya pa'i chos tshul bgrang ba'i yul las 'das pa zhig mnga' ba yin pas/

de kun sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bdag la thos 'dod kyi blo skom pa chu 'dod pa lta bu rgyun chags su yod pa lags/ yang rje rdo rje 'chang gi drung du chos rje rin po che kun dga' dbang phyug pas gsan te/ 'di ni rje'i rus dbon yin zhing shing pho 'brug la 'khrungs/ bcu gnyis dus rje rdo rje 'chang la rab byung mdzad pa nas bzung lo grangs du ma'i bar du rje nyid la mdo sngags kyi bka' bstan bcos/ lung man ngag rgya cher gsan cing bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ khyad par gsung ngag rin po che lan mang du gsan cing thugs nyams su bzhes/ rgyal ba mus pa las chos tshul mtha' yas pa dang / 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho la byams chos 'dul ba sogs kyi gsan pa rgya cher gnang / thos bsam bsgrub pa dang 'brel ba'i thugs dam la brtson par bzhugs pas nyams dang rtogs pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur/ snga mo byis pa chung ngu'i dus nas rje rdo rje 'chang gis lung bstan pa ltar e wam̐ chos ldan gyi gdan sar phebs/ bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ mnga' ris phyogs su phebs rgyud dang gsung ngag sogs kyi 'chad nyan rkang la blangs pa mdzad pas 'gro phan phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / nges don gyi gsung ngag mang po dang / dag pa'i gzigs snang bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te dgongs pa chos skur thim mo/ /de nyid kyi drung du 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel bas gsan te/ 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan gzhan las ches lhag par gyur cing / ngor gyi gdan sar yun ring por bzhugs/ gsung ngag rin po che la sogs pa'i chos tshul mtha' yas pa'i bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong dang / gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod/ zhing brje ba'i tshe yang bde ba can du gshegs par tshad ldan gyi skyes bu'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur/

dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa rnams kyis gus pas bsten cing 'phrin las rgya cher mnga'o/ /de'i zhabs drung du 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa lo chen po dang / bdag chen rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sogs kyis gsan to/ /yang rgyal ba mus pa'i drung du kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅges gsan te/ 'di khams kyi go jo'i sar sa mo bya la 'khrungs/ rong ston chen po'i slob ma kun dga' 'bum dang / bsod nams 'od zer zhes bya ba gnyis kyi sar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nos/ mtshan nyid kyi gzhung mang po bzung / dbus su byon/ rong ston chen po la mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang sogs gsan/ byams chen rab 'byams pa la mtshan nyid kyi gzhung lugs mang du gsan/ rje rdo rje 'chang la kyai rdor 'grel pa lugs/ man ngag lugs kyi dbang sogs dang / khyad par sam+bu ṭi dang / rdor dbyings kyi dbang gsan dus dbang rdzas kyi dung bskyar nas bus gsungs te/ lan gsum bus pas skad shin tu che bar byung bas/ gzhan phan rgya chen po'i rten 'brel de dus nas 'grigs/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa rje nyid la zhus/ rgyal ba mus pa la gsung ngag tshar lnga sogs gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ mgon po rnams kyis 'phrin las bsgrubs/ thub bstan gyi dgon pa btab bshad grwa legs par btsugs/ e wam̐ gyi gdan sar phebs/ mdo sngags kyi bshad sgrub rgya cher spel zhing 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa dar rgyas mdzad do/ /de'i drung du sangs rgyas rin chen gyis gsan te/ 'di rje mus pa'i dbon po gcig gi sras yin/ chu mo bya la 'khrungs/ bcu gnyis dus rgyal ba mus pa la dge tshul mdzad/ gsung ngag rin po che lan gsum dang / bde mchog gsang 'dus sogs kyi chos mang du gsan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge'i drung du 'dul ba/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ phar phyin/ spyod 'jug sdom gsum rab dbye sogs la gsan sbyang mdzad/

khyad par gsung ngag rin po che tshar gsum zhus shing / dbang khrid rgyud sogs mang du gsan/ sems dpa' chen po'i dngos slob kyi mchog grub chen dkon blo ba la lam 'bras tshar drug sogs gsan pa mang du gnang / thugs dam yang lam 'bras rnal 'byor la thun bzhi'i sgo nas nyams bzhes su mdzad cing / dngos dang mnal lam du bla ma rnams dang mjal zhing byin gyis rlobs pa dang / bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa dang mtshan ma bzang po byung zhing na len+d+ra dang / ngor gyi gdan sa mdzad de gsung ngag sogs bshad sgrub kyi 'phrin las dar rgyas su mdzad do/ /yang rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug gi drung du chos rje glo bo mkhan chen gyis gsan te/ 'di ni thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas kun gyi pha mthar son cing / mkhas shing mkhas par grags pa sus kyang 'gran par mi bzod pa'i skyes bu chen po/ dbus gtsang dang stod mnga' ris/ glo bo sogs phyogs mtha' med du bstan pa nam langs pa nyi ma shar ba lta bur gsal bar mdzad cing / zhing brje ba'i tshe yang bde ba can du thogs pa med par gshegs pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /yang yongs 'dzin/ rje sangs rin/ chos rje glo bo mkhan chen te bla ma gsum po de'i zhabs drung du bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas gsan te/ 'di ni mdo dang sngags kyi mkhyen rab mtha' las 'das shing / rig pa'i gnas lnga la thogs pa med pa'i mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nyes ltung gi dri mas nam yang ma gos pa'i sdom brtson dam pa thugs dam gyi rtogs pa bla na med par gyur cing / 'phrin las mtha' med du rgyas pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i mgon/ lha la sogs pa 'gro ba rnams kyi skyabs dam par gyur cing sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i sku'i sprul par yongs su grags shing don la gnas pa'o/ /de'i drung du yang bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug gis gsan te/ skyes bu dam pa 'di ni me mo lug la 'khrungs/

'dren mchog dam pa dang / rje mkhan chen pa la gsung ngag sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang lung man ngag bshad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan/ paṇa chen dbang phyug grub pa la sde snod kyi gsan sbyangs rgya cher gnang / gsung ngag sogs kyang gsan/ mkhas pa la btsun pas brgyan zhang / bzang po'i yon tan gyis phyug pa dang / 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis dben zhing / lam 'bras la thugs dam gtso bor mdzad/ rtogs pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ thub bstan rnam rgyal/ dga' ba gdong / na len+d+ra rnams kyi gdan sa gnang nas/ mdo sngags kyi bshad sgrub rgya cher spel ba mdzad pa yin no/ /yang yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel yab sras rnams kyi drung du ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis gsan te/ 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi mnga' bdag spyir rig gnas mtha' dag dang / lhag par sa skya pa'i gsung rab kun la bshad sgrub gang mdzad kyang thogs pa mi mnga' zhing / de'i nang nas kyang rje btsun dkar po rnam gsum gyi bstan pa'i me ro gso ba la bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes pa lta bu snang / de'i tshul rje de nyid rang gi bka' 'bum po ti gsum la bltas pas shes pa yin la/ zhing gzhan du gshegs skabs kyang 'dom gyi wa ba sbubs su nub pa dang / bde ba can gyi zhing khams kyi dag snang shar ba sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas so/ /yang 'jam dbyangs mi'i gzugs can sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs kyi drung du/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis kyis gsan pa yin la/ dam pa 'di yang sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud zab mo du ma'i mnga' bdag phyag len phra mo tshun chad la shin tu mkhas shing thugs dam la chig sgril du mdzad pas nang du rtogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa la dbang 'byor yang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul du bzhugs shing / mdor na slob ma mi bslu nges pa'i skyes chen dam pa zhig go /yang sa lo/ ngor chen/ 'phags chen gsum ka'i drung du snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsan te/

skyes bu chen po mtshungs pa med pa 'di ni nges par sa skya pa'i bstan pa sde gdung brgyud dang bcas pa dang / bod kha ba can gyi 'gro ba kun gyi 'dren pa dam par bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes pa'i sprul pa'i skur gdon mi za ba'i phyir/ de'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar gyi cha yongs su rdzogs pa kun mkhyen nyid las gzhan sus kyang brjod par mi nus mod/ 'on kyang rang nyid mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i dbang gis cung zad tsam tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas brjod na 'di lta ste/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen zhing brtse ba las/ /nus mthu gcig bsdus dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /dri med rigs su bsam zhing sku bstan pa/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen zhes grags pa'i/ /skyes mchog de nyid me mo glang lor bltams/ /bcu bdun bar du sa skya lo tsā che/ /'bral med bsten te dam chos mang du nos/ /de nas yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub dang / /dpal ldan bkra shis ngag dbang chos grags zhabs/ /sangs rgyas seṅge paṇa chen legs blo sogs/ /gus pas bsten nas dbang khrid man ngag lung / /rjes gnang byin rlabs bka' gtad la sogs pa/ /grangs med gsan pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod bzung nas/ /byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong la sogs pa'i/ /gnas mchog du mar dges rdor bde mchog dang / /rdo rje phur pa chos skyong gur zhal sogs/ /lha mchog zhi khro rab 'byams du ma yi/ /grangs dang mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho bran ltar 'khol/ /de tshe bstan la gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams/ /lo zla ma 'gyang rnam shes dbyings su bsgral/ /de dag ma 'ongs srid pa'i rgyun yang bcad/ /gzhan yang rang gi snang ngor dag snang las/ /ma 'das mod kyang gdul bya gzhan gyi ngor/ /dka' spyad drag pos bstan dang 'gro ba'i phyir/ /sku srog nyid kyang gtong la mi zhum pa'i/

/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po ches/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen kun bsal nas/ /snang srid lha mi thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /de nas sngon byon gong ma'i gnas kyi mchog /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /gtsug lag khang chen nyams pa rnams gsos te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang mchod chas bkang / /gzhan yang 'gro ba'i bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir/ /ngo mtshar mchod pa'i rten dang mchod pa'i rdzas/ /yid 'phrog khang bzang du ma'ang gsar du spel/ /khyad par rgyal ba'i bstan pa gsal mdzad pa'i/ /bshes gnyen brgya phrag mang po 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen dang / /gsang sngags 'dzin pa du ma 'du ba'i gnas/ /bde ba chen po'i gling sogs legs btab ste/ /bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / /mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis/ /bde gshegs bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar spel/ /gzhan yang rdo rje 'chang dngos sa skya pa'i/ /gong ma dgongs pa chos dbyings mnyam bzhag pa/ /de dag thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir dges rdor dang / /bde mchog gsang 'dus yang phur la sogs pa/ /dri med rgyud nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /bsgrub cing mchod dang bdag 'jug len pa dang / /slob ma dbang bskur la sogs lo re bzhin/ /ma nyams dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel bar mdzad/ /mdor na zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi/ /sna tshogs thabs mkhas du mas gdul bya rnams/ /gang la gang 'dul tshul du legs bskyangs te/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di rdzogs ldan bde la bkod/ /sngon tshe chos rgyal mes dbon de dag gis/ /bstan pa rin chen bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul/ /bsam las 'das mod sangs rgyas byang sems kyi/ /rnam par sprul pa de dag 'das pa'i rjes/ /gangs can khrod 'dir kun mkhyen sangs rgyas kyis/ /bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs chen mdzad pa la/ /sngags 'chang nyid las ngo mtshar che ba gzhan/ /med ces deng dus dpyod ldan yongs la grags/

/de lta'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po de/ /re brgyad bzhes pa shing pho spre'u'i lo/ /gro bzhin zla ba'i yar ngo'i bcu gnyis la/ /sa skya'i lha chen lhun grub pho brang du/ /dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim tshul bstan/ /de lta'i sprul pa'i skyes mchog de nyid las/ /brgyud 'dzin slob bu mang du 'phel ba yi/ /kun gyi mchog ni chos dang rigs kyi sras/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug puṇ+ya in+d+ra dang / /sems dpa' chen po grags pa blo gros mtshan/ /gzhan yang bstan pa gsal mdzad bshes gnyen tshogs/ /nyi zla bzhin du grags pas yongs khyab cing / /skar phran bzhin du bgrang ba'i yul 'das pas/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di yongs su khyab gyur te/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin po che/ /dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel ba'i dge mtshan 'di/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /kun dga' rin chen gang gi rnam thar yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ de lta bu'i sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma de nyid kyi drung du rigs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched kyis gsung ngag rin po che lan gnyis kyi bar du gsan cing phyag len phra mo tshun chad kyang thugs su chud par mdzad pa yin la/ de ltar 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa'i sku mched gnyis kyi gcen 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po ni/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'jig rten mthun 'jug sogs gang yang mi mdzad par grags shing lhag pa'i lha zhi khro du ma rdo rje chos skyong rnams dang bcas pa'i gsang sngags zab mo rnams kyi gsung bzlas kyi grangs blos dpag par dka' ba zhig mdzad la/ de la brten nas yi dam zhi khro du ma dang chos skyong du mas zhal gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs pas 'phral gyi mdzad pa yang grub pa'i spyod pa ya ma zung la sus kyang ma thul ba'i 'jig rten na dregs pa kun kyang 'dar bar mdzad nus pa dang / gzhan yang skam sar chu 'don pa/ brag la zhabs rjes 'jog pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa stod mnga' ris/

bar dbus gtsang gi cha dang / de'i nang nas kyang za phu'i gnas chen rnams su yang yang ston par mdzad pa/ lhag par slob dpon pad+ma'i gter sku tshe chu ma la gsol 'debs mdzad pas tshe chu dngos su byung ba dang / byas 'gyur du gzigs snang la zangs mdog dpal ri pad+ma 'od dang / slob dpon rin po che gtso 'khor rnams/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams rdo rje'i chos skyong du ma dang bcas pas bskor ba zhal bstan cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can byung ba sogs gang nas bsams kyang pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul lam/ rjes su bzung ba'i mthu stobs can zhig yin par gdon mi za ste/ de bzhin yin pa'i zhal bzhes bdag nyid chen po rang nyid kyis kyang mdzad de/ dam pa 'di nyid dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim par nye ba'i sprel lo hor zla drug pa bdun pa'i skabs su nged rang dang sa skyar mjal dus shin tu dges pa'i ngang nas nged rang dpon slob thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i legs lam la brten sngar su la yang ma gnang ba'i tshe bsgrub chig brgyud ma gnyis dang / lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab khyad can sogs gnang ba'i tshe/ spyir thugs dkyil nas bzhar ba'i 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya du ma dang / lhag par bstan pa'i rtsa ba gdan sa chen po'i lugs gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong spel gsum rnams 'chug mi 'chug khyed rang la rag las pas gang spyi'i spang blang 'di bzhin gyis sogs bka' stsal ba'i mod la/ nga ni slob dpon pad+ma rang mkhyen bsam pa 'di kho na min pa gzhan nyams len byed rgyu gang yang med ces gsungs byung ba dang / yang rje 'di'i gsung rtsom rang rig dbang bskur gyi bsgom tshul gcig shes kun grol zhes bya ba'i mjug na/ pad+mas rjes bzung ban rgan mgo dkar ba/ /zhes 'byung bas pad+mas rjes su bzung bar zhal gyis bzhes par go zhing / mdor na kun gyis zhal dkyil mthong ba tsam gyi dbang du 'du ba'i skyes bu chen po zhig go

/de'i drung du kho bo cag gis spyir chos tshul du ma zhig dang / lhag par rang lo gzhon nu'i dus byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du gsung ngag rin po che mdor bsdus cha lag rags pa tsam zhig dang / de dang 'brel ba'i lung gi tshogs shin tu rgya che ba dang bcas legs par thos so/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid kyi gcung bdag gi bla ma rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid ni/ nges pa kho nar rgya gar gyi mkhan po byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho dang / bod 'dir yang 'gran zla dang bral ba'i 'gro ba'i 'dren pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nyid gdon mi za ba yin pa'i tshul slob dpon rin po che'i ma 'ongs lung bstan las gsal bar gsungs pa sogs yid ches pa'i gtan tshigs ngo mtshar du ma dang ldan pa'i phyir de'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar brjod kyi ga la lang / 'on kyang rang re so so skye bo'i snang ngo tsam du bstan tshul mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ yon tan gyi tshogs gang yang sbas pa'i rnam 'byor gyi tshul gyis chos dang srid kyi bya ba gang la yang thugs skyel dang thugs dang ring po'i sgo nas gang yang 'jam dar gyi tshul gyis skyong ba la shin tu mkhas pas/ dmu rgod su gang gis kyang 'dul bar ma nus pa rnams kyang rang gi ngang gis 'dul bar mdzad cing / kun gyi sems dpa' chen po zhes sgrog cing 'dzin pa yin la/ mdor na sngags 'chang bla ma sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang kun rin gyis dpal sa skya'i sde gdung brgyud sogs bstan pa'i me ro gso bar mdzad pa'i rgyun de nyid ma nyams shing yar ldan mdzad de skyong ba la bdag gi bla ma sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can 'di nyid las lhag pa gzhan su yang ma byung bas/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i sgron me ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras rgyal tshab gcig pu lta bur gyur pa yin pas dregs ldan cher rlom kun gyis 'gran zla dang bral ba'i skyes chen zhig ste/

zhing brje ba'i tshe yang sngon gyi skyes bu chen po slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa dang mthun pa'i sku'i bkod pa gnyis su ston par mdzad pa yin te/ de yang me sbrul sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun gyi tho rangs gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshul bstan pa'i/ de dang nye ba'i tshes bcu drug tsam gyi nyin mo'i cha zhig la/ gdan sa dan na yod pa'i phun tshogs zer ba'i bu mo chung ngu smra shes tsam zhig bla brang bzhi thog gi ltag sgo na rtse zhing yod pa'i mngon sum gyi mthong snang la/ ltag sgo'i rdo spras kyi mgor bud med rgyan gos zab cing dbu rgyan dang dar dpyang dang bcas pa mang po zhig gis ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra drag tu bcams byung bas/ de nas dar tsam zhig nas sngags 'chang bla ma grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid sku gzi 'od 'bar bzhin pa dang bcas bzhi thog bla brang nas ltag sgo brgyud nas phebs byung ste/ bu mo de rang la byin rlabs gnang byung ba'i mod la sngar gyi bud med de rnams kyis bsus te ḍa ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra chen po dang bcas rim bzhin sa dkar logs kyi ngos la byon te bar snang la yal song ba mthong bas/ de ma thag bu mo chung ngu de nyid de rang gi ma'i rtsar brgyugs byung ste/ 'di bzhin byung ba'i lo rgyus rnams sgrib med du smras byung bas/ ma yang ha las te smras pa/ da lo gong bzhugs sku shin tu ma bde ba'i tshul gleng ba la khyod kyi mthong snang de bzhin byung tshul smras na chad pa yang yong bas su la yang ma zer cig ces kyang gdams so zhes thos so/ /'di lta bu ni slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo mkha' spyod du gshegs pa sa skya'i rgan mo zhig gis mngon sum du mthong ba dang tshul mthun pa yin no/ /gzhan yang thun mong du snang ba'i sku gdung la bzhu 'bul ba'i tshe yang / de dang dus mnyam du lha'i rol mo dang me tog gi char babs shing /

spur khang la 'ja' dkar po zhig mdung tshugs su zug pa kun gyis mthong ba dang / gzhan yang sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid kyi rnam thar mdo tsam ni kho bos byas pa'i gsol 'debs legs pa'i 'byung gnas ma las kyang rtogs par bya'o/ /yang rje e wam̐ pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi drung du/ brgyud pa 'dzin nus pa'i mkhas btsun du ma zhig gis gsung ngag gsan mod kyang / de rnams kyi nang nas grags che zhing gzhan phan gyi rgyun bzang po dang ldan pa ni/ rgyal tshab sangs rgyas seṅge/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rje dkon mchog dpal ldan sogs mang du yod pa'i 'dren mchog dkon mchog rgya mtsho ni mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son cing / btsun pa'i mchog bzang po'i yon tan dang ldan pas dbus gtsang gi 'gro ba ma lus pa dbang du 'dus nas 'phrin las kyis rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab cing / phyogs thams cad du spyan snga rin po che dkon mchog rgya mtsho zhes yongs su grags so/ /rje de nyid kyi drung du spyir gsung ngag gsan pa'i bu slob mang du byung yang kun gyi mchog ni bdag gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams te/ de yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched kyi tshul ni sngon du song zin la/ 'dir rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar zur tsam zhig brjod na/ bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po mtshungs pa med pa'i rdo rje slob dpon 'di nyid ni/ nges pa'i don du khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid/ gzhan ngor ngur smrig bla gos 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan mchog gi tshul bzung ba yin pa'i phyir/ de nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa rdzogs par ni rje de nyid rang dang spangs rtogs mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas nang phan tshun dag gis rtogs pa dang brjod par nus pa yin gyi/ gzhan sar gnas kyi byang sems dag gis kyang de lta ma yin na/

bdag lta bu so so skye bo 'ching ba kun ldan dag gis brjod par nus pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ 'on kyang rang nyid mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen pos kun nas bslangs te mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig ste/ de yang mkhas pa'i tshul ni/ spyir shes bya'i yul thams cad dang / lhag par sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde'i tshogs mu mtha' med pa rnams dang / de'i nang nas kyang rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kyai gsang gsum yo ga bya spyod dang bcas pa'i rgyud/ rgya gzhung / 'grel pa/ 'grel bshad/ dbang khrid/ man ngag zhar byung phyag len phra mo tshun la'ang mkhas pa'i mchog dam par dus mtshungs pa'i mkhas par grags pa'i sa skyong chen po rnams dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / rnam dpyod rab tu gsal ba'i skye bo kun gyis mgrin gcig tu 'dzin pa'i yul du gyur pa yin la/ btsun pa'i tshul ni/ so thar gyi bslab tshigs gsum gyis rim pa bzhin thugs rgyud gtams pa nas bzung / nyes ltung rags pa rnams lta ci smos/ skye bcad kyi nyes pa tsam gyis kyang ma gos par mdzad pa'i lo rgyus yod la/ tha na bla gos bzhes lugs ma legs pa tsam yang zhabs drung du yun ring du bsdad pa'i skye bo sus kyang mthong ma myong ba yin zhing / dbu lo dang / na bza' la'ang tshul khrims kyi dri zhim khyad par can 'byung ba ni kun gyi spyod yul du gyur pa yin no/ /byang sems kyi sdom pa bzhes phyin/ phar gnod pa lta ga la zhig ste tshur gnod pa chung ngu la khong khro ba tsam yang mi mnga' zhing gnod lan du phan pa bsgrub par mdzad la/ bdud sprul 'ga' zhig gis rje rang gi sku la brdeg pa dang / tshig ngan gyi mtshon cha'i char chen po phab pa la'ang thugs bzod pa chen pos de ma thag bshags pa bzhes pa dang /

slar sdang shugs can de dag gis byed pas nged la'ang khong khro skyes nas dge sbyor la gnod par byung bas rang gzhan kun las ngan la sbyar bas shin tu ma legs zhes thugs la khro ba cung zad 'khrungs pa la'ang 'gyod pa bzod glags med pa lta bu mdzad cing / zhal nas kyang sngon gyi thang sku rnams kyi rgyab yig la/ rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / /gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ /zhes bris pa 'di chos pa rnams kyi blo la 'jog dgos gsungs so/ /rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa dbang dus su tshul bzhin du thob pa/ lam dus su gus pa dang brtag pa'i sbyor bas nan tan brtan du bsrung sdom mdzad pa la brten/ de'i sdom pa'i snying po rim pa gnyis kyi lam la mngon par byang chub ste tha mal gyi rtog pa gang gis kyang rdzi bar mi nus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bzang po la dbang 'byor pa yin te/ de'i tshul ni rje rang gi gsung las kyang sngon mar pa lho brag pas/ paṇa chen nā ro ba'i drung du dbang bskur ba thob phyin chad nas tha mal rnam rtog gis rdzi ma myong gsungs pa ltar/ nged kyis kyang mkhan chen chos dbang pa sogs la dbang thob dus zhag 'ga' tha mal rnam rtog gis rdzi ma myong zhes gsungs shing / nyams len thams cad sems dang 'dres dgos pa yin pas chos gang nyams su len yang sems dang bsres nas byed dgos zhes yang yang du gsungs la/ dus phyis bdag sogs dad ldan gyi bu slob grangs mi nyung tsam zhabs drung du yod pa'i skabs 'ga' re yang / spyan 'bras shangs kyi rtser zim bur gzigs shing ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bzang po la mnyam par 'jog pa mdzad pa'i tshe de'i ngang la rgyun ring po'i bar 'byams 'gro zhing / slar gzim sgo phye ba sogs kyi rkyen gyis ting nge 'dzin de las sad yong ba yang yang mthong zhing / snga gong nas 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du 'byams pa'i lo rgyus mang po yod la/

bu slob 'ga' zhig la nged la nyams rtogs chen po med kyang ye shes 'jug ldog dum tsam yong gin 'dug ces kyang gsungs 'dug go /de ltar mkhas pa dang btsun pa'i yon tan ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag de nyid kyi bzang po'i yon tan mtha' dag lta ci smos/ kho bo rang gi blo ngor shar ba tsam zhig brjod kyang mtha' yas mod/ 'dir mtshon pa tsam zhig brjod na/ spyir rje bla ma 'di ni skabs 'di dang 'dir thugs dam la brtson la/ 'di dang 'dir mi brtson no zhes pa'i skabs med par dus khor yug tu mtshan gung gi cha la sku khams gso ba'i mnal gyi rnal 'byor cung zad re dang / snga dro dang phyi dro'i thun mtshams gang rigs la gsung rab zab mo'i gzigs rtog gam/ yang chos zhu ba yod tshe rang rang gi chos thun rnams gsung ba sogs chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i skabs rnams ma gtogs pa nyin mtshan khor yug tu thugs dam la bzhugs pa yin la/ de la brten nas ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan khyad par can 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni/ zab mo'i yang rtse mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnal 'byor la brten nas sbyor lam rtse mo'i ye shes thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing / 'chi 'pho skye ba len pa'i tshul sgrib med du gzigs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa shes pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa'ang thugs la 'khrungs shing lung bstan khyad par can thob pa dang / mda' kha ma'i rnal 'byor 'byongs pa'i rtags mtshan mig yod kun gyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa yin te/ de yang rje'i zhal nas nged kyis 'khor lo bde mchog gi rin chen bzhi'i bsnyen pa byas pa nas bzung lus kyi shig rnams med/ da dung khog pa'i nang na srin 'bu cung zad yod tshod du 'dug ces sgrib g.yogs dang bcas gsungs pa dang / bde mchog gi rdzogs rim zab mo dpyid thig gi rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu zhugs skabs sbyin bdag ma zhig 'das nas de'i yar 'dren la spyan drangs pas/

de dus sbyin bdag ma de gang du skye ba sogs shes pa tsam byung gsungs shing / rdzogs rim zab mo dpyid thig la brten nas nyams rtogs khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor la rang dbang thob pa'i rtags ni rje nyid kyi dbu gtsug na dbu thod gzhan las 'bur ba'i ting phor sgong zhabs kyi tshad tsam pa'i dbu thod 'bur mor yod pa la/ rje'i gsung las/ nged kyi thod pa 'bur ba 'di rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma de sbyangs pas 'byongs pa'i rtags dod pa yin zhing / gzhan gyis sbyang na'ang 'di ltar 'ong zhes rje'i dbon po 'ga' zhig la gsungs 'dug pa las brgyud nas thos so/ /yang dpal kye rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin gyi chu bo ma nub par thugs nyams su bzhes pas ngo bo nyid gsum gyi lta ba mthar phyin cing bskyed rim la brtan pa thob ste/ snang srid tha mal pa 'di lha dang gzhal yas khang du gzigs pa yin te/ rje'i zhal nas kho bos dgon pa rdzong du kyai rdo rje'i lam dus kyi nyams len tshul bzhin byung bar 'dug ste/ gnas der lam dus nyams su len skabs/ skabs 'gar dag pa dran pa tsam du sleb pa dang bzhugs khang tshoms kyi snang ba de khrig 'gags nas 'gro ba 'dra yang byung gsungs so/ /yang zab mo ne gu chos drug la brten nas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa yin te/ rje'i zhal nas nged kyis rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho la ne gu zhu bzhin pa'i ngang nas bsam gtan phu ru ne gu'i zab lam rnams la chig dril du mdzad pas skabs shig na nam phyed tsam nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin ngo mtshar can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs nas sang sgrub khang la nyi ma lhag gis shar gyi bar la ting nge 'dzin de'i ngang 'byams te/ nyi ma shar 'phral 'jam skol ran 'dug dgongs phyir byon pas/

bsam gtan phu'i ri rwa ba khang khyim thams cad za zi ban bun/ lang long du gyur nas snang ba thams cad bden med du rtogs pa snyam byed pa byung / de mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes btags rung tsam du gda'/ gang zag phyi mar na 'phos par go gsungs shing / yang skabs der rmi lam khrid kyi skabs bsam gtan phur mnal bzung nas/ dgon pa ma'i bla brang na rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho bzhugs pa la mjal bar phebs pas/ bla brang gi sgo mnan 'dug pas logs kyi dkar khung la 'dzegs zhugs byon pas bla brang gi 'og gzhi me ma mur gyi 'ob tu 'dug pa de rnams dkor rdzas su 'dug gsungs shing / de nas rje'i gzim chung dkar me khra thag ge 'dug pa'i nang du byon nas rje la byin rlabs zhus pas/ rje'i bdud rtsi ka pā la gang gnang byung ba gsol ba'i snang ba byung gsungs shing / nangs par ne gu'i chos thun zhu bar phebs pas tshogs 'khor la tshogs chang cung zad 'dug pas/ rje'i bzhes 'phro zhal dkar nas rje nyid la gnang byung bas/ rje nyid kyi dgongs pa la mdang dgong rmi lam bzung nas yong skabs bdud rtsi gnang ba de de ring 'di yong ba'i rten 'brel du 'dug snyam pa byung gsung ngo / /yang 'khor lo bde mchog gi rin chen bzhi'i bsnyen pa la rtse gcig tu mdzad skabs lung bstan khyad par can byung ba'i tshul ni/ rje'i gsung las/ de'i skabs shig mnal lam du mi la ras pa yin zer ba zhig byung nas khyod lo 'di tsam la 'chi zhes sku tshe ha cang mi ring ba'i lo grangs shig dus btab byung bas/ rje nyid kyis 'o na de nas gang du skye gsungs pas/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po zhig gi bur skye zer ba byung gsungs shing / de'i sku'i skye ba phyi ma ni rje btsun rin po che dang / chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta sogs kyi rnam thar dang mtshungs pa'i mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i lung bstan thob par gdon mi za ba zhig yin mod kyang 'dir ma bris so/

/rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po de yang 'khor los bsgyur ba zhig yin par sems so/ /rje nyid phyis sku tshe ring ba'i tshad du gyur pa ni tshe bsgrub zab mo rnams nyams su bzhes pa'i phan yon yin gsungs shing / 'khor lo bde mchog gi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa zhi rgyas dbang drag yod pa'i/ rgyas pa'i dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu byas pas kyang 'chi ltas 'ga' re shar rung de'i nyes pa las grol ba myong grub yin gsungs so/ /'chi 'pho dang skye ba len pa'i tshul gong du bstan pa der ma zad/ gzhan yang bsam gtan phur bzhugs skabs shig khro mo ba 'das pa'i bar srid mngon sum du gzigs pa dang / dpal sa skyar bzhugs skabs kyang de 'dra ba mang du byung bar grags shing / gzhan yang bla ma yid dam chos skyong gur dang zhal bzhi pa sogs kyis zhal yang yang bstan tshul dang / rjes su bzung zhing lung bstan byung tshul/ kun dga' bde legs grogs mched sogs dad ldan gyi slob bu du ma dang / sde srid g.yas ru byang pa/ nged rang sogs la ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i lung bstan mang po gnang ba gang bka' stsal pa bzhin thog tu babs pa'i tshul dang / skal ldan gyi gang zag 'ga' zhig rje'i zhabs drung du nangs par sleb rgyu'i do nub 'od gsal gyi ngang nas mjal ba'i tshul gsal bar gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang 'od gsal gyi nye ring med pa sgrib med du gzigs pa'i tshul/ chos skyong khyad par can rnams dang / nor lha dbyug gu ma dang / nor sbyin dzam+bha la dmar po sogs kyis 'phrin las nam mkha' khyab pa bsgrubs tshul/ gcod kyi zab khrid kyi sgo nas gzhi bdag gdug pa can dam la btags shing / gzhi bdag 'ga' zhig gis bsu ba la mngon sum du byung ba kun gyis mthong tshul/ gzhan yang sku gzhon nu'i dus su yang rgyal sras kyi rigs sad de byams snying rje rang shugs kyis thugs la 'khrungs shing / ri rwa ba khang khyim sogs 'di bzhin du rtag brtan ther zur du snang ba ya mtshan che ba la snyam du dgongs nas/

yab mes rnams la dri rtog mdzad pa dang / sku chung ngu'i dus bdag med stod 'grel phyag tu byung nas gzigs skabs mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'khrungs pa sogs bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bzang po'i bag chags sad pa'i tshul/ zhing gzhan du gshegs par nye ba'i tshe yang dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i bsu ba mngon sum du byung ba'i tshul dang / skabs der dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang rje nyid gsung gleng mdzad tshul/ gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshe yang zab bzhes thugs dam gyi rim pa la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa'i ngang nas zhabs drung na gnas pa kun la rjes kyi bya ba ji ltar bya ba'i tshul dang / sku gdung gi zhabs tog bzhu la 'bul tshul sogs rgyas par bka' stsal nas rta lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nam phyed tsam la thugs dam ngang nas nyi ma dang zla ba shar 'dug gsungs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gsung mang du byon zhing / tshes nyer gcig gi nam langs tsam la 'da' kha ma zab mo gsal 'debs par mdzad nas phaṭ che ba gnyis dang hig chung ngu zhig gsungs pa'i mod la/ de ma thag dbu las chu skol ba lta bu'i rlangs pa chen po skya bun pa dang bcas skad cig nyid la dbu gtsug tshangs pa'i bu kha zangs thal du gyur pa nas rtsa dbu ma lta bu'i sbom phra snyug ma 'bring po tsam gyi rtsa sbub stong zhig rgyang gis 'thon pa las byang sems nyil le ba dang bcas thogs pa med par mkha' spyod chen po 'og min du gshegs pa'i tshul sogs brjod kyis mi lang zhing / mdor na sngon gyi rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen de nyid sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin par rje byams pa chos 'od la spyan ras gzigs kyis lung bstan pa yin zhing / rje sangs rgyas rin chen nyid kyi rnam par sprul pa bdag cag gi bla ma de nyid yin par kho bo la nges shes khyad par can zhig yod do/

/de lta bu'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rdo rje 'chang mi'i sku gzugs can de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa rgyas pa ni kho bos logs na byas yod pas der blta bar bya'o/ /de ltar yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan de nyid kyi drung du/ skal bzang las 'phro can bdag cag gis bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa'i sdom pa gsol bzhi'i cho ga la brten nas/ dge bsnyen nas bzung ste yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar dang / sems bskyed kyi sdom pa dbu sems kyi lugs las/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi cho gas smin rgyas su stsal cing / rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa rgyud sde'i dgongs pa tshad ldan gyi skyes bus legs par bkral ba'i dkyil 'khor bgrang pa las 'das pa rnams su cho ga rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas thob par mdzad de/ mdor na bstan pa'i gzhi ma sdom pa gsum tshang la ma nor ba so so'i cho ga dang / dbang dus su gsum ka dus gcig tu legs par thob pa'i bka' drin stsal cing / de rjes bde kyai gsang gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i zab mo'i khrid kyi rim pa lnga phrag du ma dang / de dang 'brel ba'i rgyud rgya gzhung 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang bcas pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' drin nos shing / khyad par gsung ngag rin po che'i cha lag phra mo tshun chad rgyas shing zhib pa dang / lhag par lam 'bras pa yongs la ma grags pa'i brda chig brgyud thun mong ma yin pa sogs mtha' chod par stsal te/ rang lo nyer gcig pa'i tshe gling dga' bde ba can du bsgom pa'i nyams myong gi steng nas 'chad rgyu kho bo la ma mchis kyang kha bshad tsam gyi gsung ngag rin po che'i legs bshad zla ba kha shas kyi bar la rang gis gang shes rgyas shing zhib par 'chad lo bgyis pas rje bla ma nyid shin tu dges pa'i thugs kyis chos nyan pa rnams la gsung ngag 'chad lugs ji ltar 'dug ces yang yang dri rtog mdzad cing /

chos nyan pa rnams kyis de'i tshul zhus pas/ rje'i gsung gis/ 'o de lags pha la bu skyes 'dug ge gsungs pa sogs dngos cag la mgo 'dren du dgongs pa'i bstod bkur bsngags gsum du ma mdzad skabs der byang pa chos rgyal chen pos kyang / sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud la lam 'bras 'chad pa khyed las snga ba ma byung 'dug pas ngo mtshar che zhes pa'i bstod tshig gsung shog tu khyon pa dang bcas gling gar phebs byung ba yin no cing / lam 'bras grol nas bsam gtan phur ngos rang gis mjal bar phyin skabs kyang shin tu dges pa'i gsung du ma dang / lhag par da res lam 'bras la bar chad ma byung bas/ da lam 'bras nam 'chad kyang bar chad mi yong / de ngas lung bstan yang yin zhes gsungs shing / yang de'i skabs shig rje bla ma khyed kyis bdag byang chub bar du 'bral med du thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i zhal bzhes cis kyang gnang dgos zhes dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas nan tan du gsol ba btab par brten/ lan cig nged rang zhabs drung na yod skabs shig gi tshe/ rje de nyid dar cig dgongs pa la zhugs te/ de nas rang nyid la spyan cher gzigs nas/ rang re dpon slob byang chub bar du mi 'bral lo/ /mi 'bral lo/ /khyed 'jam dbyangs kyi gdung brgyud yin pas sngon la sangs rgyas na nged drongs shig ces gsungs byung bas/ nged kyi sems la rdo rje 'chang chen po 'di nyid dang byang chub bar du mi 'bral ba'i zhal bzhes 'di lta bu rjen par gnang ba 'di 'dra ba rmi lam yin nam/ mngon sum yin snyam pa'i yid la dga' bde tshad bzung las 'das pa dang / lus kyi 'tsho mi thub pa lta bu byung zhing / rjes su de dus zhabs drung na yod pa'i grogs 'dra la/ de dus rje 'di ltar gsung gis i 'dug ces yang yang dri ba yang shor ba yin no/ /yang de dus shig rje'i gsung las/ khyod kyis nyams len la brtson par byas na lam sna myur du zin pa'i lung bstan yang thob pa lags so/

/gcig chog rgyal po rje btsun mus chen rje/ /khyod kyi thugs rjes bsam don mthar phyin te/ /da dung gsung ngag skal bzang rgya mtsho la/ /lan brgyar spel te bstan pa rgyas byed shog /de rnams kyis dam pa'i chos spyi dang bye brag byung ba'i lo rgyus bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar rags pa tsam byas nas/ de'i rjes su lo rgyus de dang ldan pa'i lam dngos bshad pa la/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag gang gis 'chad pa/ des bshad pa ltar ji ltar nyams su blangs pa'i tshul/ nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa la gsang ba bcus rgyas btab cing skal ldan gyi slob ma la phan par gdams pa dang gsum/ dang po la bshad bya/ 'chad byed/ ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa ste/ de la brjod bya nyid la gnas tshul gyi dbang du byas pa'i lam 'bras dang / rjod byed gzhung gi bstan tshul gyi dbang du byas pa'i lam 'bras gnyis/ dang po ni lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa zhes pa mtshon pa tsam ste/ zhib tu na rgyu'i dus su lam gyi bya ba 'jug rung dang / 'bras bu'i yon tan lhun grub tu yod pas rgyu lam dang bcas pa dang rgyu 'bras bu dang bcas pa zhes bya/ lam dus su rgyu'i dri ma sbyang rung dang / 'bras bu'i yon tan skye rung du yod pas/ lam rgyu dang bcas pa dang lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa zhes bya la/ 'bras dus su rgyu'i yon tan gnas gyur dang / lam gyi yon tan yar ldan du yod pas/ 'bras bu rgyu dang bcas pa dang / 'bras bu lam dang bcas pa zhes bya zhing / mdor na gzhi lam 'bras gsum ngo bo dbyer med la/ ldog tshul 'brel pa can du gnas pa zhig la 'jog pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rjod byed gzhung gi bstan tshul gyi dbang du byas pa'i lam 'bras la/ lam dang / 'bras bu dang / gnyis ka tshogs pa'i ming don dang gsum/ dang po la bgrod bya'i lam dang / bgrod byed kyi lam gnyis/ dang po ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gnyis/

'khor lo 'chams pa dang 'khor lo bskor ba'i lam gnyis/ drod kyis bsdus pa dang rtags kyis bsdus pa'i lam gnyis/ ye shes 'jug ldog dang rnam rtog 'jug ldog gis bsdus pa'i lam gnyis/ lta bas bsdus pa dang grub mthas bsdus pa'i lam gnyis/ bla ma na mi 'pho ba dang 'pho ba'i gnas skabs kyi lam gnyis te rnam grangs kyi tshul gyi bcu gnyis po de dag gi ngo bo ni chos nyid kyi bden pa ma rtogs pa dang rtogs pa'i gnas skabs kyi lam gnyis la/ de yang lam ltar na lnga/ sa ltar na phyed dang bcu gsum/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos ltar na sum cu rtsa bdun gyis bsdus pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bgrod byed kyi lam la/ lam rgyas 'bring gsum du bstan pa dang / lam zab 'bring gsum du bstan pa dang gnyis/ dang po la lam rgyas pa chos bco brgyad kyis bsdus pa/ 'bring po chos bco lngas bsdus pa/ bsdus pa chos gsum gyis bsdus pa dang gsum/ dang po la 'khor 'das thun mong ba'i gzhung tshom bu bdun/ 'khor lo 'chams pa 'jig rten pa'i gzhung tshom bu bdun/ 'khor lo bskor ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gzhung tshom bu bzhi ste bco brgyad do/ /dang po bdun ni snang ba gsum du bstan pa'i lam/ rgyud gsum du bstan pa'i lam/ tshad ma bzhir bstan pa'i lam/ gdams ngag drug tu bstan pa'i lam/ snyan brgyud bzhir bstan pa'i lam/ rten 'brel lngar bstan pa'i lam/ thabs shes kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i bsrung ba'i bye brag bstan pa ste/ bdun po 'di rnams re res kyang rang rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum tshang ba re ston pas 'khor 'das thun mong ba'i lam zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'khor lo 'chams pa'i 'jig rten pa'i gzhung tshom bu bdun ni/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i rgyu mdor bstan pa/ mdor bsdus nas rgyas par bstan pa/ re dogs dang bral ba'i lam bstan pa/ sad pa bzhir bstan pa/ dran pa nyer bzhag rgyur bstan pa/

yang dag spong ba 'bras bur bstan pa/ de dag gi mjug bsdud bstan pa ste bdun po 'di rnams kyis 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi skabs su ting nge 'dzin ma skyes pa bskyed pa/ skyes pa bogs 'byin pa/ de dag gi gegs sel ba rnams ston pas 'khor lo 'chams pa 'jig rten pa'i lam zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa 'khor lo bskor ba 'jig rten pa'i gzhung tshom bu bzhi ni/ grub mtha' dang po 'khor 'das dbyer med/ gnyis pa ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa/ gsum pa bde stong rgya chung ba/ bzhi pa bde stong rgya chen po ste 'di bzhis chos nyid kyi bden pa rtogs pa yan chad kyi lam gyi rnam gzhag ston pas 'khor lo bskor ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'bring po'i chos lnga ni/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i rgyu gang yin pa/ ting nge 'dzin nyid gang yin pa/ de'i phan yon/ bar chad kyi chos bsal ba/ lam gyi sa tshod ji ltar non pa'o/ /gsum pa bsdus pa'i chos gsum ni/ ngo bo/ rang bzhin/ mtshan nyid rnam pa gsum mo/ /gnyis pa la zab 'bring gsum du bstan pa la/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'bring dam tshig dang sdom pa'i lam/ tha ma lus so so brtags pa'i 'gog pa dang gsum/ dang po ni gang zag dbang po yang rab dbang bskur mtshan nyid dang ldan pa thob pa'i bla ma la mos gus dang zhabs tog rkyang pas grol ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni bla ma la mos gus kyi steng du dam tshig nyi shu la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin byas pas 'grol ba'o/ /gsum pa ni bla ma la mos gus dang dam tshig la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin byas pa'i steng du lam rim gnyis 'bad rtsol drag pos nyams su blangs pa la brten nas tshe 'dir grub mtha' bsnyogs pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu ni che ba gsum ldan te/ bdag don gyi che ba/ gzhan don gyi che ba/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i che ba'o/ /gsum pa gnyis ka tshogs pa'i ming don ni/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag

'bras bu lam dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag gcig shes pas mang po shes par 'gyur ba'i gdam ngag skyon yon tan du bslong bar byed pa'i gdam ngag bar chad dngos grub tu len par byed pa'i gdam ngag ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel ba'i gdam ngag bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel ba'i gdam ngag skyon yon tan du slong shes shing bar chad dngos grub tu len shes pa'i gdam ngag sde snod gsum gyi de kho na nyid phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i gdam ngag gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu'i gdam ngag yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bu'i gdam ngag ste de lta bu'i gsung ngag rin po che zab pa'i tshul bcu gcig po re res kyang yon tan gyi ldog tshul mi 'dra ba re ston pa yin no/ /gnyis pa 'chad byed la tshad ma dang / snyan brgyud gnyis/ dang po la ngo bo/ grangs nges/ go rim dang gsum/ dang po ni 'jig rten gyi tha snyad dam rtog ge la sogs pa dang mthun par mi bslu ba ste/ de yang bla ma ni gdam ngag ston pa la mi bslu/ nyams myong ni nyams su myong ba la mi bslu/ bstan bcos ni bka'i dgongs pa 'grel ba la mi bslu/ lung ni rang gi bstan bya'i don la mi bslu ba yin zhing / de dag so so'i mtshan gzhi la/ bla ma tshad ma ni rgyal bas lung bstan pa dang / mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa'i grub thob dngos sam/ de nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa bar ma chad par yod pa ste rdo rje slob dpon spyi'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig go /nyams myong tshad ma ni bla mas bstan pa ltar nyams su blangs pa la brten nas rang rgyud la skyes pa'i nyams lnga gsum bco lnga gang rung gi ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /bstan bcos tshad ma ni bka'i dgongs pa rang dbang du 'grel ba'i bstan bcos ste/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa bi ru pa lta bu'i mdzad pa las 'dir ni bstan bcos rdo rje'i tshig rkang ngo /

/lung tshad ma ni rgyas par na bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' rab 'byams mtha' dag las 'dir skabs su babs pa dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum mo/ /gnyis pa grangs nges ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bzhed pas dpal sam+bu ṭa'i rjes su 'brangs nas deng sang so so skye bos rdo rje slob dpon gyis slob ma 'khrid pa la tshad ma bzhi las mang mi dgos shing nyung na mi 'du bas tshad ma bzhir grangs nges pa yin no/ /'o na dus kyi 'khor lo las yid chos kyi rkyen gsum du bshad pa ma yin nam zhe na/ rgyud tha dad kyi dgongs pa yin pas mi 'gal te dbang gi grangs bzhin no/ /gsum pa go rim la rgyud las gsungs pa'i go rim/ thog mar 'byung ba'i go rim/ nyams su len pa'i go rim/ tshad mar song ba'i go rim dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ dpal sam+bu ṭi las/ bstan bcos tshad ma slob dpon dang / /lung gi rjes 'brangs de nyid rig /ces gsungs shing / gzhan gsum ni rtogs sla la/ de nyid rig pa ni nyams myong tshad ma'i mthar thug pa mtshon bya don gyi ye shes skyes pa yin zhing / des mtshon nas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes skyes pa yan chad kyang bzung ngo / /go rim 'di ni rtog ge pa rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa'i phyir du dkrugs te gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa thog mar 'byung ba'i go rim ni dang po sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i lung tshad ma 'byung / de rjes lung gi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos tshad ma 'byung / de rjes bstan bcos nas bshad pa'i gdam ngag ston pa po'i bla ma tshad ma 'byung / de rjes bla mas bstan pa'i gdam ngag nyams su blangs pa la brten nas rang rgyud la nyams myong skye ba 'byung ngo / /gsum pa nyams su len pa'i go rim ni/ thog mar bla ma tshad mas chos skor nyams su len dgos te/ dang por bla ma la yid ches nas de rjes bla mas bstan pa'i gdam ngag nyams su len dgos pas so/ /de rjes nyams myong tshad ma'i chos skor nyams su len dgos te/

bla mas bstan pa ltar gdam ngag nyams su blangs te rang rgyud la nyams myong bskyed dgos pas so/ /de rjes bstan bcos tshad ma'i chos skor nyams su len dgos te/ rang rgyud la skyes pa'i nyams myong de yang gdam ngag mdzad pa po rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi dgongs par shes dgos pas so/ /de rjes lung tshad ma'i chos skor nyams su len dgos te/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi dgongs pa de yang tshad ma rnams kyi mthar thug pa sangs rgyas kyi dgongs par shes dgos pas so/ /bzhi pa tshad mar song ba'i go rim ni/ dang por nyams myong tshad mar song ba 'byung ste/ bsgoms stobs kyis rang rgyud la nyams lnga gsum bco lnga gang rung skyes pa na nyams myong tshad mar song bar 'jog la/ de la brten nas tshad ma gzhan gsum yang tshad mar song bar 'jog pas so/ /de rjes bla ma tshad mar song ba 'byung ste/ sngar bla mas khyod kyi rgyud la nyams 'di dang 'di skye'o zhes gsungs pa de'i thog tu phebs pa na bla ma la yid ches pa'i nges pa skye bas so/ /de'i rjes su bstan bcos tshad mar song ba 'byung ste/ rang gi nyams myong dang bla mas bstan pa de rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gzhung gi dgongs par rtogs pa na bstan bcos rdo rje'i tshig rkang drang srong gi bka' bzhin spyi bos blang bya yin par shes pa'i nges pa skye bas so/ /de rjes lung tshad mar song ba 'byung ste/ de lta bu'i nyams myong khyad par gsum ldan de lung gi dgongs par rtogs pa na lung rang gi bstan bya'i don la mi bslu ba nges pa'i shes pa skye bas so/ /gnyis pa snyan brgyud la yang ngo bo/ grangs nges/ go rim dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rig pa glegs bam las blangs pa dang / brgyud pa med pa'i chos la nyan bshad bsgom gsum byed pa lta bu ma yin par dbang khrid kyi brda don dang lag len rnams sangs rgyas nas rang gi bla ma la thug gi bar du zhal nas zhal/ snyan nas snyan du mthong ba brgyud pa bar ma chad par yod pa ste/

ye shes thig le las/ gcig nas gcig tu rim par brgyud/ /bla ma rab kyi zhal las blangs/ /zhes dang / dgongs pa lung ston las/ de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /dang bas bla ma dam pa las/ /'ong ba'i gdam ngag bslab par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa grangs nges ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su len pa la snyan brgyud bzhi las mang mi dgongs shing / nyung na mi 'du bas bzhir grangs nges par bzhed pa yin no/ /gsum pa go rim ni snyan brgyud bzhi po snga ma snga ma rgyu dang / phyi ma phyi ma 'bras bu ste rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim mo/ /gsum pa des ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul la/ tshad ma bzhi'i sgo nas 'chad tshul dang / snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgo nas 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la tshad ma bzhi chos sna drug cu dang sbyar te bshad/ man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar te bshad/ nyams myong tshad ma rgyud la skyed byed khrid kyi gzhung shing bye brag tu bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la chos sna drug cu ngos bzung ba dang / de dang tshad ma bzhi sbyar ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni gsung ngag rin po che glegs bam na bzhugs pa'i chos sna'i rkang grangs te/ spyir rje sa skya pa chen pos zhu ba so so'i ngor bstan bcos rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi rnam 'grel snga phyir bcu gcig tsam mdzad pa las de dag ni/ a 1seng ma zla 2rgyal ma ldan bu3 ma dang / /yum 4don ma klog 5kya ma sga 6theng ma zhu 7ma/ sras 8don ma jo mo 9'a 'u ma zangs10 ri phug ma/ /snyag 11ma dang ni bcu gcig go /zhes pa ltar las thams cad kyi rjes su dge bshes snyag gi don du mdzad pa 'di tshig nyung la don rgyas pas deng sang gi bar du bla ma rnams kyis phyag dpe 'di la mdzad la/ de'i bar skabs rnams su zhal las shes par bya'o zhes pa dgu las med kyang / gsal bar byed pa'i yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis te/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ gdan sogs/ lus dkyil/

bum dbang gi 'da' kha ma'i skabs su 'chi ltas/ 'khrul 'khor gyi 'chi bslu dang bcas so/ /bum dbang gi snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' kha ma/ gsang dbang gi skabs su thig le'i rnal 'byor/ shes rab ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ dbang bzhi pa'i 'da' kha ma/ bum dbang du thun mong du yi ges sgo dgag pa dang bcas pa/ bar do bzhi'i gdam ngag lam dus kyi dbang / tshad ma bzhi/ gdam ngag drug rten 'brel lnga/ grib sel gyi sbyin sreg bsdus pa grib ma khrus dang tsha tshas sel ba/ thig le srung ba/ yi ge brgya pa'i 'don thabs/ rlung gi sbyor ba bdun gyi lam khrid pa/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ dbang phyug gi don brgyad/ sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed kyi mngon rtogs rnams dang / thams cad kyi don bsdus pa a seng ma/ 'grel pa snyag ma nyid dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste 'di rnams ni rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang nyid kyi steng du bshad par bya ba yin la/ rtsa ba'i steng na gnas kyang der bshad kyis ma langs pa gud du gsungs pa'i chos la/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud las 'phros nas 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel/ gdan sogs las 'phros nas dbang bzhi'i cho ga mtha' dag mdor bsdus pa man ngag gi gnad/ mchog dbang gsum grol lam la brten nas bskur ba'i tshul/ lam sogs nyi shu las 'phros nas phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa/ dam tshig las 'phros nas bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub thabs/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams par bskur ba/ srung ba sum cu las 'phros nas gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi ste bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun/ byung rgyal du mi btang ba'i gnad bzhi/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyi bsal ba/ rnal 'byor gyi 'phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis dang bcu las byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa ni logs na bzhugs la/ gzhan rnams ni 'di nyid du bzhugs pa yin zhing / las dang po pa dang thun mong du dgos pa'i chos la/

dbang gi chu bo'i lag len rgyas pa/ srung ba'i dam tshig rtsa ltung 'khrul spongs/ yab kyi sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi drug gnyis/ yum gyi sgrub thabs/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang bdun ni logs su bzhugs kyang btub la/ glegs bam 'dir bzhugs kyang rung ste/ 'khor 'das dbyer med sogs de dag las 'phros te gsungs pa'i chos bcu bdun du 'jog cing / lam 'bring po chos lnga'i bsdus pa/ lam bsdus te bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa gnyis la yig sna re re/ lam rgyas pa'i cha lag gzhung shing la gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba/ gnad drug gi dkri ba/ gnad bcu gcig gi dkri ba/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi dkri ba'i gzhung shing ste bzhi/ rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga/ lam 'jug ldog phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag bdun/ lam bsre ba 'gros bzhi dang bcas pa/ phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis te lnga/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor la yig sna gcig de thams cad kyi rgyab rten du lung 'di nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba/ lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba/ lung 'di nyid zhib tu sbyar ba/ lung mtha' dag dang zhib tu sbyar ba ste lung sbyor bzhi/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i lo rgyus kyi yi ge gnyis/ man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs dang / drug cu las lung 'di nyid zhib tu sbyar ba ni logs na bzhugs shing / lung mtha' dag dang zhib tu sbyar ba ni brjod kyis mi langs pas yi ger ma bkod la/ man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs kyang logs su rtogs par bya'o/ /de dag bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir tshigs su bcad de brjod na/ rdo rje'i tshig gi rnam 'grel snyag1 ma dang / /gsal byed kun gzhi rgyu rgyud2 gdan sogs3 dang / /lus dkyil4 'chi bsla5ུ bum dbang mda'6 ma/ /kha ma thig le'i rnal 'byor7 phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid8 dang /

/bzhi pa'i mda' kha9 bar do'i gdam ngag10 dang / /lam dbang11 tshad ma bzhi 12dang gdam ngag drug13 /rten 'brel lnga14 dang grib sel yi ge15 gnyis16/ /thig le'i srung17 ba yig brgya'i 'don thabs18 dang / /rlung sbyor19 bha ga'i yi ge20 'khor bzhi'i rgya21/ /dbang phyug don brgyad22 sa phyed mngon rtogs23 dang / /don bsdus ma24 ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /rtsa ba nyid kyi steng du bshad bya 'o/ /de dag las 'phros gud du gsungs pa'i chos/ /'khor 'das dbyer25 med dbang bzhi'i man ngag gnad26/ /mchog dbang bskur tshul27 bskyed rim bsdus pa 28dang / /ril bu'i sgrub thab29sa yum gyi byin rlabs30 dang / /gegs31 sel32 bzhi33 dang34 dbang chu35 sgrub36 thabs37 gsum38/ /rtsa ltung 'khrul spong39 tshogs 'khor40 sbyin sreg41 te/ /'phros te gsungs pa'i chos sna bcu bdun las/ /phyi ma bdun po logs su bzhag kyang rung / /'bring 42bsdus lam gnyis43 gzhung44 shing45 chen46 po bzhi47/ /rtogs48 bskyed49 chos50 lnga51 lam52 zab bla ma53 dang / /lung54 sbyor55 bzhi56 dang57 brgyud pa'i lo rgyus58 gnyis59/ /man ngag phra mor60 bcas pa drug cu 'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa de dang tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar ba'i tshul ni go bde ba'i ngag gis brjod na/ bla ma tshad ma rgya bod rnam thar gnyis/ /nyams myong tshad ma khrid kyi gzhung shing bzhi/ /rtogs bskyed chos lnga gegs sel yi ge bzhi/ /gzhung shing dang por sbyar bya'i chos bcu gsum/ /'bring bsdus lam gnyis lam zab bla ma ste/ /nyi shu rtsa dgu nyams su blang bya'i chos/ /snyag ma gsal byed nyer gnyis don bsdus ma/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi bstan bcos tshad ma'i skor/ /lung gi tshad ma lung sbyor rnam bzhi ste/ /man ngag phra mo kun las phan 'dogs byed/ /ces pa ltar bla ma tshad ma'i skabs su brgyud pa'i lo rgyus kyi yi ge gnyis/ nyams myong tshad ma la lam rgyas 'bring rnam pa gsum dang /

zab 'bring rnam pa gsum las/ rgyas pa la nyams myong ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa la khrid kyi gzhung shing chen po bzhi/ skyes pa bogs 'byin pa byed pa la rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga/ de dag gi gegs sel ba la gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi/ gzhung shing dang po'i gseb tshags su sbyar bar bya ba'i chos sna bcu gsum ste/ bzhi las dang po gsum ni rtogs sla la phyi ma ni sngar gyi 'phros bcu bdun las gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi spangs pa'i lhag ma bcu gsum ste/ de yang dbang gi chu bo'i lag len rgyas pa/ dbang bzhi'i cho ga mtha' dag mdor bsdus pa man ngag gi gnad/ mchog dbang gsum grol lam la brten nas bskur tshul gsum ni smin byed kyi skabs su sbyar bar bya ba/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig rtsa ltung 'khrul spong / bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub thabs/ tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga gsum ni dam tshig gi skabs su sbyar bar bya ba/ 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel ni lta ba'i skabs su sbyar bar bya ba/ yab kyi sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ yum gyi sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga lnga ni bskyed rim gyi skabs su sbyar bar bya ba/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa ni gsang dbang gi lam gyi sngon 'gror sbyar bar bya la/ lam 'bring po dang / lam bsdus pa ste rgyas 'bring gsum mo/ /lam zab 'bring gsum las/ zab mo ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'bring dam tshig dang sdom pa'i lam ni gseb tshags su 'byung zhing / tha ma lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa ni gong du smos pa'i lam rnams 'bad rtsol drag pos nyams su blangs pa la brten nas tshe 'di nyid la grub mtha' bsnyogs pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ de ltar na nyams myong tshad ma'i chos skor la chos sna nyi shu rtsa dgu yod do/ /bstan bcos tshad ma'i chos skor ni/ rnam 'grel snyag ma gsal byed nyer gnyis/ don bsdus ma dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/

/lung tshad ma'i chos skor ni sngar smos pa'i lung sbyor rnams so/ /man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs ni tshad ma bzhi char la phan 'dogs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar te bshad pa ni/ man ngag phra mo zhes pa gsung ngag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i yig sna glegs bam na dngos su mi bzhugs pa rje btsun gong mas mdzad pa dang / gdam ngag 'ba' zhig snyan brgyud du bzhugs pa phyis kyi gang zag dam pa rnams kyis yi ger bkod pa rnams phyogs gcig tu nyams len tshad ma'i go rim dang mthun par glegs bam du bsgrigs pa deng sang pod dmar mar grags pa ste/ de'i chos sna'i rkang grangs dang / de dang tshad ma bzhi sbyar ba'i tshul ni/ de nyid kyi dkar chag gi steng du shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa nyams myong tshad ma rgyud la skyed byed khrid kyi gzhung shing bye brag tu bshad pa la/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba/ gnad drug gis dkri ba/ gnad bcu gcig gis dkri ba/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyis dkri ba'i gzhung shing dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung las snang ba gsum dang rgyud gsum du bstan pa la sogs pa lam rgyas pa chos bco brgyad kyis bsdus pa'i dngos bstan dang mthun pa'i lam rim ste/ gzhung las de ltar 'byung ba yang gang zag dbang po tha ma dang po nyid nas rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi lam gyis dkrir mi btub pa rnams thog mar thun mong ba'i lam rim gyis rgyud sbyangs nas 'os su gyur pa ni rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyis dkri ba'i lam rim ste/ de yang rgyud 'chad pa'i tshe dang por gso sbyong la sogs pa sdom pa 'og ma gnyis kyi lta spyod yongs su rdzogs pas sbyangs nas 'os su gyur pa ni dbang bskur ba yin la/ man ngag ston pa'i tshe sdom pa 'og ma gnyis dang na mnyam pa'i nyams len khrid kyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs nas 'os su gyur pa na dbang bskur ba gnyis cung zad mi 'dra ba ni rgyud man ngag gi 'chad tshul gyi khyad par yin zhing /
