lam gyi dngos gzhi ni rgyud gsum du bstan pa'i lam nyid yin pas gzhung shing gnyis pa dang tshul mtshungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gnad drug gis dkri ba'i gzhung shing ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i dbang bzhi dang 'grel ba'i lam mtha' dag rgyu la gnas pa/ dbang las thob pa/ lam las goms pa/ lta ba la nyams su myong ba/ grub mtha' la rtags su shar ba/ 'bras bu la don ma lus pa mngon du gyur pa ste gnad drug gis bsdus pa yin la/ de'i dang po ni rgyu rgyud/ bar pa bzhi ni thabs rgyud/ tha ma ni 'bras bu'i rgyud ste lam rang gi ngo bo rgyud gsum du bstan pa'i lam las logs na med kyang / rgyu la gnas pa de dbang las thob/ dbang las thob pa de lam la goms zhes sogs ltar rgyud gsum 'brel pa can du shes pa'i ched du logs su smos pa yin la/ zhib tu na rgyu rtsa la gnas pa de bum dbang las thob/ bum dbang las thob pa de lam bskyed rim la goms zhes sogs dbang bzhi char dang sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na gzhung shing dang po la skal dman rim 'jug pa'i lam rim dang / gnyis pa la skal ldan cig char ba'i lam rim zhes pa'i tha snyad don gyis thob bo/ /gsum pa gnad bcu gcig gis dkri ba'i gzhung shing ni/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gang zag brtson 'grus dang ldan pas/ bskyed rim rten du yod pa tsam byas nas rdzogs rim 'ba' zhig gi lam bgrod pa ste/ de yang dang po sbyangs pa khyad par can gyi gnad/ 'og rlung bskyod pa lus kyi rba rlabs kyi gnad/ ngag 'dren pa zhi ba'i gnad/ ngag 'dren pa drag po'i gnad bzhis khams 'dus pa dang po'i lam chod/ lta ba gso ba phyag rgya bsten pa'i gnad/ bogs 'byin rnam pa brgyad kyi gnad/ spyod pa chung ngu dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi'i gnad gsum gyis khams 'dus pa bar pa'i lam chod/ spyod pa chen po yang dag spong ba bzhi'i gnad/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs kyi gnad/

gnad gnyis kyis khams 'dus pa tha ma'i lam chod/ des 'jig rten pa'i lam bgrod nas 'das lam sa bcu gnyis la/ phyi nang rten 'brel dbang bzhi dang dkyil 'khor gsum gyi gnad/ mthar phyin gyi lam sa phyed la phyi nang rten 'brel 'gros bzhi thim pa'i gnad de bcu gcig go /'di ni brtson 'grus mchog gi 'jug pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /bzhi pa dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyis dkri ba'i gzhung shing la/ theg pa thun mong la bslab pa/ 'khor 'das dbyer med la bslab pa/ gang zag gi rigs so so'i 'jug pa dang gsum/ dang po la nyan thos dang thun mong ba la bslab pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dang thun mong ba la bslab pa gnyis/ dang po ni 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches bsam pa gsum gyis dkri/ gnyis pa ni/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gsum gyis dkri/ gnyis pa 'khor 'das dbyer med pa bslab pa ni/ chos thams cad sems/ sems sgyu ma/ sgyu ma spros bral du thag bcad pa gsum gyis dkri/ gsum pa gang zag gi rigs so so'i 'jug pa la/ thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba/ shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba/ zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor pa dang gsum/ de re re la yang tha ma dang / 'bring dang / rab gsum ste gang zag dgu po so so'i lam gyis dkri zhing / mdor na nyan thos dang thun mong ba la bslab pa nas brtsams te zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor pa rab kyi bar gang zag bcu gnyis po thams cad gsung ngag rin po che 'dis dkri bar nus zhes pa ste/ dper na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las/ theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs tshang bar bstan pas gang zag rigs can gsum dkri nus pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgo nas 'chad pa la/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gdam ngag gi sarga ma log pa/ mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim par nus pa dang bzhi/

dang po la lam la sbyor bar byed pa rgyu dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ kun nas goms par byed pa lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ mi 'phrogs pa la sbyor bar byed pa 'bras dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal dang 'dra ba'i cho ga'i gzhi chen po brgyad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur te/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rten 'brel bsgrigs nas/ lam bzhi bsgom rung dang / lta ba bzhi skye rung dang / grub mtha' bzhi char rung dang / 'bras bu bzhi mngon du gyur rung gi rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa'o/ /gnyis pa kun nas goms par byed pa lam dus gyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa ni/ rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur ba po'i bla ma de nyid kyi rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs te lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par blangs nas de nyid kyi rgyun goms par bya ba'i phyir du bdag nyid kyis thun bzhi la sogs par dbang bzhi len pa'o/ /gsum pa mi 'phrogs pa la sbyor bar byed pa 'bras dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa ni lam dus kyi dbang goms pa rab kyi mthar son pa la brten nas rten dkyil 'khor bzhis 'gros bzhi thim pa nye rgyu'i dbang gi 'bras bu la mtshams sbyar ba ste/ mdor na rgyu dang / lam dang / 'bras bu thams cad nye rgyu'i dbang gi lam yongs su bgrod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa ni/ gsang sngags mtha' bzhi'i bdag nyid can te/ nyams su blang ba'i mtha'/ nyams su myong ba'i mtha'/ byin gyis brlab pa'i mtha'/ grub pa'i mtha'o/ /dang po ni/ dbang dang 'brel ba'i gdam ngag gi tshig don brda lag len rnams bla ma las thob pa ltar rang nyid kyis kyang nyams su blangs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni de la brten nas nyams lnga gsum bco lnga gang rung rgyud la skyes pa'o/

/gsum pa ni de la brten nas pho brang 'du sa bzhi la sogs par rlung sems mkha' 'gro yab yum bcu'i 'du 'phro byas te bdag rgyud la byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni de la brten nas tshe 'di nyid la grub mtha' bsnyogs pa la sogs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa'o/ /gsum pa gdam ngag gi sarga ma log pa ni/ bsgom pa'i stobs kyis srin pos brdeg pa la sogs pa 'jigs shing nyams nga ba sna tshogs 'byung ba na gdam ngag med pa rnams bar chad du 'dod pa la 'di pa'i lugs kyis rlung sems kyi rten 'brel las 'byung bar ngo sprod pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel/ bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel/ skyon yon tan du slong shes/ bar chad dngos grub tu len shes/ zhes pa ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi drod nyams su shes par byed pa ste gegs sel lhong du 'khyur ba'i phan yon yin no/ /bzhi pa mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim par nus pa ni dngos grub tu re ba dang bar chad du dogs pa rnams rang gi rtsa rlung gi rten 'brel las 'byung bar bla mas bstan cing / rang nyid kyis kyang de ltar nyams su myong ba na bla ma la sangs rgyas su nges pa'i shes pa skye ba ste/ snyan brgyud snga ma gsum ni nyams myong tshad ma'i khyad chos yin la/ 'di ni bla ma tshad ma'i khyad chos su 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa des bshad pa ltar ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ gang zag so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par dkri bar byed pa'i gzhung shing chen po rnam pa bzhi las gzhung shing rgyas pa gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du dkri ba'i gzhung dang mthun par brjod na/ gzhung las bstan pa'i lam rgyas pa chos bco brgyad po mtha' dag rje sa skya pa chen pos don bsdus ma las/ lam gyi gzhi bca' ba snang ba gsum du bstan pa/ nyams su blang bya'i lam dngos brgyud gsum du bstan pa/ lam gyi spros pa gcod byed tshad ma bzhi dang snyan brgyud bzhir bstan pa/

lam gyi sa mtshams 'jog byed rten 'brel lngar bstan pa/ lam gyi bogs 'don pa shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag bdun/ lam gyi gegs sel ba srung ba sum cu dang gdam ngag drug la sogs pa/ lam gyi phan yon grub mtha' 'bras bu dang bcas pa ste don bdun du bsdu ba mdzad la/ de'ang rje btsun rin po ches gzhung shing dang po'i khrid yig las/ de'i phyi ma lnga char rgyud gsum du bstan pa'i lam gyi gseb tshags su sbyar nas/ sngon 'gro snang ba gsum gyi lam gyis gzhi bca' ba/ dngos gzhi rgyud gsum gyi dkri ba gnyis su bsdu bar mdzad pas/ 'dir yang de ltar du bshad na/ dang po lam gyi gzhi bca' ba la/ lam gang yin pa/ de'i gzhi gang yin pa/ de ji ltar bca' ba'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni gzhung shing gi babs dang bstun na kun gzhi rgyu rgyud bsgom bya 'khor 'das dbyer med dang po nyid nas yod pa la dgongs na rgyu rgyud du bzhag kyang / de'i nyams len rgyu dus kyi dbang gi rjes su 'byung bas lam du 'jog la/ thabs rgyud kyi thog ma rgyu'i dbang / lam la sogs pa'i chos nyi shu/ dam tshig gi tshogs bskyang ba/ nyams na nyams chag bskang ba/ thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo lam dus kyi dbang dang lnga ni nyams len gyi gtso bo yin pas lam du 'jog cing / phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud kyang thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa tsam ma yin par 'bras bu sku lnga rang rgyud la 'byung rung du yod pa la/ da lta nyid nas nges shes bsgom pas lam du 'jog pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni theg pa'i rim pa ltar na nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa gnyis sam/ sdom pa'i rim pa ltar na sdom pa 'og ma gnyis dang na mnyam pa'i nyams len gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs nas dbang bskur ba'i snod rung du byas pa'o/ /gsum pa de ji ltar bca' ba'i tshul ni/ ma dag snang ba'i khrid la brten nas 'khor ba la yid 'byung bskyed de brtson 'grus chen pos gzhan la gnod par 'gyur ba gzhi dang bcas pa las log par byas/

thun mong ba'i nyams kyi snang ba la brten nas bdag pas gzhan gces par rtogs te gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par byas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams kyi snang ba la brten nas sngags kyi lam la spro ba bskyed par byas/ dag pa'i snang ba la brten nas sngags kyi 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed par byas te mdor na rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi lam la don gnyer gyi brtson pa bskyed par byas pa ste/ rje sa skya pa chen pos don bsdus ma las/ snang ba gsum gyis lam gyi gzhi bcas la/ /zhes pa dang / rje btsun rin po ches de tsam gyis kyang blo gros ma khengs pa'i/ /blo chen sbyangs pa zab mo dag la mos/ /rdo rje 'chang chen myur du thob 'dod pa/ /de la rdo rje theg pa sbyin par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /'chad tshul 'di ni lam rgyas pa chos bco brgyad po mtha' dag gung bsgrigs nas gang zag gcig gi nyams len mngon rtogs la sbyar te/ snang gsum lam gyi gzhi bca'am/ sngon 'gro la sbyar nas bshad pa'i lugs yin la/ gzhung bshad rnams las snang ba gsum po re re la'ang snang ba 'char ba'i gzhi gang yin pa/ snang ba 'char ba'i rgyu gang yin pa/ snang ba rang gi ngo bo gang yin pa ste/ gsum gsum du phye nas bshad pa ni 'khor 'das thun mong ba'i gzhung tshom bu bdun pa re res kyang rang rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum tshang ba re ston pa'i dbang du byas pa'i bshad pa yin pas 'chad tshul gnyis la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ches che ba yod par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa nyams su blang bar bya ba'i lam dngos ni rgyud gsum du bstan pa'i lam ste/ rje sa skya pa chen pos/ nyams blangs ma lus rgyud gsum dag gis shes/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de gtan la dbab pa la/ rje btsun chen pos/ rgyu chos can 'khor ba'i gnas tshul dang / lam ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul dang / 'bras bu mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa bshad pa'o/

/de'i dang po ni 'dir ma 'chad de/ ma dag pa'i snang ba'i gnas skabs su bstan zin to/ /zhes gsungs pa de'i don ni sngar ma dag pa'i snang ba'i skabs su bstan pa'i rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad dngos sam brgyud pa'i sgo nas rdo rje theg pa'i lam dang 'phrad na 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa rgyu la ltos pa'i gang zag yin la/ de nyid thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa tsam las skabs 'dir dmigs par dril nas nyams su blang du med ces pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa lam ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul la/ gzhi dam tshig la gnas par bya ba/ gang zag dkri ba'i tshul gang yin pa/ nges shes khyad par can bskyed cing ting nge 'dzin ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /dang po la dam tshig ma thob pa thob par byed pa mngon par dbang bskur ba dang / thob pa mi nyams par srung ba dam tshig gi tshogs rjes su skyangs ba gnyis/ dang po la dbang gi sngon du 'gro ba sems bskyed pa dang / dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i sde snod nas bshad pa'i dbu sems kyi srol chen po rnam pa gnyis sam/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i dbang gi sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa'am/ shin tu bsdus pa mngon rtogs ljon shing nas bshad pa lta bu cho ga gang gi sgo nas blangs kyang rung ste/ skabs 'dir smon 'jug gis bsdus pa'i sems bskyed kyi sdom pa tsam thob pa skabs don gyi gtso bo yin pas so/ /gnyis pa ni gzhung las lus thabs rgyud sogs la gdan sogs gsum pa bzhi'i rgyu dbang / zhes gsungs te/ gang la dbang bskur na lus thabs rgyud la ste/ sems la rtogs pa 'char ba ni lus la gnad du bsnun pa la rag lus pas so/ /gang du bskur na gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi ru'o/ /ji ltar na dbang bzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa rim can nam/

cig car gang yang rung ba'i tshul gyis rdzogs par bskur ba'o/ /des dri ma gang dag na go rim bzhin lus ngag yid gsum de rnams kyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag par byed pa ste mdor na zhal dang 'dra ba'i cho ga'i gzhi chen po brgyad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sngar ma smin pa smin par byed pa rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur ba mtshan nyid dang ldan pa legs par thob par byed pa yin la/ lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni smin byed kyi chos sna rnam pa gsum brgyud pa'i phyag len gyis brgyan pa las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa thob pa mi nyams pa srung ba dam tshig gi tshogs bskyang ba la/ dbang bzhi'i dam tshig spyir bstan pa dang / bum dbang gi dam tshig bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la dam tshig nyi shu ngos bzung ba/ mi nyams pa srung ba'i tshul/ nyams pa'i rab tu dbye ba/ nyams na nyams chag bskang ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni dbang bzhi po re re la mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig re/ rjes spyod kyi dam tshig re/ bza' ba'i dam tshig re/ srung ba'i dam tshig re/ mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig re ste nyi shu'o/ /de'i dang po mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu sde lam bsgom pa/ rjes spyod kyi dam tshig ni ting nge 'dzin dngos te lta ba bskyang ba/ bza' ba'i dam tshig ni ting nge 'dzin gyi mthun phyogs bsten pa/ srung ba'i dam tshig ni ting nge 'dzin gyi mi mthun phyogs spong ba/ mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig ni de rnams kyi brjed tho lta bu ste/ 'di dag gi ngos 'dzin rgyas par gzhung bshad rnams las bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa mi nyams pa bsrung ba'i tshul la/ tshul bzhin rgyud la skyes pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba/ rnam grangs rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba/ nyams myong sna cig skyes pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba/ bla ma la mos gus khyad par can gyi sgo nas bsrung ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ mnyam gzhag tu lam bsgom pa dang / rjes thob tu lta ba bskyangs pa la sogs pa ji skad bshad pa bzhin nyams su blangs pa la brten nas srung ba'o/

/gnyis pa ni dam tshig nyi shu'i rkang grangs blo la nges par byas te nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du yid la dran par byas nas nyes pas mi gos par byed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni skyon med kyi ting nge 'dzin gang yang rung ba gcig skyes pa ste/ nor bu rin po che rnyed na dbul ba ngang gis 'dor ba bzhin no/ /bzhi pa ni dbang bskur mtshan nyid dang ldan pa thob pa'i bla ma la mos gus dang zhabs tog rtse gcig pas mnyes par byed pa ste/ rgyal po mnyes na khrims kyi chad pa las grol ba bzhin no/ /gsum pa nyams pa'i rab dbye la/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i dam tshig nyams pa dang / lam bgrod pa la yun ring du 'gor ba'i dam tshig nyams pa gnyis/ dang po ni bum dbang gi bsrung ba'i dam tshig rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang / yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad de nyi shu rtsa gnyis spong ba las nyams pa ste/ des rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ngan song gsum gang rung bskyed pas de skad ces bya'o/ /bzhi pa nyams na nyams chag bskang ba ni/ gzhung las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyi nyams chag bskang / /'dod yon sogs lngas mnyes pa sogs bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni bla ma sogs kyis bsdus pa/ ye shes mkha' 'gro longs sku/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sprul sku/ sha za mkha' 'gro dur khrod kyi bdag po/ dam tshig mkha' 'gro rdo rje spun grogs te/ dam tshig thams cad dam/ bum dbang gi bsrung ba'i dam tshig las nyams na rdo rje mkha' 'gro bla ma mnyes dgos pas/ phyi 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa la sogs pa dang / nang gi 'dod yon rig ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa bla ma la phul te dbang len pa'o/ /mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig las nyams na ye shes mkha' 'gro mnyes dgos pas lta ba tshad du bskyal/ rjes spyod kyi dam tshig las nyams na ma mo mkha' 'gro mnyes dgos pas sgom pa tshad du bskyal/ dam tshig lhag ma gsum las nyams na sha za mkha' 'gro dang dam tshig mkha' 'gro mnyes dgos pas sha khrag gi gtor ma dang tshogs kyi 'khor los mnyes par bya'o/

/gnyis pa bum dbang gi dam tshig bye brag tu bshad pa la lnga las/ dang po gnyis ni rtogs sla la/ gsum pa bza' ba'i dam tshig la rgyun gyi bza' ba ni bdud rtsi ril bu dang / khyad par gyi bza' ba ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo ste/ de gnyis lag tu blang ba dang bsten pa'i tshul ni so so'i yi ge las shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig ni rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis te/ de bsrung ba'i thabs rtsa ltung gi rnam gzhag 'khrul pa spong ba las shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig ni sku mi 'bral ba bris sku/ gsung mi 'bral ba glegs bam/ thugs mi 'bral ba rdo rje dril bu ste gsum char mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rab gnas can 'dzin pa'am/ de tsam ma grub na rdo rje dril bu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'dzin pa ste/ de mi 'bral ba'i tshad ni dgos ched khyad par can mthong na zhag drug tshun chad dam/ de lta bu med na zhag gcig kyang mi 'bral bar 'chang dgos pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gang zag dkri ba'i tshul gang yin pa la/ lta ba'i spros pa bcad pa'i phyir kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba bsgom pa dang / lam gyi nyams bskyed pa'i phyir lus thabs rgyud la dbang bzhi dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lam bsgom pa/ 'bras bu sku lnga mngon du 'gyur ba'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po la lta ba dbang gi rjes su bsgom pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rim gnyis kyi thog mar bsgom pa'i dgos pa/ gzhi gang gi steng du bsgom pa/ bsgom bya lta ba'i ngo bo/ tshul ji ltar bsgom pa dang lnga/ dang po ni dbang dus su skyes pa'i ye shes la yod pa sgro 'dogs dang / med pa skur 'debs kyi mtha' bsal ba'i phyir dbang rjes su lta ba ston pa yin te/ rgyud las/ phyi nas de nyid yang dag bshad/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni lta ba rtogs pa 'di yod na 'og nas 'byung ba'i lam thams cad snang ba de dang de'i rnam par snang yang rang gi ngo bo'i go yul du sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su shes par bya ba'i phyir yin te/

dpal sam+bu ṭi las/ dang por stong nyid bsam nas ni/ /lus can rnams kyi dri ma bkru/ /lus sogs stong pa'i zhing sa la/ /blo dang ldan pas sa bon gdab/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa ni kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi steng du ste/ gzhung las/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud/ ces gsungs te/ de yang kun gzhi de gang la bya na/ sa skya pa chen pos/ sems myong rig bye brag tu ma phye ba/ ris sam phyogs su ma lhung ba/ thabs rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa/ ngo bo stong pa nyid la kun gzhir bzhed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs la/ de'i don ni myong ba gsal rig gi cha nas 'jog pas sems myong rig yul gyi rnam pa rgya ma chad pas bye brag tu ma phye ba/ dge mi dge gang gi yang mthar ma lhung bas ris sam phyogs su ma lhung ba/ tha snyad bden pa thabs/ don dam bden pa thabs byung gnyis las/ tha snyad bden pa yin pas thabs/ sems can nas sangs rgyas kyi bar gsal rig gi phreng ba rgyun mi chad pas rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa/ rang bzhin mtha' bzhi'i spros pa dang bral bas ngo bo stong pa nyid zhig ste/ des na sems tsam pa rnams ngo bo bden par grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'khor 'das kyi bya byed rung bar 'dod la/ dbu ma pa rnams/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin spros pa dang bral bas 'khor 'das kyi bya byed rung bar bzhed pa ni dbu sems kyi grub mtha'i khyad par yin no/ /don 'di nyid mgon po klu sgrub kyang bzhed pa yin te/ des mdzad pa'i byang chub sems 'grel las/ dper na khab len mthong ba na/ /lcags ni myur du yongs su 'gul/ /'di la sems pa yod min yang / /sems dang bcas pa lta bur snang / /de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam par shes/ /sems med sems dang bcas pa bzhin/ /'gro dang 'ong ba rnams g.yo zhing / /srid pa gsum pa g.yo bar byed/ /dper na rgya mtsho'i mtha' ma la/

/nges par rlabs ni rnam par g.yo/ /de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam par shes/ /lus la brten nas g.yo bar byed/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /bla ma gong ma rnams 'di dang chos dbyings gnyis sgra don mtshungs par bzhed pa ni gnyis ka'ang thabs kyis ma zin na 'khor ba'i rgyu dang / thabs kyis zin na mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu byed par mtshungs par tsam la dgongs pa yin gyi/ khyab mnyam cig tu bzhed pa ni ma yin te/ bden gnyis kyi rnam dbye dang 'gal bar 'gyur bas so/ /bzhi pa bsgom bya lta ba'i ngo bo ni/ 'khor 'das dbyer med/ de yang tha snyad pa'i blo rmongs pa'i chos can 'khor bar mthong ba'i gzhi de nyid brtags shing dpyad pa'i blo rmongs med kyis chos nyid myang 'das su gzigs shing / gzigs pa de'i ngo na chos nyid myang 'das zhes bya ba zhig grub pa med pa ni dbyer med kyi don te/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas mdor bstan/ 'khor ba gzugs dang sgra la sogs/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas rgyas par bshad/ rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas don bsdus te bstan pas so/ /de yang zhib tu na/ lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyi skabs su/ mtshan nyid gsal ba 'khor ba/ rang bzhin stong pa myang 'das/ ngo bo zung 'jug dbyer med do/ /nyams su blang ba'i chos gsum gyi skabs su/ chos can gsal ba 'khor ba/ chos nyid stong pa myang 'das/ ngo bo zung 'jug dbyer med do/ /rgyud gsum las rgyu rgyud kyi skabs su/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid 'khor ba/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin myang 'das/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo dbyer med do/ /thabs rgyud kyi skabs su sbyang gzhi 'khor ba/ sbyong byed myang 'das/ sbyang gzhi de sbyong byed de'i ngo bor dag pa dbyer med do/ /'bras rgyud kyi skabs su/ lhun grub 'khor ba/ gnas 'gyur myang 'das/

mi 'gal ba dbyer med do/ /lnga pa la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni bsag sbyang 'jug gsum mo/ /gnyis pa la lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyi sgo nas mdor bstan/ nyams su blangs pa'i chos gsum gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas shin tu rgyas par bshad pa ste/ de dag ni 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhung las/ lam du bskyed rim sogs lnga pa bzhis bstan/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang dbang bzhi po re re la lam gang yin pa/ lta ba gang yin pa/ grub mtha' gang yin pa/ 'da' kha ma gang yin pa/ 'bras bu gang yin pa ste lnga bzhi nyi shu ni lam sogs nyi shur 'jog la/ de'i steng du zhar byung bar do bzhi'i gdam ngag ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa las/ dang po bskyed rim gyi lam sogs zhar byung dang bcas pa la/ lam bskyed rim/ lta ba/ ngo bo nyid gsum/ grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med/ 'da' kha ma gong du 'pho ba/ bar do yi dam gyi lha dang bdag sems ro gcig pa/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku dang drug dang po la bskyed rim gyi bya ba dang / sems 'dzin gnyis/ dang po ni/ grub na bla ma las dbang blangs/ ma grub na rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug bya zhing bskyed pa'i rim pas lam la brten nas bzhi 'bum la sogs pa'i bsnyen pa dang / de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg bya/ de tsam ma grub na bsag sbyang 'jug gsum la nan tan du bya'o/ /gnyis pa la phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / nang bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sems 'dzin gnyis/ dang po la 'jug pa'i rim pa/ gnas pa'i rim pa/ ldang ba'i rim pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bzhed pas phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa mngon par rtogs pa tshul bcu bzhi yod pa las/ skabs 'dir ā li kā li la ltos pa'i mnyam sbyor/ mi mnyam sbyor gang rung gi mngon rtogs nyams su len pa ste/ de nyid las dang po pas nyams su blang bya'i mngon rtogs yin pas so/

/de la yang yan lag bzhi drug gnyis las/ bzhi pa ltar na rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs kyi bar dang / drug pa ltar na mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rdzogs kyi bar du gsal ba drag la yun thung ba/ bskyed pa'i rim la gnad du gces/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa'o/ /gnyis pa la nga rgyal la bslab pa dang / rnam pa la bslab pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub/ /ces gsungs la/ nga rgyal ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ he ni snying rje chen po nyid/ /badz+ra'ang shes rab brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dmigs med kyi snying rje dang dmigs med kyi shes rab zung du 'jug pa nges pa don gyi kyai rdo rje nga yin snyam du bsgom pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni rgyas par na mtsho skyes kyi khrid yig las 'byung ba ltar dmigs thun sum cu rtsa gnyis sam/ bsdu na dag pa gsum gyi khrid yig nas 'byung ba ltar dmigs thun bcu gnyis su bcad de/ gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung zhes pa'i tshul gyis bsgoms pa la brten nas gsal bar 'dod na gsal ba/ mi gsal bar 'dod na mi gsal ba/ rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i gzhi gnas 'dod na gzhi gnas ma skyes kyi bar du sems 'dzin pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni dag pa dran pa/ bzlas pa/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba la sogs pa sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin nyams su blangs te/ de nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor sogs rnal 'byor lhag ma ci rigs pa la 'jug par bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa nang bskyed pa'i rim pa sems 'dzin la thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo lam dus kyi dbang len pa'i tshul dang / lus dkyil la sems 'dzin pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la thog mar bla ma las len pa'i tshul dang / phyis nas rang nyid kyis len pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni rang gi rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur thob pa'i bla ma de nyid kyi rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs te 'jug pa'i skabs su byin rlabs kyi rim pa rnam pa lngas khyad par du byas shing /

dngos gzhi'i skabs su mtha' rten bzhi spangs pa'i dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu rdzogs par blangs pa la brten nas rlung sems mkha' 'gro yab yum bcus bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs te rten dkyil 'khor bzhi/ rgyal ba sku bzhir ngo 'phrod par byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni de nyid kyi rgyun goms par bya ba'i phyir bdag nyid kyis thun bzhi la sogs pa dbang bzhi nyams su len pa ste/ gzhung las/ lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi bsgoms pas lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa 'gag cing 'tshang rgya bar gsal bas bshad rgyud/ ces gsungs te/ spang bya yang lus kyi steng du spong / gnyen po yang lus kyi steng du skye/ sa lam yang lus kyi steng du bgrod de bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob par byed pas thabs rgyud kyi gtso bor 'jog pa yin no/ /gnyis pa lus dkyil la sems 'dzin pa'i tshul ni/ 'jug pa'i rim pa dang / ldang ba'i rim pa snga ma dang 'dra la/ gnas pa'i rim pa la dmigs thun rgyas par na/ rten lus dkyil la gcig pho brang lnga la re re/ zhar byung gi lha rnams la gcig ste bdun/ 'bring du na rten lus dkyil dang / pho brang dang po la gcig pho brang bar pa gsum la re re/ pho brang tha ma dang / zhar byung gi lha rnams la gcig ste lnga/ bsdu na thog mtha' gnyis de ma thag pa dang 'dra ba las/ pho brang bar pa gsum la gcig ste gsum du bya ba'o/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pa la brten nas lus dkyil gyi cha shas gang yang rung ba spyan dbu ma lta bu gcig la sems zin na spyan dbu mar rig cing gsal bar myong bas ma rig pa las log pa'i chos can/ de'i tshe spyan dbu mar 'dzin pa las gzhan pa'i rtog pa thams cad 'gags te rtog med du myong bas yid kun btags dang bral ba'i chos nyid/ de gnyis ngo bo gcig la ldog tshul gyis tha dad de/ des gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum ni/

lam de dag nyams su blangs pa la brten nas byung ba'i snang phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ stong phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid/ de gsum las dang po gnyis sgro skur gyis bsdus pas skyon can dang / phyi ma ni skyon med yin zhing / snga ma gnyis byung rgyal gyi gnad kyis bskyangs pa la brten nas skyon med skye ba'i sna 'dren du 'gro la/ phyi ma 'bad rtsol drag pos bskyangs pa la brten nas don gyi ye shes skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin no/ /gsum pa grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lam du lta ba skyon med de bskyangs pa las 'das lam sa dang po nas drug pa'i bar la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi grub mtha' rtogs par 'gyur ba ste/ der 'khor ba snod bcud dang / myang 'das rten dang brten par bcas pa dbyer med du rtogs pas so/ /bzhi pa 'da' kha ma la gong du 'pho ba ni/ tshe 'di nyid la grub mtha' ma bsnyogs na 'chi ltas brtags la 'chi bslu bya/ 'chi bslus ma bslus pa'i tshe gang zag 'bring po'i lam 'da' kha ma sbyong ba ste/ de yang snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' kha ma/ 'od kyi go bu'i 'da' kha ma/ sgras 'pho ba'i 'da' kha ma gsum gang rung sbyangs te lam du byas pa la brten nas grub mtha' bsnyogs pa'am rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ba'am/ mtho ris kyi lus rten la sogs pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa bar dor yi dam dang bdag sems ro gcig pa ni/ gal te 'da' kha ma ma theb na gang zag tha ma'i lam bar do sbyong ba ste/ de la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag la bum dbang lam sogs dang bcas pa ston par mdzad pa'i phyi sgro 'dogs yongs su gcod par byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon sprul pa'i sku dran pa/ des bstan pa'i lam rang lus yi dam gyi lhar dran pa/ lha las gras pa'i gsang mtshan dran pa ste rnam gsum 'brel pa can du dus rgyun dang /

khyad par can 'jigs shing nyam nga ba dang / zas bza' ba dang / gnyid du 'gro kha rnams su dran par byas pa la brten nas rmi lam du 'jigs skrag la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis dran pa rnam gsum byung ba na bar do sbyong ba yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ bar dor yid kyi lus blangs te 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi/ nyam nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum ste rkyen bdun shar ba na sngar goms pa'i stobs kyis dran pa rnam gsum rang babs su 'byung la/ de la brten nas bsnam bya rnams lhag pa'i lhar 'char zhing gsang mtshan nas lung bstan te/ bar do de nyid du grub mtha' bsnyogs pa'am/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur la/ lus rten de nyid la sa lam lhag ma rnams rim gyis bgrod de 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa gsang dbang gi lam sogs la lam bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa/ lta ba rang byung gi ye shes bzhi/ grub mtha' ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'da' kha ma 'od gsal ba/ bar do rang byung gi ye shes gsal la mi rtogs pa/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang drug dang po la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ khrid kyi sngon 'gro bsag sbyang dang / thun gyi sngon 'gro bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu rnams so/ /gnyis pa la khyab byed man ngag gi gnad rlung gi sbyor ba dang / khyab bya man ngag gi gnad gtum mo'i dmigs pa/ de dag gi gnas skabs su dgos pa'i man ngag gi gnad dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rlung 'jug gnas ldang sdom bzhi ka lam du byed pa srog rtsol lam rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ phyir rgyu ba lam du byed pa phyir btang gi man ngag gsum/ nang du 'jug pa lam du byed pa dgang ba'i man ngag gnyis/ gnas pa lam du byed pa rlung sbyor gyi rgyal po kha sbyor dang bdun po re re yang nyams su len pa'i tshul/ mthar phyin pa'i tshad/ skyon gang sel ba/

yon tan gang skye ba ste man ngag gi gnad bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas nyams su len pa'o/ /gnyis pa la 'khor lo la ma brten pa lnga/ brten pa gsum/ man ngag gi gnad la brten pa'i myur ba bdun te gsum las/ dang po 'khor lo ma brten pa'i nang tshan thig le'i rnal 'byor la bzhir phye bas bco brgyad 'byung la/ de'i myur ba bdun ma gtogs gzhan rnams lam sbyangs/ lta ba bskyangs/ drod nyams byung rgyal du btang / thun grangs med/ thun tshad med/ yid 'jug yul brtag khams tshod bzung / zas dang spyod lam gyi lcag gis bskul ba ste man ngag gi gnad brgyad brgyad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas nyams su blang bar bya zhing / myur ba bdun la gzhan phal cher 'dra ba las thun grangs yod de thun bzhi/ thun tshad yod de thun re la rlung sbyor nyi shu rtsa bzhir rtsa bzhir bcad de nyams su len pa'o/ /gsum pa de dag gi gnas skabs su dgos pa'i man ngag gi gnad la/ bogs 'don dang gegs sel gnyis/ dang po la thun mong dang / thun mong min pa gnyis/ dang po ni tog rtse zhabs dang thun mong ba'i bogs 'byin rnam pa brgyad de/ lus sems sgrim lhod gnyis res 'jog thun dbri bskyed gnyis res 'jog kha zas res 'jog dang / spyod lam bag yangs/ sems kyi gnad sna tshogs su 'pho ba/ yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa dang brgyad po 'di dag gong 'og kun tu ci rigs par 'jug pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lugs kyi gdam ngag drug ste/ lta ba'i dug dbyung / bdud rtsi bsten/ la dor gsum/ bsgom pa'i dug dbyung / bdud rtsi bsten/ la dor gsum ste drug gzhung las bsgom pa'i gsum dang por bshad kyang nyams su len pa'i tshe lta ba'i gsum sngon la 'byung bar gsungs shing / skabs 'dir rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga la sogs pa gzhan rnams kyang sbyar bar bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa gegs sel ni/ de'i gtso bo srung ba sum cu ste/

thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i gang zag gi bar chad bzhi la srung ba brgyad/ shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i gang zag gi bar chad bzhi la srung ba brgyad/ gnyis ka'i thun mong gi srung ba bcu bzhi ste sum cu las/ dang po'i gang zag gi bar chad bzhi ni/ lam du 'jug pa na 'jig rten chos kyi bar chad/ lam du zhugs pa na phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad/ sems cung zad brtan pa na bdud stobs 'phel ba'i bar chad sems cher brtan pa ni ting nge 'dzin ngo mi shes pa'i bar chad dang bzhi/ de'i bsrung ba brgyad de dad pa brtan po/ srung ba'i 'khor lo/ sngags zlos/ sngags mdud de thabs kyi bsrung ba bzhi/ bar chad de rnams sems dang / sgyu ma dang / rang bzhin med par shes pa ste shes rab kyi srung ba gsum/ thun mong du gzhan dbang rten 'brel du shes pas bsrung ba'o/ /gnyis pa'i gang zag gi bar chad bzhi ni/ nyams dang sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i bar chad/ gzugs ston pa'i bar chad/ sgra brjod pa'i bar chad/ lta grub bsgyur ba'i bar chad dang bzhi/ de'i srung ba brgyad de bar chad rnams phyi rol bdud kyis byas pa na gsad pa bzhi dang / nang gi bdud kyis byas pa na dbang bzhi'i brda' bston pas bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa gnyis ka'i thun mong gi srung ba bcu bzhi ni/ grib ma drug srung ba/ 'dzag pa drug srung ba/ sgrib pa gnyis srung ba rnams las/ dang po grib ma drug ni/ dam1 don2 zas3 grogs4 gnas5 ro'i 6grib/ /ces pa ltar la srung thabs kyang drug gnyis pa la 'dzag pa drug ni/ nad 1 gdon2 zas3 spyod4 bde5 rig6 'dzag /zhes pa ltar la srung thabs kyang drug gsum pa sgrib pa gnyis la/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni rnam rtog rgyun chags kyi dug yin la/ shes bya'i sgrib pa ni nyams skyon can brgyad de/ dang po ni srog rtsol la sogs pa'i dmigs pa gang yang rung ba la brten nas sems rtse gcig pas ting nge 'dzin gyis bsrung nus la/

phyi ma ni skyon med kyi nyams gsum po gang rung gcig skyes pas bsrung bar nus shing / de la sogs pa'i gegs sel rnams kyang skabs 'dir sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /lta ba rang byung gi ye shes bzhi ni/ lam de dag nyams su blangs pa la brten nas byung ba'i nyon mongs rang byung / rnam rtog rang byung / snrel bzhi rang byung / gsal zhing yangs la mi rtog pa'i rang byung gi ye shes chen po ste bzhi las dang po gnyis rgod pa dang / gsum pa ni bying bas bsdus pas skyon can dang / phyi ma ni skyon med yin zhing / snga ma gsum byung rgyal gyi gnad kyis bskyangs pa la brten nas skyon med skye ba'i sna 'dren du 'gro la/ phyi ma 'bad rtsol drag pos bskyangs pa la brten nas don gyi ye shes skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin no/ /grub mtha' ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lam du lta ba skyon med de bskyangs pa las/ 'das lam sa bdun pa nas bcu pa'i bar la rigs drug so so'i skad du chos ston nus pa la sogs pa 'byung ba'o/ /'da' kha ma 'od gsal ba ni/ tshe 'di nyid la grub mtha' ma snyogs na/ gang zag 'bring po'i lam 'da' kha ma sbyong ba ste/ de yang skyon med kyi lta ba la goms 'dris bsten pa dang / 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku ngo shes par bya'o snyam pa'i drin 'dun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'chi ba'i rlung gis rkyen byas nas rtsa rnams bral te rlung sems thams cad dbu mar thim pas stong gsal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin skyed par byed pa yin zhing / de la brten nas gang zag gi dbang po'i bye brag gis grub mtha' bsnyogs pa'am/ rig pa 'dzin pa'am/ mtho ris kyi lus rten la sogs pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /bar do rang byung gi ye shes gsal la mi rtog pa ni/ gal te 'da' kha ma ma theb na/ gang zag tha ma'i lam bar do sbyong ba ste/ de la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/

bdag la gsang dbang lam sogs dang bcas pa ston par mdzad pa po nang rang byung gi ye shes ston par byed pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dran pa/ des bstan pa'i lam bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa dran pa/ de las byung ba'i lta ba rang byung gi ye shes bzhi dran pa ste/ rnam gsum 'brel pa can du dus rgyun dang / khyad par 'jigs shing nyam nga ba dang / zas bza' ba dang / gnyid du 'gro kha rnams su dran par byas pa la brten nas rmi lam tshun chad du de gsum gyi snang ba 'byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni bar dor yid kyi lus blangs te 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi/ nyam nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum ste rkyen bdun shar ba na sngar goms pa'i stobs kyis dran pa rnam gsum rang babs su 'byung la/ de la brten nas bsnam bya rnams ā li kā li'i rnam par shar te bar do de nyid du grub mtha' bsnyogs pa'am/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur la/ lus rten de nyid la sa lam lhag ma rnams rim gyis bgrod de/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang bzhin gyi lhun grub thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi lam sogs la/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo thabs kyi lam/ lta ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi/ grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ba/ 'da' kha ma 'chi ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa' 'byon par 'gyur la/ bar do lhan skyes kyi bde ba/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku dang drug dang po la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ khrid kyi sngon 'gro bsag sbyangs dang / thun gyi sngon 'gro bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu rnams so/ /gnyis pa la lam rgyas pa dang bsdus pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rig ma dag pa/ lus ngag gnyis mnyam pa/ byin rlabs mnyam pa/ 'dod pa mnyam pa/ man ngag gi gnad kyis zin pa dang lnga'i phyi ma la byang chub kyi sems dbab/ bzung / bzlog khyab/ mi nyams par bya ba rnams kyis bsdus te shes par 'gyur ro/

/gnyis pa ni sbyor ba thur sel gyi rlung dbang du bya ba/ dngos gzhi dbab bzung gi sgo nas ye shes ngos bzung ba/ rjes bzlog khyab kyi sgo nas byang sems mi nyams par bya ba gsum gyis bsdus te shes par 'gyur ro/ /lta ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi ni/ lam de dag nyams su blangs pa la brten nas 'byung ba'i dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ dga' bral/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste/ nang sel gyis dbye na/ phyi go rim la ltos pa'i dga' ba bzhi/ nang gnas la ltos pa'i dga' ba bzhi/ spang bya la ltos pa'i dga' ba bzhi/ rang gi ngo bo la ltos pa'i dga' ba bzhi rnams las bzhi tshan thams cad kyi dga' ba dang po gsum ni/ sred pas bsdus pas skyon can dang / phyi ma rnams ni skyon med yin zhing / snga ma gsum byung rgyal gyi gnad kyis bskyangs pa la brten nas skyon med skye ba'i sna 'dren du 'gro la/ phyi ma 'bad rtsol drag pos bskyangs pa la brten nas don gyi ye shes skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ba ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lam du lta ba skyon med de bskyangs pa las 'das lam sa bcu gcig pa dang / bcu gnyis pa la mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad bde stong du rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /'da' kha ma 'chi ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa' 'byon par 'gyur ba ni/ tshe 'di la grub mtha' ma bsnyogs na gang zag 'bring po'i lam 'da' kha ma sbyong ba ste/ de yang skyon med kyi lta ba la goms 'dris bsten pa dang / 'chi ba don dam pa'i bden pa ngo shes par bya'o snyam pa'i dran 'dun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'chi ba'i rlung gis rkyen byas rtsa rnams bral te rlung sems thig le thams cad kyi dwangs ma dbu mar thim nas snying khar nyi zla kha sbyar du gyur pa las bde stong mchog gi ting nge 'dzin skyed par byed pa yin zhing / de la rten nas gang zag gi dbang po'i bye brag gis grub mtha' bsnyogs pa'am/

rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /bar do lhan skyes kyi bde ba ni/ gal te 'da' kha ma ma theb na gang zag tha ma'i lam bar do sbyong ba ste/ de la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang lam sogs dang bcas pa ston par mdzad pa po gsang ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ston par byed pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon chos kyi sku dran pa/ des bstan pa'i lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dran pa/ de las byung ba'i lta ba yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi dran pa ste rnam gsum 'brel pa can du dus rgyun dang / khyad par 'jigs shing nyam nga ba dang / zas bza' ba dang / gnyid du 'gro kha rnams su dran par byas pa la brten nas rmi lam tshun chad du de gsum gyi snang ba 'byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bar dor yid kyi lus blangs te 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi/ nyam nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum ste rkyen bdun shar ba na sngar goms pa'i stobs kyis dran pa rnam gsum rang babs su 'byung la/ de la brten nas bsgom bya rnams byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi rnam par shar te bar do nyid du grub mtha' bsnyogs pa'am/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur la/ lus rten de nyid la sa lam lhag ma rnams bgrod de 'bras bu chos kyi sku rang bzhin gyi lhun grub thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /bzhi pa dbang bzhi pa'i lam sogs la lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs/ lta ba shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid las bstan pa'i dga' ba bzhi/ grub mtha' bde stong rgya chen po/ 'da' kha ma lam phyag rgya chen po nas 'pho ba/ bar do bde stong mchog gi ye shes/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang drug dang po ni/ srog rtsol la sogs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas 'og rlung bskyod pa lus kyi rba rlabs/ ngag 'dren pa zhi drag ngag gi rba rlabs/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs gsum gyi phyi ma la thabs kyi rgyud dag par bya ba'i skad cig ma gsum/

shes rab kyi rgyud dag par bya ba'i skad cig ma gsum/ gnyis ka'i rgyud so sor dag par bya ba'i skad cig ma gcig rnams kyis bsdus pa yin no/ /lta ba shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid las bstan pa'i dga' ba bzhi ni/ lam de dag nyams su blangs pa la brten nas 'byung ba'i dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ dga' bral/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste bzhi las/ dang po gsum ni sred pas bsdus pas skyon can dang / phyi ma ni skyon med yin zhing / snga ma gsum byung rgyal gyi gnad kyis bskyangs pa la brten nas skyon med skye ba'i sna 'dren du 'gro la/ phyi ma 'bad rtsol drag pos bskyangs pa la brten nas don gyi ye shes skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /'bras bu bzhi'i tshul gyi lus sems la phan 'dogs pa ste/ rgyu mthun pas ni skra dkar 'joms/ /rnam par smin pas stobs ster byed/ /skyes bu byed pas rnam par 'phel/ /dri ma med pas 'bras bur 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /grub mtha' bde stong rgya chen po ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lam du lta ba skyon med de bskyangs pa las 'das lam sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed snga ma la 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bde stong du rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /'da' kha ma lam phyag rgya chen po nas 'pho ba ni sbyangs pa/ goms pa/ las la sbyar ba gsum gyis shes par 'gyur ro/ /bar do bde stong mchog gi ye shes ni/ gal te 'da' kha ma ma theb na gang zag tha ma'i lam bar do sbyong ba ste/ de la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag la dbang bzhi pa lam sogs dang bcas pa ston par mdzad pa po mthar thug de kho na nyid du chos thams cad shin tu rnam dag ston par byed pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon ngo bo nyid kyi sku dran pa/ des bstan pa'i lam rdo rje rba rlabs dran pa/ de las byung ba'i lta ba mas brtan pa'i dga' ba bzhi dran pa ste rnam gsum 'brel pa can du dus rgyun dang /

khyad par 'jigs shing nyam nga ba dang / zas bza' ba dang / gnyid du 'gro kha rnams su dran par byas pa la brten nas rmi lam tshun chad du de gsum gyi snang ba 'byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ bar dor yid kyi lus blangs te 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi/ nyam nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum ste rkyen bdun shar ba na sngar goms pa'i stobs kyis dran pa rnam gsum rang babs su 'byung la/ de la brten nas bsnam bya rnams rtsa gsum du rlung ldang 'jug gnas gsum byed pa mthong ste bar do de nyid du grub mtha' bsnyogs pa'am/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur la/ lus rten de nyid la sa lam lhag ma rnams rim gyis bgrod de 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin gyi lhun grub thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gsum pa 'bras bu sku lnga mngon du 'gyur ba'i tshul ni/ gzhung las/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud ni 'bras bu'i dbang bzhin thams cad mkhyen to/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'bras bu grub pa phyag rgya la ltos dgos shing / de'i gong na 'bras bu gzhan med pas/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud ces bya la/ de mngon du byed pa'i thabs ni 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor ba/ nye rgyu'i dbang la brten nas 'gros bzhi thim pa ste/ de yang bum dbang rtsa'i 'gros thim pas sku thams cad mkhyen pa/ gsang dbang yi ge'i 'gros thim pas gsung thams cad mkhyen pa/ shes rab ye shes bdud rtsi'i 'gros thim pas thugs thams cad mkhyen pa/ dbang bzhi pa snying po ye shes rlung gi 'gros thim pas sku gsung thugs thams cad mkhyen pa/ rten gnas gyur sku bzhi'i dus nyid na brten pa kun gzhi yang gnas gyur te shin tu rnam par dag pa ngo bo nyid lhun gyis grub pa'i sku mngon du byed pa yin no/ /de ltar na rten gnas gyur gyi dus nyid na brten pa gnas gyur yang yin la/ brten pa gnas gyur gyi dus nyid na rten gnas gyur yang yin pas/

rten dang brten pa thams cad rang rig pa'i ye shes gcig gi ngo bor dbyer mi phyed cing ro mnyam du gyur pa de las ma g.yos bzhin du srid pa ji srid pa de srid du sems can gyi don 'bad med du 'byung ba yin no/ /gsum pa nges shes khyad par can bskyed cing ting nge 'dzin ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa la/ tshad ma bzhi dang snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgo nas nges shes bskyed pa dang / ting nge 'dzin ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir lam gyis sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa dang / 'khor lo bskor ba grub pa'i rtags dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po la tshad ma bzhi'i sgo nas dang / snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgo nas nges shes bskyed pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsgoms stobs kyis rang rgyud la gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi nyams skyes pa na tshad ma bzhi'i sgo nas 'di ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum dngos ma yin gyi/ de gsum gyi nyams ting nge 'dzin yin no snyam du nges shes bskyed pa ste/ nges shes bskyed pa'i tshul ni tshad ma bzhi'i yig chung las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i nyams myong tshad ma bzhi ldan de yang snyan brgyud bzhi dang ldan pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blangs pa la brten nas 'byung gi snyan brgyud kyi rten 'brel ma 'grig na mi 'byung ngo / /zhes snyan brgyud bzhi dang ldan pa'i sngags kyi lam gyis gus par byed pa ste/ 'di gnyis ni don bsdus ma las/ tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi yis spros pa bcad/ /ces gsungs pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa la lam spyi'i sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa dang / bye brag tu 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhung las/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba lngas lam yongs su rdzogs pa bstan to/ /zhes gsungs te/ lam gyis mtshon nas rgyu yongs su rdzogs pa/ lam yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs par bstan to zhes pa'i don no/

/de yang rgyu la sbyar na rten dang / brten pa gnyis las/ dang po rten la sbyar na phyi rol gyi yul/ lus rtsa/ rtsa yi ge khams bdud rtsi/ snying po ye shes rlung dang lnga ni/ go rim bzhin du phyi rten 'brel/ nang rten 'brel/ gsang ba rten 'brel/ de kho na nyid rten 'brel/ mthar thug rten 'brel 'grig pa'i gzhi yin no/ /brten pa la sbyar na sgo lnga'i rnam shes/ drug pa yid kyi rnam shes/ nyon yid/ kun gzhi rnam shes/ de rnams kyi chos nyid dang lnga ni go rim bzhin rten 'brel lnga 'grig pa'i gzhi yin no/ /lam la sbyar na bgrod byed kyi lam dang / bgrod bya'i lam la sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po la smin byed dbang dang / grol byed lam la sbyar ba gnyis kyi/ dang po smin byed dbang la sbyar na sta gon nam 'jug pa/ bum dbang / gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa dang lnga ni go rim bzhin du rten 'brel lnga dang por sgrig pa'i thabs so/ /grol byed lam la sbyar na lam gyi sngon 'gro/ lam bskyed rim/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo/ rdo rje rba rlabs dang lnga ni go rim bzhin du rten 'brel lnga 'grig zin goms par byed pa'i thabs so/ /gnyis pa bgrod bya'i lam la sbyar na tshogs/ sbyor/ mthong / sgom/ mthar phyin gyi lam lnga'am/ tshogs sbyor/ bum dbang sa drug gsang dbang sa bzhi/ shes rab ye shes sa gnyis/ dbang bzhi pa sa phyed de lnga ni go rim bzhin rten 'brel lnga 'grig pa'i phan yon yin no/ /'bras bu la sbyar na sprul sku/ longs sku/ chos sku/ ngo bo nyid sku/ shin tu rnam par dag pa ngo bo nyid lhun grub kyi sku dang lnga ni go rim bzhin du rten 'brel lnga 'grig pa'i 'bras bu yin zhing / zhib tu chos rje pas mdzad pa'i rten 'brel lnga'i yi ge las shes par bya la/ 'di ni don bsdus ma las/ rten 'brel lnga yis lam gyi sa mtshams dbye/

/zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /gnyis pa bye brag 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa ni/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i don bsdus ma las/ 'dus pa gsum la dpe gsum sbyar ba yis/ lam gyi sa mtshams the tshom med par mdzod/ /ces gsungs te/ khams 'dus pa dang po'i tshe rtsa rlung gi zug che/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing mi brtan/ yul rkyen gyis gnod pa bskyel/ dpe dgun gyi rlung po lag cha can dang 'dra/ khams 'dus pa bar pa'i tshe rtsa rlung gi zug dang bral/ ting nge 'dzin cung zad gsal zhing brtan/ yul rkyen gyis phan gnod med/ dpe dpyid kyi rlung po lag cha bri ba dang 'dra/ khams 'dus pa mtha' ma'i tshe rtsa rlung gi zug dang bral/ ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing brtan/ yul rkyen gyis phan 'dogs/ dpe dbyar gyi rlung po lag cha bral ba dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar na khams 'dus pa gsum gyi sa mtshams dang ting nge 'dzin shes par byas la/ de dang de'i thad so'i lam nyams su blangs pa la brten nas 'jig rten pa'i lam tshogs sbyor gnyis bgrod pa yin no/ /gsum pa 'khor lo bskor ba grub pa'i rtags dang bcas pa ni/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam mthong / sgom/ mthar phyin gsum/ sa ltar na phyed dang bcu gsum ste/ bum dbang sa drug la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi grub mtha' bsnyogs/ lam bskyed rim brtan/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur/ sprul sku'i zhing khams la dbang thob/ gsang dbang sa bzhi la ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa'i grub mtha' bsnyog lam bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa brtan/ yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur/ longs sku'i zhing khams la dbang byed/ shes rab ye shes sa gnyis la bde stong chung ngu'i grub mtha' bsnyog lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo brtan/ rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur/ chos sku'i zhing khams la dbang byed/ bzhi pa sa phyed la bde stong chen po'i grub mtha' bsnyogs/

lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs brtan/ snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur/ ngo bo nyid sku'i zhing khams la dbang byed cing / rtags ni phyi rtags thig ler 'char/ nang rtags rlung la 'char/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags yon tan sems la 'char ba yin no/ /gsum pa 'bras bus mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa bshad pa ni/ gzhung las/ phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel 'gros bzhi thim pa rnams kyis bsgom nyams skyon yod med phyed pas sa bcu gsum pa'o/ /thams cad mkhyen to/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin par rten 'brel 'grig pa ltar snang 'tshang rgya khar 'khor tshom bu gcig dang bcas nas 'tshang rgya/ zhes gsungs te/ 'di la bdag don gyi che ba/ gzhan don gyi che ba/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i che ba dang gsum/ dang po ni sku lnga lhun gyis grub ste/ phyi rten 'brel rgyal ba sku bzhi las dbang bzhi blangs pa dang / nang rten 'brel gong du bshad pa bzhin 'gros bzhi thim pa la brten nas rten dang brten pa gnas gyur gyi sku lnga mngon du gyur pa'o/ /de yang rtsa ba gnas gyur sprul pa'i sku zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'chang chen po kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan nas brtsams te/ shākya thub pa dang / rigs drug dpag bsam gyi shing la sogs pa brtan g.yo sna tshogs pa'i rnam par bstan pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ skus 'dul bar 'os pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi don du mi 'gyur ba cung zad kyang med pas sku thams cad pa dang / yi ge gnas gyur longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes bya ba/ dag pa lha'i skad nas brtsams te/ rigs drug so so'i skad dang / 'byung ba bzhi/ nam mkha' las kyang chos kyi sgra bstan pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed pa/ gsung gis 'dul bar 'os pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi don du mi 'gyur ba cung zad kyang med pas gsung thams cad pa/ khams bdud rtsi gnas gyur chos kyi sku zhes bya ba/

ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ thugs kyis 'dul bar 'os pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi don du mi 'gyur ba cung zad kyang med pas thugs thams cad pa dang / snying po ye shes rlung gnas gyur ngo bo nyid kyi sku zhes bya ba/ sku gsung thugs gsum char gyi sgo nas sems can gyi don byed pa/ de gsum char gyis 'dul bar 'os pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi don du mi 'gyur ba cung zad kyang med pas/ sku gsung thugs thams cad pa rten gnas gyur gyi sku bzhi dang / kun gzhi rang rig pa gnas gyur shin tu rnam par dag pa ngo bo nyid lhun grub kyi sku zhes bya ba/ rten dang brten pa thams cad gnyis med kyi ye shes gcig gi ngo bor dbyer med phyed cing ro mnyam du gyur pa/ rten dang brten pa dbyer med kyis 'dul bar 'os pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi don du mi 'gyur ba cung zad kyang med pas de rnams kyi don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba brten pa gnas gyur sku gcig ste/ rten dang brten pa gnas gyur gyi sku lnga yin pa yang / mtshan brjod las/ sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes gsungs la/ sku dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i don yang / de nyid las/ ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa gzhan don gyi che ba ni/ de la brten nas sems ma bskyed pa bskyed/ sa nas sar 'phar/ long bas gzugs mthong / 'on pas sgra thos pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba'o/ /gsum pa bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i che ba ni/ 'khor tshom bu gcig dang bcas te 'tshang rgya ba ste sgrub pa po bdag nyid/ rten yongs su dag pa'i rig ma gcig byin gyis brlabs pa'i bla ma gcig bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro gcig mos gus can gyi slob ma gcig dang lnga dus gcig car grol ba'o/ /de dag ni lam rgyas pa'i rnam par gzhag pa ste/ lam 'bring po dang bsdus pa ni de'i shugs kyis shes par nus la/

lam zab 'bring gsum du bstan pa ni/ gang zag dbang po rno 'bring rtul po'i bye brag gis nyams su len tshul shes pa'i ched du so sor smos pa tsam yin gyi/ logs su 'chad dgos pa ma yin no/ /gsum pa nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa la gsang ba bcu'i rgyas btab cing skal ldan gyi slob ma la phan par gdams pa la/ gsang ba bcu'i rgyas btab pa/ rang don bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa/ gzhan don bshad pa'i lung sbyin pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gsang sngags spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dam pa'i gsung bzhin bsgrub 'dod cing / /dngos grub myur du thob 'dod na/ /thog mar bla ma'i mdzad spyod gsang / /rjes gnang man ngag bskyed rdzogs gsang / /bla mas btags pa'i gsang mtshan gsang / /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam gsang / /mkha' 'gros lung bstan mtshan ma gsang / /bdud rtsi lnga yi dam tshig gsang / /nyams las byung ba'i drod rtags gsang / /byin rlabs zhugs pa'i dus tshod gsang / /grol byed lhan skyes ye shes gsang / /rtog med spyod pa shugs 'byung gsang / /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don gtan la dbab pa la gsang ba'i gzhi/ gsang ba'i ngo bo/ gang zag gang gis gsang ba/ gsang ba'i yul/ dus ji tsam gyi bar du gsang ba/ gsang ba'i phan yon/ ma gsang ba'i nyes dmigs/ nyams pa gso ba'i cho ga dang brgyad/ dang po ni/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsang sngags nang gi mdzad spyod la sogs bcu'o/ gnyis pa ni dgos ched khyad par can med bzhin du lus ngag gi brda don 'phrod par byed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni rnal 'byor pa rang nyid kyis so/ /bzhi pa ni dbang bskur ma thob pa dang / thob kyang nyams pa dang / ma nyams kyang mi dad cing phyogs rigs mi mthun pa rnams la'o/ /lnga pa ni sbyor lam gyi ting nge 'dzin mthar ma phyin gyi bar du'o/ /drug pa ni bla ma dang mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs/ bdud dang bar chad kyis mi tshugs/ lam dang ting nge 'dzin gong nas gong du bgrod pa'o/

/bdun pa de ni las ldog ste 'byung ba'o/ /brgyad pa ni bshags sdom dang / tshogs mchod la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dbang dang bdag 'jug blangs te gsang ba'o/ /gnyis pa rang don bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa ni/ lam bsdus te bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa'i man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa gzhan don bshad pa'i lung sbyin pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bzhed pas/ dam du sba zhing dam du spel/ /zhes gsungs te/ dam du sba ba ni slob ma 'brel ma brtag pa dang / snod du mi rung ba dang / nyams su mi len pa rnams la dam du sba zhing / dam du spel ba ni 'brel brtag pa dang / snod du rung ba dang / nyams su len pa rnams la dam du spel te bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya che bar gyis shig ces gnang ba ster ba'o/ /de dag ni gsung ngag rin po che'i khog phub kyi bshad lung yongs su grags pa ltar yin la// ༈ //yang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rgyun 'dzin pa po gsung ngag slob bshad du grags pa'i brgyud 'dzin rnams kyi gsung rab khog phub kyi zin bris gnad kyi be'u bum las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ de yang / gnyis pa byung ba'i chos la bshad bsgrub bya tshul la gsum/ bshad bsgrub bya ba'i gzhi chos ngos bzung pa/ tshad ma bzhi'i sgo nas bshad pas sgro 'dogs gcod tshul/ snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgo nas bsgrub pas nyams su blang tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum/ rjod byed tshig gi lam 'bras/ brjod bya don gyi lam 'bras/ ston byed yi ge'i rnam grangs so/ /dang po ni 'bras bu sku bzhi ye shes lnga thob byed smin grol 'khor bcas ma tshang par med par ston pa 'di nyid de/ gzhan dus 'khor sbyor drug gsang 'dus rim lnga/ bde mchog rim bzhi la sogs pa ni bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi gdam ngag tsam yin pas/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa ma yin la/ byang sa dang / nyan sa sogs las/

byang sems kyi lam 'bras dang / nyan thos kyi lam 'bras zhes ming btags pa tsam yod mod/ don dang ldan pa ma yin no/ /de bas na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung ngag zab mo mdo sde dang / rgyud sde thams cad kyi don gyi bcud phyung ba rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i gsung rab mdo rgyud ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ mkhas pa rnams kyi bgrod par bya ba'i 'jug ngogs/ bsod nams dang mi ldan pa rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa rnams kyi them skas/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin ston par byed pa'i tshig phun sum tshogs pa 'di ni bshad bsgrub kyi gzhi rjod byed tshig gi lam 'bras so/ /gnyis pa ni 'bras bu lam dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag gcig shes pas mang po shes pa'i gdam ngag skyon yon tan du bslong ba'i gdam ngag bar chad dngos grub du len pa'i gdam ngag ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel ba'i gdam ngag bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel ba'i gdam ngag gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu'i gdam ngag rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang / sde snod gsum gyi de nyid/ gzhung chung yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i gdam ngag 'di ni bshad bsgrub bya ba'i gzhi brjod bya'i lam 'bras so/ /gsum pa la gsum/ spyir glegs bam ji ltar byung tshul/ khyad par glegs bam chos sna'i grangs/ po ti dmar chung gi chos sna'i grangs bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni bla chen sa skya pa'i dus/ lam 'bras kyi dpe gsog gi sgam chung du bzhugs su gsol bas/ lam 'bras gseb shub mar grags pa byung / rje btsun gyi sku tshe'i stod la na bza' dar gos ser po'i sbubs su bzhugs su gsol bas/ lam 'bras po de ser mar grags pa byung /

phyis rje pa snyag mas zhal shes dgu sogs yig chung gis kha bskangs te/ dkar chag gi them gyis gdams nas/ lam 'bras glegs bam du bsgrigs te glegs shing gi phyi la rdo rje 'bri ste/ rtogs shing phyed par dka' ba mtshon/ nang la nor bu 'bri ste 'dod dgu stsol bar mtshon/ rgyas par na bla ma brgyud pa'ang 'bri ste/ bla ma la brten nas rtogs dgos par bstan pa'o/ /rje pa'i dkar chag la ma ltos pa'i lam 'bras glegs bam yang du ma zhig snang ste/ dkar shākya grags kyis khong rang gis mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad rtsa bar byas te/ yig chung gzhan dag gis kha bskangs pa'i lam 'bras glegs bam dang / zhang ze dmar bas snyag ma rtsa bar byas te/ yig chung gzhan dag gis kha bskangs pa'i lam 'bras glegs bam sogs yod gsungs so/ /yang lam 'bras pod dmar ma dang / pod nag ma zhes grags pa ni na bza' gos chen dmar nag las thogs pa ste/ deng sang po ti dmar chung zhes grags pa 'di dang / bla ma dam pa'i gzhung bshad man ngag gter mdzod/ khrid yig bzhi sogs glegs bam du dril ba 'di gnyis la rim pa ltar byas la/ mdzad pa po'i mtshan thogs pa/ dmar gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad gsung 'gros ma la'ang dmar mar grags te/ dmar gyis mdzad pa'i yig chung du ma yod mod/ gzhung bshad kyi gsal byed du sbyar nas 'chad pa'am glegs bam du bsgrigs pa ni med gsungs/ gnyis pa glegs bam chos sna'i grangs ston pa ni/ glegs bam dkar chag 'di nyid/ klad don/ gzhung don/ mjug gi don gsum du bsdus nas 'chad pa'i/ dang po la mchod brjod/ dam bca' ba gnyis te/ phal cher bklags pas go la/ glegs bam gyi za ma tog ces pa nor bu bzhugs pa'i snod za ma tog ltar dkar chag 'dis gces par gdams pa'i chos rnams ni/ 'dod dgu stsol ba'i nor bu lta bu yin la/ de nyid bsre bslad sogs kyis chud mi za bar byed pa'i snod lta bu yin pas so/ gnyis pa gzhung don ni/

spyir glegs bam dkar chag 'di la snga rtsom dang / phyi rtsom gnyis/ dang po ni/ rten 'brel/ don bsdus/ lta ba rtsa 'grel rnams med pa zhig bzhugs la/ phyi rtsom la'ang mchan dkyus shor ba legs po min pa zhig snang ste/ ji skad du/ de ltar na lam rgyas pa'i cha lag yi ger dkar chag la theb pa drug cu tham pa ste/ glegs bam 'dir cis kyang 'bri dgos pa zhe dgu dpe chung lnga dang bcas pa yod do zhes pa 'di mchan dkyus shor du snang zhing / legs por yang mi sems te drug cu po lam rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum po thams cad kyi chos sna yin pas/ lam rgyas pa'i chos sna kho nar ma nges pa'i phyir dang / las dang gi chos sna bdun/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa sogs logs su bzhugs chog pa'ang mang dag snang bas 'dir cis kyang bzhugs dgos pa zhe dgu'ang cung zad dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na phyi rtsom nyid gtso bor bzung nas chos sna drug cu'i grangs rten tshul la mi 'tshams pa mang yang / 'dir rang re'i brgyud pas/ bdag chen rin po che'i gsung bzhin 'di ltar mdzad pa/ nyung ngus sdom gyis bsdus na/ rtsa ba'i gzhung dang rnam 'grel thog mtha' gnyis/ /gsal byed nyer gnyis 'phros don bcu dang bdun/ /rtsa ba med dang yod pa'i 'bring dang bsdus/ /gzhung shing rnam bzhi rtogs bskyed rnam pa lnga/ /rtogs gsal dpe chung zab mo bla ma'i lam/ /lung sbyor rnam gsum rgya bod lo rgyus gnyis/ /brgyud pa 'di las byon pa'i glegs bam gyi/ /chos sna drug cu'i grangs yin 'khrul pa med/ /rdo rje'i tshig dang rtogs gsal dor nas ni/ /yi ge med pa'i lung sbyor rgyas pa dang / /phra mo'i dkar chag rnam gnyis 'dren pa dang / /grangs kyi gtso bo rtsa ba'i gzhung dor nas/ /mi 'os glegs bam phra mo 'dren pa sogs/ /brgyud pa gzhan gyi lung yin 'dir mi bzhed/ /de ltar sdom gyis bsdus nas don lhug par bkrol na/

rtsa ba'i gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang / rnam 'grel snyag ma dang a seng ma/ gsal byed la kun gzhi'i yig chung / gdan gyi yig chung / nang dkyil gyi yig chung / 'chi ltas 'khrul 'khor/ 'chi bslu snang ba bsgyur ba'i mda' kha ma ste bum dbang gi mda' kha ma'i yig chung / gsang dbang thig le'i rnal 'byor gyi yig chung / shes rab ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid kyi yig chung / bzhi pa'i 'da' kha ma bum dbang dang thun mong du yi ges sgo dgag pa dang bcas pa'i yig chung / bar do bzhi'i yig chung / lam dbang gi yig chung / tshad ma bzhi'i yig chung / gdam ngag drug gi yig chung / rten 'brel lnga'i yig chung / grib ma khrus kyis sel ba'i yig chung / de tsha tshas sel ba'i yig chung / grib sel gyi sbyin sreg bsdus pa'i yig chung / thig le 'jag pa srung ba'i yig chung / yi ge brgya pa 'don thabs kyi yig chung ste 'khor 'das thun mong ba'i skabs su bcu bdun/ rlung sbyor bdun gyi dang / bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi ste/ 'khor lo 'chams pa la gnyis/ gsang dbang gi skabs su 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ bzhi pa'i dbang phyug gi don brgyad/ sa bcu gsum phyed 'og ma'i mngon rtogs te 'das lam gyi skabs su gsum ste gsal byed nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /'phros don la kun gzhi rgyu rgyud las 'phros nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba rtsa 'grel/ thabs rgyud kyi gdan sogs las 'phros nas dbang bzhi'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa'i man ngag gi gnad/ mchog dbang gsum grol ba'i lam la brten nas bskur ba/ dbang chu chen mo yum gyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa ste bzhi/ lam sogs las 'phros nas yab kyi bskyed rim rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ yum gyi bskyed rim/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong / sbyin sreg ste lnga/ dam tshig las 'phros nas srung ba'i dam tshig rtsa ltung 'khrul spong / rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig tshogs 'khor/

khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa ste gsum/ srung ba sum cu dang / man ngag gi gnad bdun cu las 'phros nas byung rgyal du mi gtang ba'i gnad bzhi/ bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyi bsal ba/ 'phrin las so gnyis te gegs sel bzhi dang bcas pa'i bcu bdun no/ /lam 'bring bsdus gnyis ni/ rtsa ba'i gzhung logs su med pa dang / logs su tshig bcad gcig tsam yod pa'o/ /gzhung shing bzhi ni/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin gyi khrid/ gnad drug gis dkri ba'i khrid/ gnad bcu gcig gis dkri ba'i khrid/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum du dkri ba'i khrid de bzhi'o/ /rtogs bskyed lnga ni/ lam 'jug ldog phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag bdun/ lam sre ba 'gros bzhi dang bcas pa dang / phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis te lnga'o/ /rtogs gsal gyi dpe bris la/ 'chi ltas kyi 'khrul 'khor gnyis/ rtsa'i dpe bris/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi'i dpe bris/ 'phrin las so gnyis kyi dpe bris/ gegs sel gzhan gyi dpe bris gnyis rnams yod med grangs gcig tu bsdu'o/ /zab mo'i lam ni/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ lung sbyor la/ lung 'di nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba/ lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba/ lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba ste gsum/ rgya bod kyi lo rgyus bla ma brgyud pa rgya gar ba dang / bod kyi lo rgyus te gnyis so/ /de ltar drug cu la rdo rje'i tshig rkang nges par 'dren dgos te/ man ngag 'di'i chos kyi rtsa ba yin pa dang / rje pa'i yab chos kyi dkar chag rgyud kyi dkar chag man ngag gi dkar chag rnams yod pa las/ gzhan rnams su 'di ma bcug pas/ man ngag gi dkar chag 'dir mi 'jug kha med yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na glegs bam 'dir cis kyang bzhugs dgos pa lnga bcu nga gcig logs su bzhugs dgos pa gnyis/

'dir bzhugs kyang rung ba bdun te drug cu tham pa dkar chag 'di'i grangs la bzhugs pa yin no/ /gsum pa mjug don ni/ 'grel pa'i steng gi gsal byed nyi shu rtsa gnyis ni zhes sogs kyis bstan to/ /gsum pa po ti dmar chung gi grangs ni/ tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar ba'i skabs las shes par nus pas 'dir ma bris so/ /gnyis pa tshad ma bzhi'i sgro 'dogs gcod tshul la bzhi/ de'i ngo bo/ go rim/ grangs nges/ chos sna thams cad tshad ma bzhis gtan la phab pa dngos so/ /dang po ni mi bslu ba ste/ bla mas gdam ngag la mi bslu/ nyams myong gis rang rang gi nyams skye ba la mi bslu/ bstan bcos kyis bka'i dgongs pa mi bslu/ bkas rang gi bstan bya la mi bslu bas so/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ rgyud las bstan pa'i go rim/ thog mar 'byung ba'i go rim/ nyams su blang ba'i go rim/ nyams su myong ba'i go rim mo/ /dang po ni rang dgar 'jug pa spang ba'i phyir 'khrugs can te/ sam+bu ṭar/ bstan bcos tshad ma slob dpon nyid/ /lung gi rjes 'brang de nyid rig /de nyid gsang don dngos po yang / /gcig nas gcig brgyud shes par bya/ /bla ma rab kyi zhal las blang / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dang por bka' tshad ma ste/ kun gyi thug sa mthar thug yin pas so/ /gnyis pa bstan bcos tshad ma ste bka'i dgongs pa 'grel ba la med kha med yin pas so/ /gsum par bla ma tshad ma ste bstan bcos kyi don ston par byed pa po yin pas so/ /bzhi par nyams myong tshad ma ste bstan pa'i don nyams su blang dgos pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ dang por bla ma tshad ma ste nyams su len pa la bla ma tshad ma la mos gus 'jug pa gtso bo yin pas so/ /gnyis par gdam ngag gi nyams myong tshad ma ste bla mas bstan pa'i gdam ngag snying rus kyis 'bad dgos pas so/ /gsum par bstan bcos tshad ma ste bstan pa ltar nyams myong skyes pa ste rdo rje'i tshig rkang ltar zhus dag par byed pas so/

/bzhi par bka' tshad ma ste rdo rje'i tshig gis yid ches pa'i khungs yin pas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ dang por nyams myong tshad ma ste/ rang rgyud la nyams myong gsha' ma zhig ma skyes na/ bla ma dang bka' dang bstan bcos rnams tshad mar ji ltar bsgrubs kyang / go yul tsam las tshad ma'i nges shes gting tshugs pa gzhan gyis 'phrog mi nus pa zhig bskyed mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bla ma tshad ma ste rang rgyud kyi nyams kyi steng nas bla ma la mos gus thun mong min pa zhig skye bas so/ /gsum par bstan bcos tshad ma ste/ bla mas nyams bstan bcos dang sbyar te ngo sprad pas bstan bcos la yid lhag par ches pas so/ /bzhi bar bka' tshad ma ste/ bstan bcos bka' dang sbyar bas bka' yang bslu ba med par shes pas so/ /gsum pa ni da ltar gyi gdul bya la ltos pa'i grangs nges te/ ston pa la dngos su thug pa'i gdul bya la tshad ma gnyis kyi chog bka'i dgongs pa rang dbang du 'grel ba'i gdul bya la tshad ma gsum gyis chog da ltar gyi gdul bya la bzhi las grangs mang mi dgos shing nyung na mi 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni sngar gyi chos sna drug cu po tshad ma bzhi ru ji ltar gtan la dbab te/ de yang nyams su len pa'i go rim dang bstun nas bla ma brgyud pa la mos gus tshud tshud bsgom pa/ rang rgyud la nyams myong tshad ma bskyed pa/ de nyid lo rgyus sam gzhung chung rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang sbyar ba/ de nyid bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma dang sbyar ba ste/ dang po ni bla ma rgya bod kyi lo rgyus so/ /gnyis pa la nyams ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa khrid kyi rnal 'byor/ skyes pa bogs 'byin pa rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga/ lam gyi bar chad sel ba gegs sel gyi yi ge chen po bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung khrid bzhi'o/ /khrid de nyid la dgos pa/ dang por dam tshig dang sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed pa smin byed dbang ste/

de'i yi ge dbang chu/ dbang chog mdor bsdus/ mchog dbang gsum gyi yi ge ste gsum/ thob pa mi nyams pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig la/ bza' ba/ srung ba/ bsten pa'i dam tshig gsum ste/ dang po la khyad par dang rgyun gnyis/ gnyis pa 'khrul spong / gsum pa rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor te/ bskyed rim la yab kyi gsum/ yum gyi gcig gsang dbang gi mgor yum gyi byin rlabs bskyed rim kyi bya ba la dgos pa/ lta ba sbyin sreg gnyis te/ mdor na nyi shu rtsa drug po de'i sgo nas nyams myong tshad ma zhig rang rgyud la btsal la/ nam rnyed pa na bskyangs bar bya'o/ /gsum pa bstan bcos tshad ma la gnyis/ gzhung rgyas par bshad pa dang / gzhung bsdus pa'o/ /dang po la'ang gnyis/ lam rgyas 'bring gsum du bstan pa dang / zab 'bring gsum du bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni gzhung chung rdo rje'i tshig rkang / gzhung bshad snyag mas tshom bu bco brgyad du bkrol ba'i don/ gsal byed yig chung nyer gnyis kyis brgyan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu/ ngo bo/ phan yon/ bar chad sal ba/ sa mtshams te tshom bu lngar bstan pa nyid do/ /gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor lnga la btud de bskrun/ /'bar g.yo brtan pa'i bye brag gis/ /srog rtsol 'gog pa de bzhin du/ /bde chen chos sku nam mkha' bzhin/ /zhes pa'i don ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa zab 'bring gsum gyi tha ma lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa ni de dag thams cad yin la/ 'bring dam tshig gis 'gro ba yang gseb tshags su bstan tshar bas yi ge logs na med cing / rab bla mas 'gro ba la bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gnyis pa don bsdus pa ni rnam 'grel a seng ma ste/ de ltar na bstan bcos tshad ma la yi ge nyer brgyad do/ /rtogs gsal dpe bris ni thad so thad sor 'gro yod/ bzhi pa ni lung sbyor gsum ste/ chos sna drug cu tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar ba'o/ /gnyis pa po ti dmar chung tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar ba la gsum/

ring brgyud nye brgyud rnam gnyis zhar byung dang bcas pa/ kha skong rje btsun ngor pa yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i chos sna tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni bla ma tshad ma la brgyud 'debs bla ma rdor 'dzin/ kha skong shar chen pas mdzad pa/ sa 'bir mjal ba'i lo rgyus sga theng ma bkur ba ste gsum/ nyams myong tshad ma la khrid yig tshigs bcad ma gra ston zhus lan gsal bar grags pa/ smin byed sta gon skabs su sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung / de'i gsal byed aṣ+ṭa'i gzhi bshad/ dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'byung ba/ lam dbang gi skabs dbang gi rab dbye/ dga' ston gdams yig gsang dbang gi sngon 'gro phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal/ de'i gsal byed shar chen pas mdzad pa/ lung sbyor nyi shu'i gsal byed lam 'bras pa nor bzang gis mdzad pa/ lus gnad kyi man ngag gsang dbang gi dngos gzhi gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i dmigs pa rgyas pa/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa nyer dgu/ gegs sel la bar chad gsum sel/ gleng gzhi ma/ gsang bdun ma/ bla ma chen po'i nyams chung ba/ nyams che ba/ khyad par rlung rengs bcos pa/ gegs sel bzhi'i gsal byed/ gegs sel bka' rgya ma/ 'phrin las so gnyis kyi sdom tshig zhal shes/ dbang gi lta ba ngo sprod pa dbang bzhi ngo sprod rtsa 'grel te bstan bcos tshad ma gnad du che ba drug rten 'brel lnga/ phyag chen dbye ba/ 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ tshogs sbyor mngon rtogs/ lam dus 'dod pa'i lcags kyu/ lam dus bshad pa/ bsgrub pa lung sbyin/ gsang bcu'i rgyas btab ste dgu'o/ /lung tshad ma dmar gyis mdzad pa'i lung sbyor ro/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ bir+wa pas sa chen la dngos su gnang ba/ sa chen gyis rje pa la mnal lam du gnang ba/ zhar byung dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhir grags pa ste/ lam zab/ lam sbas bshad/

bir bsrung / rnam 'joms bir lugs so/ /dang po ni sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dmar gyi bla ma rin 'byung gi man ngag ste gnyis/ gnyis pa ni lam sbas bshad kyi yi ge sa paṇa gyi mdzad pa/ pho brang lnga'i sbas bshad/ sbas bshad 'khrul 'khor so gnyis/ de'i gsal byed bud+dha shrīs mdzad pa/ grub chen bcu/ phra mo brgyad rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ gsum pa ni sa chen gyi bir bsrung gi yig rnying gsum/ bir+wa pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs byed tshul gnyis/ 'phags pas mdzad pa ste lnga'o/ /bzhi pa ni sa chen gyi rnam 'joms sgrub thabs/ de'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ sa paṇa gyi gzungs kyi mchan bu/ nub pa rig pa 'dzin grags kyi de'i lag len te bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa ni brda don gsal ba ste/ sa chen gyi rtsa ba/ sa paṇa gyi 'grel pa/ lho ba'i gsal byed de gsum mo/ /gsum pa ni rje pa'i tshar gsum khug pa/ yig brgya'i las tshogs/ sgo drug chos 'brel rnams so/ /gsum pa kha skong la bzhi/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ rje sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa/ bdag chen rin po ches mdzad pa/ rje btsun bla ma mchog gis mdzad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gsang ba'i sgo 'byed rgyud gsum lam rim sa bcad/ nang gi lam zab/ dbang bzhi'i rtogs bskyed/ thun mong ba'i bir bsrung bar chad kun sel/ thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs/ mtshan don gsung ngag dang sbyar ba/ bir bsrung gsar ma/ sku'i rnam 'gyur drug ste brgyad dam/ yang gnad kyi zla zer/ rgyud gsum 'khrul 'joms/ lus dkyil rtsod spong / smra ba ngan 'joms/ tshogs 'khor gsang ba kun rgyan/ gtor chog gi 'grel pa 'phrin las rgyas byed sogs kyang 'dir gsungs te mtha' yas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsung ngag gi khrid yig gnyis/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ dbang chu gsal ba'i me long / kha skong / sa chog lam dus dbang / gtor chog rnam bshad/ gsang ba'i lam bzang /

grub mtha'i rnam 'byed/ bla ma'i rnam thar la sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni rje sems dpa' chen po'i rnam thar/ khrid yig zin bris/ brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed/ lam dus dbang chog bdud rtsi sgrub thabs/ ltung ba'i rnam bshad 'khrul spong rab gsal/ mngon byang bzhi bshad/ 'khor 'das dbyer med gsal byed/ brda don gsal ba'i khrid/ lam sbas bshad kyi khrid/ gsang ba'i lam zab mchan bcas/ ga ya'i mgon rkyang rjes gnang la sogs pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar/ kun spangs rdo rje ring pa chen po'i rnam thar/ lam 'bras brgyud 'debs lam rim smin grol dang bcas pa/ de'i bkris/ dbang chu'i lhan thabs/ phyi dkyil gyi rnam bshad/ nang dkyil gyi rnam bshad la sogs pa ste/ de rnams kyang tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar te shes par sla'o/ /bzhi pa snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgro 'dogs gcod tshul la gnyis/ thun mong ba tshogs bshad kyi dbang du byas pa dang / thun mong min pa slob bshad kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po la bzhi/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub la/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gdam ngag gi sarga ma log pa/ mos gus kyis bsam pa tshim pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ rgyu dus kyi dbang chu ma nub pa ni sdom pa rtsa ba nas ma nyams pa/ lam dus kyi dbang chu ma nub pa ni lam dbang thob nas rab 'bring gsum du ma chag pa/ 'bras bu'i dbang chu ma nub pa ni 'gros bzhi thim pa'i rten 'brel ma 'chugs pa'o/ /byin rlabs la'ang bzhi/ nyams su blangs pa'i mtha' ni/ lus gnad bca' ba nas gegs sel gyi bar bla ma'i gsung bzhin nyams su blangs pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtha' ni/ phyi nang mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlabs pa/ nyams su myong ba'i mtha' ni/ nyams ji lta ba bzhin skyes pa/ grub pa'i mtha' ni/ grub mtha' bsnyogs pa'o/ /sarga ma log pa ni/ sarka'am sarba'am/ sarga'am gang byas kyang 'dra ste/ go rim gyi brda rnying yin la/

des na gdam ngag ston pa'i go rim ltar na/ rgyud ma sbyangs pa la dbang mi bskur/ de ma bskur ba la khrid mi byed/ de ma byas pa gzhung mi bshad/ de ma bshad pa la bsgrub lung mi sbyin/ de ma byin pa la gsang bcu'i rgyas mi gdab pa'o/ /nyams myong la/ nyams snang thams cad rtsa yi ge dang / de'i rten 'brel du shes pas re dogs dang bral ba'o/ /bzhi pa mos gus ni/ nyams myong nang nas shar bas dag pa'i snang ba rgyas te mos gus 'phrog par mi nus pa'o/ /gnyis pa slob bshad ni 'dir mi 'bri ste thun mong ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /da ni khrid kyi gzhung shing bye brag tu bshad la 'di skad gsungs te/ de yang dkri rgyu'i gang zag ngos gzung ba/ khrid byed rnal 'byor ngos gzung ba/ gzhung shing gzhi nyid khyad par du bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni dkri rgyu'i gang zag thams cad ni skal dman rim gyis pa dang / skal ldan gcig car pa gnyis su 'du la/ de gnyis sngon byung la sbyar na/ nag po pa dang / ḍom+bhi ba gnyis la go rim ltar ngos 'dzin zhing / da ltar la sbyar na spyir gang zag bzhi ste/ gsang sngags la zhugs pa dang / theg chen tsam la zhugs pa dang / nyan thos tsam la zhugs pa dang / bstan pa la ma zhugs pa'o/ /phyi ma la gsum/ tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi go 'phang 'dod pa dang / rang nyid gcig po zhi ba don gnyer tsam dang / tshe 'dir nad zhi gdon zhi tsam 'dod pa'o/ /de ltar gsum gyi snga ma ni skal ldan gcig car ba dang / phyi ma ni skal dman rim 'jug pa'i dper gzung bar bya'o/ gnyis pa khrid kyi rnal 'byor la gnyis/ rgyud las gsungs tshul/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gis bkral tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de nas bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid/ /de'i rjes su dbu ma bstan/

/sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai rdo rje stsal/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ljon shing las rim pas slob tshul la/ thun mong ba'i lam la slob tshul dang / thun mong min pa'i lam la slob tshul gnyis/ dang po la spyod pa rim can dang / lta ba rim can la slob tshul gnyis/ dang po ni gso sbyong dang / gnas bcu ste bstan khrims la slob pa/ gnyis pa ni/ grub mtha' bzhi la slob pa'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong min pa ni/ rgyud sde bzhi la rim pas slob cing / bla med kyi'ang pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis med rgyud/ rtsa bshad la legs par 'jug pa'o/ /de dag don dril na/ dang por gso sbyong phog de nas skyabs 'gro gtan khrims bdun/ sems bskyed rnam bzhir bzung nas/ lta ba sgro 'dogs gcod tshul sogs ljon shing nyid las ji skad gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa thun mong min pa'i nyams len ni/ gzhung chung rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'dis legs par bkral ba 'di nyid de/ 'di la'ang gnyis/ gzhung chung bstan bcos tshad ma rang gang gi bzhugs tshul ltar bshad pa dang / gzhung chung bla ma'i man ngag gi nyams myong tshad ma drangs te bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshig rkang gi don/ 'khor 'das thun mong ba la gzhung tshom bu bdun/ 'khor lo 'chams pa la tshom bu bdun/ 'khor lo bskor ba la tshom bu bzhi ste tshom bu bco brgyad du bstan pa las/ thun mong ba'i tshom bu bdun lta bus kyang / tshom bu re res lam 'bras re ston cing / de yang snang gsum lta bu la sbyar ba'i tshe/ snang ba re re la rten/ rgyu/ snang ba gang yin pa zhes gsum gyis bshad nas/ nyams snang gi rten tshar ba'i lus khyad du gyur pa/ thos bsam/ bslab pa/ dbang gis rgyud dag cing / nyams rgyud la skyes pa zhes 'chad pas/ rnal 'byor pas dbang dam tshig bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len thams cad 'dir bstan nas/ ma dag snang ba'i skabs su/ lam nyams len gyi dri mi bro ba'i bshad lugs shig byed pa'o/

/gnyis pa ni tshig rkang gi don tshom bu ji snyed pa thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi cha rkyen ma tshang ba med pa gcig tu dril nas ston te/ de yang sems can la/ nyon mongs pa la/ ma dag pa'i snang ba/ zhes pas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang bcas pa/ las rgyu 'bras rnams ston te/ sems can gyi khams la brtags pas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes/ nyon mongs pa'i mang tshul mthong bas dal 'byor rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed dka' bar go /ma dag pa'i snang tshul bltas pas las 'bras bslu med du mthong bas so/ /rnal 'byor pa la/ ting nge 'dzin la/ nyams kyi snang ba/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa la thun mong dang thun mong min pa gnyis su phye nas/ thun mong bas byams snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems rnams bsgom pas rgyud sbyangs te dbang bskur ba'i snod rung du byas/ lus thabs rgyud la gdan sogs gsum pa bzhi'i rgyu'i dbang / /zhes pas rgyu dbang bskur ba sogs gang zag gcig gis nyams len du sbyar nas 'chad pa'o/ /de ltar tshad ma gnyis la sbyor tshul tha dad pa'i rnam dbyes rdo rje'i tshig la bshad pa dang / nyams len gnyis tha dad par 'byung ba ni man ngag gis mig gi bltas na gsal bar mthong ste/ rnam 'grel snyag ma sogs na bstan bcos tshad ma'i bshad pa de nyid bsnyon med du yod cing / nyams myong tshad ma la sbyar ba'i nyams len 'di nyid ni/ rnam 'grel a seng ma dang / gzhung khrid jo lcags ma gnyis na gsal ba yin te/ ji skad du/ snang ba gsum gyis lam gyi gzhi bcas te/ /zhes pa snang gsum gyi nyams len te/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'a/ོ las 'bras lhur len/ byams snying rje byang sems kyis rgyud sbyangs pa ni dbang gi snod dam gzhir rung bas lam gyi gzhi ma yin pa'o/ /nyams blang ma lus rgyud gsum dag gis shes/ /zhes pa ni/ rgyud gsum nyams blang gi dngos gzhir bstan pa ste/
