de yang kun gzhi ni gtan la dbab bya yin yang / yul can 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi cha nas nyams blang du bsdus/ 'bras rgyud ni spro ba bskyed pa'i cha nas bsam/ 'bras bu'i nyams sna tshogs 'char bas der bsdus pa tsam ste/ gtso bo thabs rgyud de/ dang po dbang / bsrung bya dam tshig bsgom bya lam sogs/ nyams chag bskang thabs/ lam dus kyi dbang la sogs pa'o/ /tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi las sgro 'dogs gcod/ /ces pa ni sgro 'dogs gcod tshul te/ tshad ma bzhi'i snang gsum dang / snyan brgyud bzhi'i rgyud gsum la'o/ /sems 'dzin gnas lugs rnam gsum rtogs pa yis/ /zhes pa nas/ rgyu rkyen gzhan med re dogs bral bar mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis shes pas phan 'dogs bdun bstan/ thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug rnal 'byor pa/ /zhes pa nas/ bar chad rim gyis sel ba shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bsrung ba sum cu bstan/ rtsa yi zug la la dor shin tu gces/ /zhes sogs kyis gegs sel bstan/ lta bsgom gnyis la dug dbyung bdud rtsi bsten/ /zhes sogs kyis gdam ngag drug bstan te/ mdor na gzhung 'di'i tshom bu thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du dril nas bstan pas bstan bcos tshad mar bgrang yang / ston tshul nyams myong tshad mar bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa khrid kyi gzhung shing bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis/ spyir bshad pa dang / gnad bsdus nas nyams su len tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gang dag chos rje pa'i khrid kyi dkar chag tu grags pa de'i rjes su zhugs nas khrid tshul bco brgyad du 'byed pa yod mod/ re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag nas 'dir brgyud pa 'di nyid las 'ong pa ni/ khrid gzhung bzhir grags pa dang / cha lag lam sbas bshad/ brda' don gsal ba rnams kyi khrid mdzad la/ lam zab mo la'ang khrid med do/ /zhes bka' dog par mdzad kyang / khrid zab po zhig bzhugs zhes gsungs shing /

khrid gzhung bzhi'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin gyi khrid kyis dkris na/ khrid gzhan gsum gyis logs su dkri mi dgos te/ lam dbang rgyas pa thob na 'bring bsdus gnyis logs su bya mi dgos pa dang 'dra gsungs/ de yang khrid thog mtha' gnyis rgyas pa/ bar pa gnyis bsdus pa/ yang thog ma skal dman rim 'jug pa'i khrid de/ tshig rkang gi babs kyis bzhugs tshul ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'o/ /bar pa gnyis ni skal ldan gcig car ba'i khrid de/ gnad drug gis dkri ba ni bskyed rdzogs thun mong ba'i khrid yin la/ gnad bcu gcig gis dkri ba ni/ rdzogs rim kho na'i khrid yin pa'o/ /dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi dkri ba ni/ gcig car ba dang rim 'jug pa thun mong ba'i khrid yin pas ji ltar 'tshams pas dkri zhing rgyud tshod dang sbyar ba ste/ nyan thos lam gyis dkri bar 'os pa ni/ nyes dmigs/ rnyed dka'/ las 'bras gsum gyis dkri/ theg pa thun mong bas dkri bar 'os pa ni/ byams snying rje byang sems gsum gyis dkri/ thun mong min pa lta bas dkri bar 'os pa ni/ sems sgyu ma rang bzhin med pa gsum gyis dkri/ thabs/ shes rab/ zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor pa gsum ni dbang po rab 'bring gsum gsum du phye nas dkri ba'o/ /de lta bu'i dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi khrid yig 'di la/ sngon gyi yig rnying che chung gnyis 'dug pa las/ brgyud pa 'di pas tshad mar bya rgyu ni chung ba 'di nyid de/ 'di nyid tshad ma yin pa'i shes byed ni/ dkar shākya grags kyi 'di'i khrid yig dang / tshogs bsgom pa'i 'di'i khrid yig dang 'di nyid mthun pa yin la/ cha rgan pa'i yi ge dang yang 'di mthun pa yin no/ /khrid yig che ba de nyid ni sa paṇa gyi khrid kyi dkar chag tu grags pa las/ de nyid gzhir bzhag pa nas/ chos rje bla ma dam pa sogs kyis kyang tshad mar mdzad mod/ cung ma dag pa'i shes byed ni/ sngon 'gro dmigs pa'i grangs zlos pa dang /

sems kyi dpe mig yor dang / rten 'brel gyi dpe chu zla gnyis sgyu ma'i dper bkod pas rje pa'i gsung dang 'gal/ zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor pa'i khrid rim chad/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang tsam thob pas lus dkyil bsgom du rung bar bshad pa sogs gong ma'i gsung rab dang 'gal bar snang ba du ma zhig yod pa'o gsungs/ gnyis pa gnad bsdus nas nyams su blang ba ni/ lam 'bras khrid kyi snying po ni/ /gnyis las gsum byung gdam ngag yin/ /kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i/ /man ngag shes pa bla ma'i drin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang de nyid dang mthun par/ bshad tshul 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i dgongs pa yin mod kyi/ /deng sang lam 'bras pa zhes yongs grags pa'i/ /bshes gnyen kun gyis lta ba'i spyod yul min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don khongs su bcug nas don nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /'o na de nyid kyi don ci yin snyam na/ 'di'i don ni drin can bla ma legs par mnyes pa'i zhal las rim gyis shes par bya ba kho na yin pas spyi brtol du yi ger 'bri ba dang / gtam du smra ba'i 'os ma yin pa de bas na 'dir mi 'bri la/ gang dag brgyud ldan bla ma'i zhal shes kyi bdud rtsi yid la sim pa'i skal ba dang ma ldan nas/ rang dga'i pho tshod ngan skyugs kyi yid gdung sel du dur re ba mang du mngon te/ brgyud pa nye brgyud gnyis las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi gdam ngag byung zhes smra ba dang / khrid yig lhug pa jo lcags ma dang / tshigs bcad ma gra ston zhus lan gnyis las/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi gdam ngag byung zhes smra ba dang / brda don gsal ba rtsa 'grel gnyis las/ dmigs pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi gdam ngag byung zhes gnyis dang gsum gyi khungs gang 'grig btsal nas 'ol tshod kyis gzhal bar mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar min par brgyud pa'i man ngag snyan brgyud ma nyams pa 'dir ni/

rje btsun bla mas khog phub yongs su rdzogs pa'i dus 'dir brgyud rim gyi zhal shes nyid gsungs la/ khrid rim yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe/ man ngag gi zhal shes nyid 'dom par mdzad do zhes gsungs pa'o/ /gsum pa bsgrub pa mthar phyin nas gsang ba bcu yis rgyas btab pa ni/ de ltar rgyud sbyangs pa la dbang / dbang gis smin pa la khrid/ dkris tshar ba la gzhung chung gdam ngag tu ston/ gzhung tshar ba la ji ltar 'os pa'i bka' rgya/ ma 'ong pa'i lung bstan dang bcas pas gdams par mdzad pa ste/ de ltar de dag gis ni khog phub kyi gnad spyi bye brag rkang grangs dang bcas pa rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas brgyud pa gsum 'dus kyi bla ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi tshim par phab pa'i mod las/ cha shas 'di tsam zhig bdag blo'i ra bar tshud pa/ ngan rtog dug chus ma sbags par/ rang gi tsha gdung bsal phyin/ dkar dwangs kyi gzhi la gsal bar bkod pa ste/ skal ba dang 'tshams na re 'dod yongs su rdzogs pa kho na yin no/ /zhes pa de rnams ni gsung ngag slob bshad pa'i khog phub kyi zin bris gnad kyi be'u bum las byung ba ltar sgra ji bzhin du bkod pa yin no/ /gsung ngag slob bshad du grags pa 'di ni lam 'bras kyi zab mo'i nying khu 'ga' zhig mus chen sems dpa' chen po yan la gsung ngag slob bshad 'di'o zhes mngon gyur du mi gsung bas/ gsung ngag slob bshad ltar na 'di'o zhes yig cha sogs su ma theb pa snyan brgyud 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs pa la/ mus chen gyi slob ma'i mchog bdag chen rdo rje 'chang slob bshad ltar na 'di'o zhes ma sbas par gnang ba yin la/ de nas rje rdo ring pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje klu sgrub rgya mtsho sogs las 'phel bar grags pa yin la/ zhib tu khong rang tsho'i yig cha las rtogs par bya'o/

/de ltar gong du bshad pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma'i rkang grangs 'di rnams ni gtso bor kun mkhyen e wam̐ pa chen po'i lugs srol dang mthun pa yin la/ yang sa skya pa'i srol 'dzin rdzong lugs pa 'ga' dag bstan bcos tshad ma'i rkang grangs 'dren tshe/ nyi lde ba nam mkha' dpal bzang dang / mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag nyid gzhir mdzad par gnang ste/ de yang nyi lde ba'i dkar chag de nyid nas byung tshul bshad na 'di lta ste/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam 'bras kyi gzhung 'grel cha lag kha skong gsal byed dang bcas pa rnams kyi dpe sna'i grangs la/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang / de'i sa bcad rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel bcu gcig rje btsun chen pos yod gsungs pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' a seng gi don du mdzad pa'i don bsdus tshigs bcad ma de gzhir bzhag nas/ de'i don du mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel/ gnyan phul byung ba'i don du mdzad pa sras don mar mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ ldan ma sga theng ma'i don du mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel/ yum don mar grags pa'i rnam 'grel/ jo gdan ldan bu'i don du mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel/ klo kya chos grags kyi don du mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel/ zhu byas mar grags pa'i rnam 'grel/ byang sems zla rgyal gyi don du mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel/ sna ro ban+dhe gshin rje'i don du mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel/ jo mo 'a 'u ma'i don du mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel/ phyis rang dge bshes snyag gi don du mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel gyi cha lag rje btsun chen po'i dkar chag mdzad pa na/ kun 1gzhi rje pa rgyu rgyud/ gdan 2rtsogs/ rje pa/ lus 3dkyil/ sa chen/ bum 4dbang gi 'da' kha ma/ 'chi ltas 'khrul 'khor 'chi bslu dang bcas pa/ rje pa/ bum 5dbang gi snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' kha ma/ sa chen/ gsang 6dbang gi skabs su thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ sa chen/

shes 7rab ye shes kyi skabs su phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ sa chen/ dbang 8bzhi'i 'da' kha ma bum dbang dang thun mong du yi ge'i sgo bkag pa dang bcas/ bar 9do bzhi'i gdam ngag sa chen/ /lam 10dus kyi dbang / rje pa/ tshad 11ma 12bzhi'i gdam ngag drug rje pa/ /rten 13'brel lnga/ rje pa/ grib 14sel gyi sbyin sreg bsdus pa/ sa chen/ grib 15ma khrus kyis sel ba dang tsha tshas sel ba/ rje pa/ thig 16le bsrung ba/ rje pa/ yi ge 17brgya pa'i 'don thabs/ sa chen/ 'jig rten 18pa'i lam gyi skabs su rlung gi sbyor ba bdun gyi lam khrid pa/ rje pa/ bha 19ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi/ sa chen/ 'das 20pa'i lam la gsang dbang gi skabs su 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ sa chen/ bzhi 21pa'i skabs su dbang phyug gi don brgyad/ sa chen/ sa 22bcu gsum pa'i phyed kyi mngon rtogs/ sa chen/ thams 23cad kyi don bsdus kyi tshigs bcad/ sa chen/ 'grel pa snyag ma rang dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel gnyis/ dbang bzhi'i cho ga mtha' dag mdor bsdus pa/ mchog dbang gsum bskyed pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa/ bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa/ gegs sel bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun/ byung rgyal du mi gtong ba'i 'phrang bzhi/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyis bsal ba/ 'phrin las sum cu so gnyis dang dril bas bcu/ dbang chu chen mo/ yab yum gyi bskyed pa'i rim pa yan lag dang bcas pa/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa/ tshogs 'khor yan lag dang bcas pa/ sbyin sreg dang bdun/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i gzhung shing / gnad drug gis dkri ba/ bcu gcig gis dkri ba/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum du dkri ba ste gzhung shing bzhi/ lam 'jug ldog phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag bdun/ lam bsre ba 'gros bzhi dang bcas pa/

phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis te rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga/ dpe chung gi rim pa 'chi ltas kyi 'khor lo gnyis/ rtsa'i dpe chung / bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi'i dpe chung / 'phrin las so gnyis kyi dpe chung / gegs sel gyi dpe chung gnyis dang lnga/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ lung de nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba rje sa skya pas mdzad/ des mdzad pa'i lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i lo rgyus kyi yi ge rgya gar ba dang bod gnyis/ de ltar rje sa skya pa yab sras gsum gyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag tu theb pa'i dpe sna drug cu tham pa/ de'i dkar chag lam 'bras 'bring po/ lam bsdus par bsgrub pa lung sbyin bsdus pa/ yang rgyas pa/ lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba rin po che bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa/ lam sbas bshad kyi rtsa ba rje sa skya pas mdzad pa'i dpe chung lnga byas pa gcig chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i lam sbas bshad/ rje btsun chen po'i gsung la des zin bris mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i phyag chen dbye ba/ lam sbas bshad kyi 'khrul 'khor nyi shu'i zin bris chos rje bsod rgyal bas mdzad pa/ de'i rtsa ba zhal shes 'khrul 'khor sum cu dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis mdzad pa/ grub chen bcu'am/ rtsa ba'i gzhung / de rnams kyi gsal byed bcu/ phra mo brgyad chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ de rnams kyi zhal shes 'khrul 'khor so gnyis kyi zhal shes brgyad/ rtsa ba dang bzhi bcu rten 'brel lnga'i yi ge chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ dbang bzhi ngo sprod kyi rtsa ba rje sa skya pas mdzad pa'i dpe chung gsum yod pa/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i khrid kyi dkar chag des mdzad pa'i dbang bzhi ngo sprod/ lam bsdus pa/ dbang bzhi gdan thog gcig ma/ de dang cung mi gcig pa'i ngag dbang grags pa'i dbang bzhi gdan thog gcig ma 'di gnyug ma dran gsal las 'byung /

dbang bzhi ngo sprod theg chen pas mdzad pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ga ya dha ras dbu bsnyung bzhes pa shog gcig ma/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa gcig bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ges mdzad pa gcig rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i tshar gsum khug pa/ brda don gsal ba/ chos rje bsod rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i khrid yig chen mo/ des mdzad pa'i gnad drug gi dkri ba'i khrid yig bcu gcig gis dkri ba'i khrid yig dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyis dkri ba'i khrid yig 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i dag pa gsum gyi khrid yig des mdzad pa'i dbang gsum pa'i lam la dbye ba/ bskyed rim gyi khrid dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis zin bris su mdzad pa/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i dbang gi rab dbye/ lam dus 'dod pa'i lcags kyu/ tshogs sbyor mngon rtogs 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i 'pho ba/ rje sa skya pas mdzad pa'i gsang bcu/ de'i 'grel pa/ des mdzad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor/ bir bsrung chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ brda chig brgyud/ yab sras gsum gyis mdzad pa'i man ngag gces bsdus sna grangs sum cu so brgyad yod pa/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i phyag chen gces bsdus la sna grangs so gnyis yod pa/ rje sa skya pas mdzad pa'i gegs sel bka' rgya ma/ gsang bdun ma/ yab sras gsum dang / zhu byas kyis mdzad pa'i gegs sel nyams chen mo/ de'i zhal shes/ dbang byin rlabs la dkar chag tu kha skong rgyu kyai rdor mngon rtogs 'bring po yan lag drug pa/ khrigs chags chos rje bsod rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i bdag 'jug jim gyim ma/ dkyil 'khor bdun bsres kyi zin bris/ lus dkyil gyi rgya gzhung gnyug ma dran gsal/

de'i 'grel pa gsal byed rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa/ lus dkyil dgra las rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ kyai rdo rje lus dkyil dbang gi tho rje sa skya pas mdzad pa/ kyai rdor lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ kyai rdor lus dkyil dbang chog la ru ba bsod nams seṅges mdzad pa/ kyai rdor nag po lugs kyi mngon rtogs steng du sbyar ba'i lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang chos rje bsod rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ lam dus kyi dbang blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa/ kyai rdor lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang theg chen pas mdzad pa/ lag len zin bris mar lugs pa seng rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ lag len zin bris snye thang pa bla ma rgyal po dpal gyis mdzad pa/ aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung bdag med ma'i mngon rtogs 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ dasi mdzad pa'i bstod pa/ bdag med ma'i dbang chu ne tso sbal ston gyis mdzad pa/ de'i dbang gi tho rin po che bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa/ bdag med ma'i lus dkyil/ dbang byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa'i yi ge rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral/ rnal 'byor dbang bskur gyi tho yig zangs tsha bsod rgyal gyi zin bris/ bar ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i zin bris chen mo/ chos rje bsod rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar chen mo/ dmar chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rnam thar/ yab sras gsum khu dbon gnyis kyi rnam thar nam za pa shākya seṅges mdzad pa/ rin po che tshogs kyi rnam thar bzang po dpal gyis mdzad pa/ nyan chen pa'i rnam thar gcig zhang dkon mchog dpal gyi rnam thar dpal ldan tshul khrims pas mdzad pa/ brag phug pa'i rnam thar blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa/ blo gros brtan pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan tshul khrims pas mdzad pa/ chos rje bsod rgyal ba'i rnam thar lo tsā ba byang chub rtse mos mdzad pa/ theg chen pa'i rnam thar/

rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa la bstod pa gsol 'debs/ rje sa skya pa/ rje btsun chen po/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa re re/ rje sa skya pas zhang chos 'bar la bstod pa/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rje sa skya pa la bstod pa rin po che bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ des mdzad pa'i bsod nams rtse mo la bstod pa/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i gang drin ma/ sku'i spyod pa/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ phyogs bcu dus gsum ma/ thos pa rgya mtsho/ theg chen pa'i mdzad pas lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ngo sprod ma tshogs 'khor gyi rkang grangs tho/ lam 'bras la gsal byed kha skong lam skor rnams nas kyang len dgos pas/ lam skor la bsam mi khyab kyi gzhung tog rtse bas mdzad pa/ de la rje btsun chen po'i tshig 'grel/ bsam mi khyab kyi lo rgyus theg chen pas mdzad pa/ bsam mi khyab kyi lam lnga yongs rdzogs rje sa skya pas mdzad pa/ de'i byin rlabs kyi zin bris/ ḍom+bhi ba'i lhan cig skyes grub kyi gzhung / de la yi ge skor rje sa skya pas mdzad pa/ pad+ma badz+ras zab pa'i tshul dgu mdzad pa/ de la mi gsal ba gsal ba lo rgyus dang bcas pa rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa/ in+d+ra bo dha'i phyag rgya'i lam bsdus pa'i gsung la rje sa skya pas yi ge mdzad pa/ ngag dbang grags pa'i phyag rgya chen pos yi ge med pa mdzad pa/ de'i gsal byed rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa/ de'i lam sbyor sa bcad/ nag po pa'i gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi gzhung / de'i yi ge de'i them yig nag po pa'i yon po bsrang ba/ de'i gsal byed yi ge de'i zin bris/ klu sgrub kyi mchod rten drung thob la rje btsun chen pos gsal byed mdzad pa/ them yig sa bcad/ zin bris yod pa snye thang pa bla ma rgyal po dpal gyis mdzad pa yin/

gzhan yang lam skor rnams la rgya gzhung gsal byed rje yab sras kyis mdzad pa zin bris mang po yod/ yang spyi tsam gyi gsal byed bla chen 'brog mis mkhas pa sgo drug la gsan pa lung re la brten pa/ nā ro ta pa'i sdug bsngal gsum sel/ ngag dbang grags pa'i gnyug ma dran gsal/ shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa'i phyi rol gdon gyi bar chad srung ba/ dzñā na shrīs 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad sel ba'i man ngag rin chen rdo rjes sems kyi bar chad srung ba'i man ngag shan+ti pas rje rang la gsungs pa'i mdo rgyud bsre ba/ nā ro ta ba'i sdug bsngal gsum sel/ rje btsun chen pos yi ge mdzad la/ ngag dbang grags pa'i snyug ma dran gsal la yi ge 'grel pa mdzad pa gong du smos la/ gzhan rnams la yang 'brog mi'i gsung bgros lam 'bras kyi cha lag gsal ba kha skong dang bcas pa'i dpe sna'i grangs nyis brgya bcu gsum yod pa'i tho 'di rang nyid dran pa gso ba'i phyir du gsang sngags 'dzin pa nyi lde ba kun ting gu shrī nam mkha' bzang pos bkod pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ba yin no/ ༈ /yang rdzong lugs kyi bstan 'dzin chen po gtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras lam skor lhag ma dang bcas pa'i tho yig las 'di ltar 'byung ba yin te/ de yang bshad par bya ste/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i man ngag lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang / de'i don 'grel bar byed pa'i rnam 'grel snyag ma/ de nyid gsal bar byed pa'i gsal byed nyer gsum la sogs pa rnams ni rje btsun rin po che'i dkar chag tu gsal la/ 'dir dkar chag de nyid du man ngag phra mo gzhan gyi dkar chag kyang brjod par ga la nus pas 'dir bri bar mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag phra mo gzhan rjes 'brang gi yi ge dang bcas pa ji ltar nus pa bri bar bya ste/ de la drug

sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa'i yi ge rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge 'phags pas mdzad pa'i yi ge de dag gsal byed rjes 'brang gi yi ge'o/ /dang po la gsum/ byin rlabs kyi yi ge gegs sel gyi yi ge spyi 'gro'i yi ge'o/ /dang po la byin rlabs kyi yi ge bzhi ste/ lam dus kyi dbang chog bdag med ma'i byin rlabs/ bir+wa pa'i byin rlabs/ aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung / gnyis pa gegs sel gyi yi ge la brgyad de/ gegs sel nyams chen mo/ 'di la kha cig na re/ nyams chen mo la mi 'dra ba 'ga' re 'dug na'ang / bla ma nyan po pa'i gsung gis phan na thams cad nyams su longs gsungs so zhes zer mod/ yi ge tshan pa brgyad yod pa bsgrigs rim mi 'dra ba mang du snang yang / man ngag dang dpe tshan so so'i tshig ris la mi 'dra ba cung zad kyang yod pa ma yin pas rang smra bar 'dod nas nyan po pa'i gsung ngo zhes bris pa'o/ /yang 'di la kha cig gang zag so so'i ming smos pa'i dpe tshan gsum po de logs su phyung nas gegs sel gleng gzhi ma zhes ming 'dogs par byed kyang / gegs sel brda 'grol gyi yi ge gnyis las/ nyams chen gyi nang du rtogs par byas pa nyid sngon gyi lugs so/ /gegs sel nyams chung ba dmar khrid ma yang zer/ 'di zhu byas kyi yin yang gsungs so/ /bar chad rnam gsum bsal ba/ 'di lho brag dkar ston la gnang bas dkar ston ma'ang zer ro/ /gegs sel bka' rgya ma 'di'i thod du/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs rdul gus len pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po zhes bya dmar gyis zhus/ /zhes 'byung ba la brten nas kha cig dmar gyis mdzad par bzhed kyang / 'di'i gsham du mchan rnying par/ 'dzam dza ne/ gtsang bzhed rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mkhas pa lnga ste bdun la gnang / bka' rgyas kyang btab/ 'jam gyis bla chen la zhus nas/ rje pa sku mched gnyis dran pas/

rje'i zhal nas 'dzam 'di nged la drin che gsung ngo zhes 'byung bas/ sa chen rang gis mdzad pa yin la/ zhus tshul de ni dmar gyis phyis bsnan par gsal lo/ /gegs sel gces bsdus 'di la yi ge tshan pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod de/ gegs sel gsang bdun ma/ gegs sel ha dmigs/ lus sbyong nyi shu pa/ gsum pa spyi 'gro'i yi ge bzhi ste/ dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod rtsa 'grel/ lam bsdus pa ngo bo nyid gsum/ gsang bcu spyod pa'i rnal 'byor lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba rnams so/ /yi ge 'di rnams las 'ga' zhig dngos kyi bla ma'i gsung las zin pa bris pa yang yin pa 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa'i yi ge ni lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba mchan bu ma'o/ /gsum pa rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge la gsum/ gsol 'debs kyi yi ge slob ma la gdams pa'i yi ge rnam thar gyi yi ge'o/ /dang po gsol 'debs kyi yi ge la gnyis te/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs che ba bla ma rdo rje 'dzin ma dang / chung ba rdo rje 'chang gtso ma dang / gnyis pa slob ma la gdams pa'i yi ge gnyis te/ sras don la gdams pa dang / sga ston la spring yig go /gsum pa rnam thar gyi yi ge gcig ste/ bla ma chen po'i ngo mtshar gyi gtam gnyis zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge la bzhi/ khrid kyi yi ge bshad pa'i yi ge bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yi ge bir srung gi yi ge'o/ /dang po la khrid kyi yi ge bzhi yan lag gnyis dang bcas pa ste/ khrid kyi dkar chag kha cig 'di sa paṇa gyi gsung min par smra mod/ de 'di shin tu mi rigs te/ bka' bsgrub bstan pa'i skabs su legs par bsgrubs zin pa'i phyir ro/ /lam sbas bshad de'i yan lag grub chen bcu dang / phra mo brgyad rtsa 'grel/ brda don gsal ba rtsa 'grel/ de'i yan lag khrid kyi lung sbyor/ bsgrub pa lung sbyin/ gnyis pa bshad pa'i yi ge drug ste/

rtsa sngags bshad pa/ phyag chen dbye ba/ rten 'brel lnga/ rlung gi rten 'brel/ 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ sa paṇa zin bris/ gsum pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yi ge gnyis te/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa/ 'di la ling chu rtser khab ma yang zer/ gu shrī jo 'bum ma/ 'di la nad 'don ma yang zer ro/ /bzhi pa bir srung gi yi ge bzhi ste/ bir srung thun mong ma yin pa sngags byang / yan lag gi man ngag srung ba rnam gsum/ ril bu'i bcud len/ lnga pa 'phags pas mdzad pa'i yi ge la lnga/ phyag mchod kyi yi ge khrid kyi yi ge lus dkyil gyi yi ge bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yi ge de dag las gzhan pa'i man ngag gi yi ge'o/ /dang po phyag mchod kyi yi ge la gcig ste/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i phyag mchod/ gnyis pa khrid kyi yi ge gnyis te/ dag pa gsum gyi khrid kyi yi ge dbang gsum pa'i lam rgyas bsdus/ gsum pa lus dkyil gyi yi ge gsum/ lus dkyil dbang chog lus dkyil bsgom thabs/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas par blang ba'i lag len/ bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yi ge bla ma'i rnal 'byor le'u nyi shu ma/ shod dgon spyan snga ma/ lnga pa de dag las gzhan pa'i man ngag gi yi ge bzhi ste/ bir srung thun mong ba/ bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg tshogs sbyor mngon rtogs/ drug pa de dag gsal bar byed pa'i rjes 'brang gi yi ge la bzhi ste/ sa chen gyi yi ge gsal byed/ sa paṇa gyi yi ge gsal byed/ 'phags pa'i yi ge gsal byed/ snyag ma cha lag dang bcas pa'i gsal byed do/ /dang po la yi ge drug ste/ lus dkyil dbang chog gi gsal byed/ ri khrod pa blo brtan gyi lus dkyil dbang chog nyams chen sogs kyi gsal byed gegs sel brda' 'grol che chung / dkar ston ma'i gsal byed bar chad rnam gsum bsal ba/ bka' rgya ma'i gsal byed na bza' pa'i dbyug chos/ dbang bzhi ngo sprod kyi gsal byed ngo sprod byin rlabs lag len bar ston ma/

gnyis pa sa paṇa gyi yi ge gsal byed drug ste/ khrid kyi dkar chag gi gsal byed zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi zin bris/ chos rje gzungs pas bla ma klu pa la gnang pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa/ lam sbas bshad kyi gsal byed/ sbas bshad lag len zin bris/ phra grub kyi gsal byed grub chen dang / phra mo'i zhal shes zin bris che chung gnyis/ che ba 'di la kha cig gis/ bud+dha shrīs byas pa'i sbyar byang bris pa snang mod/ yi ge rnying ma yin pas phyis su byas pa ma yin no/ /brda don gsal ba'i 'grel pa'i gsal byed lho pa kun mkhyen rin po che dpal gyi zin bris gsum pa 'phags pa'i yi ge gsal byed gcig ste/ bir srung gi gsal byed srung ba gsum dang sbyar ba/ 'di 'phags pa'i yi ge 'di'i gsal byed du sbyar nas bris pa'i nges pa mi 'dug na'ang / skabs der sbyor bde bas sbyar ba yin no/ /bzhi pa snyag ma cha lag dang bcas pa'i gsal byed kyi yi ge la bzhi ste/ snyag ma gsal byed kyi yi ge 'phros don gsal byed kyi yi ge lam 'bring po gsal byed kyi yi ge gzhung shing gsal byed kyi yi ge'o/ /dang po la snyag ma gsal byed kyi yi ge gnyis te/ gzhung bshad gsal byed bar ston zin bris/ bdud rtsi bsten pa'i gsal byed bcud len zhal shes/ gnyis pa 'phros don gsal byed kyi yi ge bzhi ste/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi zin bris bar ston ma/ rlung bcu sogs kyi gegs sel/ rlung bcu'i gegs sel/ 'phrin las so gnyis dang zhal shes/ gsum pa lam 'bring po gsal byed kyi yi ge gnyis te/ lam 'bring po'i zin bris che chung gnyis/ bzhi pa gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i gzhung shing gsal byed snyag snying po rgyal mtshan dang / nyan chen pas khrid kyi yi ge re re'o/ /kha cig phyi ma 'di nyan chen pa'i gsung min par smra mod/ rang gi blo dang ma mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan du byas pa'o/

/'dir kha cig rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa nyer dgu dang / dmar gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rin 'byung ma dang / gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi'i zhal gdams bla ma dam pa'i phyag dpe la dge slong dpal ldan gyis bris zhes pa dang / sbas bshad 'khrul 'khor so gnyis dang / bir+wa pa dang sa chen mjal ba'i lo rgyus rje btsun gyis sga theng la bskur ba yin zer ba sogs bri ba dang / sa paṇa gyi dkar chag dang / zangs tsha'i zin bris sogs med mi rung gi yi ge du ma 'dor ba ni shin tu mi rigs te/ rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa nyer dgu ni/ sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud 'chad pa'i dus su gsungs pa'i zhal shes yin gyi/ lam 'bras kyi man ngag ma yin pa'i phyir dang / bla ma rin 'byung ma ni/ don dang lag len tshang bar bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa las 'byung bas/ 'dir med kyang man ngag ma tshang ba'i skyon med la/ ci nas bgrang bar byed na'ang / dmar gyi yi ge dag gi gseb tu bgrang bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir dang / gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi'i zhal gdams ni/ rnal 'byor gyi 'phrin las so gnyis ngos 'dzin pa na/ lus kyi 'phrin las nyi shu/ rlung gi 'phrin las bdun/ thun mong gi 'phrin las lnga/ zhes sogs 'dir ma grags shing / zha ma'i lung la grags pa mang du snang bas/ rang gzhan gyi lugs ma phyed par snang ba'i phyir dang / bla ma dam pa la zha ma'i lugs kyi phyag dpe yang yod pas/ des thun mong ma yin pa mi 'grub pa'i phyir dang / sbas bshad 'khrul 'khor so gnyis ni/ mang mkhar bya tsha lung pa'i bla ma rgyal mtshan 'bum la bla ma dam pas gsan te phyis byung ba yin pas med mi rung gi rtsa ba'i man ngag ma yin pa'i phyir dang / bir+wa pa dang sa chen mjal ba'i lo rgyus rje btsun gyis sga 'theng la bskur ba yin zer ba ni/ deng sang gi dbang rgyud gdam ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa ji snyed pa/ sa chen gyis rje btsun sku mched la brgyud de brgyud pa 'ded pa dang /

yi ge der bir+wa pa dang sa chen mjal lugs tsam yang gtan ma thos par/ rjes su gzhan la dri dgos par byung zhing / de'ang byis pa 'di tsho khyod dri ba'i dus shig 'ong gis de tsa na zlos gsungs zer ba shin tu 'gal te/ rnam 'joms bir lugs sogs rnal 'byor dbang phyug kho na la dngos su gsan pa'i gdam ngag khyad par can bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams brgyud pa gang la brgyud tsam yang rtsad gcod mi nus pa'i byis pas/ dbang brgyud gdam ngag 'di tsam 'khrul pa med par ji ltar len nus/ de'i phyir lo rgyus 'di ni rdzun ma kho na yin par the tshom med do/ /sa paṇa gyi khrid kyi dkar chag ni ngan rtog gis spangs par snang mod/ tshad mar bsgrubs zin pa'i phyir dang / zangs tsha'i yi ge sogs med mi rung gi yi ge du ma ni gzhan gyi spyod yul du ma gyur bar zad pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir 'dir bris pa'i 'di dag ni sgro bskur dang bral ba yin no/ /yang zur du gsungs pa'i man ngag la/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ tshar gsum khug pa/ aṣ+ṭa'i byad zlog go cha lnga srung / rten 'brel srung ba rnams so/ /rten 'brel srung ba'i cha lag rmi lam ngan pa zhi bar bya ba dang nad zhi bar bya ba dang / dgra zhi bar bya ba yod gsungs pas btsal lo/ /lam skor lhag ma brgyad la zab pa'i tshul dgu rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i man ngag mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gtum po lam rdzogs kyi gsal byed rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ yon po bsrang ba'i man ngag bsam mi khyab pa lngas lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i man ngag de'i yan lag rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i sa dang po/ gegs sel log non rnam pa lnga'i man ngag lhan cig skyes pa'i bsgrub pa/ de'i yan lag phyag rgya'i brtag thabs/ phyag rgya bsten thabs/ gnad khyad par can bla ma'i zhal las byung ba/ mchod rten drung thob rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/

phyag rgya lam rdzogs brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ yi ge med pa dbyibs dang bcas pa rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ de thams cad la nye bar mkho ba gnad du che ba drug lam skor byung tshul zhes bya ba'i yi ge chung ngu gcig bsam mi khyab kyi brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dkar ston chos 'od la byin rlabs zin bris/ 'di 'brog mi'i dngos slob gcig yin/ bar ston gyi lam skor zin bris la/ mchod rten drung thob/ bsam mi khyab/ pad+ma ba'i lam/ lhan cig skyes grub/ gtum mo lam rdzogs rnams kyi zin bris re re'o/ /'di rnams gsham la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi zin bris sbrel te mdzad byang phyogs gcig tu sbyar 'dug go /yi ge med pa'i khrid kyi dmigs pa snyag snying po rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ bsam mi khyab kyi zin bris chen mo rnams so/ /sgo drug chos 'brel la/ bar chad rnam gsum srung ba gcig tu byas pa'i man ngag gi yi ge sdug bsngal gsum bsal byed rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ gnyug ma dran gsal/ zab mo mdo rgyud bsre ba rnams so/ /de ltar lam 'bras lam skor lhag ma rnams dang bcas pa'i tho yig 'di/ 'gro ba'i bla ma rgyal mtshan dkon mchog gi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa gtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis shing pho rta'i lo dbyug pa zla ba'i nyer gsum la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por bris pa'o zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /de rnams kyis yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rin po che'i nyams len gyi man ngag gsung ngag rin po che'i byon tshul khog phub dang bcas pa ma tshang ba med pa bstan zin to/ /de ltar bshad pa'i chos 'byung khog phub de rnams blo nus dus skabs chos thun ring thung sogs dang sbyar te rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du dum bur bcad de ston pa zhu/ /'dir smras pa/ rab 'byams sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /zab don gcig tu bsdus pa'i lam rim mchog

/gsung ngag rin chen byung tshul khog phub bcas/ /rgyas par bshad pa'i bstan bcos 'di ngo mtshar/ 1 /gzhan las rmad byung legs par bshad pa'i gtam/ /sngon byon gong mas mang du bshad zin kyang / /de kun gcig tu bsdus pa'i gsung rab 'di/ /ngo mtshar legs bshad 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho yin/ 2 /tshul 'di sngon sbyangs blo mig cher gsal bas/ /rtsod bral mkhas pa'i gsung rab brjod don las/ /blun po'i tshig gis nam yang mi mgu ba'i/ /dbyangs can zur mig snying la sim des sbyar/ 3 /ding sang 'di na sngags la sbyangs pa nyung / /'ga' yang lto chos lag len phra mos tshim/ /de phyir mdo sngags rgya mtsho legs bshad gtam/ /don gnyer skye bo nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ 4 /sngon tshe skal bzang blo gsal gzhon nu rnams/ /chos dang bla ma 'tshol bar rtag tu brel/ /ding sang kun kyang zang zing bsgrub pa la/ /ngal ba lhur len snyigs ma'i dus 'di mtshar/ 5 /de phyir bstan pa gsal nus bshes gnyen dang / /blun po sgo phug 'phrin yang mi 'khyol ba/ /nor dang ldan na phyi ma lhag par 'dzin/ /mkhas pa 'ga' zhig yul gyi dpes/ 6 /ngan pas mgrin bsgrigs rtag par dmod pa sogs/ /bstan pa nyams pa'i snang tshul sna tshogs kyis/ /kye ma deng sang gangs can ljongs 'di khyab/ /bdag kyang sngon bsags las kyis snyigs ma'i dus/ 7 /bstan pa'i mjug 'dir gangs ri'i khrod du skyes/ /ma rung 'dul dka'i skye bos phyogs kun khyab/ /des na bstan la phan pa'i go skabs dka'/ /'on kyang rang nyid skyes stobs blo gsal zhing / 8 /lhag par yongs 'dzin mchog gis rjes bzung bas/ /mdo sngags gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshig don la/ /'bad pa chung ngus kun kyang khongs su tshud/ /khyad par rdo rje 'chang dngos yongs 'dzin mchog 9 /yab gcig he ru ka dpal mus pa rje'i/ /byin rlabs zab mo snying dbus brtan zhugs pas/ /nges don mchog gi rtogs pa 'di ltar shar/ /sngon gyi mkhas grub chen po dag gi gsung las srid zhi'i snang brnyan rmi lam zlos gar 'di/

10 /gzhan na ma mchis rang sems gcig pu'i 'khrul/ /sems nyid ngo bo rtogs bya rtogs byed bral/ /rus sbal spu yis nam mkha'i pad+mo khebs/ /chu nang zla ba brag cha'i sgra yis bos/ 11 /ri bong rwa yis mo gsham phru gu bsad/ /sngon chad don med 'khrul pas rang mgo skor/ /blta rgyu med pa'i sems la da ni blta/ /mthong rgyu med pa'i don ni kho bos mthong / 12 /brjod rgyu med pa'i tshig tu ci zhig brjod/ /kye ho da ni nyams len zad mthar phyin/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ /e ma don 'di rtogs pa bla ma'i drin/ /bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i mgon khyod kyis/ 13 da dung bdag dang bdag gi gdul bya rnams/ /byang chub bar du rab brtse'i thugs rje yis/ /'bral ba med par rjes su gzung du gsol/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ 14 /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /chos srid dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shing / /rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad med lhun grub ste/ phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog 15 /legs bshad 'di don 'dzin dang sems pa dang / 'bri dang gzhan la 'chad sogs gang byed pa/ /de dag rnams la bsrung zhing skyobs pa dang / /chos 'di spel ba pu tra chen pos phrin las gon pos mdzod/ /ces yongs rdzogs bstan pa rin po che'i nyams len gyi man ngag gsung ngag rin po che byon tshul khog phub dang bcas pa rgyas par bshad pa legs bshad 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje tshad med pa mnga' ba sku tshe dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son pas sku'i skye ba 'dir mkhas grub rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid dang / de'i gcung rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ste 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa'i sku 'gran zla dang bral ba'i sku mched rnam pa gnyis dang /

dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer ma mchis pa yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhabs sen dbang gi rgyal po spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod cing / gsung gi bdud rtsi'i skal ba bzang por gyur pa shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rtsod dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i bla chen gong ma lnga brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rab 'byams mu mtha' med pa rnams dang / gzhan yang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa sogs tshad ldan gyi mkhas pa mang po'i yig cha du ma dang / khyad par phyogs 'di la nges par mkho ba'i gsung rab la rje btsun chen po'i bla ma rgya bod kyi lo rgyus/ dmar gyi zhib mo rdo rje/ bar ston gyi zhib mo rnam dag bla ma dam pa'i ngo mtshar snang ba/ de'i gsal byed mus srad pas mdzad pa/ rje ngor pa'i chos 'byung bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od/ de'i kha skong kun mkhyen go ram pas mdzad pa/ gzhan yang zha ma'i lo rgyus chen mo/ spangs rje'i chos 'byung / 'brom lugs kyi chos 'byung / cha rgan gyi bla ma rgya bod kyi lo rgyus/ rje klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i chos 'byung khog phub zin bris sogs dang gzhan yang mdzad byang med kyang sa lugs dang / zha lugs kyi dpe rnying du ma dang / rang rang gi gzhung bshad nas 'byung ba'i lo rgyus sogs ngo mtshar ba'i cha shas kyi gter mdzod de rnams la legs par brten zhing / khog phub kyi yi ge yang rje e wam̐ pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung la rje kun dga' mchog ldan pa sogs dus mtshungs dpyod ldan gyi bu slob yang slob dang bcas pa du mas zin bris su mdzad pa'i khog phub kyi bshad pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba du ma dang /

gzhan yang rje sems dpa' chen po'i dngos slob bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi slob brgyud mkhas pa du mas mdzad pa'i khog phub kyi yig cha sogs gsung rab dri ma med pa de rnams la yun ring mo nas 'dris par byas shing zhib tu dpyad de rang lo nyer lnga lon pa rgya gar lugs la durmaḥti/ zhes pa blo ngan dang / rgya nag lugs la lcags mo bya yi lo'i mgo zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu gcig sngon slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs nyid sku'i bkod pa gnyis kyi sgo nas zab mo chos dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i nyin bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang bzhi thog bla brang chen por sbyar ba'o/ /yi ge pa ni thun mong gi rig gnas gso ba rig pa la legs par sbyangs shing / yi ge'i 'du byed la shin tu mkhas pa'i gdong dga' ba bsam pa don grub kyis dad gus chen po'i sgo nas bgyis so/ /'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma dang mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzad nas bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po dam can mon bu pu tras bstan bcos 'di nyid 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzad de/ dharma u da ya mastu/ chos 'di dar bar gyur cig shā sa na sa twa hi to bha wan+tu/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig /ka l+ya na bar+dhan+tu/ dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 248 a myes zhabs/ gsung ngag rin po che'i byon tshul khog phub legs bshad 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
